tei:div.tei:p: ༵/༵trehūṃṣṭṛyam̐ / rte/ tāri tsa rdo pho / shā rmyo sau kṣiṃ dūd/ tsu/hūṃXhohūṃ /—khripyi— kṣiṃ sna/
/ ༄/ /bcom ldan 'das dpal dgyes pa rdo rje'i zlejidhe——— —— — —— — —— dngha — — ————da —da wa—— — —————— ————— —da ————— — — — ——— ——dngha —— — — —— — — ———// zlo//
rda

slob ston pa/ 7skyabs rje yongs 'dzin khra 'gu rin po che/ ldodi3('i lta1puskru'i sbyi1ne/༷ṭī sprebazhu sgrig pa/ mkhan po shes rab phun tshogs/ mee~Xtswa ༵ /diṭwāṃ~X/༵po1 ‘dpe smig pa/ blo gros rab rgyas/ 2smo0baḍū waṃ91—542—2595748’ 2595744zhu daṅge las rogs/ yon to gling pa/ ṣā'isnu sdi91—542—2595746ste/ga klad du rnga/drug mkhan/ 'jam dbyangs bkris/wā ṇa badzra beetrī'i dpe mdzod khang nas dpe deb grangs 500 phyi lo2007 lor par bskrun zhus/

༄༅/ /ma hā parnyi ta 'jam mgon blo gros mtha' yas kyis mdzad pa'i bcom ldan 'das dpal dgyes pa rdo rje'i sgrub thabs dkyil chog tshogs mchod gtor chog sbyin sreg dang bcas pa 'di nyid/ sgrub mchod sogs kyi skabs su zhal 'don chad lhag sogs mi byung ba'i ched du/ sgrub brgyud bstan pa'i gsal byed bka' drin brjod du ma mchis pa dpa' ldan bla ma dam pa 7skyabs rje rdo rje 'chang yongs 'dzin mkhan chen khra 'gu rin po che mchog gis sgrig chog gsar bsgrigs gnang ba 'di nyid/ 7skyabs rje rin po che mchog nyid sku tshe zhabs pad 'chi med tshe lha'i ngo bor brtan pa'i ched du/ da lam badzra bidhyā'i dpe mdzod khang nas par bskrun gnang ba'i skabs su phya ra gru 'degs gnang mkhan/ dpe mdzod 'gan 'dzin pa dge slong tshe ring nas par du bskrun par go sgrig gnang ba dang / bshad grwa'i slob gnyer ba blo gros rab rgyas nas phyag dpe 'di nyid kyi dpe gzugs gsar bsgrigs gnang

ba dang / kho bos zhu dag bya ba'i skabs su slob gnyer ba yon tan gling pa nas phyag rogs gang thub gnang ba bcas la bka' drin che zhu dang rjes su yi rang yod/ zhu dag gnang ba'i skabs su shes brtson dang nyams myong zhan pa'i rkyen gyis yi ge chad lhag dang go rim 'khrugs pa sogs mi nyung ba yod srid pas mkhyen spyan yangs pa'i mdun sar bshags shing bka' slob lhug stsol yod par zhu/ wā ṇa badzra bisdi'i gtsug lag slob gnyer khang du chos smra ba karma shes rab phun tshogs nas/ phyi lo 2007 zla 1 tshes 23 nyin/

༄༅/ /rje btsun thams cad mkhyen pa kun mkhyen mi bskyod rdo rjes mdzad pa'i mnga' bdag mar pa lo tsā ba'i bstod pa la ldeb/ te/ 1 da 2 mar lugs rgyud sde spyi'i brgyud pa'i gtso bo rags bsdus kyi gsol 'debs byin rlabs sprin phung la ldeb/ // 3da 6 bcom ldan 'das dgyes pa rdo rje'i sgrub thabs dngos grub char 'bebs la ldeb/ 4// 7da 90 dpal dgyes pa rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga dngos grub rgya mtsho la ldeb/ 13bye/ 91 da 350 mar lugs bla med rgyud sde spyi'i tshogs mchod kyi cho ga yongs 'du'i snye ma la ldeb/ 14) 351da 378 rngog dkyil tshogs mchod 'don 'grigs la ldeb/ te/ 379da 380 bstan srung gtso mo dud sol ma'i gtor chog 'bring po yongs 'dus ljon pa'i skyed tshal la ldeb/ 2bye/ 381 da 420 bstan srung gtso mo dud sol ma'i gtor chog dbyar rnga'i sgra dbyangs la ldeb/

1te/ 421da 442 bcom ldan 'das dgyes pa rdo rje'i las bzhi'i sbyin sreg phrin las 'od 'bar la ldeb/ 69) 443da 580 dpal dgyes pa rdo rje'i bsreg blugs kyi cho ga bsdus pa blo dman ngal gso la ldeb/ 4) 583da 590 bcom ldan 'das dgyes pa rdo rje'i rgyun gyi rnal 'byor dran pa gcig pa la ldeb/ 1bye/ 591 da 610dpal dgyes pa rdo rje'i cho ga dang 'brel ba'i sngags kyi don bshad pa la ldeb/ 4) 611 da 618 dgyes rdor yab bka' dang yum bka'i mchod rol zin bris la ldeb/re/ 619da 622 bcas bzhugs/ maṅga lo//

༄༅/ /rje btsun thams cad mkhyen pa kun mkhyen mi bskyod rdo rjes mdzad pa'i mnga' bdag mar pa lo tsā ba'i bstod pa ni/ la lwa rā swa dhā tir dag pa'i mthus/ /dben gasdo/ma bdud rtsis brlan pa'i padma can/ /mi shigs snying po'i char yang rdo rje'i srog /lo tsā chen po'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ /sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i cha shas bcu drug rdzogs/ /nyin byed nyi shu'i 'od zer rnam par 'phro/ /chags sdang rmongs pa chen po'i pha rol son/ /lo tsā chen po'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ /dngos kun byang chub nye bar thob pas sdud/ /skad cig mkha' snang rdul mun mchog tu rdzogs/ /thig rlung 'gyur med sna tshogs ro yis myos/ /lo tsā chen po'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ /dgyes mdzad sdom pa dpal ldan 'dus pa ste/ /khyab bdag dus 'khor bcom ldan rdo rje sems/ /rdo rje slob dpon gzugs kyis mngon

sprul pa/ /lo tsā chen po'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ /bdag kyang shes rab bcom ldan 'das ma dang / /he ru ka dpal snyoms par 'jug pa la/ /spyi bor rigs bdag mchog gis sba ba yi/ /lo tsā chen po'i dngos grub stsal du gsol//

༄tsho/ /mar lugs rgyud sde spyi'i brgyud pa'i gtso bo rags bsdus kyi gsol 'debs byin rlabs sprin phung zhes bya ba bzhugs so// dgyes mdzad he ru ka dpal sprul pa'i sku/ /sdo/ba chen nā 1du mai tri'i thugs kyi sras/ /bka' brgyud yongs kyi spyi mes lho brag pa/ /chos kyi blo gros zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ /bshad brgyud chu bo lta bu'i bka' chen bab/ /rnam smin lus kyis mkha' spyod chen por gshegs/ /rgyud sde rgya mtsho'i mnga' bdag rngog pa che/ /chos sku rdo rje'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs//dben gsum lam las rdo rje gsum dngos grub/ /sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i rol mo mkha' khyab spro/ /dpal ldan 'dus pa'i rang gzugs mtshur ston mchog/dbang gi rdo rje'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ /bla ma'i thugs zin gdams pa'i gsang mdzod thob/ /myur bde'i thabs kyis grub pa'i rgyal srid

skyong / /'od gsal gnyug ma'i gar mkhan mes ston rje/ /bsod nams rgyal mtshan zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ /dka' spyad chen pos mchog gi dngos grub brnyes/ /sgrub pa'i rgyal mtshan tshad las 'das pa btsugs/ /grub pa'i cho 'phrul srid gsum khyab par ston/ /rje btsun mi la'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ /lhag pa'i lha dang bla mas lung bstan cing / /rdo rje 'chang gi rgyal tshab rim byon pa/ /mdo sde rgyal tsha thogs med grags pa sogs/ /rngog ston rin chen phreng bar gsol ba 'debs/ /rgyal ba gnyis pa rang byung thams cad mkhyen/ /gar dbang rdo rje 'chang dngos chos kyi grags/ /rdo rje rnon po bstan pa'i nyin mor byed/ /chos kyi rgyal po gsum la gsol ba 'debs/ /bka' brgyud rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i rnam thar 'chang / /snyigs ma'i gdul byar sangs rgyas

༄tsho/ /mdzad pa ston/ /lhan skyes grub pa'i gzi brjid lham me ba/ /padma nyin byed dbang por gsol ba 'debs/ /bee ro rnam sprul shes bya kun gzigs shing / /gsar rnying mdo rgyud rgya mtsho'i dgongs don kun/ /mdzod chen lngar bzlums rgyal bas lung bstan brnyes/ /'jam mgon padma gar dbang gsol ba 'debs/ /sa bcu'i spo la gnas pa'i ma pham mgon/ /zhing 'dir dgyes mdzad dngos byon mar ston rje/ /bsam bzhin srid bzung sgrub brgyud bstan pa'i mgon/ /pad ma dbang mchog rgyal por gsol ba 'debs/ /rab 'byams ye shes las bskrun brtse ba'i spyan/ /nam yang 'gro la gzigs pa mi g.yel ba/ /phan bde 'byung gnas srid dang zhi ba'i nor/ /rig pa'i rdo rje'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ /dgyes pa rdo rje dpal ldan gsang ba 'dus//

mā yā gdan bzhi 'jam dpal rigs bsdus lha/ /rigs kyi btsun mo 'khor lo bka' nyan bcas/ /bcom ldan dkyil 'khor lha la gsol ba 'debs//dbang bzhi'i chu bos lus sems dri ma bkrus/ /rim gnyis lam gyis rdo rje'i sa mchog bgrod/ /spyod pa'i nye rgyus 'bras bur mtshams sbyar te/ /zung 0〈cog rdo rje 'chang dbang myur 'khru/ba rbe|ga/ ces pa'i gsol 'debs 'di'ang mar lugs kyi rgyud sde'i bskyed rdzogs rnams kyi yan lag tu blo gros mtha' yas kyis rgyal ba lha las bab pa'i dus tshes bzang por dpal spungs yang khrod du bris pa dge legs 'phel// //
/bcom ldan 'das dgyes pa rdo rje'i sgrub thabs dngos grub char 'bebs zhes bya ba bzhugs so// //

ra༅༅/ /oṃ susti/ dpal dgyes pa rdo rje'i sgrub thabs dngos grub char 'bebs zhes bya ba/ bla ma dang dpal dgyes pa rdo rje la phyag 'tshal lo//dpal ldan lhan cig skyes dga'i rol rtsed sangs rgyas thams cad dgyes pa'i rdo rje ni//snying rje rnam gsum ro mnyam zhi ba'i mtha' spangs mtshan 'dzin bcom pas srid las grol/ /khrag 'thung bye ba'i 'khor lo'i dbang phyug bdag med lha mos bde ba'i gar gyis 'byud/ /khyod zhabs padmor gus pas 'dud do thugs

༄tsho/ /brtses byin rlobs grub gnyis mchog stsol mdzod/ /dgyes mdzad sprul pa'i skur bzhengs lo tsā ba/ /snyan grags phrin las phul byung mar ston rje/ /brgyud pa'i srog 'dzin karma pa yab sras/ /ngo mtshar rtsa brgyud bla ma la phyag 'tshal/ /rdo rje 'chang dbang tshe 'dir brnyes byed pa/ /brgyud dang gdams pa'i zab don 'khrul med ni/ /rje btsun rngog pa'i bka' srol ji lta bar/ /sgrub thabs rim pa byin rlabs gzi ldan 'chad/ /de'ang dgyes pa rdo

rje'i rnal 'byor la gnas par 'dod pas ji skad du/ dngos po'i gnas lugs lam dang ni/ /'bras bu skye ba'i rim pa'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i lus sems dngos po'i gnas lugs sbyang gzhir byas nas/ sbyong byed lam gyi rim pa sgom pa la gnyis te bskyed rim dang rdzogs rim mo/ /bskyed rim la gnyis/ dngos dang yan lag go /dang po la lnga/ bsgom par bya ba/ sgom pa'i dgos pa/ sgom pa'i gnas/ sgom pa po'i gang zag /ji ltar bsgom pa'i tshul lo/ /dang po la rigs bsdus pa dang rigs bye brag pa'i dkyil 'khor 'khor lo lam du byed pa'i tshul gnyis las 'dir ni rigs bye brag pa mi bskyod dgyes pa rdo rje lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor gyi rnal 'byor bstan par bya ba'o/ /de la'ang gtso bo'i zhal phyag dbang gis dbye ba bzhir 'gyur ba las skabs 'dir phyag bcu drug pa gtso bor byas pa'i dkyil 'khor ro/ /gnyis pa sgom pa'i dgos pa ni/ kun rdzob pa'i rnam rtog gi gnyen por lha'i rnal 'byor bsgom pas mun pa la sgron me btegs pa ltar glo bur zhabrul pa skad cig gis sel zhing / brten pa rdzogs rim bde ba chen po'i ye shes 'dren pa'i rten tu gyur pas mchog gi dngos grub kyi rgyur 'gyur ba

༄tsho/ /yin no/ /gsum pa sgom pa'i gnas ni/ rgyud las/ dur khrod dang ni chu 'gram dang / /nags tshal skye bo med grong du/ /snying rje chen po kyai rdo rje/ /bsnyen bkur ba la dngos grub ster/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ram gong mas byin gyis brlabs shing yid dang mthun pa'i gnas su'o/ /bzhi pa sgom pa po'i gang zag ni/ slob dpon mtshan nyid dang ldan pa las 'di nyid kyi dbang bskur ba thob cing dam tshig dang ldan pas so/ /lnga pa ji ltar bsgom pa'i tshul la nyer bsdogs dang dngos so/ /dang po yo byad nye bar bsdogs pa ni/ gnas khang legs par brgyan pa'i gung du brtags pa phyi ma'i le'u drug pa las gsungs pa ltar ram bris sku rab gnas dang ldan pa bkram pa'i mdun tu stegs kyi khar maṇḍal dang / mchod pa dang gtor ma phyag len bzhin tu bsham/ sgrub pa po stan bde bar rdo rje skyil mo krung gis 'dug pa'i mdun du g.yon nas thod pa mtshan ldan bdud rtsi lnga'i ril bu dang ldan pa'i chang gis gang ba/ ḍā ma sa rdo rje/ dril bu rnams dang / bsangs gtor dang / chu gnyis kyi dung chos chu gtsang 'o ma 'dres pas gang ba/ bzed zhal/ me tog gi sdod dang bcas pa bsham/ g.yas nas

brtsams te nyer spyod lnga yang bkod cing / gzhan yang dgos pa'i yo byad tshogs par bya'o/ /gnyis pa bsgom tshul dngos la spyi dang khyad par ro/ /spyir mngal sgong brdzus skyes gsum gyi sbyong byed dam dbang po rab 'bring tha gsum gyi khyad par ram/ yang na gang zag bsdus pa la dga' bas rdo rje rnam pa bzhis bskyed pa la dbye ba bcu gnyis/ spros pa la dga' bas cho ga gsum bskyed la dbye ba bcu drug khren tu spros pa la dga' bas don tshan bzhi las dbye ste bskyed pa gsum yod/ don tshan bzhi ni/ bskyed rim/ bzlas pa/ rdzogs rim/ thun mtshams kyi chos so/ /dang po la rgyu'i he ru ka bskyed pa'i chos bcu/ 'bras bu'i he ru ka bskyed pa'i chos bcu/ gnyis pa la dmigs pa tha dad pa/ gsum pa la chags grol gyi dbye ba/ bzhi pa la dag pa/ gtor ma/ glu/ smon lam bzhir dbye ba rje mar rngog gi bzhed pa thun mong ma yin pa'o/ /khyad par rje rang 'byung zhabs dang spyan snga thams cad mkhyen pa'i phyag bzhes su gong bshad gsum ka tshang ba'i nyams len gyi chings su mdzad pa bzhin 'dir yang de'i rjes su 'brang ste/ thog mar tshogs pa yod na/ las kyi rdo rjes phyag 'tshal/ maṇḍal spyi mthun tshom bu bdun ma/

༄7/ /oṃ badzra dhwa mi āḥhūm̐/ gzhi rnam par dag pa dbang chen gser gyi sa gzhi/ oṃ badzra re khe āḥhūm̐/ phyi lcags ri'i khor yug gi rwa bas yongs su bskor ba'i dbus su ritshi rgyal po ri bo mchog rab/ shar lus 'phags po/ lho 'dzam bu gling / nub ba lang spyod/ byang sgra mi snyan/ byang shar du zla ba/ lho nub tu nyi ma/ lha dang mi'i dpal 'byor phun sum tshogs pa ma tshang ba med pa 'di nyid bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo tha mi dad pa'i drung du/ lha'i rnal 'byor gyi rim pa la gnas par bskul ba'i ched du 'bul bar bgyi'o/ /thugs rjes 'gro ba'i don du bzhes su gsol/ bzhes nas byin gyis brlab tu garbedul/ zhes phul/ sku1 ga sa mā dhi kra ma hūm̐/ zhes rnal 'byor la gnas par bskul lo/ /de nas lus kyi mngon zhen bzlog pa'i phyir yan lag drug ldan gyi bskyed rim bsgom pa dang / ngag gi mngon zhen

bzlog pa'i phyir bzlas pa bya ba dang / sems kyi mngon zhen bzlog pa'i phyir rdzogs rim bsgom pa/ thun mtshams kyi bya ba'o/ /dang po la gnyis sbyor ba dang / dngos so/ /spyor ba 'a 'ang dgu ste/ dam tshig bsten dang gtor ma sbyin/ /mchod pa byin rlabs skyabs sems dang / /rdor sems bla ma dag pa dang / /tshangs gnas ye tshogs srung 'khor ro/ /zhes pa'i dang po bdud rtsi myang ba ni/ tshul bzhin bsgrubs pa'i ril bu yod na lcer bzhag /med na nang mchod byin gyis bammu ste/ rang gi snying gar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ zla ba'i 'od ltar dkar ba'i hūm̐ las 'od zer dkar po 'phros/ lus thams cad gang / sdig pa dang sgrib pa ma sdo/sa pa sbyangs nas rnyastong par gyur/ ngag tu/ hūm̐/ zhes brjesad pas/ bdag nyid las kyi he 〈co ka zhal gcig phyag gnyis par gsal ba'i spyi bor zla ba'i steng du oṃ dkar po/ /lkog mar padma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i steng du āḥdamar po/ /snying gar nyi ma'i steng du hūm̐ sngon pos mtshan par

༄༅/ /gyur/ oṃ badzra a skṛ ta kuṇḍa lī ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭa ces bsangs/ oṃ su bhā wa shuddhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa dhwa ba shuzlo3 haṃ gis sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las ye las rlung / ram̐ las me/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ las thod pa'i sgyed bu gsum gyi steng du/ a las thod pa yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du/ hūm̐ sum̐ e dzī khaṃ/ lī māṃ māṃ tt+waṃ māṃ las skyes pa'i bdud rtsi lnga dang / sha lngar gyur/ ha hoḥhrīḥ zhes brjod pas/ tha mal pa'i kha dog dang dri dang nus pa phrogs shing / rlung g.yos/ me sbar/ bcud rnams bskol bas/ nyi ma 'char kha lta bu'i mdog can gyi rlangs pa hūṃ las rdo rje kha ṭwāṃ ga 'bar bar gyur pa zhu zhing / de nyid du lan gsum lhung bas dri ma thams cad dang bral ba shel ltar gsal ba'i dam tshig gi bdud rtsis gang ba'i steng/du/ oṃ las byung ba'i zla ba kha chod kyi tshul du gnas pa la g.yas skor du ā li

g.yon skor du kā li yongs su gyur pa'i oṃ āḥhūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros/ phyogs bcur bzhugs pa'i rdo rje 'dzin pa thams cad kyi thugs ka nas/ ye shes kyi bdud rtsi bkug /zla ba yi ge gasdo/ma dang bcas pa zhu bas bdud rtsi'i rgya macesar gyur/ zhes byin gyis rlabs pa'i bdud rtsi g.yon pa'i mtheb srin sbyar bas myang / lag gnyis bsnol bas rdor dril blang ste/rdo rje thabs bde chen gyi bdag nyid du mos la/ skyed ma hā badzra hūm̐/ zhes brjod cing gsor/dril bu shes rab stong nyid kyi rang bzhin du mos te/ skyed badzra gharnye āḥ zhes pas dkrol la pang du bzhag go/ /gnyis pa 'byung po la gtor ma sbyin pa ni/ chu gtsang dang nang mchod kyis bran la/ skyes badzra a skṛ ta kuṇḍa lī ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭa ces bsangs/ skyed swa bhā wa 8/rnaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā ba shuzlo3 haṃ gis sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las/ ye las rlung gi dkyil 'khor dud kha gzhu'i dbyibs lta bu mtha' ma gnyis ba dan gyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du ram̐

༄7/ /las me'i dkyil 'khor dmar po gru gsum pa/ de'i steng du a las thod pa phyi dkar la nang dmar ba/ nang gi dbus su mi'i sha dang byang chub kyi sems/ shar du glang po che'i sha dang dri chen/ lhor rta'i sha dang dri chu/ nub tu ba lang gi sha dang rakta/ byang du khyi'i sha dang rgyungs pa/ de rnams kyi phyi'i rnam pa oṃ/ srog la āḥ de'i steng du zla phyed rdo rje'i rtse mo la hūm̐ gis mtshan pa mgo thur du blta ba/ rlung gis me sbar thod pa bsros sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga khol bas/ oṃ dang āḥlas 'od zer 'phros te zla phyed rdo rje hūm̐ dang bcas pa las ye shes kyi bdud rtsi bab/ dam tshig gi bdud rtsi dang gnyis su med par 'dres par gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ gsum/ mthar zla phyed rdo rje yang thod pa'i nang du lhungs te zhu bas bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin tu gyur/ pad kor rdo rje thal mo kha phye bas/ oṃ ind+ra/

dza ma/ dza la/ dzakṣa/ dhwa da/ banni/ bā u/ rakṣa/ tsanda/ snyuspyo mā da/ baspa/ ta la/ pā tā la/ aṣṭha saspa swā hā/ i rda/ ba li/ bhulga dzi gha/ phulla/ dhuskra/ māṃ sa/skra gha/ ambha/ saskra/ skadzdza sa ṅgā/ khānti/ khu ni/ phe ḍa/ gā da/ oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharmā khāe ā du nutpanda twa ta/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ lan gsum gyis bsngo/ g.yas rdo rje dang bcas pa'i thal mo snying khar bzhag /g.yon pas dril bu 'brol bzhin pas/ lha chen brgyad po 'khor dang bcas/ /klu chen brgyad po 'khor dang bcas/ /'jig rten skyong ba brgyad rnams dang / /gnod sbyin tshogs rnams ma lus dang / /srin po'i tshogs rnams ma lus dang / /'byung po'i tshogs rnams ma lus dang / /yi dwags tshogs rnams ma lus dang / /sha za'i tshogs rnams ma lus dang / /spyo byed tshogs rnams ma lus dang / /rjed byed tshogs rnams ma lus dang / /mkha'

༄7/ /'gro'i tshogs rnams ma lus dang / /de la sogs pa 'byung po'i tshogs/ /ma lus 'khor dang bcas pa kun/ /'dir gshegs bdag la dgongs su gsol/ /mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di snoms la/ /rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas la/ /nad med tshe dang dbang phyug dang / /dpal dang grags dang skal pa bzang / /longs spyod rgya chen kun thob cing / /dbang dang mngon spyod dgra sde 'joms/ /dgar dang bsad dang dgug pa dang / /zhi dang rgyas la sogs pa yi/ /las kyi dngos grub bdag la stsol/ //dam tshig can gyis bdag la srungs/ /dngos grub kun gyi stong grogs mdzod/ /dus min 'chi dang nad rnams dang / /gdon dang bgegs rnams med par mdzod/ /rmi lam ngan dang mtshan ma ngan/ /mkha' 'gro'i byad sogs med par mdzod/ /'jig

rten bde zhing lo legs dang / /'bru rnams 'phel zhing chos 'phel dang / /bde legs thams cad 'byung ba dang / /yid la 'dod pa kun rdzogs mdzod//ces phrin las bcol la/ gtor ma btang ngo / /slar yang dril bu gsil zhing /skyes rakṣa rakṣa hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ lan gsum/ bdag dang gnas dang rnal 'itswa1ra bsrung bar gyur/ gsum pa mchod pa byin rlabs ni/ oṃ sarba saṃ shes dha ni āḥhūm̐ swā hās bsangs/ oṃ swa bhā wa shuddhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā ba shukhro3 haṃ gis sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las/ a las thod pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du/ hūm̐ 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i bsang gtor/ mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me tog /bdug spos/snang gsal/ dri/ zhal zas/ rol mo la sogs pa'i mchod pa'i yo byad rnams rang bzhin stong pa/ byed las dbang po drug gi spyod yul du zag pa med pa'i

༄tsho/ /bde ba skyed nus par gyur/ oṃ sarba saṃ sho dha ni āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥkhaṃ ram̐ āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ nī rī ti hūm̐ kha āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ badzra puspro āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ badzra dhu pe āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ skye( badzra ā 31 ke āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ skyed badzra garnye āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ skye( badzra ni widre āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ skye( badzra shabhā āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ rol mo bya zhing / oṃ badzra ghaṇḍa ra ṇi ta pra ra ṇi ta saṃ pra ra ṇi ta sarba buddhā kṣe tra pra tsa li te pra dzñā pa ra mi tā nā da saṃ bha wa badzra dharmakhṛ da ya sarnyo ṣa ni hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hoḥ.āḥkhaṃ swā hā/bzhi pa skyabs su 'gro ba ni/ bdag dang nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las thams cad gcig tu bsdus pa'i ngo bor gyur pa/ chos kyi phung po stong phrag brgyad cu rtsa bzhi'i 'byung gnas/ 'phags

pa'i dge 'dun thams cad kyi mnga' bdag /drin can rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /sangs rgyas la skyabs su mchi'o/ /chos la skyabs su mchi'o/ /dge 'dun la skyabs su mchi'o//dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs ye shes kyi spyan dang ldan pa rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /brgya 'am nyer gcig la sogs pa bya/ sems bskyed pa ni/ sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir/ /bdag ni he ru kar gyur cing / /sems can thams cad he ru ka'i/ /go 'phang mchog la 'god par bgyi/ /lan gsum/ lnga pa rdor sems bsgom bzlas ni/ nag po dam tshig rdo rje'i bzhed pa ltar/ bdag nyid kyi spyi bor pad zla la hūm̐ las rdor sems he ru ka sku mdog dkar po/ g.yas rdo rje thugs kar 'dzin

༄7/ /cing / g.yon dril bu snyems pa dkur brten pa/ dar dang rus pa dang / rin po ches brgyan pa/ zhabs sems skyil gyis bzhugs pa'i pang du yum rdo rje snyems ma dkar mo gri thod can gyis 'khyud pa/ gnyis ka'i gnas gsum du yig 'bru gsum dang khyad par yab kyi thugs kar zla ba la hūm̐ gi mthar yig brgya dkar pos bskor ba/ de las 'od zer 'phros/ rang 'dra'i ye shes pa spyan drangs/ dam tshig pa la thim/ dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥganyis su med par gyur/ slar yang hūm̐ gi 'od kyis dbang lha spyan drangs te dbang bskur/ bdud rtsis sku gang / chu lhag spyi bor 'khyil pa las mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan par gyur/ bcom ldan 'das bdag gi sdig sgrib nyes lhung thams cad byang zhing dag par mdzad du gsol/ /zhes gsol ba btab pas/ thugs ka'i sngags

'khor las bdud rtsi babs/ rdor sems kyi sku gang sbyor mtshams nas lud de/ rang gi spyi bo nas zhugs pas sdig sgrib nyes lhung rnam smin gyi phung po dang bcas pa dag nas rang lus 'od gsal bar gyur/ oṃ badzra he ru ka sa twa sa ma ya/ ma nu pā la ya/ he ru ka twe no pa/ tiṣṭhadṛ ḍho me bha wa/ su tostso me bha wa/a nu rakto me bha wa/ su po〉 me bha wa/ sarba sirnyi mme pra yasmo sarba karma su tsa me/ tsitt+waṃ shri yaḥ ku ru hūm̐/ ha ha ha ha hoḥ bha ga wān/ he ru ka mā me muñtsa he ru ko bha ba ma hā sa ma ya sa twa āḥhūm̐ phaṭa/ zhes ci nus dang / oṃ badzra sa twa hūm̐/ ces yang snying bzla/mgon po bdag ni mi shes rmongs pa yis/ /dam tshig las ni 'gal zhing nyams/ /bla ma mgon pos skyabs mdzod cig /gtso bo rdo rje 'dzin pa kye/ /thugs rje chen po'i bdag nyid can/ /'gro ba'i gtso la bdag skyabs mchi//

༄7/ /zhes gsol ba btab pas/ rdo rje sems dpa'i zhal nas/ rigs kyi bu khyod kyi sdig sgrib thams cad dag go zhes gsungs shing / mthar the/ra sems 'od du zhu nas rang nyid la thim par gyur/ skye( āḥhūm̐/ gnyis su med par gyur par mos/ drug pa bla ma dag pa'i cho ga la/ rngog pa gong ma rnams kyi bzhed pas gsol ba gdab pa dang / tshogs bsags gnyis/ dang po ni/ bla ma mnyam med sangs rgyas rin po che/ /dus gsum bde gshegs sras bcas thams cad kyis/ /sku gsung thugs kyi rang bzhin byin brlabs pa/ /bka' drin chen po'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rigs kun gtso bo drug pa rdo rje 'chang / /dus gsum rgyal ba skyed mdzad rnal 'byor ma/ /gsang ba'i mdzod 'dzin rdo rje snying po dang / /grub pa'i spyi mes sa ra ha par 'dud/ /theg mchog dbu ma'i srol 'byed klu sgrub dang / /mu stegs

rgol ba tshar gcod 'phags pa lha/ /gnas lnga rig pa'i paṇa chen zla ba grags/ /rnal 'byor mā taṅgi pa'i zhabs la 'dud/ /sa bcu'i dbang phyug rje btsun tilli pa/ /mkhas grub kun gyi gtsug rgyan nā ro pa/ /phyag rgya che brnyes mnga' bdag mai tri pa/ /sgra sgyur mar pa lo tsā'i zhabs la 'dud/ /zung 'jug sku brnyes chos sku rdo rje'i zhabs/ /de sras zhe sdang rdo rje seng ge sgra/ /kun dga' rdo rje rgya sgom ye shes 'od/ /grub chen karma pakshi'i zhabs la 'dud/ /bla ma gnyan ras tshul khrims rin chen mtshan/ /rang byung rdo rje chos kyi rgyal mtshan mchog /ye shes dpal ba rig pa'i ral gri dang / /kun mkhyen mthong ba don ldan zhabs la 'dud/ /dpal 'byor don grub spyan snga chos kyi grags/ /karma phrin las mi bskyod rdo rje'i zhabs/ /dkon mchog yan lag grags pa don grub dang //

༄༅/ /rnam rgyal dpal bzang yab sras zhabs la 'dud/ /bkra shis dpal grub mkhan chen nyi ma'i mtshan/ /phrin las zhabs dang go shrī don yod snying / /chos kyi don grub bstan pa'i nyin mor byed/ /tshe dbang kun khyab karma ratnar 'dud/ /ye shes nyi ma blo gros mtha' yas dang / /padma dbang mchog rig pa'i rdo rje sogs/ /bka' brgyud nor bu'i phreng ba thams cad la/ /sgo gsum gus pa chen pos gsol btab pas/ /'di nas bzung ste tshe rabs thams cad du/ /zab mo'i lam bzang rgyud sde du ma'i bcud/ /nyams su blangs nas ye shes sku 'grub shog /phun tshogs dge legs kun stsol dkon mchog gsum/ /rgya chen smon lam yongs grub la btud de/ /rnam dag mos pa'i blo yis rab dad pas/ /gcig tu 'dod pa'i don rnams gsol bar bgyi//

bdag ni skye zhing skye ba thams cad du/ /rigs gzugs skal pa mchog dang ldan pa dang / /theg pa bla na med pa legs 'doms pa'i/ /dge ba'i bshes kyis rjes su 'dzin gyur cig /khyad par dpal ldan bla ma mchog gi ni/ /skyes pa'i rabs kyi phreng ba kun tu yang / /zab cing rgya che'i gsung las skyes gyur te//bla na med pa'i byang chub myur thob rbestog /sangs rgyas kun gyi rang bzhin sku/ /slob dpon la ni skyabs su mchi/ /gtso bo lha mor bcas pa yi/ /lha rnams la yang phyag 'tshal lo/ /thar pa chen po'i grong mchog tu/ /mgon pos bdag ni 'jug par 'tshal gnyis pa bsod nams kyi tshogs bsags pa ni/ he badzra/ zhes brjod pas/ rang nyid skad cig gis dgyes pa rdo rje sku mdog nag po zhal brgyad/ phyag bcu drug /zhabs bzhi pa/ rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan cing yum bdag

༄༅/ /med ma dang mnyam par sbyor ba'i skur gyur pa'i snying gar hrī las padma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa'i dbus su/ ra las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor dmar po/ de'i dbus su hūm̐ sngon po 'od zer lnga dang bcas pa/ hūm̐ gi 'od zer gyis bcom ldan 'das 'khor gyi lha mos mchod pa byed bzhin pa dang bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi shar khyams na rang gi bla ma bzhugs pa mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs/ snying ga'i sa bon las 'phros pa'i go rī la sogs pa'i lha mo brgyad kyis mchod par gyur/ /dkar mo ri dwags mtshan ma 'dzin/ /chom rkun bdud las rgyal ba'i snod/ /ro langs ma ni chu lag ma/ /ghasma rī ni sman 'dzin zhing / /puska sī ni rdo rje'i lag /de bzhin ri khrod ma ro 'dzin/ /gdol pa mo ni cang te'u brdung / /'di rnams kyis ni gtso bo mchod//

'dod chags chen po'i rjes chags pas/ /g.yung mos sku la 'khyud pa nyid/ /oṃ go rī go āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ tso rī rtsa āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ bee tā lī baṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ ghasma rī rghaṃ āḥhūm̐ swāhā/ oṃ puska sī paṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ sha ba rī shaṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ tsaṇḍa lī rtsa āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ ḍombi ni ḍo āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ zhes pa'i sngags rnams la thal mo sbyar ba sngon tu 'gro bas/ lha mo rnams kyis rim bzhin mchod par bltas la/ mthar se gol gtogs so/ /de nas sdig pa bshags pa la sogs bya ste/ ji srid lhu1ga ma med pa'i 'oXṅger bar phyin ci 31ga gi rtog pas bsags pa'i sdig pa'i las bdag gis bgyis pa de dag thams cad bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar bshags shing phyis bsdams par bgyi'o//sems can thams cad kyi dge ba ji snyed pa thams cad la rjes su yi rang zhing / bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu yongs su bsngo bar

༄za/ /bgyi'o/ /khams gsum thams cad bde ba chen po'i rnam par ro gcig pa'i sangs rgyas kye'i rdo rje dang / des gsungs pa'i sngags dang /phyag rgya dang / dkyil 'khor la sogs pa'i chos dang / de'i 'khor na gnas pa'i lha mo'i tshogs la bdag skyabs su mchi bar bgyi'o/ /sems can thams cad kyi don bya ba'i phyir rnam pa thams cad kyi mchog dang ldan pa'i stong pa nyid kyi mtshan nyid kyi byang chub kyi sems yang dag par bsten par bgyi'o/ /zhes dang / dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su mchi/ /sdig pa thams cad so sor bshags/ /'gro ba'i dge la rjes yi rang / /sangs rgyas byang chub yid kyis bzung / /sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs mchog la/ /byang chub bar du skyabs su mchi/ /byang chub sems su 'di bgyis te/ /bdag dang gzhan don rab sgrub

phyir/ /bdag gis byang chub sems mchog bskyed/ /i ma'o sems can kun 'gron gnyer/ /byang chub spyod mchog mdzad bzhin spyad/ /'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas shog /sangs rgyas sras bcas thams cad dang / /dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma rnams kun/ /bdag la dgongs par mdzad du gsol/ /bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi bas ni/ /dus 'di nas ni bzung nas su/ /byang chub snying por mchis kyi bar/ /ji ltar dus gsum mgon po rnams/ /byang chub tu ni nges mdzad pa'i/ /byang chub sems ni bla na med/ /dam pa bdag gis bskyed par bgyi/ /sangs rgyas rnal 'byor sdom pa la/ /sdom pa yi ni tshul khrims dang //dge ba'i chos ni sdud pa dang / /sems can don byed tshul khrims gsum/ /bdag gis brtan por bzung bar bgyi/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te//

༄tsho/ /bla na med pa'i dkon mchog gsum/ /deng nas brtsams te bzung bar bgyi/ /nam du yang ni mi spang ngo / /rdo rje'i rigs mchog chen po la/ /rdo rje dril bu'i phyag rgya yang / /yang dag nyid du bzung bar bgyi/ /slob dpon dag kyang bzung bar bgyi/ /rin chen rigs mchog chen po yi/ /dam tshig yid du 'ong ba la/ /nyin re bzhin du dus drug tu/ /sbyin pa rnam bzhi rtag tu sbyin/ /byang chub chen po las byung ba'i/ /padma'i rigs chen dag pa la//phyi nang gsang ba theg pa gsum/ /dam pa'i chos ni gzung bar bgyi/ /las kyi rigs mchog chen po la/ /sdom pa thams cad ldan par ni/ /yang dag nyid du gzung bar bgyi/ /mchod pa'i las kyang ci nus bgyi/ /bla na med pa'i byang chub sems/ /dam pa bdag gis bskyed bgyis nas/ /sems can kun gyi

don gyi phyir/ /bdag gis sdom pa ma lus bzung / /ma brgal ba rnams bsgral bar bgyi/ /ma grol ba rnams bdag gis dgrol/ /dbugs ma phyin pa dbugs dbyung zhing / /sems can mya ngan 'das la 'god/ /he badzra maṇḍal muḥ tshogs zhing de rnams rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs par gyur/ zhes bsgom/bdun pa tshangs pa'i gnas bzhi bsgom pa ni/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan par gyur cig /sdug bsngal dang sdug bsngal gyi rgyu dang bral bar gyur cig /sdug bsngal med pa'i bde ba dam pa dang mi bral bar gyur cig /nye ring chags sdang gnyis dang bral ba'i btang snyoms chen po la gnas par gyur cig /ces pa'i don dran par byas la nan to tu bsgom mo/ /brgyad pa ye shes kyi tshogs bsags pa ni/ rang gi snying ga'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros pas/ snod kyi 'jig rten bcud kyi

༄༅/ /sems can la bsdu/ de rnams rang gi lus la thim zhing / lus kyang snying ga'i padma 'dab brgyad la thim ste rim pa bzhin du nyi ma dang / hūṃ yang zhabs kyu khog pa zla tshes thig le'i bar du 'dus nas/ nā da'i rnam par gnas pa las stong nyid kyi rang sgra byung bar gyur/ oṃ shu n+ya tā dzñā na badzra swa bhā wa ātma bo/྅ haṃ/ zhes stong nyid kyi don nges par byas nas mnyam par bzhag go/'di ni rdo rje bzhi las stong nyid byang chub ces bya'o/ /dgu pa srung 'khor ni/ slob dpon mtsho skyes sogs dang rngog lugs pa rnams rtsa rgyud dngos bstan ltar bsdus pa bzhed kyang / ram lugs pa dang rang byung yab sras rnams kyis bshad rgyud nas kha skong ba'i lugs su mdzad pa ltar spro na/ lha/nga pa'i ngang las/ ra las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ hūm̐ las sna tshogs rdo rje/ lte ba la hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ de'i 'od zer gyi rtse mo las/ rdo rje rgya gram dpag tu med pa spros pas/ 'og tu rdo

rje'i sa gzhi/ bar snang du rdo rje'i ra ba dang dra ba/ steng du rdo rje'i gur yangs shing rgya che ba/ 'og gzhi'i nyi ma las 'od zer phyi rol du 'phros pas me ri dang /rdo rje rgya gram las rdo rje rkyang pa dpag tu med pa spros pas/ rdo rje'i dra mig rnams kyang bkag par gyur/ oṃ badzra rakṣa rakṣa hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes brtan par byin gyis bas bo// de'i dbus su sum̐ las 'khor lo ser po rtsibs bcu rtse mo rno dbal dang ldan pa g.yas skor du myur bar mi mngon par 'khor zhing rab tu mi g.yo ba'i dbus dang rtsibs rnams la/ padma dang nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ hūm̐ re re yongs su gyur pa las/ dbus su rang nyid hūm̐ mdzad sku mdog mthing nag 'jig rten gsum las rnam par rgyal ba'i phyag rgyas rdo rje dang dril bu thugs kar bsnol thabs su 'dzin pa/ mi bskyod pa'i dbu rgyan can/

༄7/ /shar du gshin rje gshed nag po g.yas tho ba bsnams pa/ rnam snang gi dbu rgyan can/ lhor gzhan gyis mi thub pa dkar po rdo rjes mtshan pa'i dbyug pa dkar po bsnams pa/ mi bskyod pa'i dbu rgyan can/ nub tu rta mgrin dmar po chu skyes dmar po bsnams pa/ 'od dpag med kyi dbu rgyan can/ byang du bdud rtsi 'khyil ba sngon po rdo rje bsnams pa/ don grub kyi dbu rgyan can/ shar lhor 'dod pa'i rgyal po lcags kyu bsnams pa/ lho nub tu dbyug sngon can/ dbyug pa sngon po bsnams pa/ nub byang du stobs po che rtse gsum bsnams pa/ byang shar du mi g.yo ba ral gri bsnams pa/ bzhi ka yang rol pa'i khro bo sku mdog sngon po mi bskyod pa'i dbu rgyan can/ steng du gtsug tor 'khor los sgyur ba ser po 'khor lo bsnams pa/ rnam snang gi dbu rgyan

can/'og tu gnod mdzes nag po gtun shing 'dzin pa/ mi bskyod pa'i dbu rgyan can/ thams cad kyang zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas rang rang gi phyag mtshan phyar thabs su bsnams shing / g.yon thugs kar sprul gyi zhags pa dang bcas pa'i sdigs mdzub mdzad pa/ zhabs g.yon brkyang ba'i stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ dbu skra dang smin ma sma ra dmar ser 'bar ba/ spyan gsum dmar la zlum zhing zhal mche ba gtsigs pa/ sku sbom zhing thung la gsus pa 'phyang ba/ sgrul gyi chun po brgyad kyis brgyan pa/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/rol pa'i khro bo bzhi ni/ lha'i na bza' dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/bskal pa'i me ltar 'bar ba'i gzi brjid mnga' ba/ sprul pa'i sprin du mas bgegs kyi tshogs rnams brlag par byed pa'o/ /gtso 'khor thams cad kyi

༄7/ /gnas gsum 'bru gsum gyis mtshan pa/ de las 'od 'phros/ bsgoms pa dang 'dra ba'i ye shes kyi srung 'khor rten dang brten par bcas pa spyan drangs/ badzra sa mā dzaḥ oṃ badzra ma hā kro dha rā dza sa pā ri wā ra dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥkhaṃ ram̐ āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ badzra ma hā kro dha rā dza sa pā ri wā ra ni rī ti hūṃ kha āḥhūṃ swā hā/ oṃ badzra ma hā kro dha rā dza sa pā ri wā ra puṅge āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ badzra ma hā kro dha rā dza sa pā ri wā ra dhu pe āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ badzra ma hā kro dha rā dza sa pā ri wā ra gandhe āḥhūṃ swā hā/ oṃ badzra ma hā kro dha rā dza sa pā ri wā ra ni wibye āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ badzra ma hā kro dha rā dza sa pā ri wā ra ā lo ke āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ badzra ma hā kro dha rā dza sa pā ri wā ra shabha āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ chu gnyis nyer spyod rol mo 4sa pas mchod/dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ dam tshig pa dang gnyis su med par gyur/ bsrung bya rnams lubor lo'i lte bar dmigs/

sngags bzlas pa'i tshe gnod byed nye ba rnams rtsibs kyis gtubs/ sprul pa'i khro bo'i tshogs kyis rgyang ring du gnas pa'i bgegs bcom par bsgom la/ na maḥs manta bzhi nai/ na maḥs manta dharmā rṇa/ na maḥs manta saṃ ghā nai/ skyed si tā tā pa tre/ skyed bi ma la/ skyed shang ka ra/ tsho( pra tyadhi ra/ badzra gi ṣa tsakra brti/ sarba yant+ra mant+ra/ mū la karma/ bandha rna/ tā ḍa rna/ gī la nai thā/ ma ma kṛ ta ye na ken tsi ta kṛ tanta tra/ sarbantu/ tshinda tshinda/ bhinda bhinda/ tsi ri tsi ri/ gi ri gi ri/ mā ra mā ra/ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ hūm̐ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ/ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa/ces phyir bzlog la sogs pa'i dus su ci 'grub bzla'o/ /de rnams kyis sbyor ba'i chos dgu grub bo/ ༈ /gnyis pa dngos gzhi la drug /pho brang bskyed pa rnam par snang mdzad kyi yan lag /rjes su chags pa rdo rje 'chang gi yan lag /dbang bskur ba mi bskyod pa'i yan lag /bdud rtsi myang ba 'od dpag med kyi yan lag /mchod pa don yod grub pa'i yan lag /bstod pa rin chen 'byung ldan gyi yan lag go/de la yan lag dang po ni/ ji/nga

༄tsho/ /ba'i 'khor lo'i dbus su/ e las chos kyi 'byung gnas dkar po gru gsum pa rtsa ba phra ba thur du zug pa/ kha gdengs che ba gyen tu bstan pa'i nang du/ paṃ las sna tshogs padma dang / hūm̐ las sna tshogs rdo rje rtse mo bcu gnyis pa phyogs kyi mdog can gyi lte bar/ lam̐ las sa'i dkyil 'khor gru bzhi ser po/ de'i steng du baṃ las chu'i dkyil 'bor zlum po dkar po/ de'i steng du ram̐ las me'i dkyil 'khor gru gsum dmar po/ de'i steng du yam̐ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor zla gam dud kha/ de'i steng du sum̐ las 'khor lo dkar po rtsibs sum cu rtsa gnyis pa'i dbus su/ nam mkha'i nā da cha gcig zhugs pas/ de thams cad 'dres pa las byung ba rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i khang pa brtsegs pa gru bzhi sgo bzhi pa/ phyi nas dkar ser dmar ljang sngo ba'i rtsig pa

rim pa lnga dang ldan zhing / rin po che'i pha gu dang do shal dang do shal phyed pa 'phyang ba/ shar bu dang mda' yab kyis mdzes pa/ ka ba bzhi bzhis btegs pa'i rta babs bang rim bzhi dang ldan pa'i steng du/ padma la gnas pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo dang / gdugs dang ri dwags dang bcas pa/ 'dod yon gyi snam bu dmar po la lha mo bcu drug dkyil 'khor pa la mchod pa'i tshul gyis 'bod cing / sgo khyud kyi mtshams su zla phyed rdo rjes spras pa/ lha snams kyi shar dkar/lho ser/ nub dmar/ byang ljang ba/ ka ba brgyad dang ldan zhing / rdo rje'i gdung nye bar bres pa/ thog phyur bur gyur pa'i rtse mor rdo rje rin po che'i tog gis spud pa/ gzhan yang gos dang / me tog gi phreng ba dang / rnga yab dkar po dang / gdugs dang / ba dan kha dog sna tshogs pa rlung gis bskyod pa dang dril bu

༄7/ /'khrol ba la sogs pas brgyan pa'i dbus su/ padma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa ge sar dang bcas pa/ gzhal yas khang gi phyi rol rdo rje'i phreng bas bskor ba'i nang du/ shar du gtum drag /lhor 'jigs su rung ba/ nub tu 'bar ba 'khrugs pa/ byang du tshang tshing 'khrigs pa/ byang shar du ha ha rgod pa/ shar lhor dpal gyi nags/ lho nub tu 'jigs pa'i mun pa/ nub byang du ki li ki li sgrogs pa/ dur khrod chen po de rnams su shīrṣa la sogs pa'i shing chen po brgyad kyi drung brgya byin la sogs pa'i phyogs skyong brgyad yum dang bcas pa/ lha'i dge 'dun la sogs pa'i zhing skyong brgyad phyogs skyong gi bzhon pa'i gdong can shing lo'i gseb nas lus stod phyung ba/ mtsho chen po brgyad la gnas pa'i nor rgyas ser po la sogs klu chen brgyad yum dang

bcas pas thal mo sbyar ba'i steng du sgrogs byed sogs sprin brgyad lding ba/ gzhan yang me dang ri bo mchod rten rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug brgyad brgyad gnas shing / dur khrod kyi bkod pa 'jigs su rung ba dang ldan pa'i gzhal yas khang gi dbus kyi padma'i lte bar tshangs pa/ dbang po/ nye dbang / drag po ste bdud bzhi'i gdan/ 'dab ma brgyad la/ shar du tshangs pa ser po/ lhor dbang po dkar po/ nub tu nye dbang dmar po/ byang du drag po sngon po/ byang shar du gshin rje nag po/ shar lhor nor bdag ser po/ lho nub tu srin po sngo nag /nub byang du thag bzang ris ljang gu rnams gan rkyal du gnas pa'i snying gar nyi ma'i gdan dang bcas pasna(/ /skyed sarba ta thā ga ta a nī la ya badzra swa bhā wa ātma bo/྅ haṃ/ yan lag gnyis pa rjes su chags pa rdo rje 'chang gi yan lag la gsum/mngon byang lngas gtso

ra༅༅ bo rgyu rdor 'dzin skyed pa/ mkha' gsang byin gyis brlab ste snyoms 'jug bya ba/ sngags kyis rgyas gdab pa'o/ /dang po ni/ dbus kyi gdan la/ a ā/ i sī/ u lha/ ṛ dṛ/li snyi/ e i/ o au/ e aḥ nyis 'gyur las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor mngon par byang chub pa dang po dang / me long lta bu'i ye shes/ de'i steng du/ ka kha ga gha nga / tsa tsha dza dzha nya/ ṭa ṭha ḍa dhe ṇa/ ta tha da dha na/ pa pha ba bha ma/ ya ra la wa/ sha ṣa sa hakṣaḥ ya ra la ḍa dhe ṇa/ nyis 'gyur las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor mngon byang gnyis pa dang / mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes/ de gnyis kyi dbus su hūṃ dang e las rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa dang / gri gug e gis mtshan pa mngon byang gsum pa dang / so sor kun tu rtogs pa'i ye shes/ de dag las 'od zer 'phros shing / slar 'dus pas nyi zla sa bon phyag mtshan rnams 'dres pa

mngon byang bzhi pa dang / bya ba nan tan gyi ye shes te rdo rje bzhi yis sa bon bsdu ba'o// de thams cad yongs su gyur pa las/ bcom ldan 'das rgyu rdo rje 'dzin pa sku mdog nag po zhal brgyad dang ldan pa'i rtsa ba'i zhal nag po/ g.yas zhal kunda ltar dkar ba/ g.yon zhal dmar zhing cher 'jigs pa/ lhag ma g.yas zhal gnyis dang g.yon zhal gnyis bung ba ltar nag cing / steng zhal dud kha gtsigs pa'i nyams can/ spyan nyi shu rtsa bzhi phye ba/ dbu skra ser po gyen tu brdzes pa/ dpral ba'i steng du thod pa lnga lnga'i phreng ba dang / sna tshogs rdo rje spyi bor 'dzin pa/ zhal nas hūm̐ gi sgra spro zhing / 'khor lo/ snyan cha/ mgul rgyan/phyag zhabs kyi gdu bu/ ska rags/ thal bas byugs pa ste phyag rgya drug dang ldan pa/ mgo bo lnga bcu'i phreng ba'i do shal 'phyang ba/ phyag bcu drug gi g.yas

༄tsho/ /kyi phyag gi thod pa brgyad na/ rim pa bzhin tu/ glang po che dkar po/ rta sngon po/ bong bu kham pa/ glang dmar po/ rnga mong thal kar/ mi dmar po/ sha ra bha sngon po/ byi la gwa pa/ g.yon gyi phyag gi thod pa brgyad na/ sa'i lha mo ser mo/ chu'i lha mo dkar mo/ rlung gi lha mo dud kha/ me'i lha mo dmar mo/ zla ba'i lha mo dkar mo/ nyi ma'i lha mo dmar mo/ gshin rje nag po/ nor bdag ser po/ snying gar thal mo sbyar ba rnams bsnams pa'i phyag dang po gnyis kyis yum la 'khyud pa/ gcer bu zhabs bzhi'i mdun ma gnyis g.yas brkyang ba'i gar dang rgyab ma gnyis skyil krung phyed pa'i stabs kyis nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la bdud bzhi mnyam par mnan zhing / gar gyi nyams dgu dang ldan pa/ 'jigs pa'ang 'jigs par mdzad pa'o/ /yum bdag med ma

sku mdog nag mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum mnga' ba/ mche ba gtsigs pa/ dbu skra ser po gyen tu brdzes pa/ phyag g.yas gri gug /g.yon thod pa bsnams pas yab la 'khyud pa/ gcer bu phyag rgya lnga dang ldan zhing / thod pa skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang / skam po lnga bcu'i phreng bas brgyan pa/ zhabs g.yon brkyang / g.yas bskum pas yab la 'khyud pa/ mngon par byang chub pa lnga pa dang / chos dbyings ye shes kyi bdag nyid do/ /gnyis pa mkha' gsang byin gyis btso ste snyoms 'dug bya ba ni/ yum gyi gsang gnas stong pa'i ngang las/ hriḥlas padma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa/ āḥlas ze'u 'bru/ phaṭa ser pos bu ga bkag par gyur/ oṃ padma su kha dha ra ma hā rā ga su khaṃ dad tsa tur nanda bha ga bi shwa hūm̐ hūṃ hūm̐ kāhūm̐ ku ru ṣā me/ zhes yab kyis bskul bar bsgom/ yab kyi gsang gnas stong pa'i

༄za/ /ngang las hūm̐ las rdo rje sngon po/ oṃ dkar po las nor bu/ phaṭa ser pos bu ga bkag par gyur/ oṃ badzra ma hā dre ṣa tsa tur nanda dwa ya ka kha ga mu khe ka ra so nā tha hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ kāju ku ru ṣā me/ zhes yum gyis bskul bar bltas la/ bsrub pa dang srub pa'i sbyor bas/ yab yum thabs dang shes rab gnyis su med par snyoms par zhugs pa'i sbyor mtshams nas/ dga' ba sgyu ma lta bu sid dang phaṭa kyi sgra dang bcas pa'i 'od zer 'phros pas/ sangs rgyas thams cad bskul/ tshur 'dus te zhal du zhugs/ thugs kar zhu/ rtsa dbu ma nas song /rdo rje'i lam nas byang chub sems kyi ngo bo rga rtsa baṃ rghaṃ paṃ shaṃ rtsa ḍi sa bon brgyad yum gyi padmar spros pa las/ yab yum gnyis dang sangs rgyas thams cad zag pa med pa'i bde bas tshim par gyur/ gsum pa sngags kyis rgyas gdab pa ni/ oṃ sarba ta

thā ga ta 65 ṭa/ rā ga ṇa badzra swa bhā wa ātma be|྅ haṃ/ zhes nga rgyal bzung / yan lag gsum pa dbang bskur ba mi bskyod pa'i yan lag la'ang gsum/ gang la dbang bskur ba lha'i bskyed chog /ji ltar dbang bskur ba dngos/ de rgyas gdab pa'i sngags so/ /dang po la lnga/ 'khor spro ba/ bar srid zhugs te zhu ba glus bskul/ 'bras bu rdo rje 'dzin par bzhengs pa/ sems dpa' dang skye mched gnas gsum byin gyis brlab pa/dam ye dbyer med du bya ba'o/ /dang po ni/ yum gyi mngal du gnas pa'i sa bon lha mo so so'i skur gyur pa rnams rang rang gi stan la 'khod/ oṃ go rī rga swā hā/ yum gyi mkha' nas ge spros pa las/ go rī nag mo g.yas gri gug /g.yon nya ro hi ta bsnams pa phyung ste/ shar gyi padma'i 'dab mar tshangs pa'i gdan la bzhugs par gyur/ glu rto rī rtsa swā hā/ rtsa spros pa las tso rī dmar mo g.yas cang telā g.yon phag pa bsnams pa phyung ste/ lho'i padma'i 'dab mar dbang po'i gdan

༄tsho/ /la bzhugs par gyur/ oṃ bee tā lī baṃ swā hā/ baṃ spros pa las/ bee tā lī ser mo g.yas ru sbal/ g.yon thod pa bsnams pa phyung ste/ nub kyi padma'i 'dab mar nye dbang gi gdan la bzhugs par gyur/ oṃ ghasma rī rghaṃ swā hā/ rghaṃ spros pa las/ ghasma rī ljang gu g.yas sprul/ g.yon thod pa bsnams pa phyung ste/ byang gi padma'i 'dab mar drag po'i gdan la bzhugs par gyur/ oṃ puska sī paṃ swā hā/ paṃ spros pa las/ pukka sī sngon mo g.yas seng ge/ g.yon dgra stu bsnams pa phyung ste/ byang shar gyi padma'i 'dab mar gshin rje'i gdan la bzhugs par gyur/ oṃ sha ba rī shaṃ swā hā/ shaṃ spros pa las/ sha ba rī dkar mo/ g.yas dge slong / g.yon gsil byed bsnams pa phyung ste/ shar lho'i padma'i 'dab mar nor bdag gi gdan la bzhugs par gyur/ oṃ tsaṇḍa lī rtsa swā hā/

rtsa spros pa las/ tsaṇḍa lī sngon mo/ g.yas 'khor lo/ g.yon thong gshol bsnams pa phyung ste/ lho nub kyi padma'i 'dab mar srin po'i gdan la bzhugs par gyur/ oṃ ḍombi nī ḍi swā hā/ ḍo spros pa las/ ḍombi nī sna tshogs pa'i mdog can/ g.yas rdo rje/ g.yon sdigs mdzub mdzad pa phyung ste/ nub byang gi padma'i 'dab mar thag bzang ris kyi gdan la bzhugs par gyur/ lha mo thams cad kyang zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum ma/ mche ba gtsigs pa/ dbu skra ser po gyen tu brdzes pa/ gcer bu phyag rgya lnga dang ldan zhing / thod pa skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang / skam po lnga bcu'i phreng bas brgyan pa/ zhabs g.yon brkyang ba'i skyil krung phyed pa'i gar gyis gnas pa'o/ /gnyis pa bar srid tsos te zhu ba glus bskul ba ni/ nam mkha'i nā da skar mda' 'pho ba bzhin tu bcom ldan 'das

༄༅/ /kyi zhal du zhugs nas yum gyi padmar babs pas/ yum bde ba'i ngo bor zhu/ yum zhu bas yab kyang bde ba'i ngo bor zhu nas/ dngul chu'i rnam pa lta bur gyur pas/ mtshams kyi lha mo bzhis tshad med pa'i rang bzhin gyi glus bskul ba ni/ rje btsun snying rje'i yid bzhengs shig /puska sī ni bdag la skyobs/ /stong pa'i rang bzhin nyid spongs la/ /bdag la bde chen sbyor bzhed mdzod/ /khyod med na ni bdag 'gums pas/ /kye yi rdo rje khyod bzhengs shig /stong pa'i rang bzhin nyid spongs la/ /ri khrod ma 'bras grub par mdzod/ /dga' gtso 'jig rten 'gron gnyer ba/ /stong pa nyid la zhugs sam ci//khyod med phyogs ni mi 'tshal bas/ /gdol pa mo bdag zhu ba bgyi/ /bdag gis khyod kyi thugs 'tshal gyi/ /mig 'phrul mnga' ba khyod bzhengs shig/

g.yung mo bdag nyid dran nyams pas/ /snying rje rgyun chad ma mdzad cig /gsum pa 'bras bu rdo rje 'dzin par bzhengs pa ni/ shin tu snyan pa'i glus bskul bas/ byang chub kyi sems dngul chu'i rnam pa las/ hūm̐ dang e las rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa dang / gri gug e gis mtshan par gyur/ de las 'od zer 'phros 'dus pa las/bcom ldan 'das 'bras bu rdo rje 'dzin pa sku mdog nag po zhal brgyad dang ldan pa'i rtsa ba'i zhal nag po/ g.yas zhal kunda ltar dkar ba/ g.yon zhal dmar zhing cher 'jigs pa/ lhag ma g.yas zhal gnyis dang g.yon zhal gnyis bung ba ltar nag cing / steng zhal dud kha gtsigs pa'i nyams can/ spyan nyi shu rtsa bzhi phye ba/ dbu skra ser po gyen tu brdzes pa/ dpral ba'i steng du thod pa lnga lnga'i phreng ba dang / sna tshogs rdo rje spyi bor 'dzin pa/ zhal nas hūm̐ gi sgra spro

༄༅/ /zhing / 'khor lo/ snyan cha/ mgul rgyan/ phyag zhabs kyi gdu bu/ ska rags/ thal bas byugs pa ste phyag rgya drug dang ldan pa/ mgo bo lnga bcu'i phreng ba'i do shal 'phyang ba/ phyag bcu drug gi g.yas kyi phyag gi thod pa brgyad na/ rim pa bzhin tu/ glang po che dkar po/ rta sngon po/ bong bu kham pa/glang dmar po/ rnga mong thal kar/ mi dmar po/ sha ra bha sngon po/ byi la gwa pa/ g.yon gyi phyag gi thod pa brgyad na/ sa'i lha mo ser mo/ chu'i lha mo dkar mo/rlung gi lha mo dud kha/ me'i lha mo dmar mo/ zla ba'i lha mo dkar mo/ nyi ma'i lha mo dmar mo/ gshin rje nag po/ nor bdag ser po/ snying gar thal mo sbyar ba rnams bsnams pa'i phyag dang po gnyis kyis yum la 'khyud pa/ gcer bu zhabs bzhi'i mdun ma gnyis g.yas brkyang ba'i gar dang rgyab ma gnyis skyil

krung phyed pa'i stabs kyis nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la bdud bzhi mnyam par mnan zhing / gar gyi nyams dgu dang ldan pa/ 'jigs pa'ang 'jigs par mdzad pa'o/ /yum bdag med ma sku mdog nag mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum mnga' ba/ mche ba gtsigs pa/ dbu skra ser po gyen tu brdzes pa/phyag g.yas gri gug /g.yon thod pa bsnams pas yab la 'khyud pa/ gcer bu phyag rgya lnga dang ldan zhing / thod pa skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang / skam po lnga bcu'i phreng bas brgyan pa/ zhabs g.yon brkyang / g.yas bskum pas yab la 'khyud pa'o/ /zhes pa'i bar gyis gtso bo yab yum sngar ltar gsal bar bsgom pa ni rdo rje bzhi las gzugs rdzogs pa'o//bzhi pa sems dpa' dang skye mched gnas gsum byin gyis bslab pa ni/bcom ldan 'das kyi thugs kar rang 'dra'i ye shes sems dpa'/ de'i thugs kar ting

༄tsho/ /'dzin sems dpa' rdo rje rtse dgu pa'i lte bar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su hūm̐ sngon po/ yum gyi thugs kar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du e sngon po 'od zer dang bcas pa/ mig tu oṃ las gti mug rdo rje ma dkar mo/ /rna bar dwo las zhe sdang rdo rje ma nag mo/ /sna la me las ser sna rdo rje ma ser mo/ /lce la rī las 'dod chags rdo rje ma dmar mo/ /dpral bar i las phrag dog rdo rje ma ljang gu/ /snying ga'i cha stod du a las reg bya rdo rje ma sngon mo/ /spyi bor oṃ las sku rdo rje ma dkar mo/ /mgrin par āḥlas gsung rdo rje ma dmar mo/ /snying ga'i cha smad du hūm̐ las thugs rdo rje ma sngon mo/ /de thams cad kyang zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ g.yas gri gug /gaskusnan na 〈snad pa bsnams shing kha ṭwāṃ ga mchan khung du bcug pa/ spyan garna/ma pa/ dbu skra ser

po gyen tu brdzes pa/ phyag rgya lnga dang ldan pa/ stag gi pags pas smad dkris pa/ ro'i stan la skyil krung phyed pa'i gar gyis bzhugs pa'o/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta khe tsa dī badzra swa bhā wa ātma ko3 haṃ/ skyed sarba ta thā ga ta bhu tsa ri badzra swa bhā wa ātma ko3 haṃ/ skyed sarba ta thā ga ta ba ta la wā si nī badzra swa bhā wa ātma ko3 haṃ/zhes brjod par bya ste rdo rje bzhi las yig 'bru dgod pa'o/ /lnga pa dam ye dbyer med du bya ba ni/ rang gi snying ga'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas/ ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs/rdo rje'i rtse mos bsang gtor gyi chu mchod rdzas la gtor zhing / hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ brjod pas bgegs bskrad nas/ lag pa g.yas rdo rje dang bcas pas mchod pa rnams la bskor zhing / skyes āḥhūm̐ lan gsum brjod pas/ mchod pa'i yo byad rnams rang bzhin stong pa/ byed las dbang po drug gi spyod yul du zag pa med pa'i bde ba skyed nus par gyur/ zhes byin gyis

ra༅༅ brlabs la/ g.yon dril bu dkrol zhing / g.yas pas mchod rdzas stob pa'i tshul gyis dbul bzhin pas/ skyersha dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥkhaṃ ram̐ āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ zhes pas mchod yon/ skyed ni ri ti hūm̐ khaḥ.āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ zhes pas zhabs bsil/ skyed badzra puṣṭi āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ badzra dhu pe āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ badzra garnye āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ skyes badzra ni widre āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ skyes badzra ā 31 ke āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ zhes pa'i mchod pa lngas mchod/dkar mo ri dwags mtshan ma 'dzin/ /chom rkun bdud las rgyal ba'i snod/ /ro langs ma ni chu lag ma/ /ghasma rī ni sman 'dzin zhing / /puska sī ni rdo rje'i lag /de bzhin ri khrod ma ro 'dzin/ /gdol pa mo ni cang te'u brdung / /'di rnams kyis ni gtso bo mchod/ /'dod chags chen po'i rjes chags pas/ /g.yung mos sku la 'khyud pa nyid/ /oṃ go rī rga āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ tso rī rtsa āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ bai tā lī baṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ ghasma rī rghaṃ

āḥhūm̐ swāhā/ oṃ puska sī paṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ sha ba rī shaṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ tsaṇḍa sī rtsa āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ ḍombi ni ḍo āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ zhes lha mo brgyad kyis kyang mchod nas/ oṃ ma hā badzra hūm̐/ oṃ badzra gharnye āḥzhes pas rdo rje dang dril bu bzung la/zhe sdang rdo rjer phyag 'tshal bstod/ /gti mug rdo rjer phyag 'tshal bstod/ /ser sna rdo rje bdag la skyobs//'dod chags rdo rje bdag la stsol/ /phrag dog rdo rje nga rgyal te/ /sgyu 'phrul rdo rje mgon po kun/ /las kun rab tu sgrub byed pa/ /thams cad rdo rje bdag mgur 'khru/ra/ /zhes pas bstod/ so so'i phyag rgya bcings la sku/ rī dzaḥ zhes pas ye shes pa dgug ce ༷shrī hūm̐ gis bzhug bee tā lī baṃ gyis bcings/ ghasma rī the1ཿ zhes pas dgyes par byas/ gnyis pa dbang bskur ba dngos ni/ slar yang thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer nag po lcags kyu'i rnam pa 'phros pas khams gsum na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas thams cad

༄7/ /spyan drangs pa la go rī ma la sogs pas mchod pa ni/oṃ go rī ge āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ tso rī rtsa āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ bee tā lī baṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ ghasma rī rghaṃ āḥhūm̐ swāhā/ oṃ puska sī paṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ sha ba rī shaṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ tsaṇḍa lī rtsa āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ ḍombi ni ḍo āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ mgon po de bzhin gshegs pa kun/ /khyed kyis bdag la dbang skur cig /ces gsol ba btab pas/ sangs rgyas de rnams he ru ka'i gzugs su gyur nas bdud rtsi lngas gang ba'i bum pas dbang bskur ba na/ me tog gi char 'bab pa dang / rnga'i sgra grags pa dang / gur gum gyi char 'bab pa dang / gzugs rdo rje ma la sogs pas mchod pa dang / rdo rje'i glu/ spyan ma la sogs pas len pa dang / rig pa'i rgyal po khro bo rnams kyis bgegs bskrad cing dbang bskur/ chu'i lhag ma cung zad yar 'khyil ba

las rang gi rigs kyi bdag pos dbu brgyan pa ni/ gtso bo yab yum la mi bskyod pa/ pukka sī dang go rī la mi bskyod pa/ sha ba rī dang tso rī la rnam par snang mdzad/ tsaṇḍa lī dang bee tā lī la rin chen 'byung ldan/ ḍombi nī dang ghasma rī la snang ba mtha' yas kyis dbu brgyan par bsam la/ gsum pa sngags rgyas gdab pa ni/skyersha sarba ta thā ga ta 65 bhi sheng ka ta badzra swa bhā wa ātma be|྅ haṃ/ yan lag bzhi pa bdud rtsi myang ba 'od dpag med kyi yan lag la'ang gsum/ byin gyis brlab pa/ bdud rtsi myang ba/ sngags rgyas gdab pa'o/ /dang po ni/ bdud rtsi byin rlabs gong du 'byung ba ltar 'dir yang spro na/ oṃ badzra a mṛ ta kuṇḍa lī ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭa ces bsangs/ oṃ swa bhā wa shuddhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa dhwa ba 8)(྅ haṃ gis sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las yam̐ las rlung / ram̐ las me/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ las thod pa'i sgyed bu gsum gyi steng du/ a las thod pa yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du/ hūm̐ sum̐

༄༅/ /e dzī khaṃ/ lī māṃ māṃ tt+waṃ māṃ las skyes pa'i bdud rtsi lnga dang / sha lngar gyur/ ha hoḥhrīḥ zhes brjod pas/ tha mal pa'i kha dog dang dri dang nus pa phrogs shing / rlung g.yos/ me sbar/ bcud rnams bskol bas/ nyi ma 'char kha lta bu'i mdog can gyi rlangs pa hūṃ las rdo rje kha ṭwāṃ ga 'bar bar gyur pa zhu zhing / de nyid du lan gsum lhung bas dri ma thams cad dang bral ba shel ltar gsal ba'i dam tshig gi bdud rtsis gang ba'i steng du/ oṃ las byung ba'i zla ba kha chod kyi tshul du gnas pa la g.yas skor du ā li g.yon skor du kā li yongs su gyur pa'i oṃ āḥhūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros/ phyogs bcur bzhugs pa'i rdo rje 'dzin pa thams cad kyi thugs ka nas/ ye shes kyi bdud rtsi bkug /zla ba yi ge gsum dang bcas pa zhu bas bdud rtsi'i rgya mtshor gyur/ bsdu na gong du song

bas tsos par mdzad/ gnyis pa bdud rtsi myang ba ni/ gtso 'khor thams cad kyi ljags kyi rtse mo rdo rjer gyur pa'i 'od kyi sbu gus bdud rtsi drangs te gsol bar dmigs la/g.yon pa'i mtheb srin gyis nang mchod blangs nas 'bul zhing /phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi ngo bo dpal ldan rtsa ba'i bla ma dam pa'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ bcom ldan 'das rigs drug pa rdo rje 'chang chen po'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/bcom ldan rdo rje phag mo'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ rgyal sras rdo rje snying po'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ grub chen sa ra ha pa'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ dpal ldan 'phags pa klu sgrub zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ rgyal sras ārya de ba'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ paṇa chen zla ba grags pa'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ rnal 'byor mā taṅgi pa'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ te lo shes rab bzang po'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ nā ro dzñā na sirnyi'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/

༄7/ /mnga' bdag rgyal ba mi tri'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ mar pa chos kyi blo gros zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ rngog ston chos sku rdo rje'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ rngog ston zhe sdang rdo rje'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ rngog ston seng ge sgra yi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ rngog ston kun dga' rdo rje'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ rgya sgom ye shes 'od kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ grub chen karma pakshi'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ gnyan ras dge 'dun 'bum gyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ bshes gnyen tshul khrims rin chen zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/kun mkhyen rang byung rdo rje'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ bla ma chos kyi rgyal mtshan zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ yor pa ye shes dpal ba'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ bka' bzhi ratna bha dra'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ rje btsun mthong ba don ldan zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ byang sems dpal 'byor don grub zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ spyan snga chos kyi grags pa'i zhal

du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ rje btsun karma phrin las zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ 'jigs bral mi bskyod rdo rje'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ sprul sku dkon mchog yan lag zhaX du oṃ āḥhūm̐/rgyal tshab grags pa don gyub zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ stag lung rnam rgyal dpal bzang zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ chos rje ngag dbang rnam rgyal zhalta du o āḥsnyosle/ ༷tshudās med bkra shis dpal grurbo zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ mkhan chen karma nyi ma'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ mkhan mchog phrin las mtshan can zhal du o āḥhūm̐/ go shrī rdan yod snying po'i zharme du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ dpal chen chos kyi don grub zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ kun gzigs chos kyi 'byung gnas zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ karma tshe dbang kun khyabyi zhaX sdu oṃ āḥhūm̐/ mchog sprul phrin las rab rgyas zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ khra legs ye shes nyi ma'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ rgyal sras blo gros mtha' yas zhal du a āḥhūṃ/

༄7/ /padma dbang mchog rgyal po'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ rang byung rig pa'i rdo rje'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ drin can rtsa brgyud bla ma'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ lho brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams la 'bul/ oṃ de ba pi tsu badzñā ya oṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ e ni natpa yi oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes gtso bo yab yum dang / oṃ go rī haṃ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ tso rī rtsa oṃ āḥhūṃ/ oṃ bee tā lī baṃ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ ghasma rī rghaṃ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ puska sī paṃ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ sha ba rī shaṃ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ tsaṇḍa lī rtsa oṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ ḍombi ni ḍo oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes 'bor brgyad dang /oṃ hūṃ shrī ya de wī kā li kā li ma hā kā li hūṃ bhyo oṃ āḥhūm̐/ ces dud sol ma dang / oṃ ma hā kā lā ya oṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ ma hā kā li ye oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes pas chos skyong spyi ste thams cad la 'bru gsum sbyar bas nang mchod 'bul/ gsum pa sngags rgyas gdab pa ni/ skyes sarba ta thā ga ta a mṛ ta swā da badzra swa bhā wa ātma be|྅ haṃ/ zhes sngags rgyas gdab bo/ /yan lag lnga pa mchod pa don

yod grub pa'i yan lag la dngos dang / rgyas gdab bo/ dang po ni/slar yang thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas/ 'jig rten na gzugs sdug pa/ sgra snyan pa/dri zhim pa la sogs pa 'od zer gyis bsdus/ lha snams la mchod pa'i lha mo dpag tu med pa sprul pa/ de rnams kyis bdag lha dgur gsal ba la mchod par bsam zhing / oṃ sarba saṃ sho dha ni āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥkhaṃ ram̐ āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ nī rī ti hūm̐ kha āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ badzra pursha āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ badzra dhu pe āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ badzra ā 31 ke āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ skyed badzra garnye āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ skyes badzra ni widre āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ skyed badzra shabha āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ ces bsang gtor dang mchod yon nas rol mo'i bar gyis mchod nas/lha mo brgyad mchod pa ni/ dkar mo ri dwags mtshan ma 'dzin/ /chom rkun bdud las rgyal ba'i snod/ /ro langs ma ni chu lag ma/ /ghasma rī ni sman 'dzin zhing //

༄༅/ /pukka sī ni rdo rje'i lag /de bzhin ri khrod ma ro 'dzin/ /gdol pa mo ni cang te'u brdung / /'di rnams kyis ni gtso bo mchod/ /'dod chags chen po'i rjes chags pas/ /g.yung mos sku la 'khyud pa nyid/ /oṃ go rī ge āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ tso rī rtsa āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ bee tā lī baṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ ghasma rī rghaṃ āḥhūm̐ swāhā/ oṃ puska sī paṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ sha ba rī shaṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ tsaṇḍa lī rtsa āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ ḍombi ni ḍo āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ gnyis pa ni/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pū dza badzra swa bhā ba ātma ska/྅ haṃ/ zhes rgyas gdab bo/ /yan lag drug pa bstod pa rin chen 'byung ldan gyi yan lag la gsum/dngos dang /rgyas gdab/khyad par lha'i rnal 'byor ro/ /dang po ni/skyed ma hā badzra hūm̐/oṃ badzra gharnye āḥ ces sngags wo gnyis brjod cing don dran bzhin pas rdor dril bzung la/ khyod ni rnal 'byor ma yi tshogs kyis yongs su bskor/ /khyod ni nyid kyi thugs kyis

khyod dgongs 'gab/ /khyod ni rgyu dang mi rgyu 'khor ba kun sgrub pa/ /snying rje'i thugs kyis sems can byang chub tu/ /kun rdzob sgyu ma byang chub gaub pa yirke//dargyes skre rdo rje dawel gyi he ru ka la bstod/ /gnyis pa rgyas gdab ni/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta stu ti badzra swa bhā ba ātma ko3 haṃ/ gsum pa khyad par lha'i rnal 'byar ni/ o de wa paṃ hūṃ badzra hūm̐ lhe hūm̐ rmeṭa swā hā/ oṃ badzra karta( ri he bahṝ ya hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ aṭī na nā ya/ skra gorbha ke sha brtu ne/ tsa tur bi sha ti ne tru ya/ skyo ḍa sha bhu dzā ya/kṛrdzi dzi mā ta wa pu ṣe/ ka pā la mā la a ni kai dha ri ṇi/ ātma ta kru ra tsitta la/ andhemru rdaṣṭi nee/ oṃ mā ra ya mā ra ya/ kā ra ya kā ra ya/ gardza ya gardza ya/ tardza ya rterdza zlo/rjo sho ṣa ya sho ṣe ya/ sapta swā ga rā rno/ bandha banta/ nā ga aṣṭa kā na/ grohā grohā/ sha phrin rsha hā hi hi hu hū he hai ho ho haṃ haḥphaṭa swā hā/ ces snying po/ nye snying /

༄7 rtsa sngags rnams lan re brjod pas/ gtso bo yab yum gyi sku mdog phyag mtshan rgyan cha lugs shin tu gsal bar gyur/ oṃ go rī rga āḥhūṃ swā hā/ oṃ tso rī rtsa āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ bee tā lī baṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ ghasma rī rghaṃ āḥhūm̐ swāhā/ oṃ pukka sī paṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ sha ba rī shaṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ tsaṇḍa lī rtsa āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ ḍombi ni ḍo āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ ces 'bor brgyad kyi sngags brjod pas/ lha mo brgyad sku mdog phyag mtshan rgyan cha lugs shin tu gsal bar 'gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ gzhal yas khang dur khrod chen po brgyad rdo ra me ri dang bcas pa shin tu gsal bar gyur/ zhes mos la rim gyis gsal btab ste ji srid mi skyo'i bar bsgom mo/ ༈ /gnyis pa ngag gi mngon zhen bzlog pa'i don du bzlas pa bya ba la gsum/ phreng ba byin brlab/ ting nge 'dzin/ bzlas pa dngos so/ /dang po ni/ las mthun nam bo dhi tsi'i phreng ba 'du byas/ rang gi lag pa g.yon pa'i rbesar mo rnams

padma 'dab ma lnga pa/ mthil du zla dkyil la ā li g.yon skor du gnas pa'i lte bar a/ lag pa g.yas pa'i sor mo rnams rdo rje rtse lnga pa/ mthil du nyi dkyil la kā li g.yas bache/ra du gnas pa'i lte bar hūm̐/pad kor dang bcas phreng ba blang ste thal mo sbyar ba'i bar du bzung la/skyed badzra a mṛ ta kuṇḍa lī ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭa ces bsangs/oṃ swa bhā wa shuddhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā ba shuddhi3 haṃ gis sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las bdud rtsi'i yi ge sum̐ dkar po 'od zer 'phro bar gyur/ thal mo bsrub pa'i tshul bya zhing /rdo rje dang padma snyoms par zhugs/ byang chub kyi sems sum̐ la khyab/ des ā li kā li la khyab/ de phreng ba dang gnyis su med par gyur/ zhes mos la/ skyed pa de pa de ma hā dzñā na/ sarba bzhi ma yam̐ bha be ta hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ ho ho ho āḥkhaṃ swā hā/ zhes thog mar brgya rtsa dkyus la gsum re bzlas pas mthu dang ldan par 'gyur ro/ /gnyis pa ting nge 'dzin ni/ yum gyi thugs

༄༅/ /kar zla ba la gnas pa'i a yig gi mthar bzla bya'i sngags phreng rang mdog g.yas bskor du gnas pa las 'od zer dang sngags kyi phreng ba byung / yum gyi zhal nas yab kyi zhal du zhugs/ a ba dhā ti nas mar song / rdo rje nor bu nas yum gyi padmar bab ste thugs kar zhugs/ slar yang yum gyi zhal nas yab kyi zhal du zhugs te thi gu sgro chun lcags sgrog mda'i shugs kyi 'gros kyis 'khor bas phrin las bzhi bsgrub par gyur/ gsum pa bzlas pa dngos ni/ oṃ de wa pi tsu badzra hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes snying pon// oṃ badzra karta ri he badzā ya hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes nye ba'i snying po'o// oṃ aṭī na nā ya/ skra gorja ke sha brtu ne/ tsa tur bi sha ti ne tpā ya/ kho ḍa sha bhu dzā ya/ kṛṣṭa dzi mū ta wa pu ṣe/ ka pā la mā la a ni kai dhwa ri ṇi/ ātma ta kru ra tsitta la/ andhentu rdaṣṭi nee/ oṃ mā ra ya

mā ra ya/ kā ra ya kā ra ya/ gardza ya gardza ya/ tardza ya tardza ya/ 3| ṣa ya re ṣa ya/ sapta swā ga rā na/ bandha bandha/ nā ga aṣṭa kā na/ kṛṇḍa grohā/ sha trun ha hā hi hi hu hū he hai ho ho haṃ haḥphaṭa swā hā/ rtsa ba'i sngags so// oṃ gau ri ge āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ tso rī rtsa āḥhūṃ swā hā/ oṃ bee tā lī baṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ ghasma rī rghaṃ āḥhūm̐ st+waṃhā/ oṃ puska sī paṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ sha ba rī shaṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ tsaṇḍa lī rtsa āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ ḍombi ni ḍo āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ ces de rnams ni lha mo brgyad so so'i snying po ste/ rtsa rgyud las/ lubor la'i bdag po'i bzlas pa 'bum/ /dkyil 'khor can gyi de bzhin khri/ /zhes gtso 'khor gyi bzlas pa'i grangs su gsungs pa bzhin bzla ste/ 'khor lo'i bdag po la ni rtsa sngags nyid gtso bor bzla bar bzhed do/ ༈ /gsum pa sems kyi mngon zhen bzlog pa'i phyir rdzogs pa'i rim pa bsgom pa la/ dngos po'i gnas thabs/ lam gyi gnas thabs/ 'bras bu'i gnas thabs so/ /dang po la gnyis te/ sems dngos po'i gnas thabs kyis bsgom

ra༅༅ rgyu'i don gyi ngo bo shes par bya ba'i phyir lta ba'i don gtan la dbab pa dang / lus dngos po'i gnas thabs kyis bsgom pa'i gnad shes par bya ba'i phyir lus kyi gnas lugs gtan la dbab pa'o//lam gyi gnas thabs la gzhan lus shes rab dang / rang lus thabs ldan no/ /'di la gtum mo dang sgyu lus 'od gsal rnams bsgom pa ste/ sgom pa'i thabs bla ma'i zhal las shes par bya'o/ /'bras bu'i gnas thabs la mnyam bzhag rjes thob gnyis las/ lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes gong nas gong du skye ba la bya'o/ /skabs 'dir de dag ji bzhin mi nus pas gzhung gi dgongs pa hol khong du mi lus pa'i phyir rdzogs rim gyi sa bcad du smos pa la gnyis/ rnam dag dran pa dang / thun bsdu ba'o/ /dang po ni/ snying rje'i spyan ni dmar po ste/ /rdo rje gsum gyis dag pa'i spyan/ /byams pa'i thugs la yan lag gnag/bsdu ba'i dngos po bzhi yis ni/ /zhabs ni rnam pa bzhi zhes brjod/ /zhal brgyad rnam par thar pa brgyad/ /phyag ni stong pa bcu drug nyid/ /gug skyed kyis

ni sangs rgyas lnga/ /gdug pa 'dul phyir khro bor byas/ /gzugs la dkar mo rtag tu bshad/ /sgra la chom rkun ma rab grags/ /dri yi cha la ro langs ma//ro la ghasma rī rab grags/ /sha yis puska sī ru byas/ /de bzhin khrag gis ri khrod ma/ /gdol pa mo ni khu bar brjod/ /g.yung mo rkang dang tshil bu dag/pags pa byang chub yan lag bdun/ /rus pa bden pa bzhi po nyid/ /ces pas kun rdzob lha so so' rnam dag dang / de thams cad kyang bde stong dbyer med kyi rang bzhin tu rnam par dag pa'o/ /zhes pas don dam de bzhin nyid kyi rnam dag bsgom pa'o/ /gnyis pa thun bsdu ba ni/ thugs ka'i sa bon gyi 'od kyis brtan g.yo snod bcud thams cad gzhal yas khang la bsdu/ de yang lha mo brgyad la thim/ de rnams kyang gtso bo'i zhal brgyad la thim zhing /yum yab la/ yab thugs ka'i ye shes sems

༄༅/ /dpa' dang ting nge 'dzin sems dpa' la rim gyis 'dus pas/ de nyid kyang zhabs kyu/ khog pa zla tshes thig le nā da'i rnam par snang ba mi dmigs par gyur te/ chos thams cad kyi rang bzhin 'od gsal ba'i de kho na nyid la zhugs par gyur/ zhes mnyam par bzhag/ slar rang nyid las kyi he ru ka zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa'i skur gyur/ spyi bor skyes/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐ gis mtshan par gyur/ zhes mos la thun mtshams kyi bya ba la 'jug go/ ༈ /gnyis pa thun mtshams kyi chos la gsum/ gtor ma btang ba/ rdo rje'i glu blang ba/ smog lam gdab pa'o/ /dang po ni/ 'byung po thams cad pa'i gtor ma bshams la/ mdun gyi nam mkhar cedros 'byung sdispyi gasdo/ma pa'i nang du/ padma 'dab ma brgyad pa/ dkar sngo dmar ba'i mdog can gsum brtsegs mar gnas pa/ rang gi gnas gsum gyi oṃ āḥhūm̐ las 'od zer

dkar dmar mthing kha 'phros pas sa bla sa 'og sa steng gi 'gro ba thams cad la phog /tshur 'dus pas/ steng du oṃ dkar po/ bar du hūm̐ sngon po/ 'og tu āḥdamar po/ dgu dgu yongs su gyur pa las steng du sku rdo rje lha chen brgyad dang bcas pa dkar po/ bar ma la thugs rdo rje phyogs skyong brgyad dang bcas pa mthing kha/ 'og ma la gsung rdo rje klu chen brgyad dang bcas pa dmar po'i mdog can/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ rang 'od kyi yum la 'khyud cing g.yas brkyang ba'i stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ thams cad kyi gnas gsum yi ge gsum gyis mtshan pa'i thugs ka'i sa bon gyi 'od kyis rang 'dra'i ye shes pa spyan drangs bar bsam la/ go rī aṅku sha dzaḥ tso rī pā sha hūm̐/ bee tā lī banta baṃ/ ghasma rī ghaṇḍa hoḥ zhes dgug gtso bcing mnyes byas la/slar yang snying

༄tsho/ /kha'i 'od zer lcags kyu lta bus rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa spyan drangs/ oṃ badzra purmye āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ badzra dhu pe āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ badzra garnye āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ badzra ni widre āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ badzra ā lo ke āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ zhes mchod pa lngas mchod/ de rnams kyis dbang bskur bas sku rdo rje 'khor bcas la rnam par snang mdzad/ thugs rdo rje 'khor bcas la mi bskyod pa/ gsung rdo rje 'khor bcas la 'od dpag tu med pas dbu brgyan par bsgoms nas/ gtor ma sngar ltar byin gyis brlab pa ni/ oṃ badzra a mṛ ta kuṇḍa lī ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭa ces bsangs/ oṃ swa bhā wa shuddhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā ba shuddha3 haṃ gis sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las/ yam̐ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor dud kha gzhu'i dbyibs lta bu mtha' ma gnyis ba dan gyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du ram̐ las me'i dkyil 'khor dmar po gru gsum pa/ de'i

steng du a las thod pa phyi dkar la nang dmar ba/ nang gi dbus su mi'i sha dang byang chub kyi sems/ shar du glang po che'i sha dang dri chen/ lhor rta'i sha dang dri chu/ nub tu ba lang gi sha dang rakta/ byang du khyi'i sha dang rgyungs pa/ de rnams kyi phyi'i rnam pa oṃ/ srog la āḥ de'i steng du zla phyed rdo rje'i rtse mo la hūṃ gis mtshan pa mgo thur du blta ba/ rlung gis me sbar thod pa bsros sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga khol bas/ oṃ dang āḥlas 'od zer 'phros te zla phyed rdo rje hūm̐ dang bcas pa las ye shes kyi bdud rtsi bab/ dam tshig gi bdud rtsi dang gnyis su med par 'dres par gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ gsum/ mthar zla phyed rdo rje yang thod rma 'i nang du lhungs te zhu bas bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin tu gyur/ gtor mgron rnams kyi ljags rdo rje'i sbu gus gsol bas dgyes par gyur par bltas te/rdor dril dang dkus pa'i

༄7/ /rdor thal kha phye bas/ oṃ int+ra/ dza ma/ dza la/ dzakṣa/ bhā da/ banni/ bā u/ rakṣa/ tsanda/ gyudzdza/ mā da/ baspa/ ta la/ pā tā la/ aṣṭha saspa swā hā/i rda/ ba kla/ bhulga dzi gha/ phulla/ dhulpa/ māṃ sa/ skra gha/ ambha/ sospa/ kadzdza/ sa dhā/ khānti/ khu ni/ phe ḍa/ gā da/ dril bu bsil zhing / oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharmā ṇḍaṃ ā du nutpanma twa ta/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ ces btags pa lan gsum gyis bsngo/ lha chen brgyad po 'khor dang bcas/ /klu chen brgyad po 'khor dang bcas/ /'jig rten skyong ba brgyad rnams dang / /gnod sbyin tshogs rnams ma lus dang / /srin po'i tshogs rnams ma lus dang / /'byung po'i tshogs rnams ma lus dang / /yi dwags tshogs rnams ma lus dang / /sha za'i tshogs rnams ma lus dang / /smyo byed tshogs rnams ma lus dang / /rjed byed tshogs rnams ma lus dang / /mkha'

'gro'i tshogs rnams ma lus dang / /de la sogs pa 'byung po'i tshogs/ /ma lus 'khor dang bcas pa kun/ /'dir gshegs bdag la dgongs su gsol//mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di snoms la/ /rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas la/ /nad med tshe dang dbang phyug dang / /dpal dang grags dang skal pa bzang / /longs spyod rgya chen kun thob cing / /dbang dang mngon spyod dgra sde 'joms/ /dgar dang bsad dang dgug pa dang / /zhi dang rgyas la sogs pa yi/ /las kyi dngos grub bdag la stsol/ /dam tshig can gyis bdag la srungs/ /dngos grub kun gyi stong grogs mdzod/ /dus min 'chi dang nad rnams dang / /gdon dang bgegs rnams med par mdzod/ /rmi lam ngan dang mtshan ma ngan/ /mkha' 'gro'i byad sogs med par mdzod/ /'jig rten bde zhing lo

༄7/ /legs dang / /'bru rnams 'phel zhing chos 'phel dang / /bde legs thams cad 'byung ba dang / /yid la 'dod pa kun rdzogs mdzod//ces phrin las bcol/ oṃ badzra he ru ka sa twa sa ma ya/ ma nu pā la ya/ he ru ka twe no pa/ tiṣṭhadṛ ḍho me bha wa/ su tostso me bha wa/ a nu rakto me bha wa/ su postso me bha wa/sarba sidhi mme pra yasmo sarba karma su tsa me/ tsitt+waṃ shri yaḥ ku ru hūm̐/ ha ha ha ha hoḥ bha ga wān/ he ru ka mā me muñtsa he ru ko bha ba ma hā sa ma ya sa twa āḥhūm̐ phaṭa/ma 'byor pa dang nyams pa dang / /gang yang bdag rmongs blo yis ni/ /bgyis pa dang ni bgyid stsal ba/ /de kun mgon pos bzod par mdzod/ /ces yi ge brgya pa brjod la bzod par gsol/ badzra muḥ zhes brjod la se gol lan gsum gtogs shing / gtor ma'i mgron rnams rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs par gyur zhes mos/ chos

skyong gi gtor ma btang bar 'dod na'ang skabs 'di nyid du bya'o/ /gnyis pa rdo rje'i glu blang ba ni/ cang te'u brdung la/kolla i riṣṭa sogs sam/dag po bklag mi shes na mnga' bdag mar pas bod skad du bsgyur ba/ padma la ni rdo rje gnas/ /padma nyid ni zhing yin no/ /rgyun tu cang te'u brdung bya ste/ /snying rjes ku co bsgrag mi bya/ /de ru stobs ldan 'bad pas bza' chang yang mang po btung bar bya/ /grogs po skal ldan gzhug par bya/ /skal ba med pa rnam par spang / /bzhi mnyam gla rtsi sihla dang / /ga bur rnams kyis byugs par bya/ /der ni tshod ma sha chen gyis/ /bkang ba dag kyang bza' bar bya/ /'gro dang 'ong ba 'gog mi byed/ /dag dang ma dag bsam mi bya/ /rus pa'i rgyan gyis lus la brgyan/ /de ru ro ni gzhug par bya/ /'dus phyir gnyis ni sbyor ba bya/ /der ni reg min spang mi bya/ /zhes dbyangs dang bcas te bya'o/ /gsum pa smon lam gdab pa

༄༅ ni/rdo rje thal mo snying gar bzhag la/ skye zhing skye bar rigs mchog tu/ /skye zhing khengs med dam tshig ldan/ /dgyes pa rdo rje ston pa dang / /brtse ldan bla mar gus gyur cig /skye zhing skye bar gyur pa na/ /lag pa rdo rje dril bu 'khrol/ /zab mo'i chos ni ston pa dang / /btsun mo'i shu kra len 'gyur shog /kun tu sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /rdo rje 'chang chen go 'phang ldan/ /dge ba 'di yis thob 'gyur zhing / /'gro ba lngas kyang thob par shog /byang chub rdo rjes bsngags pa yi/ /rdzogs pa'i byang chub phyir spyod dang / /rdzogs sangs rgyas kyi spyod pa gang / /bdag kyang de nyid spyod par lha ga /ces pa la sogs pa bya'o/ /de dag gis bskyed rim dngos gzhi bshad zin nas/ gnyis pa yan lag la gnyis/ dam tshig dang / spyod pa'o/ /dang po ni/rtsa ba'i dam tshig bcu bzhi dang / yan lag gi dam tshig lnga la sogs pa srog bzhin du bsrung ngo / /gnyis

pa ni/ gtor ma chu sbyin sutstsha la sogs las dang po pa'i bya ba bco lngar grags pa rnams skabs su ci nus bya'o/ /de lta bus bskyed pa'i rim pa mthar phyin pa na/ rang byin rlabs dang lhan cig skyes pa'i rnal 'byor gyi rdzogs pa'i rim pa la bslab cing / bsrung ba dang bza' ba'i dam tshig la sogs pa bsten pas ye shes la dbang bar gyur pa na/ spros bcas/ spros med/ tshogs spyod/ phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba mthar phyin pa'i bar gyi spyod pa rnam pa bzhis mtshams sbyar bas 'bras bu skye ba'i rim pa yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur te/ de la'ang gsum/ bskyed rim/ rdzogs rim/ gnyis ka'i mthar thug gi 'bras bu'o/ /dang po ni/ lus tha mal du 'dzin pa'i zhen pa spangs shing phrin las chen po bzhi dang phran tshegs rnams 'grub pas gzhan gyi don byed do/ /gnyis pa la rtags dang yon tan gnyis las/ rtags ni du ba la sogs pa nges pa can lnga dang / nges pa med pa lnga dang / sku'i sgo dgu bkag pas yan lag gi rlung la dbang thob pa dang / gsung gi sgo bkag pas 'khor lo'i rtsa rlung las su rung ba dang / thugs kyi sgo dbye ba las mngon shes lnga 'char zhing ye shes kyi rlung dbu mar zin pa'o/ /yon tan la

ra༅༅ gnyis te thun mong gi yon tan lta stangs bzhi dang grub pa chen po brgyad/ thun mong ma yin pa gsang gnas nas gtsug tor gyi bar du rtsa rlung byang chub kyi sems brtan pas dag pa'i sa thob par 'gyur te/ brgya phrag bco brgyad las rlung 'gag pa yis/ /rim pa bzhin tu sa re 'thob par 'gyur/ /zhes pa ltar ro/ /gsum pa ni/ sku bzhi ye shes lnga dbang phyug gi yon tan brgyad dang ldan pa sangs rgyas rdo rje 'chang gi go 'phang ste/ de nyid tshe 'di la mngon tu byed par 'gyur ro/ /dgyes rdor rgyud kyi rgya mtsho bsrubs pa las/ /sgrub thabs snying po dri med be ḍūrya/ /rang bzos ma bslad brgyud pa'i phyag bzhes can/ /dngos grub gru char 'jo ba'i dpyid 'di grub/ /mar rngog ring lugs byin rlabs rgyun 'bab pa/ /rang byung yab sras rnam dpyod kyis phyes pa'i/ /rgyas pa gang de deng sang skye bo yi/ /spyod yul 'tshams par nyung ngu rnam gsal byas/ /nongs pa gang mchis bcom ldan rnal 'byor mar/ /bshags shing dge bas dgyes mdzad sprul pa'i sku'i/ /bstan pa nyin mo'i dpal bzhin gsal ba dang / /'gro kun zung 'jug he ru ka 'grub shog /ces pa 'di'ang dkyil 'khor gyi dbang phyug he ru

ka'i ngo bor bzhugs pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa dag gis gser gyi me tog dang bcas te rjes su gnang ba yang nas yang du bstsal ba dang / smyari khye/ na pa'i spyan ras yangs shing bstan 'gro la thugs gcig tu gzhol ba'i skyes chen khyad par can dag gis kyang yang yang bkas bskul ltar/ mar rngog gi gsung rnams gzhir bzhag /rje rang byung ba dang spyan snga thams cad mkhyen pa'i dgongs don srog tu bzung ste rgyas bsdus kyi bsnon 'brid phran bu tsam las rang babo'i tshig gis ma bslad par/ kun mkhyen tā'i si tu'i bka' 'bangs karma ngag dbang yon tan rgya mtshos gdan sa chen po dpal spungs kyi yang dben tu sbyar ba dge legs 'phel/ /bla ma'i bkas gnang rang bzo med pa'i gzhung / /byin rlabs ngad ldan brgyud pa'i zam ma chad/ /mar lugs dgyes rdor sgrub pa'i thabs 'di yang / /dpal spungs thub bstan chos 'khor gling chen por/ /yi ge'i sprin chen 'phro ba'i phyi mo mā/dgos pa chen pos bsgrubs pa'i dge gang des/ /rje btsun bla ma'i dgongs pa yongs rdzogs shing / /kai tshang bstan pa'i rdzogs ldan gsar 'char shog/ // rnam 'dren bzhi pa zas gtsang sras po yis/ /dam chos 'khor

ra༅༅ lo thog mar bstsal ba'i gnas/ /drang srong smra ba'i ri dwags nags zhes par/ /skyabs rje khra 'gu mchog sprul dgu pa yis/ /badzra bidu'i gdan sa bskrun par mdzad/ /gang der phyi lo nyis stong gnyis kyi lor/ /sgrub brgyud bstan pa'i gtsug nor karma pa/ /rgyal mchog bcu bdun pa dang de bzhin du/ /kam tshang bla chen mang po zhal 'dzoms nas/ /mnyam med 'gro ba'i mgon po bka' brgyud pa'i/ /tshogs chen dang po gsar du dbu btsugs mdzad/ /de'i tshe rgyal ba'i dbang po bcu bdun par/ /rgyal mchog brgyad pas lung bstan bstsal ba bzhin/ /mnga' bdag mar lugs rgyud sde bcu gsum gyi/ /bstan pa'i srol chen 'dzin skyongs spel ba'i phyir/ /dgon khag so sor rgyud sde so so yi/ /lha skal byin zhing lo rer tshugs srol btod/ /skabs der khra 'gu bkris chos gling du/ /dgyes rdor yab bka' yum bka'i skal bzang thob/ /de'i phyir mkhan chen rdo rje 'chang chen pos/ /badzra bisdi'i gdan sa chen po 'dir/ /phyi lo stong phrag gnyis dang gsum gyi lor/ /dgyes rdor yab bka'i sgrub pa dbu 'dzugs mdzad/ /de bzhin phyi lo nyis stong lnga yi lor/ /yum

bka' bdag med ma yi sgrub pa btsugs/ /skabs der ngag 'don ma dag chad pa'i skyon/ /du ma byung bas cho ga 'di nyid la/ /nag po 'gro shes dgos pa rab gzigs nas/ /mkhan chen rdo rje 'dzin pa'i ye shes kyi//gzigs par nag 'gros gsar pa'i tshul 'di rnyed/ /de nas mkhan chen rdo rje 'chang chen pos/ /gzhung don sa bcad go rim ma 'brugs par/ /sgrig chog 'di ltar bgyis zhes bka' bstsal ltar/ /ban btsun shes rab phun tshogs bdag gis kyang / /zhu sgrig las la zhabs stegs gang thub zhus/ /'dir 'bad rnam dkar dge tshogs gang mchis mthus/ /ma 'gyur mkha' mnyam 'a11 tshogs ma lus kun/ /dgyes rdor yab yum go 'phang thob par shog /ces pa 'di yang sgrig chog 'di nyid kyi byung ba cung zad brjod pa dang 'brel ba'i smon tshig go// zhes nga 'di'ang wā ṇa badzra bisdi'i dpe mdzod khang du par du bsgrubs pa'o// maṅga lo// //
༄7/ /dpal dgyes pa rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga dngos grub rgya mtsho zhes bya ba bzhugs so

ra༅༅/ /dpal dgyes pa rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga dngos grub rgya mtsho zhes bya ba/ bla ma dang bcom ldan 'das dgyes pa rdo rje la phyag 'tshal lo//zung 'jug chen po'i rgyal srid skyong zhing bde chen bdag med dga' mar 'khyud/ /srid pa gsum por 'jig rten dang ni 'jig rten 'das pa'i dbang bskur stsal/ /mchog bde'i gnas las rtag tu nyams med dgyes pa'i rdo rje'i gar mdzad pa/ /'gro ba mtha' dag khyod kyi go 'phang mi 'gyur mchog tu dbang bskur

༄tsho/ /stsol/ /gang de'i ngo bo nyid gyur mar rngog gzhung gi srol/ /rang byung yab sras chos kyi spyan gyis legs phyes pa/ /dus 'di'i skal mnyam rnams kyi lag len khrigs bsdeb ste/ /bslad med bkod la dpa' bo mkha' 'gros brtse bar mdzod/ /zab mo sngags kyi lam bzang las 'ongs pa ye shes sku can rnams kyi gshegs pa'i shul/ /dngos grub nor bu 'byung ba'i rgya mtsho ni/ /skal bzang 'dod pa 'jo ba'i gnyen du sbyin/ /de'ang bcom ldan

'das dgyes pa rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba 'dod pas thog mar shes par bya ba rgyud kyi rgyal po 'di'i bsdus pa'i don ni/ 'grel pa lugs dang man ngag lugs gnyis su grags pa las/ 'dir dpal dzñā na sirnyis/ gzhi dngos po'i gnas lugs/ lam gyi rim pa/ 'bras bu skye ba'i rim pa gsum du gsungs pa la bod kyi mkhas pa so sos 'grel tshul mang yang / dpal rang byung kun mkhyen gyi bzhed pas/ gzhi la gnyis te dngos dang / lam gyi gzhi dbang ngo / /dngos la gnyis/ lus dngos po'i gnas lugs rdo rje'i lus sku gsum dang thabs shes kyi rang bzhin rtsa rlung byang chub sems kyi bdag nyid can dang / sems dngos po'i gnas lugs rgyud las/ sems can rnams ni sangs rgyas nyid/ /'on kyang glo bung dri mas bsgribs/ /de gsal na ni sangs rgyas nyid/ /ces gsungs pa ltar sems kyi chos nyid spros pa kun zhi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po dang / sems phung khams skye mched bag chags thams cad kyis bgos pa/ sa bon thams cad pa'i kun gzhi'i rnam par shes pa glo bur gyi dri ma dang lhan cig pa'o/ /de la lus dang

༄tsho/ /sems dngos po'i gnas lugs bde gshegs snying po ni sbyang gzhi'o/ /glo bur dri ma ma rtogs log rtog sbyor ba'i lam la zhugs pa'i 'brul pa gnas skabs bzhi la sogs pa ni sbyang bya'o/ /lam gyi rim pa bskyed rdzogs kyi rnal 'byor ni sbyong byed do/ /'bras bu'i rim pa gsum ni sbyangs 'bras so/ /gzhi gnyis pa dbang bskur ba lnga ste/ ngo bo rgyud ma smin pa smin par byed pa/ nges tshig sgo gsum gyi dri ma 'khrud pa dang skal pa 'jog pa/ dbye ba bum gsang sher ye tshig dbang bzhi/ cho ga'i rim pa 'og tu 'byung zhing / dgos pa ni dbang gis ma smin par lam sgom du mi rung bas lam sgom pa la dbang ba dang / gsang ba mdzod kyi rgyud las/ dbang bskur yang dag sbyin ldan na/ /skye zhing skye bar dbang bskur 'gyur/ /de yi skye ba bdun na ni/ /ma bsgoms kyang ni 'grub par 'gyur/ /zhes so/ /de ltar na dbang bskur ba ni/ rang gi lus sems kyi dngos po'i gnas lugs rtogs par byed pa'i cha nas lam dang / lam rim pa gnyis kyi gzhi'am bya ba yin pas lam gyi gzhi ste lo tog 'dod pa la sa bon ltar rim gnyis la 'jug pa'i thog mar med ka med du song bas de 'chad pa la gsum/
