gang gis dbang skur ba po slob dpon gyi mtshan nyid/ gang la bskur ba slob ma'i mtshan nyid/ tshul ji ltar dbang bskur ba'o/ /dang po ni/ rgyud las/ rang 'dod lha mnyam rnal 'byor pa/ /rab mthong sngags kyi pha rol son//zhes dang / rin chen 'bar bar/ rdo rje dril bu ye shes dang / /lha dang dkyil 'bor sbyin sreg dang / /sngags dang rdul tshon gtor ma dang / /dbang bskur de nyid bcu rig pa/ /zhes pa la sogs pa'i mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'o//gnyis pa ni/ des shing 'jam la snyan par smra ba/ byams pa dang snying rje'i sems dang ldan pa/ thos bsam sogs dge la brtson pa/ bla ma la gus shing gsang ba zab mor mi skrag cing dad pa/ gtong sems che zhing bstan bcos mkhas pa'i slob ma ni skal pa dang ldan pa'o/ /gsum pa la bzhi/ sngon du bya ba bsnyen pa'i rim pa/ sa'i cho ga /sta gon tu gnas pa/ dngos gzhi'o/ /dang po ni sgrub thabs su bshad pa'i grangs bsnyen la sogs pa sbyin sreg gis kha bskangs pa sngon nas legs par grub pa'i slob dpon la/ slob mas lan gsum du gsol ba btab par gyur pa na/ bsnyen pa kha gsor grags pa lha la gnang ba zhu ba'i don tu mtshan ma mthong gi bar ram zhag

༄༅/ /bdun la sogs par bsnyen pa la 'jug par bya ste/ mdo sbyar las/ yang na de ltar bzlas pa las/ /lha yi snang ba gsal ba'am/ /mtshan ma bzang dang ldan gyur na/ /des kyang dkyil 'khor bri ba yin//zhes so/ /gnyis pa sa'i cho ga la lnga/ sa brtag pa/ slong ba/ sbyong ba/ srung zhing bzung ba/ bgegs bsal ba'o/ /dang po ni/ ji skad du/ tshal dang skye bo med gnas dang / /byang chub sems dpa'i khyim dang ni/ /dkyil 'khor khang pa'i nang du yang / /dkyil 'khor dam pa rab tu bzhengs/ /zhes gsungs pa lta bu'i gnas su dkyil 'khor bri ste/ gnas rnying par ni sa brtag tu med pas de'i tshul 'dir mi 'bri yi/ dgos pa byung na gzhung gzhan tu shes par bya'o// thog mar tshogs pa yod na/ las kyi rdo rjes phyag 'tshal/ maṇḍal spyi mthun tshom bu bdun ma/ skyed badzra bhā mi āḥhūm̐/ gzhi rnam par dag pa dbang chen gser gyi sa gzhi/oṃ badzra re khe āḥhūm̐/ phyi lcags ri'i khor yug gi rwa bas yongs su bskor ba'i dbus su ri'i rgyil po ri bo mchog rab/ shar lus 'phags po/ lho 'dzam bu

gling / nub ba lang spyod/ byang sgra mi snyan/ byang shar du zla ba/ lho nub tu nyi ma/ lha dang mi'i dpal 'byor phun sum tshogs pa ma tshang ba med pa 'di nyid bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo tha mi dad pa'i drung du/ lha'i rnal 'byor gyi rim pa la gnas par bskul ba'i ched du 'bul bar bgyi'o/ /thugs rjes 'gro ba'i don du bzhes nda/ garbershal/ bzhes nas byin gyis brlab tu garbesal/ /zhes phul/ skusna ga sa mā dhi kra ma hūm̐/ zhes rnal 'byor la gnas par bskul lo/ /gnyis pa sa slong ba ni/sgrub thabs ltar/ rang gi snying gar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ zla ba'i 'od ltar dkar ba'i hūm̐ las 'od zer dkar po 'phros/ lus thams cad gang / sdis/ pa dang sgrib pa ma lus pa sbyangs nas stong par gyur/ ngag tu/ hūm̐/ zhes brjod pas/ bdag nyid las kyi he ru ka zhal gcig phyag gnyis par gsal ba'i spyi

༄7/ /bor zla ba'i steng du oṃ dkar po/ /lkog mar padma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i steng du āḥdamar po/ /snying gar nyi ma'i steng du hūm̐ sngon pos mtshan par gyur/ oṃ badzra a mṛ ta kuṇḍa lī ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭa ces bsangs / skyed swa bhā wa shuddhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa ṭwāṃ ba sdokhresa3 haṃ gis sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las ye las rlung /ram̐ las me/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ las thod pa'i sgyed bu gsum gyi steng du/ a las thod pa yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du/ hūm̐ sum̐ e dzī khaṃ/ lī māṃ māṃ tt+waṃ māṃ las skyes pa'i bdud rtsi lnga dang / sha lngar gyur/ ha hoḥhrīḥ zhes brjod pas/ tha mal pa'i kha dog dang dri dang nus pa phrogs shing / rlung g.yos/ me sbar/ bcud rnams bskol bas/ nyi ma 'char kha lta bu'i mdog can gyi rlangs pa hūṃ las rdo rje kha ṭwāṃ ga 'bar bar gyur pa zhu zhing / de nyid du lan gsum lhung bas dri ma thams

cad dang bral ba shel ltar gsal ba'i dam tshig gi bdud rtsis gang ba'i steng du/ oṃ las byung ba'i zla ba kha chod kyi tshul du gnas pa la g.yas skor du ā li g.yon skor du kā li yongs su gyur pa'i oṃ āḥhūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros/ phyogs bcur bzhugs pa'i rdo rje 'dzin pa thams cad kyi thugs ka nas/ ye shes kyi bdud rtsi bkug /zla ba yi ge garna/ma dang bcas pa zhu bas bdud rtsi'i rgya ma31ra gyur/ zhes byin gyis rlabs pa'i bdud rtsi g.yon pa'i mtheb srin sbyar bas myang / lag gnyis bsnol bas rdor dril blang ste/rdo rje thabs bde chen gyi bdag nyid du mos la/ skye( ma hā badzra hūm̐/ zhes brjod cing gsor/dril bu shes rab stong nyid kyi rang bzhin du mos te/ skyes badzra gharnye āḥ zhes pas dkrol la pang du bzhag go/ /gtor ma gcig bshams la/ chu gtsang dang nang mchod kyis bran la/ skye( badzra a mṛ ta kuṇḍa lī ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭa ces bsangs/ skyed swa bhā wa sderngu'iḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā ba 8)(྅ haṃ

༄༅/ /gis sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las/ ye las rlung gi dkyil 'khor dud kha gzhu'i dbyibs lta bu mtha' ma gnyis ba dan gyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du ram̐ las me'i dkyil 'khor dmar po gru gsum pa/ de'i steng du a las thod pa phyi dkar la nang dmar ba/ nang gi dbus su mi'i sha dang byang chub kyi sems/ shar du glang po che'i sha dang dri chen/ lhor rta'i sha dang dri chu/ nub tu ba lang gi sha dang rakta/ byang du khyi'i sha dang rgyungs pa/ de rnams kyi phyi'i rnam pa oṃ/ srog la āḥ de'i steng du zla phyed rdo rje'i rtse mo la hūm̐ gis mtshan pa mgo thur du blta ba/ rlung gis me sbar thod pa bsros sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga khol bas/oṃ dang āḥlas 'od zer 'phros te zla phyed rdo rje hūm̐ dang bcas pa las ye shes kyi bdud rtsi bab/ dam tshig gi bdud rtsi dang gnyis su med par 'dres par

gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ gsum/ mthar zla phyed rdo rje yang thod pa'i nang du lhungs te zhu bas bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin tu gyur/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta bhyo bi shwa mu khe bhyaḥsarba thā khaṃ uṅga te spa ra ṇa i me ga ga na khaṃ kṛste rda ba lbā di swā hā/ lan gsum gyis 'bul/rdor dril bcas/ gang yang 'di na lha dang klu/ /gnod sbyin srin po'am gzhan yang rung / /sa 'di bdag gis dresang bgyid na/ /dkyil 'oshesar ched du stsal du garbesal/ /zhes lan gsum gyis gsol ba btab pas gnang ba byin par mos la gtor ma gtsang sar bskyal/ dkyil 'khor gyi sa gzhir ba byung lngas zlum por byug pa'i dbus su dri bzang gi chus thig le bya/ me tog ser po'i tshom bu bkod pa'i mdun tu mchod gtor/ chu gnyis nyer spyod lnga g.yas bskor du bsham/ lag g.yas sa gnon gyi phyag rgya sa la lan gsum bsnun tshul byas la/ paṃ las byung ba'i sa'i lha 51 lte ba yan chad sa gseb nas 'a21na pa/ sku mngesag gser bces ma lta bu/ g.yas

༄༅/ /pa khas len gyi phyag rgya dang / g.yon rin po che'i bum pa bsnams pa/ rin po che'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ bdag gis las ci bgyi zhes bka' nod par gyur/ dril stabs bcas/ oṃ tshur spyon tshur spyon lha mo che/ /sa yi lha mo 'jig rten yum/ /rin chen kun gyis rab gang ba'i/ /mchog gi rgyan gyis rab tu brgyan/ /mgul do zhabs gdub sil sil can/ /rdo rje sems dpa' rab mchod ma/ /mchod yon 'di ni bzhes mdzod la/ /dkyil 'khor las rnams rab tu sgrubs/ /hrīḥhi hi hi baṃ swā hā/ zhes bsgoms pa dang 'dra ba'i ye shes pa spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ dam tshig pa dang gnyis med du gyur/ oṃ dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥkhaṃ ram̐ āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ nī rī ti hūm̐ kha āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ zhes chu gnyis dang / oṃ bṛ thi bī de bī sa pa ri wā ra puṣṭi pra titstsha swā hā/ oṃ mṛ thi bī de bī sa pa

ri wā ra dhu pe pra tītstsha swā hā/ oṃ bṛ thi bī de bī sa pā ri wā ra gandhe pra tītstsha swā hā/ oṃ bṛ thi bī de bī sa pā ri wā ra nai wihye pra tītstsha swā hā/ oṃ bṛ thi bī de bī sa pā ri wā ra ā lo ke pra tītstsha swā hā/ oṃ bṛ thi bī de bī sa pā ri wā ra shabha pra tītstsha swā hā/ bar gyis mchod/ gtor ma/ oṃ badzra a skṛ ta kuṇḍa lī ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭa ces bsangs/ oṃ su bhā wa shuddhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā ba shuddha3 haṃ thi/sa sbyangs/ oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharmā ṇḍaṃ ā du nutpanma twa ta/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ lan gsum gyis byin brlab/oṃ bṛ thi bī de bī sa pa ri wā ra na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta bhyo bi shwa mu khe bhyaḥ sarba thā khaṃ uṅga te spa ra ṇa i me ga ga na khaṃ kṛste rda ba lbā di swā hā/ lan gsum gyis 'bul/ ma ma rin chen sna tshogs 'dzin/ /kye yi rdo rje khros mchod pa'i/ /lha mo khyod ni dpang du gyur/ /rnal 'byor bdag ni dkyil 'khor bri/ /zhes gsol ba bto pas/ sa'i phyogs 'dir

༄7/ /khyod kyis dkyil 'khor bris shig ces gnang ba byin nas ye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig sems dpa' gnas de nyid du thim par gyur/zhes mos la mchod gtor bsdu'o/ /gsum pa sa sbyong ba ni/ rdo rje slob dpon lha'i nga rgyal gyis stegs bu'i dbus su sems skyil gyis 'dug la/ skyed dhwa khaṃ hūm̐/ sa gzhi stong pa nyid du gyur/ hūm̐ lam̐ hūm̐/gser gyi sa gzhir gyur/ oṃ me di ni badzrī bha ba badzra bandha hūm̐/ sa gzhi rdo rje'i rang bzhin tu gyur/ rdo rje dang bcasastu 'i lag pa sa la bzhag nas/ oṃ aṭī na nā ya/ skra gorbha ke sha brtu ne/ tsa tur bi sha ti ne tru ya/ kho ḍa sha bhu dzā ya/ kṛṣṭa dzi mū ta wa pu ṣe/ ka pā la mā la a ni kai dhā ri ṇi/ ātma ta kru ra tsitta la/ andhentu rdaṣṭi ne/ oṃ mā ra ya mā ra ya/ kā ra ya kā ra ya/ gardza ya gardza ya/ tardza ya tardza ya/ rberte ṣa ya the ṣa ya/ sapta swa ga rā na/ bandha banta/ nā ga aṣṭa kā na/ kṛhā grohā/ sha phrin ha

hwa hi hi hu hā he hai ho ho haṃ haḥphaṭa swā hā/ lan bdun brjod/ sa gzhi'i nyes skyon thams cad dag par gyur/ bzhi pa sa srung ba ni—/ stegasabu'i dbus su bdud rtsi lnga'i chus byugs la/re larme nyi rmi'i dkyil 'khor gyi rtseng du/ hūm̐ las sna tshogs rdo rje/ lte ba la hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ de'i 'od zer gyi rtse mo las/ rdo rje rgya gram dpag tu med pa sgos pas/ 'og tu rdo rje'i sa galgo/ bar snang du rdo rje'i ra ba dang dra ba/ steng du rdo rje'i gur yangs shing rgya che ba/ 'og gzhi'i nyi ma las 'od zer phyi rol du 'ephros pas me ri dang / rdo rje rgya gram las rdo rje rkyang pa dpag tu med pa spros pas/ rdo rje'i dra mig rnams kyang bkag par gyur/ oṃ badzra rakṣa rakṣa hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ sngags lan gsum brjod pa'i bar gyis srung 'khor bsgom mo/ /bzung ba ni/mchod gtor 'du byas la/sngon 'gro gtor ma gtong ba nas/ bzlas pa dang rnam dag dran pa yan sgrub thabs las 'byung ba ltar

dbyutsho rdzogs par bya'o// ༈ lnga pa bgegs bsal ba ni/ slob dpon gyi phyogs bzhi'am mdun tu chu gsum nyer spyod bcas bsham/ phyogs bzhi'i slob ma rnams kyis thun mong du byin rlabs bya ngani /oṃ sarba saṃ sho dha ni āḥhūm̐ swā tsho bsangs/ oṃ swa dhwa wa shuddhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā ba shuddhi3 haṃ gis sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las/ a las thod pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du/ hūm̐ 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i bsang gtor/ mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me tog /bdug sbos/ snang gsal/ dri/zhal zas/ rol mo la sogs pa'i mchod pa'i yo byad rnams rang bzhin stong pa/ byed las dbang po drug gi spyod yul du zag pa med pa'i bde ba skyed nus par gyur/ oṃ sarba saṃ sho dha ni āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥkhaṃ ram̐ āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ nī rī ti hūm̐ kha āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ badzra purmye āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ badzra dhu pe āḥhūm̐ swā hā/

oṃ badzra ā lo ke āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ badzra garnye āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ badzra ni widre āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ badzra shabha āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ rol mo bya zhing / oṃ badzra ghaṇḍa ra ṇi ta pra ra ṇi ta saṃ pra ra ṇi ta sarba buddhā kṣe tra pra tsa li te pra dzñā pa ra mi tā nā da saṃ bha wa badzra dharmakhṛ da ya sarnyo ṣa ni hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hoḥ.āḥkhaṃ swā hā/ dag cing dri med yid 'ong ba'i//sngags kyi bsang gtor mchog 'di dag /mchog tu dad pas khyed la 'bul/ /ci bde bar ni bzhes su gsol/ /oṃ shrī he ru ka sa pa ri wā ra sarba saṃ sho dha ni āḥhūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ dag cing dri med yid 'ong ba'i/ /sngags kyi mchod yon mchog 'di dag /mchog tu dad pas khyed la 'bul/ /ci bde bar ni bzhes su gsol/ /oṃ shrī he ru ka sa pa ri wā ra dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥkhaṃ ram̐ āḥhūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ dag cing dri med yid 'ong ba'i/ /sngags kyi zhabs bsil mchog 'di dag /mchog

༄7/ /tu dad pas khyed la 'bul/ /ci bde bar ni bzhes su gsol/ /oṃ shrī he ru ka sa pa ri wā ra nī rī ti hūm̐ kha āḥhūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ me tog 'di ni bzang zhing dge/ /dag pa'i skye gnas las dag pa/ /bdag gis dad pas 'bul lags kyi/ /bzhes nas bdag la dgyes par mdzod/ /oṃ shrī he ru ka sa pa ri wā ra badzra puṣṭi āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ nags tshal las byung phan pa yi/ /gang zhig dri dang bdug spros mchog /bdag gis dad pas 'bul lags kyi/ /bzhes nas bdag la dgyes par mdzod/ /oṃ shrī he ru ka sa pa ri wā ra badzra dhwa pe āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ srin po 'joms shing dag byed la/ /dge zhing mun pa rnam sel ba//bdag gis dad pas 'bul lags kyi/ /bzhes nas bdag la dgyesaṃ par mdzod/ /oṃ shrī he ru ka sa pa ri wā ra badzra ā lo ke āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ lhan cig skyes

dang sbyar ba'i dri/ /tshim byed dag pa'i bdud rtsi 'di/ /bdag gis dad pas 'bul lags kyi/ /bzhes nas bdag la dgyes par mdzod/ /oṃ shrī he ru ka sa pa ri wā ra badzra garnye āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ baye sa gtsang bza' ba dang bcas pa'i/ /kha dog dri dang ro ldan pa/ /bdag gis dad pas 'bul lags kyi/ /bzhes nas bdag la dgyes par mdzod/ /oṃ shrī he ru ka sa pa ri wā ra badzra nai wi dre āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ sna tshogs dril bu'i sgra rnams dang / /cang te'u la sogs sgra yi tshogs//bdag gis dad pas 'bul lags kyi/ /bzhes nas bdag la dgyes par mdzod/ /oṃ shrī he ru ka sa pa ri wā ra badzra shabha āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ ces chu gsum nyer spyod rol tsho mchod pa dang / dkar mo ri dwags mtshan ma 'dzin/ /chom rkun bdud las rgyal ba'i snod/ /ro langs ma ni chu lag ma/ /ghasma rī ni sman 'dzin zhing / /pukka

༄༅/ /sī ni rdo rje'i lag /de bzhin ri khrod ma ro 'dzin/ /gdol pa mo ni cang te'u brdung / /'di rnams kyis ni gtso bo mchod/ /'dod chags chen po'i rjes chags pas/ /g.yung mos sku la 'khrud pa nyid/ /oṃ go rī shaṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ tso rī rtsa āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ bee tā lī baṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ ghasma rī rghaṃ āḥhūm̐ swāhā/ oṃ pukka sī paṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ sha ba rī shaṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ tsaṇḍa lī rtsa āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ ḍombi ni ḍo āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ zhes lha mo brgyad kyis mchod/ oṃ ma hā badzra hūm̐/ oṃ badzra gharnye āḥ ces sngags tshan gnyis brjod cing don dran bzhin pas rdor dril bzung la/ khyod ni rnal 'byor ma yi tshogs kyis yongs su bskor/ /khyod ni nyid kyi thugs kyis khyod dgongs 'grub/ /khyod ni rgyu dang mi rgyu 'khor ba kun sgrub pa/ /snying rje'i thugs kyis sems can byang chub tu/ /kun rdzob sgyu ma byang chub sgrub pa

yi/ /dgyes pa rdo rje dpal gyi he ru ka la bstod/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta stu ti badzra swa bhā ba ātma ko3 haṃ/ zhes pas bstod la/ ༈ shar phyogs pas/ rang nyid skad cig gis go rī nag mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum ma/ mche ba gtsigs pa/ dbu skra ser po gyen tu brdzes pa/ gcer bu phyaka/ rgya lnga dang ldan zhing / thod pa skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang / skam po lnga bcu'i phreng bas brgyan pa/ g.yas gri gug /g.yon nya ro hi ta bsnams pa/ zhabs g.yon brkyang ba skyil krung phyed pa'i gar gyis padma dang tshangs pa'i gdan la bzhugs par gyur/ maṇḍal tshom bu bdun ma/ oṃ badzra dhwa mi āḥhūm̐/ gzhi rnam par dag pa dbang chen gser gyi sa gzhi/oṃ badzra re khe āḥhūm̐/ phyi lcags ri'i khor yug gi rwa bas yongs su bskor ba'i dbus su ri'i rgyel po ri bo mchog rab/ shar lus 'phags po/ lho 'dzam bu

༄༅/ /gling / nub ba lang spyod/ byang sgra mi snyan/ byang shar du zla ba/ lho nub tu nyi ma/ lha dang mi'i dpal 'byor phun sum tshogs pa ma tshang ba med pa 'di nyid bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo tha mi dad pa'i drung du dkyil 'khor chen po sgrub cing mchod pa'i yon tu 'bul bar bgyi'o/ /thugs rjes 'gro ba'i don tu bzhes su gsol/ /bzhes nas byin gyis brlab tu gsol//zhes 'bul la/dril stabs bcas/de bzhin gshegs pa kun zhi ba/ /de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi gnas/ /chos kun bdag med pa yi mchog /dkyil 'khor gtso bos bshad du gsol// zhes bskul/ pho/ lho phyogs pas/ rang nyid skad cig gis tso rī dmar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum ma/ mche ba gtsigs pa/ dbu skra ser po gyen tu brdzes pa/ gcer bu phyag rgya lnga dang ldan zhing / thod pa skam

po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang / skam po lnga bcu'i phreng bas brgyan pa/ g.yas cang telā g.yon phag pa bsnams pa/ zhabs g.yon brkyang ba skyil krung phyed pa'i gar gyis padma dang dbang po'i gdan la bzhugs par gyur/ maṇḍal ni/oṃ badzra bhā mi āḥhūm̐/ gzhi rnam par dag pa dbang chen gser gyi sa gzhi/ oṃ badzra re khe āḥhūm̐/phyi lcags ri'i khor yug gi rwa bas yongs su bskor ba'i dbus su ri'i rgyol po ri bo mchog rab/ shar lus 'phags po/ lho 'dzam bu gling / nub ba lang spyod/ byang sgra mi snyan/ byang shar du zla ba/ lho nub tu nyi ma/ lha dang mi'i dpal 'byor phun sum tshogs pa ma tshang ba med pa 'di nyid bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo tha mi dad pa'i drung du dkyil 'khor chen po sgrub cing mchod pa'i yon tu 'bul bar bgyi'o/ /thugs rjes 'gro ba'i don tu bzhes su gsol//

༄༅/ /bzhes nas byin gyis brlab tu gsol// zhes 'bul la/ dril stabs bcas/ mtshan rnams thams cad yang dag rdzogs/ /mtshan min thams cad yang dag spangs/ /kun tu bzang po sku yi mchog /dkyil 'khor gtso bos bshad du gsol// zhes bskul/ 7/ nub phyogs pas/ rang nyid skad cig gis bai tā li ser mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum ma/ mche ba gtsigs pa/ dbu skra ser po gyen tu brdzes pa/ gcer bu phyag rgya lnga dang ldan zhing / thod pa skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang / skam po lnga bcu'i phreng bas brgyan pa/ g.yas rus sbal/ g.yon thod pa bsnams pa/ zhabs g.yon brkyang ba skyil krung phyed pa'i gar gyis padma dang nye dbang gi gdan la bzhugs par gyur/ maṇḍal ni/ oṃ badzra bhū mi āḥhūm̐/ gzhi rnam par dag pa dbang chen gser gyi sa gzhi/ oṃ badzra re khe

āḥhūm̐/ phyi lcags ri'i khor yug gi rwa bas yongs su bskor ba'i dbus su ri'i rgyal po ri bo mchog rab/ shar lus 'phags po/ lho 'dzam bu gling / nub ba lang spyod/ byang sgra mi snyan/ byang shar du zla ba/ lho nub tu nyi ma/ lha dang mi'i dpal 'byor phun sum tshogs pa ma tshang ba med pa 'di nyid bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo tha mi dad pa'i drung du dkyil 'khor chen po sgrub cing mchod pa'i yon tu 'bul bar bgyi'o/ /thugs rjes 'gro ba'i don tu bzhes su gsol/ /bzhes nas byin gyis brlab tu gsol// zhes 'bul la/ dril stabs bcas/ zhi ba'i chos ni mchog las byung / /ye shes spyod pa rnam sbyangs pa/ /kun tu bzang po gsung gi mchog /dkyil 'khor gtso bos bshad du gsol// zhes bskul/ ༈ byang phyogs pas/ rang nyid skad cig gis ghasma rī ljang gu zhal gcig phyag

༄༅/ /gnyis spyan gsum ma/ mche ba gtsigs pa/ dbu skra ser po gyen tu brdzes pa/ gcer bu phyag rgya lnga dang ldan zhing / thod pa skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang / skam po lnga bcu'i phreng bas brgyan pa/ g.yas sgrul/ g.yon thod pa bsnams pa/ zhabs g.yon brkyang ba skyil krung phyed pa'i gar gyis padma dang drag po'i gdan la bzhugs par gyur/ maṇḍal ni/ oṃ badzra bhā mi āḥhūm̐/ gzhi rnam par dag pa dbang chen gser gyi sa gzhi/ oṃ badzra re khe āḥhūm̐/ phyi lcags ri'i khor yug gi rwa bas yongs su bskor ba'i dbus su ri'i rgyal po ri bo mchog rab/ shar lus 'phags po/ lho 'dzam bu gling / nub ba lang spyod/byang sgra mi snyan/ byang shar du zla ba/ lho nub tu nyi ma/ lha dang mi'i dpal 'byor phun sum tshogs pa ma tshang ba med pa 'di nyid bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi

gtso bo tha mi dad pa'i drung du dkyil 'bor chen po sgrub cing mchod pa'i yon tu 'bul bar bgyi'o/ /thugs rjes 'gro ba'i don tu bzhes su gsol/ /bzhes nas byin gyis brlab tu gsol// zhes 'bul la/ dril stabs bcas/ sems can kun gyi sems chen po/ /rang bzhin dag pas gos pa med/ /kun bzang thugs mchog kha lo sgyur/ /dkyil 'khor gtso bos bshad du gsol// zhes bskul/ 7/ slob dpon stegs bu'i dbus su 'greng ste/ rten gzhal yas khang 'khor gyi lha mo brgyad la bsdu/ de rnams kyang gtso bo'i zhal brgyad la thim zhing / rang nyid he ru ka zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa'i rnam par gsal ba'i rkang pa gnyis su hūm̐ las sna tshogs rdo rje re re/ mig gnyis su ma dang ṭa las nyi ma dang zla ba'i dkyil 'khor/ mig gnyis hūm̐ las sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte ba la hūm̐ rab tu 'bar ba re res

ra༅༅/ /mtshan par gyur/ badzra ṭiṣṭa hūm̐/ zhes brjod la myur zhing g.yo ba'i mig gis blta/ rdor dril dang bcas pa'i lag gnyis snying gar 'byud pa'i tshul gyis he ru ka'i nga rgyal bskyed pa ni/kha yi padma 'dzum dang bcas/ /cung zad dmar ba'i mche ba 'chang / /kunda dkar gsal so yi phreng / /dpal ldan khrag 'thung rnal 'byor che/ /sems can sgrol ba rmad du byung / /de la sogs pa'i gar gyis ni/ /bgegs la sogs pa bskrad par bya'o/ /zhes brjod la/ byang shar mtshams su song nas/ nga ni dpal ldan snying rje'i stobs/ /srung ba'i 'khor lo sbyor ba po/ /rdo rje rtse mo 'bar ba yis/ /lus gsum las skyes dgag bya ste/ /rmongs pa'i bdag nyid gang mgo bo/ /tshal par dgas kyis gzhan tu min/ /bde chen ye shes rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /rdo rje sems dpa' dngos las skyes/ /lus srul po ni gang su dag /bgegs chen

po rnams so sor rbe|nga zhes lan gsum mthar/ sa phyogs 'dir bdag rdo rje stsophab dpon 'di zhes bya bas 〉stob ma che ge zhes bya ba rdzogs pa'i byang chub rtogs par bya ba dang / sems can thams cad bla na med pa'i byang chub thob par bya ba'i phyir bcom ldan 'das dgyes pa rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo 'bri yis/gang su yang rung ba sa phyogs 'dir gnas pa'i lha dang / klu dang / lha ma yin dang / gnod sbyin dang / srin po dang / yi dwags dang / sha za dang / rjed byed dang / 'byung po dang / gnon po dang / nam mkha' lding dang / mi'am ci dang / rig 'dzin la sogs pa rgan po dang / rgan mo dang / g.yog dang 'khor dang bcas pa rnams 'dir ma gnas par gzhan tu dengs shig /de ltar rdo rje 'dzin gyi bka' thos nas myur ba nyid du dengs shig /gang dag mi 'gro ba de dag

༄tsho/ /ni phyag na rdo rje rab tu 'bar ba/ hūm̐ ka ra shin tu khros pa/ ye shes kyi rdo rje chen po kun nas rab tu 'bar bas mgo bo tshal pa brgyar 'gas par 'gyur ta re/ zhes dang / na maḥs manta brnye bhyaḥ oṃ na mo badzra kro dhā ya/ ma hā rdotāsko ṭa bhe ra wā ya/ badzra sarnyo ha darṣa ya/ oṃ a mṛ ta kuṇḍa lī hūm̐ phaṭa/ces pa'i sngags bzla ba dang /bka' bsto tshigs bcad/nga ni dpal ldan snying rje'i stobs/ /srung ba'i 'khor lo sbyor ba po/ /rdo rje rtse mo 'bar ba yis/ /lus gsum las skyes dgag bya ste/ /rmongs pa'i bdag nyid gang mgo bo/ /tshal par dgas kyis gzhan tu min/ /bde chen ye shes rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /rdo rje sems dpa' dngos las skyes/ /lus srul po ni gang su dag /bgegs chen po rnams so sor song zhes lan gsum du brjod de/rdo rje gsor/dril bu dkrol/ hūm̐ lan mang du brjod cing de nyid

nas g.yas su bskor ba gsum gyi rjes su/ he ru ka'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ gi 'od zer gyis bgegs thams cad shin tu bskrad par gyur/ zhes pa ni he ru ka 'jigs pa'i gar ro/ /slad yang bdag med ma'i nga rgyal gyis/ hi mang du brjod cing de nyid nas g.yon tu bskor ba gsum gyi rjes su/ snying ga'i a las bde ba'i 'od zer 'phros pas bgegs rnams myos par gyur/zhes pa ni bdag med ma bde ba'i gar ro/ /slar dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su g.yas brkyang gis 'dug ste/ rang nyid he 〈co kar gsal bar sdo/ra/ hūm̐ zhes brjod pa dang g.yon sngon 'gro'i gzhi bca' pad kor dang sbrags pa'i mthar g.yas brkyang / lag gnyis kar g.yas su phyir bsgyur dang sdigs mdzub gnyis steng du phyar la 'og tu sprugs pa gsum gsum spel/ g.yon brkyang gis 'dug ste/ rang nyid bdab/ med mar ba/rba/ku5 bar shākyar/ :/ zhes g.yas sngon 'gro'i gzhi bca' pad kor dang sbrags pa'i mthar g.yon brkyang / lag gnyis kar g.yon tu phyir bsgyur/ sdigs mdzub gnyis steng du phyar la 'og tu sprug pa gsum gsum

༄༅/ /spel/slar yang rang nyid he ru ka zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa gsal bar gyur/ ra las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ hūm̐ las sna tshogs rdo rje/ lte ba la hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ de'i 'od zer gyi rtse mo las/ rdo rje rgya gram dpag tu med pa spros pas/ 'og tu rdo rje'i sa gzhi/ bar snang du rdo rje'i ra ba dang dra ba/ steng du rdo rje'i gur yangs shing rgya che ba/ 'og gzhi'i nyi ma las 'od zer phyi rol du 'phros pas me ri dang / rdo rje rgya gram las rdo rje rkyang pa dpag tu med pa spros pas/ rdo rje'i dra mig rnams kyang bkag par gyur/ oṃ badzra rakṣa rakṣa hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes pas srung 'bor bsgom/ spro na 'dir rdo rje gur las 'byung ba'i gar rnams rgyas par bya'o// ༈ gsum pa sta gon la bzhi/ lha sta gon/ bum pa sta gon/ sbyin sreg sta gon/ slob ma sta gon no/ /dang po ni/ ba'i rnam lnga dang bdud rtsi lnga sbyar bas pho brang gi tshad tsam du zlum por byugs/

thig tshon gyi bya ba 'og tu 'byung yang skabs 'dir tshom bu'i gnas mi 'khrul ba'i phyir thig chen brgyad 'debs pa phyag len tu 'byung / slob dpon gyis gtso 'khor so so'i sngags brjod bzhin du dbus su dri'i thig le gru bzhi dang / phyogs mtshams brgyad la zlum po re bya/ de steng me tog gi tshom bu ga/tso bo la che zhing 'khor rnams la de'i sum 'gyur gyi chung ba bkod pa'i mthar/ mdun du chu gsum gtso 'khor spyi khyab dang / me tog la sogs pa cha dgu dgu g.yas bskor du bsham/ oṃ badzra a mṛ ta kuṇḍa lī ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭa ces bsangs/ oṃ swa bhā wa shuddhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā ba shuddhi3 haṃ gis sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las srung ba'i 'khor lo'i dbus su/ e las chos kyi 'byung gnas dkar po gru gsum pa rtsa ba phra ba thur du zug pa/ kha gdengs che ba gyen tu bstan pa'i nang du/ paṃ las sna tshogs padma dang / hūm̐ las sna tshogs rdo rje rtse mo bcu gnyis pa phyogs kyi mdog can gyi lte bar lju las byung ba'i rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i

༄7/ /khang pa brtsegs pa gru bzhi sgo bzhi pa/phyi nas dkar ser dmar ljang sngo ba'i rtsig pa rim pa lnga dang ldan zhing /rin po che'i pha ga dngang shal dang do shal phyed pa 'phyang ba/shar bu dang mda' yab kyis mdzes pa/ ka ba bzhi bzhis btegs pa'i rta babs bang rim bzhi dang ldan pa'i steng du/padma la gnas pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo dang / gdugs dang ri dwags dang bcas pa/ 'dod yon gyi snam bu dmar po la lha mo bcu drug dkyil 'khor pa la mchod pa'i tshul gyis 'khod cing /sgo khyud kyi mtshams su zla phyed rdo rjes spras pa/lha snams kyi shar dkar/lho ser/nub dmar/byang ljang ba/ka ba brgyad dang ldan zhing /rdo rje'i gdung nye bar bres pa/thog phyur bur gyur pa'i rtse mor rdo rje rin po che'i tog gis spud pa/gzhan yang gos dang /me tog gi

phreng ba dang / rnga yab dkar po dang / gdugs dang / ba dan kha dog sna tshogs pa rlung gis bskyod pa dang dril bu 'khrol ba la sogs pas brgyan pa'i dbus su/ padma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa ge sar dang bcas pa/ gzhal yas khang gi phyi rol rdo rje'i phreng bas bskor ba'i nang du/ shar du gtum drag /lhor 'jigs su rung ba/ nub tu 'bar ba 'khrugs pa/ byang du tshang tshing 'khrigs pa/ byang shar du ha ha rgod pa/ shar lhor dpal gyi nags/ lho nub tu 'jigs pa'i mun pa/ nub byang du ki li ki li sgrogs pa/ dur khrod chen po de rnams su shrīrṣa la sogs pa'i shing chen po brgyad kyi drung brgya byin la sogs pa'i phyogs skyong brgyad yum dang bcas pa/ lha'i dge 'dun la sogs pa'i zhing skyong brgyad phyogs skyong gi bzhon pa'i gdong can shing lo'i gseb nas lus stod phyung ba/

༄༅/ /mtsho chen po brgyad la gnas pa'i nor rgyas ser po la sogs klu chen brgyad yum dang bcas pas thal mo sbyar ba'i steng du sgrogs byed sog/sa sprin brgyad lding ba/ gzhan yang me dang ri bo mchod/ rten rnal 'byor gyi da/bang phyug brgyad/ brgyad gnas shing / dur khrod kyi bkod pa 'jigs su rung ba dang ldan pa'i gzhal yas khang gi dbus kyi padma'i lte bar tshangs pa/ dbang po/ nye dbang / drag po ste bdud bzhi'i gdan/ 'dab ma brgyad la/ shar du tshangs pa ser po/ lhor dbang po dkar po/ nub tu nye dbang dmar po/ byang du drag po sngon po/ byang shar du gshin rje nag po/ shar lhor nor bdag ser po/lho nub tu srin po sngo nag /nub byang du thag bzang ris ljang gu rnams gan rkyal du gnas pa'i snying gar nyi ma'i gdan dang bcas pa'o/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta

a nī la ya badzra swa bhā wa ātma ko3 haṃ/ sngags kyis rgyas gdab/ dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du hūm̐ dang e sngon po yongs su gyur pa las bcom ldan 'das dgyes pa rdo rje sku mdog nag po zhal brgyad dang ldan pa'i rtsa ba'i zhal nag po/ g.yas zhal kunda ltar dkar ba/ g.yon zhal dmar zhing cher 'jigs pa/ lhag ma g.yas zhal gnyis dang g.yon zhal gnyis bung ba ltar nag cing / steng zhal dud kha gtsigs pa'i nyams can/ spyan nyi shu rtsa bzhi phye ba/ dbu skra ser po gyen tu brdzes pa/ dpral ba'i steng du thod pa lnga lnga'i phreng ba dang / sna tshogs rdo rje spyi bor 'dzin pa/ zhal nas hūm̐ gi sgra spro zhing / 'bor lo/ snyan cha/ mgul rgyan/phyag zhabs kyi gdu bu/ ska rags/ thal bas byugs pa ste phyag rgya drug dang ldan pa/ mgo bo lnga bcu'i phreng ba'i do shal 'phyang ba/ phyag bcu drug gi g.yas

༄༅/ /kyi phyag gi thod pa brgyad na/ rim pa bzhin tu/ glang po che dkar po/ rta sngon po/ bong bu kham pa/ glang dmar po/ rnga mong thal kar/ mi dmar po/ sha ra bha sngon po/ byi la gwa pa/ g.yon gyi phyag gi thod pa brgyad/ na/ sa'i lha mo ser mo/ chu'i lha mo dkar mo/ rlung gi lha mo dud kha/ me'i lha mo dmar mo/ zla ba'i lha mo dkar mo/ nyi ma'i lha mo dmar mo/ gshin rje nag po/ nor bdag ser po/ snying gar thal mo sbyar ba rnams bsnams pa'i phyag dang po gnyis kyis yum la 'khyud pa/ gcer bu zhabs bzhi'i mdun ma gnyis g.yas brkyang ba'i gar dang rgyab ma gnyis skyil krung phyed pa'i stabs kyis nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la bdud bzhi mnyam par mnan zhing / gar gyi nyams dgu dang ldan pa/ 'jigs pa'ang 'jigs par mdzad pa'o/ /yum bdag med ma

sku mdog nag mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum mnga' ba/ mche ba gtsigs pa/ dbu skra ser po gyen tu brdzes pa/ phyag g.yas gri gug /g.yon thod pa bsnams pas yab la 'khyud pa/ gcer bu phyag rgya lnga dang ldan zhing / thod pa skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang / skam po lnga bcu'i phreng bas brgyan pa/ zhabs g.yon brkyang / g.yas bskum pas yab la 'khyud pa/ 'dab ma brgyad la haṃ rtsa baṃ rghaṃ paṃ shaṃ rtsa ḍi rnams yongs su gyur pa las/ shar du go rī nag mo g.yas gri gug /g.yon nya ro hi ta bsnams pa/ lhor tso rī dmar mo g.yas cang te'u g.yon phag pa bsnams pa/ nub tu bee tā li ser mo g.yas rus sbal g.yon thod pa bsnams pa/ byang du ghasma rī ljang gu g.yas sprul g.yon thod pa bsnams pa/ byang shar du pukka sī sngon mo g.yas seng ge g.yon dgra stu bsnams pa/

༄7/ /shar lhor sha ba rī dkar mo g.yas dge slong g.yon gsil byed bsnams pa/ lho nub tu tsaṇḍa lī sngon mo g.yas 'khor lo g.yon thong gshel bsnams pa/ nub byang du ḍombi ni sna tshogs pa'i mdog can/ g.yas rdo rje/ g.yon sdigs mdzub mdzad pa/ lha mo thams cad kyang zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum ma/ mche ba gtsigs pa/ dbu skra ser po gyen tu brdzes pa/ gcer bu phyag rgya lnga dang ldan zhing / thod pa skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang / skam po lnga bcu'i phreng bas brgyan pa/ zhabs g.yon brkyang ba'i skyil krung phyed pa'i gar gyis gnas pa'o/ /rang gi snying ga'i sa bon gyi 'od zer gyis ye shes kyi dkyil 'ashesar spyan drangs te nam mkhar bzhugs par gyur/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ brjod pas bsang gtor gyis phyi 'brang gi bgegs bskrad/ lag pa g.yas rdo rje dang bcas pas mchod pa rnams la bskor

zhing / oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan gsum brjod pas/ mchod pa'i yo byad rnams rang bzhin stong pa/ byed las dbang po drug gi spyod yul du zag pa med5pa'i bde ba skyed nus par shākyar/ zhes byin gyis brlabs la/ g.yon dril bu dkrol zhing / g.yas pas mchod rdzas stob pa'i tshul gyis dbul bzhin pas/ skyes dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ thertoḥkhaṃ ram̐ āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ zhes pas mchod yon/ skye( ni ri ti hūm̐ khaḥ.āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ zhes pas zhabs bsil/ skyed badzra pulpe āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ skyes badzra dhu pe āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ skyersha badzra gandhe āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ skyed badzra ni wibye āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ skye/ badzra ā 31 ke āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ zhes pa'i mchod pa lngas mchod/ dkar mo ri dwags mtshan ma 'dzin/ /chom rkun bdud las rgyal ba'i snod/ /ro langs ma ni chu lag ma/ /ghasma rī ni sman 'dzin zhing / /puska sī ni rdo rje'i lag /de bzhin ri khrod ma ro 'dzin/ /gdol pa mo ni cang te'u brdung / /'di rnams kyis ni gtso bo mchod/ /'dod chags

༄༅/ /chen po'i rjes chags pas/ /g.yung mos sku la 'khyud pa nyid/ /oṃ go rī rga āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ tso rī rtsa āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ bee tā lī baṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā/oṃ ghasma rī rghaṃ āḥhūm̐ swāhā/ oṃ puska sī paṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ sha ba rī shaṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ tsaṇḍa lī rtsa āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ ḍombi ni ḍo āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ zhes lha mo brgyad kyis kyang mchod nas/ oṃ ma hā badzra hūm̐/ oṃ badzra gharnye āḥ zhes pas rdo rje dang dril bu bzung la/ zhe sdang rdo rjer phyag 'tshal bstod/ /gti mug rdo rjer phyag 'tshal bstod/ /ser sna rdo rje bdag la skyobs/ /'dod chags rdo rje bdag la sdel/ /phrag dog rdo rje nga rgyal te/ /sgyu 'phrul rdo rje mgon po kun/ /las kun rab tu sgrub byed pa/ /thams cad rdo rje bdag mgur 'gyur/ /zhes nga/sa bstod/ so so'i phyag rgya bcings la gau rī dzaḥ zhes pas ye shes pa dgug cepo ༷ hūm̐ gis bzhug bee tā lī baṃ gyis bcings/ ghasma rī hoḥ zhes pas

dgyes par byas/ dbang bskur ba ni/ slar yang thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer nag po lcags kyu'i rnam pa 'phros pas khams gsum na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas thams cad spyan drangs pa la go rī ma la sogs pas mar pa ni/ oṃ go rī rga āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ tso rī rtsa āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ bee tā lī baṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ ghasma rī rghaṃ āḥhūm̐ swāhā/ oṃ puska sī paṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ sha ba rī shaṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ tsaṇḍa lī rtsa āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ ḍombi ni ḍo āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ mgon po de bzhin gshegs pa kun/ /khyed kyis lha la dbang skur cig /ces gsol ba btab pas/ sangs rgyas de rnams he ru ka'i gzugs su gyur nas bdud rtsi lngas gang ba'i bum pas dbang bskur ba na/ me tog gi char 'bab pa dang / rnga'i sgra grags pa dang / gur gum gyi char 'bab pa dang / gzugs rdo rje ma la sogs pas mchod pa dang / rdo rje'i glu/

༄༅/ /spyan ma la sogs pas len pa dang / rig pa'i rgyal po khro bo rnams kyis bgegs bskrad cing dbang bskur/ chu'i lhag ma cung zad yar 'khyil ba las rang gi rigs kyi bdag pos dbu brgyan pa ni/ gtso bo yab yum la mi bskyod pa/ puska sī dang gau rī la mi bskyod pa/ sha ba rī dang tso rī la rnam par snang mdzad/ tsaṇḍa sī dang bee tā lī la rin chen 'byung ldan/ ḍombi ni dang ghasma rī la snang ba mtha' yas kyis dbu brgyan par gyur/ de nas mchod pa byin gyis brlabs pa ni/ oṃ sarba saṃ de| dha ni āḥhūm̐ swā hās bsangs/ oṃ swa bhā wa shuddhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā ba shuddhi3 haṃ gis sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las/ a las thod pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du/ hūm̐ 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i bsang gtor/ mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me tog /bdug spos/

snang gsal/ dri/ zhal zas/ rol mo la sogs pa'i mchod pa'i yo byad rnams rang bzhin stong pa/ byed las dbang po drug gi spyod yul du zag pa med pa'i bde ba skyed nus par gyur/ oṃ sarba saṃ re/ dha ni āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥkhaṃ ram̐ āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ ni rī ti hūm̐ kha āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ badzra pursha āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ badzra dhu pe āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ skye/ badzra ā 61 ke āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ skyed badzra garnye āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ skyed badzra ni widre āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ skye( badzra shabha āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ rol mo bya zhing / skyed badzra ghaṇḍa ra ṇi ta pra ra ṇi ta saṃ pra ra ṇi ta sarba bzhi kṣe tra pra tsa li te pra dzñā pa ra mi tā nā da saṃ bha wa badzra dharmalha da ya sarnyo ṣa ni hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hoḥ.āḥkhaṃ swā hā/ phyi nang gsang ba de kho na nyid kyis mchod pa las dang po phyi'i mchod pa la lnga las dang po chu gsum nyer spyod rol ma'i mchod pa ni/dag cing dri med yid 'ong ba'i/ /sngags kyi bsang gtor mchog 'di dag /mchog

༄༅/ /tu dad pas khyed la 'bul/ /ci bde bar ni bzhes su gsol/ /oṃ shrī he ru ka sa pa ri wā ra sarba saṃ sho dha ni āḥhūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ dag cing dri —med yid 'ong ba'i/ /sngags kyi mchod yon mchog 'di dag /mchog tu dad pas khyed la 'bul/ /ci bde bar ni bzhes su gsol/ /oṃ shrī he ru ka sa pa ri wā ra dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥkhaṃ ram̐ āḥhūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ dag cing dri med yid 'ong ba'i/ /sngags kyi zhabs bsil mchog 'di dag /mchog tu dad pas khyed la 'bul//ci bde bar ni bzhes su gsol/ /oṃ shrī he ru ka sa pa ri wā ra ni rī ti hūm̐ kha āḥhūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ me tog 'di ni bzang zhing dge/ /dag pa'i skye gnas las dag pa/ /bdag gis dad pas 'bul lags kyi/ /bzhes nas bdag la dgyes par mdzod/ /oṃ shrī he ru ka sa pa ri wā ra badzra pursha āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ nags tshal

las byung phan pa yi/ /gang zhig dri dang bdug spros mchog /bdag gis dad pas 'bul lags kyi/ /bzhes nas bdag la dgyes par mdzod/ /oṃ shrī he ru ka sa pa ri wā ra badzra dha pe āḥhūṃ swā hā/ srin po 'joms shing dag byed la/ /dge zhing mun pa rnam sel ba/ /bdag gis dad pas 'bul lags kyi/ /bzhes nas bdag la dgyes shār mdzod/ /oṃ shrī he ru ka sa pa ri wā ra badzra ā lo ke āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ lhan cig skyes dang sbyar ba'i dri/ /tshim byed dag pa'i bdud rtsi 'di/ /bdag gis dad pas 'bul lags kyi/ /bzhes nas bdag la dgyes par mdzod/ /oṃ shrī he ru ka sa pa ri wā ra badzra gandhe āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ bshos gtsang bza' ba dang bcas pa'i/ /kha dog dri dang ro ldan pa/ /bdag gis dad pas 'bul lags kyi/ /bzhes nas bdag la dgyes par mdzod/ /oṃ shrī he ru ka sa

༄༅/ /pa ri wā ra badzra ni wi dre āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ sna tshogs dril bu'i sgra rnams dang / /cang te'u la sogs sgra yi tshogs/ /bdag gis dad pas 'bul lags kyi/ /bzhes nas bdag la dgyes par mdzod/ /oṃ shrī he ru ka sa pa ri wā ra badzra shabha āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ gnyis pa 'dod yon lnga yi mchod pa ni/ rang gi snying gas spros pa'i 'dod yon gyi lha mo du mas mchod par bsam la/ gzugs la rnam gsum shes bya ste/ /lha rnams la ni dbul bar bya/ /de nyid bcom ldan rgyal ba ni/ /mnga' bdag rdo rje rnam snang mdzad/ /oṃ shrī he ru ka sa pa ri wā ra rū pa pū dza me gha sa mu dra spa ra ṇa sa ma ye hūm̐/ sgra la rnam gsum shes bya ste/ /lha rnams la ni dbul bar bya/ /de nyid bcom ldan rdo rje can/ /rdo rje sems dpa' grags chen po/ /oṃ shrī he ru ka sa pa ri wā ra shapta pū dza me gha sa mu dra spa ra ṇa sa ma ye hūm̐/ rol mo bya/

dri la rnam gsum shes bya ste/ /lha rnams la ni dbul bar bya/ /de nyid bcom ldan sangs rgyas ni/ /rin chen phung por rab tu grags/ /oṃ shrī he ru ka sa pa ri wā ra garnye pū dza me gha sa mu dra spa ra ṇa sa ma ye hūm̐/ ro la rnam gsum shes bya ste/ /lha rnams la ni dbul bar bya/ /de nyid bcom ldan 'dod chags che/ /rdo rje chos kyis bzhes su gsol/ /oṃ shrī he ru ka sa pa ri wā ra ra sa pū dza me gha sa mu dra spa ra ṇa sa ma ye hūm̐/ reg la rnam gsum shes bya ste/ /lha rnams la ni dbul bar bya/ /de nyid bcom ldan sna tshogs pa/ /don yod 'bras bu ster ba po/ /oṃ shrī he ru ka sa pa ri wā ra sparnye pū dza me gha sa mu dra spa ra ṇa sa ma ye hūm̐/rṣa dang / srab 'jam yang ba lha yi gos/ /mi bskyod rdo rje'i sku brnyes la/ /mi phyed dad pas bdag 'bul na/ /bdag kyang rdo rje'i sku thob shog /sna tshogs

༄7/ /dbang po'i gzhu ltar rab bkra zhing / /gang la reg na bde ba'i rgyur gyur pa/ /gos bzang rin chen bdag blo sbyang phyir 'bul/ /bzod pa dam pa'i bo/sa kyis brgyan par the ga /skyes badzra wast+ra āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ zhes pas gos zung 'bul lo/ /gsum pa rgyal srid bdun gyi mchod pa ni/rin chen sna bdun ri mor bris pa sogs 'bul ba'am so so'i phyag rgya spyi mthun byas la/gser las legs byas lte ba shin tu zlum/ /rtsibs stong ldan zhing mu khyud rab mnyam bzang / /dang po'i sa las rnam par rgyal gyur gang / /'khor lo rin chen nam mkha' bkang ste 'bul/ /oṃ tsakra ratna pū dzi te āḥhūm̐/ bdag dang mtha' yas pa'i sems can thams cad dran pa yang dag byang chub kyi chos bla na med pa kun tu spyod pa thob par gyur cig /yan lag thams cad legs skyes sa la ni/ /rab gnas gangs can rtse 'dra'i glang po

mchog /rgyal po la 'os mkha' la rab 'gro ba'i/ /glang po rin chen nam mkha' bkang ste 'bul/ /oṃ hasti ratna pū dzi te āḥhūm̐/ bdag dang mtha' yas pa'i sems can thams cad shes rab yang dag byang chub kyi chos bla na med pa kun tu spyod pa thob par gyur cig /tho rangs dus su phyogs rnams ma lus pa'i//sa rnams bskor nas slar yang ldog gyur gang / /rma bya'i mgrin 'dra spu ni yid 'ong ba'i/ /rta mchog rin chen nam mkha' bkang ste 'bul/ /oṃ a shwa ratna pū dzi te āḥhūm̐/ bdag dang mtha' yas pa'i sems can thams cad brtson 'grus yang dag byang chub kyi chos bla na med pa kun tu spyod pa thob par gyur cig /dri med beeḍūrya 'dra'i rin po che/ /kun tu dpag tshad tsam du snang byed pa/ /sgrib med mtshan mo ci 'dra nyin de bzhin/ /nor bu rin chen nam mkha' bkang ste

༄༅/ /'bul/ /oṃ ma ṇi ratna pū dzi te āḥhūm̐/ bdag dang mtha' yas pa'i sems can thams cad dga' ba yang dag byang chub kyi chos bla na med pa kun tu spyod pa thob par gyur cig /gang zhig reg dri gzugs dang mdangs ldan pa/ /bud med dam pa dregs ldan rnams kyi mchog /lha mo bzhin tu yon tan kun ldan pa/ /btsun mo rin chen nam mkha' bkang ste 'bul/ /oṃ sdi ratna pū dzi te āḥhūm̐/ bdag dang mtha' yas pa'i sems can thams cad shin tu sbyangs pa yang dag byang chub kyi chos bla na med pa kun tu spyod pa thob par gyur cig /gang yang 'di na rgyal la mu tig dang / /gser sogs mang po thub la phul ba yi/ /nor ldan mtshungs par nor mang ldan pa yi/ /khyim bdag rin chen nam mkha' bkang ste 'bul/ /oṃ gro ha spa ti ratna pū dzi te āḥhūm̐/ bdag dang

mtha' yas pa'i sems can thams cad ting nge 'dzin yang dag byang chub kyi chos bla na med pa kun tu spyod pa thob par gyur cig /'gro dang kun tu gnas dang rnam ldog par/ /ma lus dpung la mkhas par byed pa yi/ /dpal ldan bdun pa 'byung 'gyur mi yi ni/ /blon po rin chen nam mkha' bkang ste 'bul//oṃ pu ru ṣa ratna pū dzi te āḥhūm̐/ bdag dang mtha' yas pa'i sems can thams cad btang snyoms yang dag byang chub kyi chos bla na med pa kun tu spyod pa thob par gyur cig /bzhi pa sgeg sogs brgyad kyi mchod pa ni/ sgeg mo'i lag pas sgeg mo ste/ /phreng bas phreng ba'i mkha' 'gro ma/ /hūm̐ gi glu yis dam tshig glu/ /lag bskum pas ni gar nyid de/ /mchod pa 'di dag bla na med/ /sangs rgyas thams cad mnyes par byed/ /sangs rgyas rnams ni mchod pas mchod/ /'dod

༄tsho/ /pa'i dngos grub byed par 'gyur/ /phyag rgya mthong brgyud ltar bya zhing / oṃ badzra sa twa su saṃ gra hā da/ oṃ badzra lā su hūm̐/ oṃ badzra ratna mā nutta ram̐/ oṃ badzra mā le tt+waṃ/ oṃ badzra dharma gā ya ni/ oṃ badzra gī ti hrīḥ oṃ badzra karma ka roddhā be/ oṃ badzra dṛ tī āḥ me tog skyur ba'i tshul gyis dang / /bdug pas bdug pa'i tshul gyis dang / /sdong bu mar me'i mchod pa dang / /byug pa'i tshul gyis rjes su dri/ /mchod pa 'di rnams bla na med/ /sangs rgyas thams cad mnyes par byed//sangs rgyas rnams ni mchod pas mchod/ /'dod pa'i dngos grub byed paratsho'agyur/ /phyag rgya mthong brgyud ltar bya zhing / oṃ badzra sa twa su saṃ gra hā da/ oṃ badzra dha pe hūm̐/oṃ badzra ratna mā nutta ram̐/ oṃ badzra puṣṭi hūm̐/ oṃ badzra dharma gā ya ni/ oṃ badzra ā lo ke hrīḥ oṃ badzra karma ka roddha be/ oṃ badzra gandhe āḥ lnga pa phyag rgya nyi shu'i mchod pa sna/ rin

chen 'bar ba dang bzang po yongs bzung dgongs pa ltar phyag len tu rgyas par sbyar ba'i tshul 'byung yang bsdu na/ gar pad bcas/ te na hūm̐/ te na hūm̐/ te na te te hūm̐/ hūm̐ hūm̐/ pi wang tshul gyis sgreng ba dang / /gling bu'i tshul gyis sgyur ba dang / /dung gi tshul gyis 'bud pa dang / /sil khrol tshul gyis rdeb pa dang / /phyag 'tshal tshul gyis 'dud pa dang / /rnga yab tshul gyis g.yob pa dang / /rgyal mtshan tshul gyis sgreng ba dang / /bla bre'i tshul gyis bre ba dang / /ba dan tshul gyis 'phyar ba dang //gdugs kyi tshul gyis dgab pa dang / /rnga zlum tshul gyis rdeb pa dang / /rdza rnga'i tshul gyis rdung ba dang / /gar gyi tshul gyis yan lag skyod/ /bzhad pa'i tshul gyis 'dzum pa dang / /sgeg pa'i tshul gyis sgeg pa dang / /khro ba'i tshul gyis 'jigs pa dang / /mda' 'phen tshul gyis drang bar bya/ /rdo

༄7/ /rje gsor zhing phyag 'tshal lo/ /chags pa'i tshul gyis nu ma 'jib/ /gus pa'i tshul gyis thal mo sbyor/ /rdo rje'i mchod pa nyi shu pos//he ru ka dpal 'khor bcas mchod// gnyis pa nang gi mchod pa ni/ zla zhun byang sems ga bur gyis gang ba'i/ /padma'i snod 'dzin lha mo go rī ma/ /zhing gi rdul dang mnyam par sprul nas kyang / /bde chen mngon par 'phel slad lha rnams mchod/ /oṃ go rī rga āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ nyi 'od mdangs chags rang byung me tog ni//sihlas yongs bkang snod 'dzin tso rī ma/ /zhing gi rdul dang mnyam par sprul nas kyang / /gtum mo'i nus pa rgyas phyir lha rnams mchod/ /oṃ tso rī rtsa āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ nang gi gdung ba sel byed gla rtsi ste/ /rdo rje dri chu'i snod 'dzin bee tā li/ /zhing gi rdul dang mnyam par sprul nas kyang / /mtshan 'dzin dri ma sbyong phyir

lha rnams mchod/ /oṃ bee tā li baṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ bzhi mnyam bdud rtsis gang ba'i thod pa yis/ /phyag gnyis rtag tu brel gyur ghasma rī/ /zhing gi rdul dang mnyam par sprul nas kyang / /'chi med thob par bya phyir lha rnams mchod/ /oṃ ghasma rī rghaṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ sā li skyes pa rab brjod tsandan dmar/ /rdo rje stobs kyi snod 'dzin pukka sī/ /zhing gi rdul dang mnyam par sprul nas kyang / /mtha' yas mthu stobs rgyas phyir lha rnams mchod/ /oṃ puska sī paṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ ro bcud sbrang rtsi'i btung ba dang bcas pa'i/ /rnal 'byor lhung bzed thogs pa'i ri khrod ma/ /zhing gi rdul dang mnyam par sprul nas kyang / /rdo rje'i lus thob bya phyir lha rnams mchod/ /oṃ sha ba rī shaṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ gzhom med nā da'i rang bzhin cang telā /dbyangs gsal rdo rje'i sgra sgrogs tsaṇḍa lī/ /zhing gi rdul dang mnyam

༄༅/ /par sprul nas kyang / /rdo rje chos ni 'grub phyir lha rnams mchod/ /oṃ tsaṇḍa lī rtsa āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ thabs shes snyoms par 'jug las dga' ba —bzhi/ /zag med yongs su bskyed pa'i ḍombi nī/ /zhing gi rdul dang mnyam par sprul nas kyang / /bde stong dbyer med thob phyir lha rnams mchod/ /oṃ ḍombi ni tos yi/ཿhūm̐ swā hā/ thams cad la'ang mthar se gol dang bcas pa bya'o/ /gsum pa gsang ba'i mchod pa ni/ gtso 'khor thams cad dpa' bo'i cha lugs su bsgyur te g.yung mos 'khyud pa las byung ba'i bde ba chen po'i de kho na nyid sku nyams su bstar ba'i mos pas/ gang gis rnam rtog rnam spangs te/ /byang chub sems ni rnam bsgom zhing / /lus dang sems ni rnam dag pa/ /'di ni don dam mchod pa yin/ /zhes pa rnams kyi mthar/ skyed sarba ta thā ga ta pū dza badzra swa bhā ba ātma ko3 haṃ/ zhes pa'i sngags kyis rgyas gdab/ skyes ma hā badzra hūm̐/ skyed badzra gharnye āḥ

spyo rdor dril sngags kyis bzung la/ srid pa ngo bo nyid kyis dag /ngo bo nyid kyis srid bral byas/ /rang bzhin dag pa'i sems dpa' ni/ /dam pa'i srid pa byed par shog/ ces dang / thams cad dngos po'i rang bzhin mchog /gdod nas thams cad bdag nyid gnas/ /thabs dang shes rab gnyis med pa'i/ /kye'i rdo rje la phyag 'tshal/ /bdag med mas ni mgul nas 'khyud/ /dbu skra ser po gyen tu 'bar/ /zhal brgyad pa la spyan gsum pa/ /mgon po de la gus phyag 'tshal/ /spyi bo'i steng na nag po mdzes/ /dkar dang dmar po g.yas dang g.yon/ /gang gi lhag ma'i zhal rnams ni/ /nag pa de la bdag phyag 'tshal//glang po rta bong glang rnga mo/ /mi dang sha ra bha byi la/ /g.yas pa'i phyag brgyad la gnas pa'i/ /thod pa 'dzin la bdag phyag 'tshal/ /sa dang chu dang rlung dang

༄7/ /me/ /zla nyi gshin rje gsang ba pa/ /g.yon pa'i phyag brgyad la gnas pa'i/ /thod pa 'dzin la bdag phyag 'tshal/ /zhabs bzhi yis ni bdud bzhi ngo// /mnyam par mnan zhing gcer bu nyid/ /nyi mar zhabs g.yas brkyang dang bskum/ /gar mdzad de la bdag phyag 'tshal/ /'khor lo bzhi yi bdag nyid mdzes/ /'dzag pa'i mgo bos rnam par brgyan/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rnam dag pa'i/ /phyag rgya lngas ni rnam par brgyan/ /sna tshogs rdo rje spyi bor 'dzin/ /dpral bar rigs kyi bdag po nyid/ /dam pa'i dga' ba yang dag thob/ /bde chen de la bdag phyag 'tshal/ /shaṃ las skyes pa'i go rī shar//kha dog nag cing g.yon pa nya/ /g.yas pa na ni gri gug 'dzin/ /tshangs pa mnan la bdag phyag 'tshal/ /rtsa 'a/sa byung ba'i chom rkun ma/ /btsod kyi kha dog

lho phyogs su/ /phyag na phag dang cang te'u bsnams/ /dbang po mnan la bdag phyag 'tshal/ /baṃ las skyes pa'i ser mo nub/ /ro langs ma ni nye dbang mnan/ /phyag g.yon lhung bzed g.yas pa yis/ /rus sbal 'dzin la bdag phyag 'tshal/ /ghasma rī ni byang gi sgor/ /ljang gu rghaṃ las byung ba yi/ /phyag na sbrul dang thod pas brel/ /drag po mnan la bdag phyag 'tshal/ /gshin rje mnan zhing paṃ las byung / /g.yon pa dgra stu seng ge g.yas/ /dbang ldan tu ni 'jigs gzugs ma/ /phyag 'tshal puska sī sngon la'o/ /ri khrod ma dkar shaṃ las byung / /me ru gnod sbyin steng du gamyo/sa/ /g.yon na gsil byed g.yas pa na/ /dge slong 'dzin la bdag phyag 'tshal/ /gtum mo nam mkha'i sngo bsangs ma/ /srin por rtsa las byung ba yi/ /g.yon na thong gshol 'khor lo g.yas//

༄༅/ /phyag 'tshal srin po mnan khyod la'o/ /ḍi las zhabrungs pa'i g.yung mo ni/ /rlung mtshams thag bzang ris steng gshegs/ /phyag g.yon sdig mdzub g.yas rdo rje/ /sna tshogs mdog la bdag phyag 'tshal/ /skyil krung phyed pa'i gar gyis gnas/ /phyag rgya lnga yis rnam par brgyan/ /gcer bu spyan gsum thams cad la/ /bdag ni gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /phung po khams rnams rnam dag pa/ /byang chub sems las byung ba yi/ /bde rab ster 'di thams cad la/ /dngos po kun gyis phyag 'tshal lo/ /nyid kyi phyag na gzung ba yi/ /phyag mtshan sa bon las byung ba'i/ /bde chen 'dod pa thams cad la//rtag tu yang dag phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang zhig nyi zla kha sbyor gnas sa bon/ /gnyis las skyes pa'i gtso bo rig mar bcas/ /nyid kyis nyid kyi dkyil 'khor

'di la ni/ /'jig rten gsum po sprul par mdzad dang ldan/ /nyid la 'di dag thams cad ma lus pa'i/ /zhi ba bde gsol rig ma bsdu byed pa'i/ /shes rab chags pa bdud rtsi'i ro nyid kyis/ /gnas su zhi ba de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mkha' 'gro ma gtso kye'i rdo rje/ /lha mo 'khor lo bcas bstod pas/ /bdag gis bsod nams gang thob pa/ /des ni 'jig rten de mtshungs 3|ga/ ces dang /sgrub thabs su bzhad pa ltar bdud rtsi 'bul zhing myang ba ni/gtso 'khor thams cad kyi ljags kyi rtse mo rdo rjer gyur pa'i 'od kyi sbu gus bdud rtsi drangs te gsol bar dmigs la/g.yon pa'i mtheb srin gyis nang mchod blangs nas 'bul zhing /phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi ngo bo dpal ldan rtsa ba'i bla ma dam pa'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ bcom ldan 'das rigs drug pa rdo rje 'chang chen po'i zhal du oṃ

༄7/ /āḥhūm̐/ bcom ldan rdo rje phag mo'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ rgyal sras rdo rje snying po'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ grub chen sa ra ha pa'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/dpal ldan 'phags pa klu sgrub zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ rgyal sras ārya de ba'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ paṇa chen zla ba grags pa'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ rnal 'byor mā taṅgi pa'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ te lo shes rab bzang po'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ nā ro dzñā na sirnyi'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ mnga' bdag rgyal ba mi tri'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ mar pa chos kyi blo gros zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ rngog ston chos sku rdo rje'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ rngog ston zhe sdang rdo rje'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ rngog ston seng ge sgra yi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ rngog ston kun dga' rdo rje'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ rgya sgom ye shes 'od kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ grub chen karma pakshi'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ gnyan ras dge

'dun 'bum gyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ bshes gnyen tshul khrims rin chen zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ kun mkhyen rang byung rdo rje'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ bla ma chos kyi rgyal mtshan zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ yor pa ye shes dpal ba'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ bka' bzhi ratna bha dra'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ rje btsun mthong ba don ldan zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/byang sems dpal 'byor don grub zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ spyan snga chos kyi grags pa'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ rje btsun karma phrin las zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ 'jigs bral mi bskyod rdo rje'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ sprul sku dkon mchog yan lag zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ rgyal tshab grags pa don grub zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ stag lung rnam rgyal dpal bzang zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ chos rje ngag dbang rnam rgyal zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ mtshungs med bkra shis dpal grub zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ mkhan chen karma nyi ma'i

༄༅/ /zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ mkhan mchog phrin las mtshan can zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ go shrī don yod snying po'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ dpal chen chos kyi don grub zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ kun gzigs chos kyi 'byung gnas zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ karma tshe dbang kun khyab zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ mchog sprul phrin las rab rgyas zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ khra legs ye shes nyi ma'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ rgyal sras blo gros mtha' yas zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ padma dbang mchog rgyal po'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ rang byung rig pa'i rdo rje'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/drin can rtsa brgyud bla ma'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes brgyud rnga/'i bla ma rnams la 'bul/ oṃ de ba pi tsu badzā ya oṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ e ni nātpa yi oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes gtso bo yab yum dang / oṃ go rī rga oṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ tso rī rtsa oṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ bee tā lī baṃ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ ghasma rī rghaṃ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ puska sī paṃ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ sha

ba rī shaṃ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ tsaṇḍa lī rtsa oṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ ḍombi ni ḍo oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes 'dur brgyad dang / oṃ hūṃ shrī ya de wī kā li kā li ma hā kā li hūṃ bhyo oṃ āḥhūm̐/ ces dud sol ma dang /skyed ma hā kā lwa ya skyed āḥhūm̐/ skyed ma hā kā li ye skye( āḥhūm̐/ zhes pas chos skyong spyi ste thams cad la nang mchod 'bul/ skye( sarba ta thā ga ta a skṛ ta swā da badzra swa bhā wa ātma ska|྅ haṃ/zhes sngags rgyas gdab/ 7/ slob dpon gyis spos dang rdor dril 'dzin pas/ gnyis med ye shes las byung ba'i/ /khyab bdag dngos grub bdag nyid can/ /ston pa'i gtso bo khrag 'thung dpal/ /bdag med ma dang yang dag ldan/ /phyogs mtshams rnams kyi mkha' 'gro dang / /rig pa'i lha mo rdzu 'phrul ldan/ /byang chub sems dpa' la sogs kun/ /ma lus bdag la dgongs su gsol/ /slob ma la ni phan pa dang / /khyed rnams la yang mchod pa'i phyir/ /rdo rje can bdag 'di

༄༅/ /zhes pas/ /nang par dkyil 'khor 'bri bar 'tshal/ /rjes su brtse bas nyer dgongs te/ /byin gyis brlab par mdzad du gsol/ /zhes lan gsum du gsol ba gdab la/ sta gon gyi dkyil 'khor rten dang brten par bcas pa rnams nam mkhar bzhugs par gyur/ zhes bya'o// ༈ gnyis pa bum pa sta gon ni/rin po che'i bum pa dgu las bum dang bcas pa'am/ ma 'byor na bum pa gnyis gu gul gyis 'dug /yungs kar gyis brabs shing / na maḥs manta brnye bhyaḥ oṃ na mo badzra kro dhwa ya/ ma hā do〉sko ṭa bhe ra wā ya/ badzra sarten ha darṣa ya/ skyed a mṛ ta kuṇḍa lī hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces pa'i bdud rtsi 'byil pa'i sngags ring thung gang mos bzlas pas bgegs bsal/ hūm̐/ lan bdun bzlas la ras kha tshar ma nyams pa sna lngas mgul chings phrog lnga pa bya zhing srad bus bcing / skyes taste taste ma hā taste swā hā/ zhes bzla zhing chu gtsang mas dgang la bum rdzas so lnga gzhug /'bras bu can gyi shing gis kha brgyan/ bum mtshan

gzugs dngos btags pa'am dri dang bdud rtsi lnga'i chus padma la gnas pa'i so so'i phyag mtshan dang / las bum la sna tshogs rdo rje bri ba'am phyag bzhes sla thabs su de ltar bris pas gdan bya/ ras dkar po dri ma med pa'i steng du me tog dkar po gcal du bkram par lha grangs dang mnyam pa yod na/ rnam rgyal dbus dang / gzhan rnams phyogs mtshams dang / las bum byang shar du dgod/ rnam rgyal gyi steng du bdud rtsi lnga dang sbyar ba'i chang gis gang ba'i thod pa'i steng du rdo rje'i lte bar me tog gi phreng ba brgyus pa'i gzungs thag btags pa bzhag /lha grangs dang mnyam pa'i mchod pa bshams la/ so sor bskyed pa ni/ rnamargyal du gtso bo yab yum dang / bum pa gzhan rnams su rim pa bzhin tu go rī nag mo zhes sogs kyis bskyed cing ye shes pa rnams gzhug /nyer spyod lngas mchod la/ ge las skyes pa'i go rī shar/ /zhes sogs kyis bstod/ bdud rtsi myang nas/ gtso bo yab yum la 'og tu 'byung ba ltar dang / gzungs thag rdo rje de go rī'i bha gar chud par bltas te bzlas pa byas la/ rdo rje bton pas lha mo de nyid bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin du zhu bar bsgom/ bum pa gzhan bdun la yang lha bskyed pa sogs

ra༅༅ rim pa de ltar shes par bya'o//bum pa gnyis la ni rnam rgyal steng thod pa'i bdud rtsi sogs bca' gzhi de dang 'dra ba las/ skye( badzra a mṛ ta kuṇḍa lī ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭa ces bsangs/oṃ swa bhā wa shuddhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā ba shuddhi3 haṃ gis sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las/ zlo las rin po che'i bum pa mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i rnam rgyal gyi dbus su padma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar tshangs pa la sogasaṃ pa'i gdan gyi steng dang / bum mtshan pad nyi bdud bzhi'i gdan la skad cig gis bcom ldan 'das dgyes pa rdo rje sku mdog nag po zhal brgyad dang ldan pa'i rtsa ba'i zhal nag po/ g.yas zhal kunda ltar dkar ba/ g.yon zhal dmar zhing cher 'jigs pa/ lhag ma g.yas zhal gnyis dang g.yon zhal gnyis bung ba ltar nag cing / steng zhal dud kha gtsigs pa'i nyams can/ spyan nyi shu rtsa

bzhi phye ba/ dbu skra ser po gyen tu brdzes pa/ dpral ba'i steng du thod pa lnga lnga'i phreng ba dang / sna tshogs rdo rje spyi bor 'dzin pa/ zhal nas hūm̐ gi sgra spro zhing /'khegar 'e1/ snyan cha/ mgul rgyan/ phyag zhabs kyi gdu bu/ ska rags/ thal bas byugs pa ste phyag rgya drug dang ldan pa/ mgo bo lnga bcu'i phreng ba'i do shal 'phyang ba/ phyag bcu drug gi g.yas kyi phyag gi thod pa brgyad na/ rim pa bzhin tu/ glang po che dkar po/ rta sngon po/ bong bu kham pa/ glang dmar po/ rnga mong thal kar/ mi dmar po/ sha ra bha sngon po/ byi la ga pa/ g.yon gyi phyag gi thod pa brgyad na/ sa'i lha mo ser mo/ chu'i lha mo dkar mo/ rlung gi lha mo dud kha/me'i lha mo dmar mo/ zla ba'i lha mo dkar mo/ nyi ma'i lha mo dmar mo/ gshin rje nag po/ nor bdag ser po/ snying gar thal mo sbyar ba rnams bsnams

༄༅/ /pa'i phyag dang po gnyis kyis yum la 'byud pa/ gcer bu zhabs bzhi'i mdun ma gnyis g.yas brkyang ba'i gar dang rgyab ma gnyis skyil krung phyed pa'i stabs kyis nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la bdud bzhi mnyam par mnan zhing / gar gyi nyams dgu dang ldan pa/ 'jigs pa'ang 'jigs par mdzad pa'o/ /yum bdag med ma sku mdog nag mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum mnga' ba/ mche ba gtsigs pa/ dbu skra ser po gyen tu brdzes pa/phyag g.yas gri gug /g.yon thod pa bsnams pas yab la 'khyud pa/ gcer bu phyag rgya lnga dang ldan zhing / thod pa skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang / skam po lnga bcu'i phreng bas brgyan pa/ zhabs g.yon brkyang / g.yas bskum pas yab la 'khrud pa/ 'dab ma brgyad la/ shar du tshangs pa ser po/ lhor dbang po

dkar po/ nub tu nye dbang dmar po/ byang du drag po sngon po/ byang shar du gshin rje nag po/ shar lhor nor bdag ser po/ lho nub tu srin po sngo nag /nub byang du thag bzang ris ljang gu rnams gan rkyal du gnas pa'i snying gar nyi ma'i gdan dang bcas pa'i steng du/ shar du go rī nag mo g.yas gri gug g.yon nya ro hi ta bsnams pa/ lhor tso rī dmar mo g.yas cang te'u g.yon phag pa bsnams pa/ nub tu bee tā li ser mo g.yas rus sbal g.yon thod pa bsnams pa/byang du ghasma rī ljang gu g.yas sprul g.yon thod pa bsnams pa/ byang shar du pukka sī sngon mo g.yas seng ge g.yon dgra stu bsnams pa/ shar lhor sha ba rī dkar mo g.yas dge slong g.yon gsil byed bsnams pa/ lho nub tu tsaṇḍa lī sngon mo g.yas 'khor lo g.yon thong gshol bsnams pa/ nub byang du ḍombi nī

༄༅/ /sna tshogs pa'i mdog can/ g.yas rdo rje/ g.yon sdigs mdzub mdzad pa/ lha mo thams cad kyang zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum ma/mche ba gtsigs pa/ dbu skra ser po gyen tu brdzes pa/ gcer bu phyag rgya lnga dang ldan zhing / thod pa skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang / skam po lnga bcu'i phreng bas brgyan pa/ zhabs g.yon brkyang ba'i skyil krung phyed pa'i gar gyis gnas pa/ mig tu mo las gti mug rdo rje ma dkar mo/ /rna bar dwo las zhe sdang rdo rje ma nag mo/ /sna la mo las ser sna rdo rje ma ser mo/ /lte 'a rī las 'dod chags rdo rje ma dmar mo/ /dpral bar i las phrag dog rdo rje ma ljang gu/ /snying ga'i cha stod du a las reg bya rdo rje ma sngon mo/ /spyi bor oṃ las sku rdo rje ma dkar mo/ /mgrin par āḥlas gsung rdo rje ma dmar mo/ /snying ga'i cha smad du

hūṃ las thugs rdo rje ma sngon mo/ /de thams cad kyang zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ g.yas gri gug /g.yon na thod pa bsnams shing kha ṭaṃ ga mchan khung du bcug pa/ spyan gsum pa/ dbu skra ser po gyen tu brdzes pa/ phyag rgya lnga dang ldan pa/ stag gi pags pas smad dkris pa/ ro'i stan la skyil krung phyed pa'i gar gyis bzhugs pa'o/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta khe tsa dī badzra swa bhā wa ātma ko3 haṃ/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta bhu tsa ri badzra swa bhā wa ātma ko3 haṃ/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ba ta la wā si nī badzra swa bhā wa ātma ko3 haṃ/ zhes brjod par bya ste rdo rje bzhi las yig wī dgod pa'o// rang gi snying ga'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas/ ye shes kyi dkyil 'ishesar mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs/ rdo rje'i rtse mos bsang gtor gyi chu mchod rdzas la gtor zhing /hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ brjod pas bgegs bskrad nas/lag pa g.yas rdo rje dang bcas pas mchod pa rnams la

༄༅/ /bskor zhing / oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan gsum brjod pas/ mchod pa'i yo byad rnams rang bzhin stong pa/ byed las dbang po drug gi spyod yul du zag pa med pa'i bde ba skyed nus par sdo/ra/ zhes byin gyis brlabs la/ g.yon dril bu dkrol zhing / g.yas pas mchod rdzas stob pa'i tshul gyis dbul bzhin pas/ skyes dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ therteḥkhaṃ ram̐ āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ zhes pas mchod yon/oṃ nī ri ti hūm̐ khaḥ.āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ zhes pas zhabs bsil/ oṃ badzra purmye āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ badzra dhu pe āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ badzra gandhe āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ badzra ni widre āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ badzra ā lo ke āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ zhes pa'i rma chod pa lngas mchod/ dkar mo ri dwags mtshan ma 'dzin/ /chom rkun bdud las rgyal ba'i snod/ /ro langs ma ni chu lag ma/ /ghasma rī ni sman 'dzin zhing / /pukka sī ni rdo rje'i lag /de bzhin ri khrod ma ro 'dzin/ /gdol pa mo ni cang te'u brdung / /'di rnams kyis ni gtso

bo mchod/ /'dod chags chen po'i rjes chags pas/ /g.yung mos sku la 'byud pa nyid/ /oṃ go rī ge āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ tso rī rtsa āḥhūṃ swā hā/ oṃ bee tā lī baṃ āḥhūṃ swā hā/ oṃ ghasma rī rghaṃ āḥhūm̐ swāhā/ oṃ pukka sī paṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ sha ba rī shaṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ tsaṇḍa lī rtsa āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ ḍombi ni ḍo āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ zhes lha mo brgyad kyis kyang mchod nas/ oṃ ma hā badzra hūm̐/ oṃ badzra gharnye āḥzhes pas rdo rje dang dril bu bzung la/ zhe sdang rdo rjer phyag 'tshal bstod/ /gti mug rdo rjer phyag 'tshal bstod/ /ser sna rdo rje bdag la skyobs/ /'dod chags rdo rje bdag la stsol/ /phrag dog rdo rje nga rgyal te/ /sgyu 'phrul rdo rje mgon po kun/ /las kun rab tu sgrub byed pa//thams cad rdo rje bdag mgur 'gyur/ /zhes pas bstod/ so so'i phyag rgya bcings la go rī dzaḥ zhes pas ye shes pa dgug ce dzardo hūm̐ gis bzhug bee tā lī baṃ gyis bcings/ ghasma rī hoḥ

༄7 zhes pas dgyes par byas/ dbang bskur ba ni/slar yang thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer nag po lcags kyu'i rnam pa 'phros pas khams gsum na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas thams cad spyan drangs pa la go rī ma la sogs pas mchod pa ni/oṃ go rī rga āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ tso rī rtsa āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ bai tā lī baṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ ghasma rī rghaṃ āḥhūm̐ swāhā/ oṃ puska sī paṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ sha ba rī shaṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ tsaṇḍa lī rtsa āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ ḍombi ni ḍo āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ mgon po de bzhin gshegs pa kun/ /khyed kyis lha la dbang skur cig /ces gsol ba btab pas/ sangs rgyas de rnams he ru ka'i gzugs su gyur nas bdud rtsi lngas gang ba'i bum pas dbang bskur ba na/ me tog gi char 'bab pa dang / rnga'i sgra grags pa dang / gur gum gyi char 'bab pa dang / gzugs rdo rje ma la sogs pas mchod

pa dang / rdo rje'i glu/ spyan ma la sogs pas len pa dang / rig pa'i rgyal po khro bo rnams kyis bgegs bskrad cing dbang bskur/ chu'i lhag ma cung zad yar 'khyil ba las rang gi rigs kyi bdag pos dbu brgyan pa ni/ gtso bo yab yum la mi bskyod pa/ puska sī dang go rī la mi bskyod pa/ sha ba rī dang tso rī la rnam par snang mdzad/ tsaṇḍa lī dang bee tā lī la rin chen 'byung ldan/ ḍombi nī dang ghasma rī la snang ba mtha' yas kyis dbu brgyan par gyur/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta badzra swa bhā wa ātma ska|྅ haṃ/ ces sngags kyis rgyas gdab// de nas mchod pa byin brlabs ni/ skyes sarba saṃ theg dha ni āḥhūm̐ swā hās bsangs/ skyed swa bhā wa 〈khyuḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā ba shurnyo3 haṃ gis sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las/ a las thod pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du/ hūm̐ 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub

༄༅/ /pa'i bsang gtor/ mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me tog /bdug spros/ snang gsal/ dri/ zhal zas/ rol mo la sogs pa'i mchod pa'i yo byad rnams rang bzhin stong pa/ byed las dbang po drug gi spyod yul du zag pa med pa'i bde ba skyed nus par gyur/ oṃ sarba saṃ sho dha ni āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥkhaṃ ram̐ āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ nī rī ti hūm̐ kha āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ badzra pursha āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ badzra dhu pe āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ badzra ā lo ke āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ badzra garnye āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ badzra ni widre āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ badzra shabha āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ rol mo bya zhing / oṃ badzra ghaṇḍa ra ṇi ta pra ra ṇi ta saṃ pra ra ṇi ta sarba buddha kṣe tra pra tsa li te pra dzñā pa ra mi tā nā da saṃ bha wa badzra dharmalha da ya sarnyo ṣa ni hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hoḥ.āḥkhaṃ swā hā/ dag cing dri med yid 'ong ba'i/ /sngags kyi bsang gtor mchog 'di dag/

mchog tu dad pas khyed la 'bul/ /ci bde bar ni bzhes su gsol/ /oṃ shrī he ru ka sa pa ri wā ra sarba saṃ sho dha ni āḥhūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ dag cing dri med yid 'ong ba'i/ /sngags kyi mchod yon mchog 'di dag /mchog tu dad pas khyed la 'bul/ /ci bde bar ni bzhes su gsol/ /oṃ shrī he ru ka sa pa ri wā ra dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥkhaṃ ram̐ āḥhūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ dag cing dri med yid 'ong ba'i/ /sngags kyi zhabs bsil mchog 'di dag /mchog tu dad pas khyed la 'bul/ /ci bde bar ni bzhes su gsol/ /oṃ shrī he ru ka sa pa ri wā ra ni rī ti hūm̐ kha āḥhūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ me tog 'di ni bzang zhing dge/ /dag pa'i skye gnas las dag pa//bdag gis dad pas 'bul lags kyi/ /bzhes nas bdag la dgyes par mdzod/ /oṃ shrī he ru ka sa pa ri wā ra badzra pursha āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ nags tshal las byung

༄༅/ /phan pa yi/ /gang zhig dri dang bdug spos mchog /bdag gis dad pas 'bul lags kyi/ /bzhes nas bdag la dgyes par mdzod/ /oṃ shrī he ru ka sa pa ri wā ra badzra dhā pe āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ srin po 'joms shing dag byed la/ /dge zhing mun pa rnam sel ba/ /bdag gis dad pas 'bul lags kyi//bzhes nas bdag la dgyes per mdzod/ /oṃ shrī he ru ka sa pa ri wā ra badzra ā lo ke āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ lhan cig skyes dang sbyar ba'i dri/ /tshim byed dag pa'i bdud rtsi 'di/ /bdag gis dad pas 'bul lags kyi/ /bzhes nas bdag la dgyes par mdzod/ /oṃ shrī he ru ka sa pa ri wā ra badzra gandhe āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ bshos gtsang bza' ba dang bcas pa'i/ /kha dog dri dang ro ldan pa/ /bdag gis dad pas 'bul lags kyi/ /bzhes nas bdag la dgyes par mdzod/ /oṃ shrī

he ru ka sa pa ri wā ra badzra nai wi dre āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ sna tshogs dril bu'i sgra rnams dang / /cang te'u la sogs sgra yi tshogs/ /bdag gis dad pas 'bul lags kyi/ /bzhes nas bdag la dgyes par mdzod/ /oṃ shrī he ru ka sa pa ri wā ra badzra shabha āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ ces chu gsum nyer spyod rol mo dang / go rī sogs lha mo brgyad kyi mchod pa sta gon skabs su bsdu na/ dkar mo ri dwags mtshan ma 'dzin/ /chom rkun bdud las rgyal ba'i snod/ /ro langs ma ni chu lag ma/ /ghasma rī ni sman 'dzin zhing //pukka sī ni rdo rje'i lag /de bzhin ri khrod ma ro 'dzin/ /gdol pa mo ni cang te'u brdung / /'di rnams kyis ni gtso bo mchod/ /'dod chags chen po'i rjes chags pas/ /g.yung mos sku la 'khyud pa nyid/ /oṃ go rī haṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ tso rī rtsa āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ bee tā lī baṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ ghasma rī rghaṃ āḥhūm̐ swāhā/ oṃ

༄༅/ /puska sī paṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ sha ba rī shaṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ tsaṇḍa lī rtsa āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ ḍombi ni ḍo āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ dngos gzhi'i skabs su rgyas par spro na/zla zhun byang sems ga bur gyis gang ba'i/ /padma'i snod 'dzin lha mo go rī ma/ /zhing gi rdul dang mnyam par sprul nas kyang / /bde chen mngon par 'phel slad lha rnams mchod/ /oṃ go rī rga āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ nyi 'od mdangs chags rang byung me tog ni/ /sihlas yongs bkang snod 'dzin tso rī ma/ /zhing gi rdul dang mnyam par sprul nas kyang / /gtum mo'i nus pa rgyas phyir lha rnams mchod/ /oṃ tso rī rtsa āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ nang gi gdung ba sel byed gla rtsi ste/ /rdo rje dri chu'i snod 'dzin bee tā li/ /zhing gi rdul dang mnyam par sprul nas kyang / /mtshan 'dzin dri ma sbyong phyir lha rnams mchod/ /oṃ bee tā li baṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ bzhi mnyam bdud

rtsis gang ba'i thod pa yis/ /phyag gnyis rtag tu brel gyur ghasma rī/ /zhing gi rdul dang mnyam par sprul nas kyang / /'chi med thob par bya phyir lha rnams mchod/ /oṃ ghasma rī rghaṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ swā li skyes pa rab brjod tsandan dmar/ /rdo rje stobs kyi snod 'dzin pukka sī/ /zhing gi rdul dang mnyam par sprul nas kyang / /mtha' yas mthu stobs rgyas phyir lha rnams mchod/ /oṃ puska sī paṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ ro bcud sbrang rtsi'i btung ba dang bcas pa'i/ /rnal 'byor lhung bzed thogs pa'i ri khrod ma/ /zhing gi rdul dang mnyam par sprul nas kyang / /rdo rje'i lus thob bya phyir lha rnams mchod/ /oṃ sha ba rī shaṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ gzhom med nā da'i rang bzhin cang telā /dbyangs gsal rdo rje'i sgra sgrogs tsaṇḍa lī/ /zhing gi rdul dang mnyam par sprul nas kyang / /rdo rje chos ni 'grub phyir lha rnams

༄/ /mchod//oṃ tsaṇḍa lī rtsa ānghruhūm̐3 hā/dathagās spus snoms par wīkyi las krotram̐ zlo zlozhu//ṭīg med yongs su bskyed patweshombinid/ /zhes/ spyal dang/snamyu pa/sdirnikās kyadī //bdā staḍi ༷byar mad thab phyar lha rnaspras ༷sad//sdu ḍasba hūṃ ḍa āḥnghru swā hā/ thams cad la'ang mthaḍi gal dang bcas pa bya'// ma 3 ba hū/'i bad ghaṭa spyaḥdro tram̐rti tram̐s rdar dral bdī la/thams cadā dngas dā' rang bzhan mchag/gdad na~X thardzuswā cad bdag nyad gnas//thabs dang shas rab gnyazi mdā ༷'a//kya'ardarja~Xphyag ḍishes/ste/bdag ma༄ masnan mgul nas 'byud/ོ/dbu skra ra po gyan tu 'bazlo//zhaldu brgyad pa la spyan gsum pa//mgan pa da la gus phyag 'al//spya ba' nga na nag pa mas//dkar dang dmar pa g.yas dang g.yan//gang ga lhag ma' zhal rnams

ni/ /nag pa de la bdag phyag 'tshal/ /glang po rta bong glang rnga mo/ /mi dang sha ra bha byi la/ /g.yas pa'i phyag brgyad la gnas pa'i/ /thod pa 'dzin la bdag phyag 'tshal/ /sa dang chu dang rlung dang me/ /zla nyi gshin rje gsang ba pa/ /g.yon pa'i phyag brgyad la gnas pa'i/ /thod pa 'dzin la bdag phyag 'tshal//zhabs bzhi yis ni bdud bzhi po/ /mnyam par mnan zhing gcer bu nyid/ /nyi mar zhabs g.yas brkyang dang bskum/ /gar mdzad de la bdag phyag 'tshal//'khor lo bzhi yi bdag nyid mdzes/ /'dzag pa'i mgo bos rnam par brgyan/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rnam dag pa'i/ /phyag rgya lngas ni rnam par brgyan//sna tshogs rdo rje spyi bor 'dzin/ /dpral bar rigs kyi bdag po nyid/ /dam pa'i dga' ba yang dag thob/ /bde chen de la bdag phyag 'tshal/ /rga las

༄༅/ /skyes pa'i go rī shar/ /kha dog nag cing g.yon pa nya/ /g.yas pa na ni gri gug 'dzin/ /tshangs pa mnan la bdag phyag 'tshal/ /rtsa las byung ba'i chom rkun ma/ /btsod kyi kha dog lho phyogs su/ /phyag na phag dang cang te'u bsnams/ /dbang po mnan la bdag phyag 'tshal/ /baṃ las skyes pa'i ser mo nub/ /ro langs ma ni nye dbang mnan/ /phyag g.yon lhung bzed g.yas pa yis/ /rus sbal 'dzin la bdag phyag 'tshal/ /ghasma rī ni byang gi sgor/ /ljang gu rghaṃ las byung ba yi/ /phyag na sgrul dang thod pas brel/ /drag po mnan la bdag phyag 'tshal/ /gshin rje mnan zhing paṃ las byung / /g.yon pa dgra stu seng ge g.yas/ /dbang ldan tu ni 'jigs gzugs ma/ /phyag 'tshal puska sī sngon la'o/ /ri khrod ma dkar shaṃ las byung / /me ru gnod sbyin steng du

gnas/ /g.yon na gsil byed g.yas pa na/ /dge slong 'dzin la bdag phyag 'tshal/ /gtum mo nam mkha'i sngo bsangs ma/ /srin por rtsa las byung ba yi//g.yon na thong gzhol 'khor lo g.yas/ /phyag 'tshal srin po mnan khyod la'o/ /ḍo las zhabrungs pa'i g.yung mo ni/ /rlung mtshams thag bzang ris steng gshegs/ /phyag g.yon sdig mdzub g.yas rdo rje/ /sna tshogs mdog la bdag phyag 'tshal/ /skyil krung phyed pa'i gar gyis gnas/ /phyag rgya lnga yis rnam par brgyan/ /gcer bu spyan gsum thams cad la/ /bdag ni gus pas phyag 'tshal 'o1/ /phung po khams rnams rnam dag pa/ /byang chub sems las byung ba yi/ /bde rab ster 'di thams cad la/ /dngos po kun gyis phyag 'tshal lo/ /nyid kyi phyag na gzung ba yi/ /phyag mtshan sa bon las byung ba'i/ /bde chen

༄7/ /'dod pa thams cad la/ /rtag tu yang dag phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang zhig nyi zla kha sbyor gnas sa bon/ /gnyis las skyes pa'i gtso bo rig mar bcas/ /nyid kyis nyid kyi dkyil 'khor 'di la ni/ /'jig rten gsum po sprul par mdzad dang ldan/ /nyid la 'di dag thams cad ma lus pa'i//zhi ba bde gsol rig ma bsdu byed pa'i/ /shes rab chags pa bdud rtsi'i ro nyid kyis/ /gnas su zhi ba de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mkha' 'gro ma gtso kye'i rdo rje/ /lha mo 'khor lo bcas bstod pas/ /bdag gis bsod nams gang thob pa/ /des ni 'jig rten de mtshungs shog /ces slob dpon mtsho skyes rdo rjes mdzad pa'i bstod pa nyi shu pas bstod/ 7/ gzungs thag gi sne g.yon pa'i khu tshur gyis bzung la/ sngags kyi 'od zer gzungs thag la 'khril nas rbershang bas/ bcom ldan 'das yab yum gyi

thugs rgyud bskul/ byang chub sems kyis bum pa gang bar gyur / oṃ de wa pi tsu badzra hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes snying po'o// oṃ badzra karta ri he badzrī ya hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes nye ba'i snying posno// oṃ aṭī na nā ya/ skra gorbha ke sha banma ne/ tsa tur bi sha ti ne tru ya/ kho ḍa sha bhu dzā ya/ kṛṣṭa dzi mū ta wa pu ṣe/ ka pā la mā la a ni kai ṅgā ri ṇi/ ātma ta kru ra tsitta la/ andhentu rdaṣṭi ne/ oṃ mā ra ya mā ra ya/ kā ra ya kā ra ya/ gardza ya gardza ya/ tardza ya tardza ya/ 3( ṣa ya rbesto ṣa ya/ sapta swa ga rā na/bandha bandha/ nā ga aṣṭa kā na/ kṛṇḍa grohā/ sha trun ha hā hi hi hu hū he hai ho ho haṃ haḥphaṭa swā hā/ rtsa ba'i sngags so// oṃ go ri ge āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ tso rī rtsa āḥhūm̐ swā hā/oṃ bee tā lī baṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ ghasma rī rghaṃ ārtswahūm̐ swāhā/ oṃ pukka sī paṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ sha ba rī shaṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ tsaṇḍa snyi rtsa āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ ḍombi ni ḍo

da༅༅/ /āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ zhes gtso 'bor snying po brgya rtsa la sogs pa bzlas pa'i mthar thod pa'i bdud rtsi bum par blugs pas/ bcom ldan 'das yab yum 'a31ra dang bcas pa 'od du zhu ba bum chu dang ro gcig tu gyur par bsam/ las thams cad pa'i bum pa'i dbus dang / sna tshogs rdo rje'i mtshan ma dang bcas pa padma dang nyi ma'i steng du/ khro bo bdud rtsi 'khyil ba sku mdog sngon po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas rdo rje bsnams shing g.yon sdigs mdzub mdzad pa/ zhabs g.yon brkyang ba'i stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ dbu skra dang smin ma sma ra dmar ser 'bar ba/ spyan gsum dmar la zlum zhing zhal mche ba gtsigs pa/ sku sbom zhing thung la gsus pa 'phyang ba/ sgrul gyi chun po brgyad kyis brgyan pa/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can no/ /bar srung 'bor gyi skabs ltar bskyed/ oṃ badzra

purmye āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ skyed badzra dhu pe āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ skyed badzra garnye āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ skyed badzra ni widre āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ skyes badzra ā 31 ke āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ skye( badzra shabha āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ ces nyer spyod lnga dang rol mos mchod/ rnam dag chos kyi dbyings las ma g.yos kyang / /thabs kyis sprul sku sna tshogs ston mdzad cing / /gdug pa 'dul phyir khro bo'i skur ston pa/ /khro rgyal bdud rtsi 'khyil pa khyod la 'dud/ /ces bstod/ gzungs thag las bum gyi steng du spos la bzung ste/ skyed badzra a mṛ ta kuṇḍa lī hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces brgya rtsa sogs bzlas nas/ bdag cag dpon slob 'khor dang bcas pa'i bgegs ma rungs pa rnams las ma grub kyi bar du bsrung du gsol/ zhes phrin las bcol/ slob ma rjes su 'dzin pa'i tshe skabs 'dir las bum gyi chus dgyes rdor gyi sku brnyan la khrus gsol/des dpon slob thams cad la khrus bya zhing gnas khang rdzas dang yo byad kun la 'thor/yungs kar dang zan bsres pas lus la dril phyis

dbyugyi byas te lus ngag yid gsum gyi dri ma bsdus par bkām la changs bu byas pa gyo mo'i nang du blugs la rgyab tu bor bas byur bsal/ ༈ zhi ba'i sbyin sreg yig rnying las 'byung ba ltar ram spyi khyab rgyas pa zhig bya ste sgrub mchod kyi dkyus su de dag mi dgos sa/// ༈ bzhi pa slob ma sta gon ni/ slob ma'i bar chad bsal ba'i don du sngon 'gro'i skabs ltar 'byung po la gtor ma btang / sdom ni/ khrus byas maṇḍal phul nas ni/ /gzhan don la bskul gsol ba gdab/ /spro ba bskyed cing nyan par bskul/ /sgrib sbyang tshogs bsags sems bskyed cing / /gnas gsum byin brlabs mchod byas la/ /so shing sbyin zhing skyor chu blud/ /ku sha sbyin zhing srung skud/ gdag /chos bshad rmi lam brtag pa'o/ /zhes pa rnams so/ /de la nyer lnga'i bar zur du ma gyur pa'i slob ma rnams yol ba'i phyi rol du las thams cad pa'i chus khrus byas/ slob dpon la phyag gsum sngon du 'gro bas/ sngon 'gro sta gon gyi chos rnams zhu ba'i yon tu mardzo 'bul/ thal mo sbyar te lubod pa la/ bla mas/ sngags kyi dngos grub don gnyer gang / /dkyil 'khor

྅dir ni gzhug par bya/ /bsod nams 'dod pas de las gzhan/ /gzhan ni 'jig rten pha rol gnyer/ /slar yang dad dang lngan pa yis/ /'jig rten pha rol la lkedamigs te/ dhe/blo ldan dkyil 'bar gzhug par bya/ /'di yi 'bras bu mi gnyer te/ /gal te 'di 'bras don gnyeram̐ rne/ /'jig rten /rmo hūṃl 'o/spyob mo 'gyur/ /'jeg rten pha rol la dmigs na/ /'bad pa med par 'di 'bras 'khru/ba/ /ces pa'i don bkrol la bshad do/ /de nas thun mong ma yin paṣṭṛ hūṃms bskyed pa'i don tu slob mas gsol ba dzidab pa ni/ dga' chen khyod bdag ston pa pos/ /slob dpon khyod ni dgongs su gsol/ /byang chub chen pa'i tshul bstan pa/ /sngom pa rnams kyang bdag la stsal/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te/ /skyabs gsum dag kyang bdag la stsol/ /thar pa chen pa'i grong mchog ltu/ /mgon/ pos

༄7/ /bdag ni 'jurge par 'tshal zhes lan gsum/ sngags kyi theg par blo dgug cing spro ba bskyed pa ni/ bu tshur theg pa chen po pa/ /khyod ni tshul chen snod yin gyi/ /gsang sngags spyod tshul cho ga ni/ /khyod la yang dag bstan par bya/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas gang 'das dang / /gang dag de bzhin ma byon dang / /da ltar byung ba'i rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /'gro la phan phyir bzhugs pa rnams/ /de dag kun gyis gsang sngags kyi/ /cho ga mchog bzangatsho'adi mkhyen nas/ /dpa' bos byang chub shing drung du/ /thams cad mkhyen pa tshad med brnyes/ /gsang sngags sbyor ba mnyam med nga/sa/ /skyob pa sangs rgyas he ru kas/ /bdud sde shin tu mi bzad pa/ /dpung chen dag kyang de yis bcom/ /de bas kun mkhyen thob bya'i phyir/ /bu yis/ blo gros 'di gyis shig /ces dang / nyan par gdams pa ni/

rtog pa thams cad legs par bsdus nas ni/ /shin tu bsam pa bzang po ldan pas nyon/ /brjed ngas blo la he ru ka sogs pa'i/ /bde bar gshegs pa rnams kyis byin mi rlob/ /ces pa'i don go bar bya/rgyud dag pa'i phyir lnga rnam par dag par bya ste/bdag gis sdig pa bgyis pa dang / /bgyid du bstsal dang yi rang ba sangs rgyas spyan sngar mchis nas su/ /de dag thams cad bshags par bya/ /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dang / /rang rgyal dgra bcom 'a11 rnams kyi/ /sgom dang bzlas brjod bsod nams gang / /de la bdag ni yi rang ngo / /bdag gi dge ba'i las rnams 'di dag gis/ /'jig rten 'dir ni myur du sangs rgyas shog /'gro la phan phyir chos rnams ston bgyid cing / /sems can sdug bsngal mang pos gzir las dgrol/ /sems bskyed mngon par sangs rgyas dang //

༄tsho/ /chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba dang / /byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyi mchog /de la bdag ni skyabs su mchi/ /sangs rgyas 'byung ba ji lta bar/ /skal ldan byang chub sems dpa' yis/ /byang chub sems ni bskyed pa ltar/ /deng nyid du ni sems bskyed do/ /zhes lan gsum/ de nas slob rme lhar bskyed pa ni/ khyed rang rnams skad cig gis sna tshogs padma'i ze'u 'brur ro'i snying gar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la skyil krung phyed pa'i gar gyis bzhugs pa'i bcom ldan 'das kye rdo rje sku mdog sngon po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas rdo rje dang g.yon thod pa 'dzin cing / g.yon pa'i gru mor kha ṭwāṃ ga dang ldan pa/ dbu skra ser po gyen tu brdzes pa/ thod pa skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang / rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal can/ spyan gsum pa/ zhal mche ba gtsigs pa/ phyag rgya drug gis

brgyan par bye/mas shig /ces brjod cing dri bzang gi chus snying kha/ mgrin pa/ spyi bo rnams su byugs la/ hūm̐ āḥskyed/ zhes brjod/ yang de bzhin tu rdo rje gtugs la/ snying gar hūm̐ las lnge/ rje 11na po hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ mgrin par āḥlas padma dmar po āḥs mtshan pa/ spyi bor oṃ las 'khor lo dkar po oṃ gyis mtshan pa'i 'od zer lcags kyu lta bus/sku dang gsung dang thugs rdo rje rnams bkug ste/ rang rang gi sa bon la thim par blo/mas shig byas la/slob dpon gyis dril bu 'brol bzhin pas me tog la sogs pa slob ma'i gnas so sor 'bul ba'i tshul byas la/ oṃ badzra puspro āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ badzra dhu pe āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ badzra gandhe āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ badzra ni widre āḥhūṃ swā hā/ oṃ badzra ā lo ke āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ ces nyer spyod lngas mchod pas rigs gsum gyi lha mnyes par bsam pa ni sku gsung thugs kyi lhas slob ma lhag par gnas par byas pa yin no/ /de nas dngos grub kyi mtshan ma brtag pa'i don tu so shing sbyin pa ni/

da༅gyi/ /ji skad du/ u dum wā ra a shwa twa/ /me tog bcings shing dri yis byugs/ /sor ni bcu gnyis tshad du bya/ /zhes gsungs pa lta bu'i so shing ngam/ de dag ma rnyed na/ lcang ma'am/ shug pa'am/ bal bu la sogs pa 'bus ma zos shing / ya yo gas chag la sogs pa'i skyon dang bral ba sor bcu gnyis pa dri'i chus brlan zhing / rtse mor me tog sngon po bcings pa/ skyes khu/ཿhūm̐ bzlas te byin la/ ba'i rnam lngas byugs pa'i maṇḍal khru gang ngam khru bzhi pa byas nas/ so 'drud pa'i tshul gyis/ de'i dbus su dor du gzhug pa ni/shar phyogs ngos su kha bltas te/ /mi smra bar ni tre/ shing bca'/ /bca' zhing de bzhin mi dgas shing / /phan tshun tu yang mi 'dor ro/ /so shing mdun tu drang por dor/ /zhes pa bzhin so shing maṇḍal du dor mdzod byas la 'dor du bcug pas/ rtse mo bdag dang gyen du lta na mchog gi dngos grub/ shar lho nub tu lta na dngos grub 'bring / mtshams dang byang du lta na 'jig rten pa'i dngos grub/ 'og tu bltas na sa 'og gi dngos grub 'grub par lung bstan no/ /sgrib pa sbyong ba'i

don tu khyor chu sbyin pa ni/ dri bzang gi chu/ skye'o hrīḥbi shuddha dharmāḥsarba pā pā ni tsā su bi theg dha ya sarba bi kalpun a pā na ya hūm̐ gis bsngags te/ hub gsum 'thung du gzhug cing rnam rtog thams cad sbyangs bar bsam/ rmi lam gyi ltas brtag pa'i don tu/ skyes āḥhūm̐ bzlas pa'i ku sha nyung ba sngas dang / mang ba stan tu sbyin/ bar chad srung ba'i phyir skud pa dmar po la rtsa ba'i sngags kyis btab pa'i srung skud nā/dud pa gsum dang ldan pa skyes pa'i dpung pa g.yon dang / bud med kyi g.yas su gdab/ de la dri bzang chus byug /spro ba bskyed pa'i phyir chos bshad pa ni/ 'jig rten khams ni ma lus par/ /thams cad mkhyen pa 'byung mi 'gyur/ /u dum wā ra'i me tog bzhin/ /brgya lam na ni res 'ga' bzhin/ /'byung 'gyur yang ni mi 'byung srid/ /gsang sngags spyod pa'i tshul 'byung ba/ /de bas kyang ni dkon pa ste/ /gnyis med zab mo'i spyod tshul 'dis/ /sems can sangs rgyas byed pa yin/ /bskal pa grangs med
