༄7/ /mang por ni/ /sngon tu byas pa'i rnam smin gang / /de kun zad par 'gyur ba ni/ /zab mo'i dkyil 'khor mthong bas so zhes brjod la rang gnas su btang / slob dpon gyis sta gon gyi lha la mchod bstod mdor bsdus dang yi ge brgya pa ci 'grub bzlas pas nongs pa 'chags/ dge ba sngo/ mar me dang spos sogs mchod pa rgyun ma chad par phul/ slob ma rnams bla ma dang dkyil 'khor la mgo phyogs pas nyal te rmi lam gang byung nangs par bla ma la zhu shing bzang na skal ba dang ldan par bzung la/ ngan na drag po'i sbyin sreg gam/ ba'i rnam lnga'i btung ba la 'khyil ba'i sngags bzlas pa'am bdud rtsi lnga'i chu sbyin/ bzang ngan gang byung yang rmi lam dang snang ba bsres la sgyu ma'i don dran par byar bcug ste/ gzugs ni dbu ba gdos pa 'dra/ /dbu ba de la snying po med/ /de la rnal 'byor blo mi ltos/ /chos kun de ltar yid la byos/ /zhes tshor ba sogs la'ang de bzhin tu sbyar la bshad do/ ༈ /lnga pa dngos gzhi la gsum/ dkyil 'khor zhag gi cho ga /dbang bskur ba/ rjes kyi bya ba'o/ /dang po la gsum/ thig tshon gyi cho ga/

dkyil 'khor sgrub pa/ de la mchod pa'o/ /dang po ni/ sta gon dang zhag gis bar du chod na nang par bskyed rim rgyas bsdu rim yan grub nas he ru ka phyag gnyis pa'i rnam pas las bya/ bar ma chod na bskyed rirme bskyar bldabs mi dgos/ dkyil 'khor gyi gnyis 'gyur gyi srad bu gsar pa lnga tshan re re kha dog lngar bsgyur ba tshangs bur byas te rin po che'am thod pa'i snod du dbus su sngon po/ phyogs bzhir dkar ser dmar ljang bkod la/oṃ badzra a mṛ ta kuṇḍa lī ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭa ces bsangs/ oṃ swa bhā wa shuddhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā ba shukhro3 haṃ gis sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las srad bu sngon po hūm̐ las mi bskyod dgyes pa rdo rje sngon po/ dkar po zlo las rnam snang dgyes pa rdo rje dkar po/ ser po āo las rin 'byung dgyes pa rdo rje ser po/ dmar po dzrī las snang mtha' dgyes pa rdo rje dmar po/ ljang gu༄ khaṃ las don yod dgyes pa rdo rje ljang gu rnams zhal brgyad dang ldan pa'i rtsa zhal rang rang gi sku mdog dang mtshungs shing /

༄༅/ /g.yas zhal kunda ltar dkar ba/ g.yon zhal dmar zhing cher 'jigs pa/ lhag ma g.yas zhal gnyis dang g.yon zhal gnyis bung ba ltar nag cing / steng zhal dud kha gtsigs pa'i nyams can/ spyan nyi shu rtsa bzhi phye ba/ dbu skra ser po gyen tu brdzes pa/ dpral ba'i steng du thod pa lnga lnga'i phreng ba dang / sna tshogs rdo rje spyi bor 'dzin pa/ zhal nas hūm̐ gi sgra spro zhing / 'khor lo/ snyan cha/ mgul rgyan/ phyag zhabs kyi gdu bu/ ska rags/ thal bas byugs pa ste phyag rgya drug dang ldan pa/ mgo bo lnga bcu'i phreng ba'i do shal 'phyang ba/ phyag bcu drug gi g.yas kyi phyag gi thod pa brgyad na/ rim pa bzhin tu/glang po che dkar po/ rta sngon po/ bong bu kham pa/ glang dmar po/ rnga mong thal kar/ mi dmar po/ sha ra bha sngon po/ byi la gwa pa/ g.yon gyi phyag gi thod pa

brgyad na/ sa'i lha mo ser mo/ chu'i lha mo dkar mo/ rlung gi lha mo dud kha/ me'i lha mo dmar mo/ zla ba'i lha mo dkar mo/ nyi ma'i lha mo dmar mo/ gshin rje nag po/ nor bdag ser po/ snying gar thal mo sbyar ba rnams bsnams pa'i phyag dang po gnyis kyis yum la 'khyud pa/ gcer bu zhabs bzhi'i mdun ma gnyis g.yas brkyang ba'i gar dang rgyab ma gnyis skyil krung phyed pa'i stabs kyis nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la bdud bzhi mnyam par mnan zhing / gar gyi nyams dgu dang ldan pa/ 'jigs pa'ang 'jigs par mdzad pa/ rang gi mig nyi zla 'bar ba'i 'od zer gyis/ sta gon gyi lha'i thugs ka nas ye shes kyi thig skud lnga spyan drangs/ so so'i phyag rgya bcings la spro/ rī dzaḥzhes pas ye shes pa dgug ce ṇḍashrī hūm̐ gis bzhugabee tā lī baṃ gyis bcings/ ghasma rī the1ཿ zhes pas dgyes par byas/ skyes dzaḥhūm̐

༄༅/ /baṃ hoḥkhaṃ ram̐ āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ zhes pas mchod yon/ oṃ nī ri ti hūm̐ khaḥ.āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ zhes pas zhabs bsil/ oṃ badzra purmye āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ badzra dhu pe āḥhūm̐ swā hā/oṃ badzra gandhe āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ badzra ni widre āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ badzra ā 31 ke āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ zhes pa'i mchod pa lngas mchod/ oṃ ma hā badzra hūm̐/ oṃ badzra gharbhe āḥ zhes pas rdo rje dang dril bu bzung la/ zhe sdang rdo rjer phyag 'tshal bstod/ /gti mug rdo rjer phyag 'tshal bstod/ /ser sna rdo rje bdag la skyobs/ /'dod chags rdo rje bdag la stsol//phrag dog rdo rje nga rgyal te/ /sgyu 'phrul rdo rje mgon po kun/ /las kun rab tu sgrub byed pa/ /thams cad rdo rje bdag mgur 'gyur/ /zhes pas bstod/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ rigs lnga zhu ba thig skud so se'i rnam par gyur/ rang nyid he ru ka dang slob ma ghasma rīr gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ brjod bzhin pas lnga po gcig tu bsgril zhing bskyil nas snod du

bzhag/ skyed badzra sa ma ya gyu tra mā ti kra ma hūm̐/ brgya rtsas brtan par bya/ thig skud kyi mtha' gnyis dang dbus su skyed dkar āḥdamar hūm̐ mthing gis mtshan par gyur/de nas dang por ye shes kyi thig gdab pa ni/slob dpon shar na gnas pas/ dza dzaḥ zhes thig gi sna grogs kyi lag tu gtad/ des kyang skud pa'i sna bzung la rgyab nas bskor te nub tu song la/ skyes badzra sa ma ya sdo/ tra ma ti kra ma ti/ zhes brjod cing / thig skud kyi sgras 'jig rten gyi khams kyi bde bar gshegs pa thams cad la/ khyed kyis sems can gyi don mdzad pa'i dus yin ces/ /zhes ba//la bar sdo/ra bar mos la slob dpon rdor dril dang bcas pa'i khu tshur g.yon pas lte ba'i thad du bzung / g.yas kyi mtheb srin gyis steng nas bcus te 'og nas gyen tu lan gsum btab/de bzhin tu/ grogs lho dang / slob dpon rgyab nas bskor te byang du gnas pas gnyis pa/ de nas grogs kyis rgyab nas bskor te dbang ldan dang / slob dpon gyis bskor te mer 'dug la shar gyi logs thig /slob mas

ra༅༅/ /bskor te bden bral dang / slob dpon gyis bskor te rlung du gnas pas nub kyi logs thig /slob dpon de nyid dang / grogs kyis bskor te dbang ldan tu gnas pas byang gi logs thig /slob dpon gyis rgyab nas bskor te me dang / grogs kyis bskor te bden bral du gnas pas lho'i logs thig /slob dpon de nyid dang / grogs kyis bskor te rlung du gnas pas zur thig dang po/slob dpon bden bral dang /grogs dbang ldan tu gnas pas zur thig gnyis pa rnams gdab ste srad bu chad pa dang phyogs 'khrul ring thung sogs skyon spang ba nan tan tu bya/thams cad du g.yas bskor gyis 'gro zhing slob dpon dbang ldan dang slob ma me mtshams su mi 'a11(/ /de ltar ye thig nam mkhar btab nas/thig skud gzhan dkar chal du spags pas las kyi thig gdab pa ni/ dang po shar nub tshangs thig gdab/ /dbus nas mtha' bar cha bzhi bgo/gcig gis dbus su zlum por bskor/ /shar nub tshangs zlum 'dzom pa nas/ /snga ma'i tshad las gnyis 'gyur gyis/ /g.yas g.yon bya rjes btsal ba'i steng / /lho byang thig gdab de bzhin tu/ /phyogs bzhi'i tshangs zlum 'phrad

mtshams nas/ /bya rjes btsal steng zur thig gdab/ /zur nas zur gyi bya rjes steng / /ngos su gru bzhir bcad pa ni/ /mda' yab phyi mtha'i thig yin no/ /de nyid tshangs nas zur thig bar/ /dum bu drug bgos dum re la//cha chen dang ni sgo tshad grags/ /de yi bzhi cha cha chung ngo / /tshangs nas g.yas g.yon cha chen gnyis/ /dang po phyed gdab phyi ma gdab/ /gnyis pa bzhi char gdab par bya/ /sgo dang sgo khyud sgo 'gram logs/ /mun pa ka ba ka rgyan no/ /lnga pa dbus dor mtha' gnyis gdab/ /drug pa phyed gdab phyi ma gdab/ /rtsig pa 'dod snam pha gu dang / /dra phyed shar bu mda' yab bo/ /dang po dang ni gnyis pa gnyis/ /mda' yab las kyang phyi rol du/ /cha chen gcig gi tshod tsam gdab/ /lnga pa drug pa'i cha rnams ni/ /rang rang zur thig bar du gdab/ /lnga pa'i nang mtha' rtsa ba'i thig /dbus nas cha chen gcig dang gnyis/ /bskor zhing so so'i nang logs nas/ /cha phran res bskor dzo ba dang / /'dab ma mu khyud bcas pa'o/ /de rgyab lha snam cha phran gnyis/ /logs su thig gdab dkyus thig ni/ /shar sgo'i g.yas logs ka rgyan gyi/ /rtse nas nub g.yas ka rgyan rtser/ /dbus su lte ba la reg gdab//

ra༅༅ shar sgo'i g.yon nas nub sgo'i g.yon/ /de bzhin lho byang phan tshun sgo'i/ /g.yas nas g.yas dang g.yon nas g.yon/ /lte ba la reg thig brgyad po/ /dur khrod sa gzhi'i mtha' bar gdab/ /padma'i mu khyud nang skor dang / /tshangs zur so so 'doms pa nas/ /logs nas logs dang zur nas zur/ /gru bzhi bsnol ma'ang spro na gdab/ /mda' yab phyi ru sgo tshad gcig /tshangs nas ka rgyan phyi thig bar/ /rta bab don tu bzhi char gdab/ /tshangs nas g.yas g.yon brgyad bdun drug /lnga rnams bcad pas gser snam dang / /shar bu rin chen mda' yab yul/ /gser snam phyi dang tshangs thig nas/ /cha chung gnyis bskor glang rgyab ste/ /mda' thig phyi dang tshangs nas gnyis/ /dor te gnyis bskor glang sna snyesprubyung / /nang du sum cha re yang ngo / /mda' nas gcig dang tshangs nas gsum/ /dor te ka rgyan rtse nas bzung / /steng du bskor ro mda' nas gnyis/ /tshangs nas phyed lnga 'phags pa nas/ /tshad des bskor ba rdo rwa 'o/ /rta bab snam bu'i steng nas phyir/ /cha chen gcig gdab dbus dor la/ /mtha' gnyis bcad pas padma dang / /'khor lo gdugs dang dbus rwa'i yul/ /dbus rwa'i smad cha

sgo tshad mnyam/ /rtse mo de phyed gsegs 'gros bcad/ /mda' yab zur nas zlum thig bsgos/ /de rgyab sgo tshad gcig gsum bgo /dang po pad rwa phyogs re la/ /brgyad char bsil zhing phyi ma gnyis/ /dur khrod sa ste phyogs mtshams rnams/ /dkyus thig rtses bcad cha phran ni/ /gsum gyi tshad tsam phyogs bzhi zlum/ /mtshams bzhi gzhu mchog dbyibs su bcad/ /de rgyab cha chen gcig gnyis bgos/ /nang ma rdo ra phyi ma ni/ /me ri'i phyogs rer bzhi'am drug /bcad de g.yon bskor 'bar bar bya/ /ye shes kyi thig skud la/ tso( badzra puṣṭi āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ skyed badzra dhu pe āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ skye( badzra gandhe āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ skye( badzra ni widre āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ badzra ā lo ke āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ badzra shabha āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ ces nyer spyod lnga dang rol mos mchod/ ye shes kyi thig skud lnga po sta gon gyi lha'i thugs kar gshegs par gyur/ ༈ rdul tshon kha dog lnga dbus sngon po sogs thig skud ltar bkod/ oṃ badzra a mṛ ta kuṇḍa lī ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭa ces bsangs/ oṃ swa bhā wa shuddhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā ba shukhro3

༄7/ /haṃ gis sbyangs/stong pa'i ngang las/ rdul tshon sngon po hūm̐ las mi bskyod dgyes pa rdo rje sngon po/ dkar po zlo las rnam snang dgyes pa rdo rje dkar po/ ser po āo las rin 'byung dgyes pa rdo rje ser po/ dmar po dzrī las snang mtha' dgyes pa rdo rje dmar po/ ljang gye khaṃ las don yod dgyes pa rdo rje ljang gu rnams zhal brgyad dang ldan pa'i rtsa zhal rang rang gi sku mdog dang mtshungs shing / g.yas zhal kunda ltar dkar ba/ g.yon zhal dmar zhing cher 'jigs pa/ lhag ma g.yas zhal gnyis dang gaskuston zhal gnyis bung ba ltar nag cing / steng zhal dud kha gtsigs pa'i nyams can/ spyan nyi shu rtsa bzhi phye ba/ dbu skra ser po gyen tu brdzes pa/ dpral ba'i steng du thod pa lnga lnga'i phreng ba dang / sna tshogs rdo rje spyi bor 'dzin pa/ zhal nas hūm̐ gi sgra spro zhing / 'khor lo/ snyan cha/

mgul rgyan/ phyag zhabs kyi gdu bu/ ska rags/ thal bas byugs pa ste phyag rgya drug dang ldan pa/ mgo bo lnga bcu'i phreng ba'i do shal 'phyang ba/ phyag bcu drug gi g.yas kyi phyag gi thod pa brgyad na/ rim pa bzhin tu/ glang po che dkar po/ rta sngon po/ bong bu kham pa/ glang dmar po/ rnga mong thal kar/ mi dmar po/ sha ra bha sngon po/ byi la gwa pa/ g.yon gyi phyag gi thod pa brgyad na/ sa'i lha mo ser mo/ chu'i lha mo dkar mo/ rlung gi lha mo dud kha/ me'i lha mo dmar mo/zla ba'i lha mo dkar mo/ nyi ma'i lha mo dmar mo/ gshin rje nag po/ nor bdag ser po/ snying gar thal mo sbyar ba rnams bsnams pa'i phyag dang po gnyis kyis yum la 'khyud pa/ gcer bu zhabs bzhi'i mdun ma gnyis g.yas brkyang ba'i gar dang rgyab ma gnyis skyil krung phyed pa'i stabs kyis nyi ma'i dkyil

༄༅/ /'khor la bdud bzhi mnyam par mnan zhing / gar gyi nyams dgu dang ldan pa/ 'jigs pa'ang 'jigs par mdzad pa/ rang gi mig nyi zla 'bar ba'i 'od zer gyis/ sta gon gyi lha'i thugs ka nas ye shes kyi rdul tshon so sor spyan drangs/ so so'i phyag rgya bcings la go rī dzaḥ zhes pas ye shes pa dgug tso rī hūm̐ bi/sa bzhugabee tā lī baṃ gyis bcings/ghasma rī hoḥ zhes pas dgyes par byas/skyes dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥkhaṃ ram̐ āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ zhes pas mchod yon/skye/ nī ri ti hūm̐ khaḥ.āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ zhes pas 'bas bsil/ skyed badzra pursha āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ skye( badzra dhu pe āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ skyes badzra gandhe āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ skyes badzra ni widre āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ skyed badzra ā 31 ke āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ zhes pa'i mchod pa lngas mchod/ oṃ ma hā badzra hūm̐/ oṃ badzra gharnye āḥzhes pas rdo rje dang dril bu bzung la/ zhe sdang rdo rjer phyag 'tshal bstod/ /gti mug rdo rjer phyag 'tshal bstod/ /ser sna rdo

rje bdag la skyobs/ /'dod chags rdo rje bdag la stsol/ /phrag dog rdo rje nga rgyal te/ /sgyu 'phrul rdo rje mgon po kun/ /las kun rab tu sgrub byed pa//thams cad rdo rje bdag mgur 'gyur/ /zhes pas bstod/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ rigs lnga zhu ba rdul tshon so se'i rnam par gyur/ oṃ badzra be ga kra ma hūm̐/ zhes ye thig nam mkhar btegs pa'i 'og tu zhugs par mos/ mig gnyis hi hi las nyi zlar sdo/ra/ hi hi zhes brjod la thar pa'i sgor 'jug pa'i sdig sgrib bsal bar mos te dri bzang chus sgo'i phyi thig dbye/ slob dpon gyis byang shar nas g.yas bskor cha chen gcig gi bar du phyi nas rim par dkar ser dmar ljang nag po'i rtsig pa mkhyid gang tsam du g.yon pa'i rdo rje khu tshur gyis 'then cing / thod pas bkab pa'i steng du rdo rje bzhag la/ byebyetra/ dbyings 'di ni dag pa ste/ /sems can khams ni rab sgrol ba/ /rgyal chen dgyes pa rdo rje yi/ /dkyil 'khor rab tu bri bar bya/ /zhes brjod cing me tog gtor nas

da༅༅/ /tshon bra brtag go/de yang / sgo yi nyi shu'i cha ru ni/ /ri mo mnyam par dgye bar bya/ /sbom por dgyes pas nad kyis 'debs/ /phra mos nor rnams rnam par 'jig /yon pos rnam 'gres chad pa yis//bla ma dang ni slob ma 'chi/ /g.yas bskor min par dgyes pa yis/ /tshon ni phur bus btab par 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pa'i skyon dang bral bar bri'o/ /tshon thob ni/ pad lte nag la ze'u 'bru ni/ /sna lnga pad 'dab brgyad dmar po/ /gong ras mu khyud nag po la/ /thod pa'i phreng ngam rdor phreng ser/ /lha snam sgo yi khyams dang bcas/ /phyogs mdog bum pa brgyad kyis mdzes/ /rtsig pa sngo ljang dmar ser dkar/ /'dod snam dmar la sgo khyud kyi//mtshams su zla phyed rdo rjes mtshan/ /pha gu ser po rin chen bkra/ /drwa phyed dkar la gzhi ma nag /shar bu sngon po mda' yab dkar/ /rin chen drwa ba drwa phyed ni/ /chu srin kha nas dpyangs pa dang / /ril ba thur bstan pad 'dab kyi/ /dbyibs can ri mos rnam par mdzes/ /rta bab snam bu 'og rim bzhin/ /gser snam ser la shar bu sngo/ /rin chen dmar la mda' yab dkar/ /de steng padma sna tshogs mdog /'khor lo ser po g.yas g.yon

tu/ /ri dwags pho mo bcas pa'o/ /glang rgyab nang dang rdo rje'i rwa/ /rta bab ka ba phyogs kyi mdog /mun pa nag la rgyan mdzes tshon/ /bar khyams ljang gu pa tra ris/ /rta bab g.yas g.yon bum bzang las/ /'thon pa'i shing la rgyal srid bdun/ /yang na padma mdog lnga dang / /seng sogs rgyal mtshan brgyad spel bya/ /dur khrod sa gzhi ljang gu la/ /chu yis bcad pa'i ling tshe brgyad/ /shing chen brgyad drung phyogs skyong ni/ /shar du brgya byin ser po yis/ /rdo rje bsnams shing glang chen zhon/ /lho ru gshin rje dud pa'i mdog /be con 'dzin cing ma he zhon/ nub tu chu lha dkar po ni/ /sprul zhags 'dzin cing chu srin zhon/ /byang du gnod sgyin gser mdog can/ /dbyug pa thogs nas rta mchog zhon/ /byang shar 'byung po kha dog dkar/ /rtse gsum 'dzin cing khyu mchog zhon/ /shar lhor me lha dmar ser phyag /bgrang phreng ril ba ra skyes zhon/ /lho nub srin po sngo nag ste/ /ral gri phyar nas ro langs zhon/ /nub byang rlung lha ljang nag ni/ /ba dan 'dzin cing sha ba zhon/ /me lha ma gtogs g.yon pa rnams/ /thod pa bsnams pa yum la 'khyud/ 'ung le'i gseb nas lus 'thon zhing / /phyogs skyong bzhon pa'i gdong

ra༅༅ can gyi/ /zhing skyong brgyad ni gri thod 'dzin/ /shar dkar lho sngo nub dmar po/ /byang ser byang shar sogs rim bzhin/ /sngo skya dmar sngo ljang gu'o/ /chu brgyad dbus gnas klu chen brgyad/ /yum bcas sprul mjug thal sbyar can/ /shar dang dbang ldan nas rim bzhin/ /ser dkar dmar nag ser sngo dkar/ /khra bo dag go sprin chen brgyad/ /ser ser dkar sngo dmar sngo ser/ /dkar po rnams so ri bo brgyad/ /sna tshogs dkar gnyis ljang gu phyogs/ /nag po ser gnyis sngon po mtshams/ /so sor me chen 'bar ba brgyad/ /ri rtser mchod rten brgyad po yang / /lho nag shar lho dmar lho nub/ /ljang gu gzhan rnams dkar po'o/ /logs kyi phug par grub chen brgyad/ /ind+ra bo dhi btsun mo shar/ /ku ku ri pa khyi bcas byang / /padma badzra yug sa nub/ /klu sgrub snying po dge slong lho/ /ḍombi stag zhon shar lho ste/ /lū hi nya gsol lho nub mtshams/ /nub byang dril bu pa yum bcas/ /byang shar mda' bsnun mda' gzhu 'dzin/ /dur khrod bkod pa 'jigs rung bri/ /rdo rwa gzhi dkar phreng ba nag /me ri kha dog sna tshogs spel/ /ma brjod spyi ltar shes par bya/ /de nas lha mtshan dgod pa ni//

padma'i dbus su thod pa dkar/ /sna tshogs rdo rjes mtshan pa bri/ /pad 'dab shar nas g.yas bskor du/ /gri gug cang te'u rus sbal sbrul/ /nag dmar ser dang ljang gu'i mdog /byang shar nas brtsams seng ge dang / /dge slong 'khor lo rdo rje rnams/ /sngo dkar ser po sna tshogs mdog /'dod snam shar nas rim pa bzhin/ /pi wang ma ser gling bu dmar/ /rnga zlum ma nag rnga chen dkar/ /bzhad ma ser la sgeg mo dmar/ /glu ma dmar ser gar khra bo/ /me tog ma dkar spos ma nag /mar me ma dmar dri ma ser/ /gzugs dkar ro dmar reg ma ljang / /chos 'byung ma dkar de dag rnams/ /gzugs sam phyag mtshan thig le dgod/ /de ltar tshon bkye grub ma thag tu rdul tshon lhag ma la mchod cing gshegs pa ni/ skyed badzra puṣṭi āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ skyed badzra dhu pe āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ skyed badzra gandhe āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ skyed badzra ni widre āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ skyed badzra ā 31 ke āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ badzra shabhā āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ ces dang / ye shes kyi rdul tshon so sor sta gon gyi lha'i thugs kar gshegs par gyur/ ༈ de nas bum pa rnams spos dang rol

ra༅tsho mos sna drangs dkyil 'khor la lan gsum bskor te rnam rgyal shar dang / gzhan rnams phyogs mtshams/ las bum byang shar du bkod/ bla bre 'phan gdugs lda ldi rgyal mtshan brgyad la sogs pas brgyan/ sku brnyan ris su bris pa'am 'bur du gtod pa'ang bzhugs su gsol/ srung ba'i yan lag tu mda' bo che bzhi dar kha dog skrezhi btags pa dang / ral gri bzhi dang / me long bzhi la sogs pa zur bzhir btsug la tshon skud kyi drwa ba sbrel/ nyer spyod lnga po re re la'ang rab brgya rtsa/ tha na bcu las mi nyung bas bskor/ stegs gzhan nam/ kai tshang gi phyag rgyun ltar na dkyil 'khor gyi lhor dbu rgyan thor tshugs su dpyangs/ nub tu rdo rje/byang du dril bu/ dbus su ming dbang rdo rje/ nye logs su brtul zhugs rjes gnang gri thod/ mig dar/ me tog /dam chu bdud rtsi/ mchog dbang gsum po'i bca' gzhi rgyas pa'am/ bsdu na dkyil 'khor lto dang nub tu thod chang rig tsaka sogs 'du bya'o/ /tshogs kyi yo byad bza' bca' btung ba'i rigs gyur ci 'byor dang / 'byung po spyi dang chos skyong gi gtor ma/ khyad par du dpal nā ro pa yab sras kyi thun mong ma yin pa'i chos skyong ba dud

pa'i sol ba ma'i gtor ma che zhing legs pa bsham/ bsangs chu la las bum gyi chu cung zad re bsre'o/ ༈ /gnyis pa dkyil 'khor sgrub pa ni/ sgrub pa po rnams khrus byas shing / dri bzang pos byugs pa dang / rus pa'i rgyan cha lngas brgyan te/ dkyil 'khor gyi shar phyogs su stan nang tshangs can la rdo rje skyil krung gis 'dug nas bdud rtsi'i ril bu khar bcug pa'am nang mchod byin gyis brlabs la lcer bzhag cing / gtor ma sbyin pa nas rdor sems bsgom bzlas yan chad grub pa dang / rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor/ oṃ badzra a mṛ ta kuṇḍa lī ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭa ces bsangs/ oṃ swa bhā wa 〈khyuḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā ba 〈tusa3 haṃ gis sbyangs/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ brjod cing nang mchod dkyil 'khor la 'thor la/ dngos gzhi nyin dang po'i skabs su/ phyag mtshan rnams bdud rtsi'i thig ler gyur/ nyin phyi ma rnams la/ lha tshogs 'od du zhu ba'i thig ler gyur/ zhes sbyar maho/ rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor thabs shes rab kyi ngang las lha dgu gzhal yas khang dang bcas par gsal ba

༄༅/ /ni/ e las chos kyi 'byung gnas dkar po gru gsum pa rtsa ba phra ba thur du zug pa/ kha gdengs che ba gyen tu bstan pa'i nang du/ paṃ las sna tshogs padma dang / hūm̐ las sna tshogs rdo rje rtse mo bcu gnyis pa phyogs kyi mdog can gyi lte bar/ rghaṃ las byung ba'i rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i khang pa brtsegs pa gru bzhi sgo bzhi pa/ phyi nas dkar ser dmar ljang sngo ba'i rtsig pa rim pa lnga dang ldane zhing / rin po che'i pha gu dang do shal dang do shal phyed pa 'phyang ba/ shar bu dang mda' yab kyis mdzes pa/ ka ba bzhi bzhis btegs pa'i rta babs bang rim bzhi dang ldan pa'i steng du/ padma la gnas pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo dang / gdugs dang ri dwags dang bcas pa/ 'dod yon gyi snam bu dmar po la lha mo bcu drug dkyil 'bor pa la mchod pa'i tshul gyis 'khod

cing / sgo khyud kyi mtshams su zla phyed rdo rjes spras pa/ lha snams kyi shar dkar/ lho ser/ nub dmar/ byang ljang ba/ ka ba brgyad dang ldan zhing / rdo rje'i gdung nye bar bres pa/ thog phyur bur gyur pa'i rtse mor rdo rje rin po che'i tog gis spud pa/ gzhan yang gos dang / me tog gi phreng ba dang / rnga yab dkar po dang / gdugs dang / ba dan kha dog sna tshogs pa rlung gis bskyod pa dang dril bu 'khrol ba la sogs pas brgyan pa'i dbus su/ padma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa ge sar dang bcas pa/ gzhal yas khang gi phyi rol rdo rje'i phreng bas bskor ba'i nang du/ shar du gtum drag /lhor 'jigs su rung ba/ nub tu 'bar ba 'khrugs pa/ byang du tshang tshing 'khrigs pa/ byang shar du ha ha rgod pa/ shar lhor dpal gyi nags/ lho nub tu 'jigs pa'i mun pa/ nub byang du ki

༄tsho/ /li ki li sgrogs pa/ dur khrod chen po de rnams su shīrṣa la sogs pa'i shing chen po brgyad kyi drung brgya byin la sogs pa'i phyogs skyong brgyad yum dang bcas pa/ lha'i dge 'dun la sogs pa'i zhing skyong brgyad phyogs skyong gi bzhon pa'i gdong can shing lo'i gseb nas lus stod phyung ba/ mtsho chen po brgyad la gnas pa'i nor rgyas ser po la sogs klu chen brgyad yum dang bcas pas thal mo sbyar ba'i steng du sgrogs byed sogs sprin brgyad lding ba/gzhan yang me dang ri bo mchod rten rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug brgyad brgyad gnas shing / dur khrod kyi bkod pa 'jigs su rung ba dang ldan pa'i gzhal yas khang gi dbus kyi padma'i lte bar tshangs pa/ dbang po/ nye dbang / drag po ste bdud bzhi'i gdan/ 'dab ma brgyad la/ shar du tshangs pa ser po/ lhor

dbang po dkar po/ nub tu nye dbang dmar po/ byang du drag po sngon po/ byang shar du gshin rje nag po/ shar lhor nor bdag ser po/ lho nub tu srin po sngo nag /nub byang du thag bzang ris ljang gu rnams gan rkyal du gnas pa'i snying gar nyi ma'i gdan dang bcas pa'o/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nī la ya badzra swa bhā wa ātma ko3 haṃ/ zhes sngags kyis rgyas gdab/ dbus kyi gdan la thod pa dang sna tshogs rdo rje thig le'i rnam par gnas pa de yongs su gyur pa las/ bcom ldan 'das dgyes pa rdo rje sku mdog nag po zhal brgyad dang ldan pa'i rtsa ba'i zhal nag po/ g.yas zhal kunda ltar dkar ba/ g.yon zhal dmar zhing cher 'jigs pa/ lhag ma g.yas zhal gnyis dang g.yon zhal gnyis bung ba ltar nag cing / steng zhal dud kha gtsigs pa'i nyams can/ spyan nyi shu rtsa bzhi phye ba/ dbu skra

༄7/ /ser po gyen tu brdzes pa/ dpral ba'i steng du thod pa lnga lnga'i phreng ba dang / sna tshogs rdo rje spyi bor 'dzin pa/ zhal nas hūm̐ gi sgra spro zhing /'khor lo/ snyan cha/ mgul rgyan/ phyag zhabs kyi gdu bu/ ska rags/ thal bas byugs pa ste phyag rgya drug dang ldan pa/ mgo bo lnga bcu'i phreng ba'i do shal 'phyang ba/ phyag bcu drug gi g.yas kyi phyag gi thod pa brgyad na/ rim pa bzhin tu/ glang po che dkar po/ rta sngon po/ bong bu kham pa/ glang dmar po/ rnga mong thal kar/ mi dmar po/ sha ra bha sngon po/ byi la gwa pa/ g.yon gyi phyag gi thod pa brgyad na/ sa'i lha mo ser mo/ chu'i lha mo dkar mo/ rlung gi lha mo dud kha/me'i lha mo dmar mo/ zla ba'i lha mo dkar mo/ nyi ma'i lha mo dmar mo/ gshin rje nag po/ nor bdag ser po/ snying gar thal mo sbyar ba rnams bsnams

pa'i phyag dang po gnyis kyis yum la 'khyud pa/ gcer bu zhabs bzhi'i mdun ma gnyis g.yas brkyang ba'i gar dang rgyab ma gnyis skyil krung phyed pa'i stabs kyis nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la bdud bzhi mnyam par mnan zhing / gar gyi nyams dgu dang ldan pa/ 'jigs pa'ang 'jigs par mdzad pa'o/ /yum bdag med ma sku mdog nag mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum mnga' ba/ mche ba gtsigs pa/ dbu skra ser po gyen tu brdzes pa/ phyag g.yas gri gug/g.yon thod pa bsnams pas yab la 'khyud pa/ gcer bu phyag rgya lnga dang ldan zhing / thod pa skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang / skam po lnga bcu'i phreng bas brgyan pa/ zhabs g.yon brkyang / g.yas bskum pas yab la 'khyud pa/ ces gtso bo yab yum dang /'dab ma brgyad la so se'i phyag mtshan thig le'i rnam par gnas pa de

༄7/ /yongs su gyur pa las/ shar du go rī nag mo g.yas gri gug g.yon nya ro hi ta bsnams pa/ lhor tso rī dmar mo g.yas cang te'u g.yon phag pa bsnams pa/ nub tu bee tā li ser mo g.yas rus sbal g.yon thod pa bsnams pa/ byang du ghasma rī ljang gu g.yas sbrul g.yon thod pa bsnams pa/byang shar du puska sī sngon mo g.yas seng ge g.yon dgra stu bsnams pa/shar lhor sha ba rī dkar mo g.yas dge slong g.yon gsil byed bsnams pa/ lho nub tu tsaṇḍa lī sngon mo g.yas 'khor lo g.yon thong gshel bsnams pa/ nub byang du ḍombi nī sna tshogs pa'i mdog can/ g.yas rdo rje/ g.yon sdigs mdzub mdzad pa/ lha mo thams cad kyang zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum ma/ mche ba gtsigs pa/ dbu skra ser po gyen tu brdzes pa/ gcer bu phyag rgya lnga dang

ldan zhing / thod pa skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang / skam po lnga bcu'i phreng bas brgyan pa/ zhabs g.yon brkyang ba'i skyil krung phyed pa'i gar gyis gnas pa'o//zhes dang / skye mched kyi lha rdo rje gsum dang bcas pa bsgom la rgyas gdab pa ni/ mig tu oṃ las gti mug rdo rje ma dkar mo/ /rna bar sdu las zhe sdang rdo rje ma nag mo/ /sna la mo las ser sna rdo rje ma ser mo/ /lce la rī las 'dod chags rdo rje ma dmar mo/ /dpral bar i las phrag dog rdo rje ma ljang gu/ /snying ga'i cha stod du a las reg bya rdo rje ma sngon mo/ /spyi bor oṃ las sku rdo rje ma dkar mo/ /mgrin par āḥlas gsung rdo rje ma dmar mo/ /snying ga'i cha smad du hūm̐ las thugs rdo rje ma sngon mo/ /de thams cad kyang zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ g.yas gri gug /g.yon na thod pa bsnams shing kha snyi ga mchan khung du bcug pa/ spyan gsum pa/

rjog/sa pa'o///ṭwāṃ shāṭwāṃ tram̐ ṭwāṃ / tram̐ kā gā snrusbyi ༵/ bhāphya ༵ shā ༵ dū nga kṣiṃ/༵ sa/rbarnyi ga thā shā pasna ṭwāṃ ༵ zlo spraṭwāṃ ṭwāṃ ṭwāṃ ༵ ༵/tma trī rnyin/ ༵ kto~X ḍibye dzhai / ba zhi ༵༵ ni badzra swa bhā wa ātma ko3 haṃ/ dngos gzhi nyin dang tsho skabs su/—sta gon gyi lnga nam mkhar bzhugs pa rnams spyan drangs te thim/go rī dzaXtso rī hūm̐/bee tā lī baṃ/ghasma rī hoḥzhes brjod pas/rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'ashesar dang ro gcig tu gyur/ zhes mdun bskyed bsgrub/ / de nas ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor gzhug pa'i hūṃ tu bdag bskyed bsgom pa ni/bla ma dag pa'i gsol 'debs bla ma mnyam med ces sogs nas brtsam/mngon rtogs yongs rdzogs/bzlas pa dang dag pa brjod pa la thug gi bar btang /thugs ka'i sa bon gyi 'od kyis rten gzhal

yas khang 'khor gyi lha mo brgyad la bsdu/ de rnams kyang gtso bo'i zhal brgyad la thim ste/ rang nyid gtso bo yab yum du gsal ba snyoms par zhugs pa'i sid kyi sgras ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor sbyan drangs pa rnams bdag nyid kyi zhal du zhugs/rdo rje'i lam nas lha mo'i padmar bab pa/ slar yang nam mkhar thon te gnas par //ra/ sgrub thabs ltar rdo rje'i rtse mos bsang gtor gyi chu mchod rdzas la gtor zhing /hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ brjod pas bgegs bskrad nas/lag pa g.yas rdo rje dang bcas pas mchod pa rnams la bskor zhing /oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan gsum brjod pas/ mchod pa'i yo byad rnams rang bzhin stong pa/ byed las dbang po drug gi spyod yul du zag pa med pa'i bde ba skyed nus par gyur/zhes byin gyis brlabs la/ g.yon dril bu dkrol zhing / g.yas pas mchod rdzas stob pa'i tshul gyis dbul bzhin pas/ skyersha dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ the1ཿkhaṃ ram̐ āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ zhes pas mchod yon/ skye( ni ri ti hūm̐ khaḥ.āḥhūm̐

ra༅༅/ /swā hā/ zhes pas zhabs bsil/ oṃ badzra purmye āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ badzra dhu pe āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ badzra gandhe āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ badzra ni widre āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ badzra ā lo ke āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ zhes pa'i mchod pa lngas mchod/dkar mo ri dwags mtshan ma 'dzin/ /chom rkun bdud las rgyal ba'i snod/ /ro langs ma ni chu lag ma/ /ghasma rī ni sman 'dzin zhing / /pukka sī ni rdo rje'i lag /de bzhin ri khrod ma ro 'dzin/ /gdol pa mo ni cang te'u brdung / /'di rnams kyis ni gtso bo mchod//'dod chags chen po'i rjes chags pas/ /g.yung mos sku la 'khyud pa nyid/ /oṃ go rī rga āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ tso rī rtsa āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ bee tā lī baṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ ghasma rī rghaṃ āḥhūm̐ swāhā/ oṃ puska sī paṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ sha ba rī shaṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ tsaṇḍa lī rtsa āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ ḍombi ni ḍi āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ zhes lha mo brgyad kyis kyang mchod

nas/ oṃ ma hā badzra hūm̐/ oṃ badzra gharnye āḥ zhes pas rdo rje dang dril bu bzung la/ zhe sdang rdo rjer phyag 'tshal bstod/ /gti mug rdo rjer phyag 'tshal bstod/ /ser sna rdo rje bdag la skyobs/ /'dod chags rdo rje bdag la stsol/ /phrag dog rdo rje nga rgyal te/ /sgyu 'phrul rdo rje mgon po kun/ /las kun rab tu sgrub byed pa/ /thams cad rdo rje bdag mgur 'gyur/ /zhes pas bstod/ so so'i phyag rgya bcings la go rī dzaḥ zhes pas ye shes pa dgug ce ṇḍashrī hūm̐ gis bzhug bee tā snyi baṃ gyis bcings/ ghasma rī hoḥ zhes pas dgyes par byas/ dbang bskur ba ni/ slar yang thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer nag po lcags kyu'i rnam pa 'phros pas khams gsum na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas thams cad spyan drangs pa la/ go rī ma la sogs pas mchod pa ni/ oṃ go rī ge āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ tso rī rtsa āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ bee tā lī baṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ ghasma rī rghaṃ āḥhūm̐ swāhā/ oṃ

༄7/ /puska sī paṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ sha ba rī shaṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ tsaṇḍa lī rtsa āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ ḍombi ni ḍo āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ mgon po de bzhin gshegs pa kun/ /khyed kyis lha la dbang skur cig /ces gsol ba btab pas/ sangs rgyas de rnams he ru ka'i gzugs su gyur nas bdud rtsi lngas gang ba'i bum pas dbang bskur ba na/ me tog gi char 'bab pa dang / rnga'i sgra grags pa dang / gur gum gyi char 'bab pa dang / gzugs rdo rje ma la sogs pas mchod pa dang / rdo rje'i glu/ spyan ma la sogs pas len pa dang / rig pa'i rgyal po khro bo rnams kyis bgegs bskrad cing dbang bskur/ chu'i lhag ma cung zad yar 'khyil ba las rang gi rigs kyi bdag pos dbu brgyan pa ni/ gtso bo yab yum la mi bskyod pa/ puska sī dang go rī la mi bskyod pa/ sha ba rī dang tso rī la

rnam par snang mdzad/ tsaṇḍa lī dang bee tā lī la rin chen 'byung ldan/ ḍombi nī dang ghasma rī la snang ba mtha' yas kyis dbu brgyan par bsam la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta 65 bhi ṣe ka ta badzra swa bhā wa ātma ska/྅ haṃ/ zhes sngags kyis rgyas gdab grub nas/ bdud rtsi 'bul myong sngags kyis rgyas gdab pa ni/ bdud rtsi byin rlabs gong du 'byung ba ltar 'dir yang spro na/ skyes badzra a mṛ ta kuṇḍa lī ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭa ces bsangs/ oṃ swa dhwa wa shuddhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā ba shukhro3 haṃ gis sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las ye las rlung / ram̐ las me skyed āḥhūm̐ las thod pa'i sgyed bu gsum gyi steng du/ a las thod pa yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du/ hūm̐ sum̐ e dzī khaṃ/ lī māṃ māṃ tt+waṃ māṃ las skyes pa'i bdud rtsi lnga dang /sha lngar gyur/ ha hoḥhrīḥ zhes brjod pas/ tha mal pa'i kha dog dang dri dang nus pa phrogs shing / rlung g.yos/ me sbar/ bcud rnams bskol bas/ nyi ma

༄7/ /'char kha lta bu'i mdog can gyi rlangs pa hūṃ las rdo rje kha ṭwāṃ ga 'bar bar gyur pa zhu zhing / de nyid du lan gsum lhung bas dri ma thams cad dang bral ba shel ltar gsal ba'i dam tshig gi bdud rtsis gang ba'i steng du/ oṃ las byung ba'i zla ba kha chod kyi tshul du gnas pa la g.yas skor du ā li g.yon skor du kā li yongs su gyur pa'i oṃ āḥhūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros/ phyogs bcur bzhugs pa'i rdo rje 'dzin pa thams cad kyi thugs ka nas/ ye shes kyi bdud rtsi bkug /zla ba yi ge gsum dang bcas pa zhu bas bdud rtsi'i rgya mtshor gyur/ bsdu na gong du song bas 'thus par mdzad/ gtso 'khor thams cad kyi ljags kyi rtse mo rdo rjer gyur pa'i 'od kyi sbu gus bdud rtsi drangs te gsol bar dmigs la/g.yon pa'i mtheb srin gyis nang mchod blangs nas 'bul zhing /phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi de

bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi ngo bo dpal ldan rtsa ba'i bla ma dam pa'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ bcom ldan 'das rigs drug pa rdo rje 'chang chen po'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/bcom ldan rdo rje phag mo'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ rgyal sras rdo rje snying po'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ grub chen sa ra ha pa'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ dpal ldan 'phags pa klu sgrub zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ rgyal sras ārya de ba'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ paṇa chen zla ba grags pa'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ rnal 'byor mā taṅgi pa'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/te lo shes rab bzang po'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ nā ro dzñā na sirnyi'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ mnga' bdag rgyal ba mai tri'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ mar pa chos kyi blo gros zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ rngog ston chos sku rdo rje'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ rngog ston zhe sdang rdo rje'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ rngog ston seng ge sgra yi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ rngog ston kun

༄7/ /dga' rdo rje'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ rgya sgom ye shes 'od kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ grub chen karma pakshi'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ gnyan ras dge 'dun 'bum gyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ bshes gnyen tshul khrims rin chen zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ kun mkhyen rang byung rdo rje'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ bla ma chos kyi rgyal mtshan zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ yor pa ye shes dpal ba'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ bka' bzhi ratna bha dra'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ rje btsun mthong ba don ldan zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ byang sems dpal 'byor don grub zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ spyan snga chos kyi grags pa'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ rje btsun karma phrin las zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ 'jigs bral mi bskyod rdo rje'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ sprul sku dkon mchog yan lag zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ rgyal tshab grags pa don grub zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ stag lung rnam rgyal dpal

bzang zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ chos rje ngag dbang rnam rgyal zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ mtshungs med bkra shis dpal grub zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ mkhan chen karma nyi ma'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ mkhan mchog phrin las mtshan can zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ go shrī don yod snying po'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ dpal chen chos kyi don grub zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/kun gzigs chos kyi 'byung gnas zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ karma tshe dbang kun khyab zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ mchog sprul phrin las rab rgyas zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ khra legs ye shes nyi ma'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ rgyal sras blo gros mtha' yas zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ padma dbang mchog rgyal po'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ rang byung rig pa'i rdo rje'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ drin can rtsa brgyud bla ma'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams la 'bul/ oṃ de ba pi tsu badzā ya oṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ e ni natpa yi oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes gtso

༄tsho/ /bo yab yum dang / oṃ go rī rga oṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ tso rī rtsa oṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ bee tā lī baṃ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ ghasma rī rghaṃ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ pukka sī paṃ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ sha ba rī shaṃ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ tsaṇḍa snyi rtsa oṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ ḍombi ni ḍo oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes snyor brgyad dang / oṃ hūṃ shrī ya de wī kā li kā li ma hā kā li hūṃ bhyo oṃ āḥhūm̐/ ces dud sol ma dang / oṃ ma hā kā lā ya skyes āḥhūm̐/ skyes ma hā kā li ye skyes āḥhūm̐/ zhes pas chos skyong spyi ste thams cad la 'bru gsum sbyar bas nang mchod 'bul/ skyes sarba ta thā ga ta a mṛ ta swā da badzra swa bhā wa ātma na/྅ haṃ/ zhes sngags kyis rgyas gdab bo/ ༈ /gsum pa mdun bskyed la mchod bstod rgyas par bya ste/ de la bzhi/ phyi nang gsang mchod bstod pa'o/ /dang po la'ang lnga/ chu gsum nyer spyod rol mor bcas pa/'dod yon lnga/ rgyal srid bdun/ sgeg sogs brgyad/ phyag rgya nyi shu'i mchod pa'o/ /dang po ni/ mchod pa rnams/ oṃ sarba saṃ theg dha ni āḥhūm̐ swā hā sa bsangs/ oṃ swa bhā wa shuddhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā ba

shuzlo3 haṃ gis sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las/ a las thod pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du/ hūm̐ 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i bsang gtor/ mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me tog /bdug spos/ snang gsal/ dri/ zhal zas/ rol mo la sogs pa'i mchod pa'i yo byad rnams rang bzhin stong pa/ byed las dbang po drug gi spyod yul du zag pa med pa'i bde ba skyed nus par gyur/ oṃ sarba saṃ sho dha ni āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥkhaṃ ram̐ āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ skyed nī rī ti hūm̐ kha āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ skyed badzra puṣṭi āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ skyed badzra dhu pe āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ skyed badzra ā 31 ke āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ skyed badzra garnye āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ skyed badzra ni widre āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ badzra shabha āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ rol mo bya zhing / oṃ badzra ghaṇḍa ra ṇi ta pra ra ṇi ta saṃ pra ra ṇi ta sarba buddha kṣe tra pra tsa li te pra dzñā pa ra mi tā nā da saṃ bha

༄7/ /wa badzra dharmalha da ya sarnyo ṣa ni hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hoḥ.āḥkhaṃ swā hā/ ces byin gyis btso/ dag cing dri med yid 'ong ba'i/ /sngags rdo/ bsang gtor mchog 'di dag /mchog tu dad pas khyed la 'bul/ /ci bde bar ni bzhes su gsol/ /pad kor sngon tu 'gro bas/ g.yas pa'i mtheb mdzub kyis bsang gtor dbul zhing / oṃ shrī he ru ka sa pa ri wā ra sarba saṃ sho dha ni āḥhūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/dag cing dri med yid 'ong ba'i/ /sngags kyi mchod yon mchog 'di dag /mchog tu dad pas khyed la 'bul//ci bde bar ni bzhes su gsol/ /pad kor sngon tu 'gro bas/rdo rje'i thal mo gnyis kyis dung chos bzung la mchod yon bzed zhal du dbul zhing / oṃ shrī he ru ka sa pa ri wā ra dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥkhaṃ ram̐ āḥhūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ dag cing dri med yid 'ong ba'i/ /sngags kyi zhabs bsil mchog 'di dag /mchog tu dad pas khyed la 'bul/ /ci bde bar ni bzhes

su garbe la/ /pad kor sngon tu 'gro bas/ skyetshe shrī he ru ka sa pa ri wā ra nī rī ti hūm̐ kha āḥhūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ g.yas pa'i mtheb mdzub sbyar ba'i khu tshur gyis me tog blangs la lan gsum bskor nas/mthe'u chung nas mdzub mo'i bar rim gyis bkrol te bzed zhal du sgreng ngo / /de nas lag pa g.yon pas dril bu 'brol zhing / g.yas pas mchod rdzas so sor blangs nas bstab pa'i tshul gyis dbul ba'am/ so so'i phyag rgya dang bcas pas/ me tog 'di ni bzang zhing dge/ /dag pa'i skye gnas las dag pa/ /bdag gis dad pas 'bul lags kyi/ /bzhes nas bdag la dgyes par mdzod/ /oṃ shrī he ru ka sa pa ri wā ra badzra purmye āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ nags tshal las byung phan pa yi/ /gang zhig dri dang bdug spos mchog /bdag gis dad pas 'bul lags kyi/ /bzhes nas bdag la dgyes par mdzod/ /oṃ shrī he ru ka sa pa ri wā ra badzra dhū pe āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ srin po 'joms shing dag byed la/ /dge

༄༅/ /zhing mun pa rnam sel ba/ /bdag gis dad pas 'bul lags kyi/ /bzhes nas bdag la dgyes par mdzod/ /oṃ shrī he ru ka sa pa ri wā ra badzra ā lo ke āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ lhan cig skyes dang sbyar ba'i dri/ /tshim byed dag pa'i bdud rtsi 'di/ /bdag gis dad pas 'bul lags kyi/ /bzhes nas bdag la dgyes par mdzod/ /oṃ shrī he ru ka sa pa ri wā ra badzra gandhe āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ bshos gtsang bza' ba dang bcas pa'i/ /kha dog dri dang ro ldan pa/ /bdag gis dad pas 'bul lags kyi/ /bzhes nas bdag la dgyes par mdzod/ /oṃ shrī he ru ka sa pa ri wā ra badzra ni wi hye āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ zhes nyer spyod lnga'i mchod pa gur las gsungs pa dang / sna tshogs dril bu'i sgra rnams dang / /cang te'u la sogs sgra yi tshogs/ /bdag gis dad pas 'bul lags kyi/ /bzhes nas bdag la

dgyes par mdzod/ /oṃ shrī he ru ka sa pa ri wā ra badzra shabha āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ gnyis pa 'dod yon lnga'i mchod pa ni/ rang gi snying gas spros pa'i 'dod yon gyi lha mo du mas mchod par bsam la/gzugs la rnam gsum shes bya ste/ /lha rnams la ni dbul bar bya/ /de nyid bcom ldan rgyal ba ni/ /mnga' bdag rdo rje rnam snang mdzad/ /g.yon khu tshur gyi steng du g.yas pa'i thal mo me long gi tshul ltar bzhag la/ skyed shrī he ru ka sa pa ri wā ra rū pa pū dza me gha sa mu dra spa ra ṇa sa ma ye hūm̐/ sgra la rnam gsum shes bya ste/ /lha rnams la ni dbul bar bya/ /de nyid bcom ldan rdo rje can/ /rdo rje sems dpa' grags chen po/ /oṃ shrī he ru ka sa pa ri wā ra shapta pū dza me gha sa mu dra spa ra ṇa sa ma ye hūm̐/ rol mo bya/dri la rnam gsum shes bya ste/ /lha rnams la ni dbul bar bya/ /de nyid bcom ldan sangs rgyas ni/ /rin chen phung por rab tu grags/ /g.yon

ra༅༅ khu tshur las mdzub mo brkyang ba kha steng du phyogs pa la g.yas pa'i thal mos dri blangs nas byugs pa'i tshul gyis/ skye( shrī he 〈co ka sa pa ri wā ra gandhe pū dza me gha sa mu dra spa ra ṇa sa ma ye hūm̐/ ro la rnam gsum shes bya ste/ /lha rnams la ni dbul bar bya/ /de nyid bcom ldan 'dod chags che/ /rdo rje chos kyis bzhes su gsol/ /thal mo gnyis bkan nas zhal zas 'bul ba'i tshul gyis/ skyed shrī he 〈co ka sa pa ri wā ra ra sa pū dza me gha sa mu dra spa ra ṇa sa ma ye hūm̐/ reg la rnam garna/ma shes bya ste/ /lha rnams la ni dbul bar bya/ /de nyid bcom ldan sna tshogs pa/ /don yod 'bras bu ster ba po/ /gos zung dbul zhing / oṃ shrī he ru ka sa pa ri wā ra sparnye pū dza me gha sa mu dra spa ra ṇa sa ma ye hūm̐/ zhes dang / srab 'jam yang ba lha yi gos/ /mi bskyod rdo rje'i sku brnyes la/ /mi phyed dad pas bdag 'bul na/ /bdag kyang rdo rje'i sku

thob shog /sna tshogs dbang po'i gzhu ltar rab bkra zhing / /gang la reg na bde ba'i rgyur gyur pa/ /gos bzang rin chen bdag blo sbyang phyir 'bul/ /bzod pa dam pa'i tre sa kyis brgyan par 31ga /skyel badzra wast+ra āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ zhes pas gos zung 'bul lo/ /gsum pa rgyal srid bdun gyi mchod pa ni/ rin chen sna bdun ri mor bris pa sogs 'bul ba'am so sore phyag rgya spyi mthun byas la/gser las legs byas lte ba shin tu zlum/ /rtsibs stong ldan zhing mu khyud rab mnyam bzang / /dang po'i sa las rnam par rgyal gyur gang / /'khor lo rin chen nam mkha' bkang ste 'bul/ /oṃ tsakra ratna pū dzi te āḥhūm̐/ bdag dang mtha' yas pa'i sems can thams cad dran pa yang dag byang chub kyi chos bla na med pa kun tu spyod pa thob par gyur cig /yan lag thams cad legs skyes sa la ni/ /rab gnas gangs can rtse 'dra'i glang po

༄༅/ /mchog /rgyal po la 'os mkha' la rab 'gro ba'i/ /glang po rin chen nam mkha' bkang ste 'bul/ /oṃ hasti ratna pū dzi te āḥhūm̐/ bdag dang mtha' yas pa'i sems can thams cad shes rab yang dag byang chub kyi chos bla na med pa kun tu spyod pa thob par gyur cig /tho rangs dus su phyogs rnams ma lus pa'i/ /sa rnams bskor nas slar yang ldog gyur gang / /rma bya'i mgrin 'dra spu ni yid 'ong ba'i/ /rta mchog rin chen nam mkha' bkang ste 'bul//oṃ a shwa ratna pū dzi te āḥhūm̐/ bdag dang mtha' yas pa'i sems can thams cad brtson 'grus yang dag byang chub kyi chos bla na med pa kun tu spyod pa thob par gyur cig /dri med beeḍūrya 'dra'i rin po che/ /kun tu dpag tshad tsam du snang byed pa/ /sgrib med mtshan mo ci 'dra nyin de bzhin/ /nor bu rin chen nam

mkha' bkang ste 'bul/ /oṃ ma ṇi ratna pū dzi te āḥhūm̐/ bdag dang mtha' yas pa'i sems can thams cad dga' ba yang dag byang chub kyi chos bla na med pa kun tu spyod pa thob par gyur cig /gang zhig reg dri gzugs dang mdangs ldan pa/ /bud med dam pa dregs ldan rnams kyi mchog /lha mo bzhin tu yon tan kun ldan pa/ /btsun mo rin chen nam mkha' bkang ste 'bul/ /oṃ st+ri ratna pū dzi te āḥhūm̐/ bdag dang mtha' yas pa'i sems can thams cad shin tu sbyangs pa yang dag byang chub kyi chos bla na med pa kun tu spyod pa thob par gyur cig /gang yang 'di na rgyal la mu tig dang / /gser sogs mang po thub la phul ba yi/ /nor ldan mtshungs par nor mang ldan pa yi/ /khyim bdag rin chen nam mkha' bkang ste 'bul/ /oṃ kṛ ha spa ti ratna pū dzi te āḥhūm̐/ bdag dang

༄༅/ /mtha' yas pa'i sems can thams cad ting nge 'dzin yang dag byang chub kyi chos bla na med pa kun tu spyod pa thob par gyur cig /'gro dang kun tu gnas dang rnam ldog par/ /ma lus dpung la mkhas par byed pa yi/ /dpal ldan bdun pa 'byung 'gyur mi yi ni/ /blon/ po rin chen nam mkha' bkang ste 'bul/ /oṃ pu ru ṣa ratna pū dzi te āḥhūm̐/ bdag dang mtha' yas pa'i sems can thams cad btang snyoms yang dag byang chub kyi chos bla na med pa kun tu spyod pa thob par gyur cig /bzhi pa sgeg sogs brgyad kyi mchod pa ni/ sgeg mo'i lag pas sgeg mo ste/ /phreng bas phreng ba'i mkha' 'gro ma/ /hūm̐ gi glu yis dam tshig glu/ /lag bskum pas ni gar nyid de/ /mchod pa 'di dag bla na med/ /sangs rgyas thams cad mnyes par byed/ /sangs rgyas rnams ni mchod pas

mchod/ /'dod pa'i dngos grub byed par 'gyur/ /phyag rgya mthong brgyud ltar bya zhing / oṃ badzra sa twa su saṃ gra hā da/ oṃ badzra lā su hūm̐/ oṃ badzra ratna mā nutta ram̐/ oṃ badzra mā le tt+waṃ/ oṃ badzra dharma gā ya ni/ oṃ badzra gī ti hrīḥ oṃ badzra karma ka roddhā be/ oṃ badzra dṛ tī āḥ me tog skyur ba'i tshul gyis dang / /bdug pas bdug pa'i tshul gyis dang / /sdong bu mar me'i mchod pa dang / /byug pa'i tshul gyis rjes su dri/ /mchod pa 'di rnams bla na med/ /sangs rgyas thams cad mnyes par byed//sangs rgyas rnams ni mchod pas mchod/ /'dod pa'i dngos grub byed par 'gyur/ /phyag rgya mthong brgyud ltar bya zhing / oṃ badzra sa twa su saṃ gra hā da/ oṃ badzra dha pe hūm̐/oṃ badzra ratna mā nutta ram̐/ oṃ badzra pursha hūm̐/ oṃ badzra dharma gā ya ni/ oṃ badzra ā lo ke hrīḥ oṃ badzra karma ka roddhā be/ oṃ badzra gandhe āḥ lnga pa phyag rgya nyi shu'i mchod pa ni༄/rin chen

ra༅༅ 'bar ba dang bzang po yongs bzung dgongs pa ltar phyag len tu rgyas par sbyar ba'i tshul 'byung yang bsdu na/ gar pad bcas/ te na hūm̐/ te na hūm̐/ te na te te hūm̐/ hūm̐ hūm̐/ pi wang tshul gyis sgreng ba dang / /gling bu'i tshul gyis sgyur ba dang / /dung gi tshul gyis 'bud pa dang / /sil khrol tshul gyis rdeb pa dang / /phyag 'tshal tshul gyis 'dud pa dang / /rnga yab tshul gyis g.yob pa dang / /rgyal mtshan tshul gyis sgreng ba dang / /bla bre'i tshul gyis bre ba dang / /ba dan tshul gyis 'phyar ba dang / /gdugs kyi tshul gyis dgab pa dang / /rnga zlum tshul gyis rdeb pa dang / /rdza rnga'i tshul gyis rdung ba dang / /gar gyi tshul gyis yan lag skyod/ /bzhad pa'i tshul gyis 'dzum pa dang / /sgeg pa'i tshul gyis sgeg pa dang / /khro ba'i tshul gyis 'jigs pa dang / /mda' 'phen

tshul gyis drang bar bya/ /rdo rje gsor zhing phyag 'tshal lo/ /chags pa'i tshul gyis nu ma 'jib/ /gus pa'i tshul gyis thal mo sbyor/ /rdo rje'i mchod pa nyi shu pos/ /he ru ka dpal 'khor bcas mchod/ /gnyis pa nang gi mchod pa ni/ zla zhun byang sems ga bur gyis gang ba'i/ /padma'i snod 'dzin lha mo go rī ma//zhing gi rdul dang mnyam par sprul nas kyang / /bde chen ma11na par 'phel slad lha rnams mchod/ /g.yon rdo rje khu tshur gyi steng du g.yas pa'i thal mo bkan la bzhag pa dkar cha'i sdod 'dzin pa'i tshul gyis/ oṃ go rī ge āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ nyi 'od mdangs chags rang byung me tog ni/ /sihlas yongs bkang snod 'dzin tso rī ma/ /zhing gi rdul dang mnyam par sprul nas kyang / /gtum mo'i nus pa rgyas phyir lha rnams mchod/ /snga ma las zlog pa dmar cha'i snod 'dzin pa'i tshul gyis/ oṃ tso rī rtsa āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ nang gi gdung ba sel

༄7/ /byed gla rtsi ste/ /rdo rje dri chu'i snod 'dzin bee tā li/ /zhing gi rdul dang mnyam par sprul nas kyang / /mtshan 'dzin dri ma sbyong phyir lha rnams mchod/ /mchod yon gyi phyag rgyas/ oṃ bee tā li baṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ bzhi mnyam bdud rtsis gang ba'i thod pa yis/ /phyag gnyis rtag tu brel gyur ghasma rī/ /zhing gi rdul dang mnyam par sprul nas kyang / /'chi med 〈snab par bya phyir lha rnams mabye1da/ /g.yon pa'i khu tshur gyi steng du g.yas pa'i sor mo rnams kyi rtse mo bsdus te bzhag pa sman 'dzin pa'i tshul gyis/oṃ ghasma rī rghaṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ swā li skyes pa rab brjod tsandan dmar/ /rdo rje stobs kyi snod 'dzin pukka sī/ /zhing gi rdul dang mnyam par sprul nas kyang / /mtha' yas mthu lha/bas rgyas phyir lha rnams macesad/ /khu tshur gnyis mnyam du gshibs te kha drung du 'jog pa sha la rol pa'i tshul byas la/ skyed pukka sī paṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ sdud bcud sbrang rtsi'i

btung ba dang bcas pa'i/ /rnal 'byor lhung bzed thogs pa'i ri khrod ma/ /zhing gi rdul dang mnyam par sprul nas kyang / /rdo rje'i lus thob bya phyir lha rnams mchod// rdo rje thal mo kha phye bas snod 'dzin pa ltar byas la/oṃ sha ba rī shaṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ gzhom med nā da'i rang bzhin cang te'u/ /dbyangs gsal rdo rje'i sgra sgrogs tsaṇḍa lī//zhing gi rdul dang mnyam par sprul nas kyang / /rdo rje chos ni 'khru/ba phyir lha rnams mchod/ /g.yon dkur bzhag cing g.yas pa'i khu tshur gyi mdzub mo dang mthe'u chung 'khyag por byas pa cang te'u 'bral pa'i rnam pas/ oṃ tsaṇḍa lī rtsa āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ thabs shes snyoms par 'jug las dga' ba bzhi/ /zag med yongs su bskyed pa'i ḍombi ni/ /zhing gi rdul dang mnyam par sprul nas kyang / /bde stong dbyer med thob phyir lha rnams mchod/ /snying gar khu tshur bsnol ba 'byud pa'i tshul gyis/ oṃ ḍombi nī ḍo āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ thams cad

ra༅༅ la'ang mthar se gol dang bcas pa bya'o/ /gsum pa gsang ba'i mchod pa ni/ gtso 'khor thams cad dpa' bo'i cha lugs su bsgyur te g.yung mos 'khyud pa las byung ba'i bde ba chen po'i de kho na nyid sku nyams su bstar ba'i mos pas/ gang gis rnam rtog rnam spangs te/ /byang chub sems ni rnam bsgom zhing / /lus dang sems ni rnam dag pa/ /'di ni don dam mabyebyed pa yin/ /zhes pa rnams kyi mthar/ skyes sarba ta thā ga ta pū dza badzra swa bhā ba ātma skasto3 haṃ/ zhes pa'i sngags kyis rgyas gdab par bya'o/ /bzhi pa bstod pa bya ba ni/ skyes ma hā badzra hūm̐/oṃ badzra gharnye āḥ ces brjod de don dran pa dang sngags kyis rdor dril bzung la/ thams cad dngos po'i rang bzhin mchog /gdod nas thams cad bdag nyid gnas/ /thabs dang shes rab gnyis med pa'i/ /kye'i rdo rje la phyag 'tshal/ /bdag med mas ni mgul nas 'khyud/ /dbu skra ser po gyen tu 'bar/ /zhal brgyad pa la

spyan gsum pa/ /mgon po de la gus phyag 'tshal/ /spyi bo'i steng na nag po mdzes/ /dkar dang dmar po g.yas dang g.yon/ /gang gi lhag ma'i zhal rnams ni/ /nag pa de la bdag phyag 'tshal/ /glang po rta bong glang rnga mo/ /mi dang sha ra bha byi la/ /g.yas pa'i phyag brgyad la gnas pa'i/ /thod pa 'dzin la bdag phyag 'tshal/ /sa dang chu dang rlung dang me/ /zla nyi gshin rje gsang ba pa/ /g.yon pa'i phyag brgyad la gnas pa'i/ /thod pa 'dzin la bdag phyag 'tshal//zhabs bzhi yis ni bdud bzhi po/ /mnyam par mnan zhing gcer bu nyid/ /nyi mar zhabs g.yas brkyang dang bskum/ /gar mdzad de la bdag phyag 'tshal//'khor lo bzhi yi bdag nyid mdzes/ /'dzag pa'i mgo bos rnam par brgyan/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rnam dag pa'i/ /phyag rgya lngas ni rnam par brgyan/ /sna

༄༅/ /tshogs rdo rje spyi bor 'dzin/ /dpral bar rigs kyi bdag po nyid/ /dam pa'i dga' ba yang dag thob/ /bde chen de la bdag phyag 'tshal//gi las skyes pa'i go rī shar/ /kha dog nag cing g.yon pa nya/ /g.yas pa na ni gri gug 'dzin/ /tshangs pa mnan la bdag phyag 'tshal/ /rtsa las byung ba'i chom rkun ma/ /btsod kyi kha dog lho phyogs su/ /phyag na phag dang cang te'u bsnams/ /dbang po mnan la bdag phyag 'tshal/ /baṃ las skyes pa'i ser mo nub/ /ro langs ma ni nye dbang mnan/ /phyag g.yon lhung bzed g.yas pa yis/ /rus sbal 'dzin la bdag phyag 'tshal/ /ghasma rī ni byang gi sgor/ /ljang gu rghaṃ las byung ba yi/ /phyag na sgrul dang thod pas brel/ /drag po mnan la bdag phyag 'tshal/ /gshin rje mnan zhing paṃ las byung / /g.yon pa dgra stu seng ge

g.yas/ /dbang ldan tu ni 'jigs gzugs ma/ /phyag 'tshal puska sī sngon la'o/ /ri khrod ma dkar shaṃ las byung / /me ru gnod sbyin steng du gnas/ /g.yon na gsil byed g.yas pa na/ /dge slong 'dzin la bdag phyag 'tshal/ /gtum mo nam mkha'i sngo bsangs ma/ /srin por rtsa las byung ba yi/ /g.yon na thong gshol 'khor lo g.yas/ /phyag 'tshal srin po mnan khyod la'o/ /ḍo las 'brungs pa'i g.yung mo ni/ /rlung mtshams thag bzang ris steng gshegs/ /phyag g.yon sdig mdzub g.yas rdo rje/ /sna tshogs mdog la bdag phyag 'tshal/ /skyil krung phyed pa'i gar gyis gnas/ /phyag rgya lnga yis rnam par brgyan/ /gcer bu spyan gsum thams cad la/ /bdag ni gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /phung po khams rnams rnam dag pa/ /byang chub sems las byung ba yi/ /bde rab ster

༄༅/ /'di thams cad la/ /dngos po kun gyis phyag 'tshal lo/ /nyid kyi phyag na gzung ba yi/ /phyag mtshan sa bon las byung ba'i/ /bde chen 'dod pa thams cad la/ /rtag tu yang dag phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang zhig nyi zla kha sbyor gnas sa bon/ /gnyis las skyes pa'i gtso bo rig mar bcas/ /nyid kyis nyid/ kyi dkyil 'khor 'di la ni/ /'jig rten gsum po sprul par mdzad dang ldan/ /nyid la 'di dag thams cad ma lus pa'i/ /zhi ba bde gsol rig ma bsdu byed pa'i/ /shes rab chags pa bdud rtsi'i ro nyid kyis/ /gnas su zhi ba de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mkha' 'gro ma gtso kye'i rdo rje/ /lha mo 'khor lo bcas bstod pas/ /bdag gis bsod nams gang thob pa/ /des ni 'jig rten de mtshungs shog /ces slob dpon mtsho skyes rdo rjes mdzad pa'i bstod pa nyi shu pa dang / khyod

ni rnal 'byor ma yi tshogs kyis yongs su bskor/ /khyod ni nyid kyi thugs kyis khyod dgongs 'grub/ /khyod ni rgyu dang mi rgyu 'khor ba kun sgrub pa/ /snying rje'i thugs kyis sems can byang chub tu/ /kun rdzob sgyu ma byang chub sgrub pa yi/ /dgyes pa rdo rje dpal gyi he ru ka la bstod/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta stu ti badzra tra/ bhā ba yi/tma ska/྅ haṃ/ zhes sngags kyis rgyas gdab bo/ ༈ /sgrub mchod zhag mang du sbrel na skabs 'dir bum bskyed bzlas pa/ las bum phrin las bcol ba'i bar sta gon skabs ltar bya'o/ ༈ /gnyis pa dbang bskur ba la bzhi/ bdag nyid 'jug cing dbang blang ba/ bar chad zhi ba'i phyir gtor ma sgyin pa/ slob ma dkyil 'khor du gzhug pa/ dbang bzhi bskur ba'i cho ga'o/ /dang po la gsum/ glu/ ga/tor chog /bdag 'jug dngos so/ /dang po slob ma dkyil 'bor du gzhug pa'i don tu dam tshig gi glus bskul ba ni/rdor dril 'dzin pas/ nam mkha' las byung mtshan ldan phyir/ /thog ma mtha' ma med pa'i mchog/

༄༅/ /sems dpa' rdo rje che rang bzhin/ /rdo rje 'dzin par bdag sgrubs shig /dngos grub chen po kun gyi mchog /dbang phyug chen po lhag pa'i lha/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa kun gyi rgyal/ /mi 'gyur mchog tu bdag sgrubs shig /nyes pa med pa rtag pa ste/ /'dod chags kun gyi rjeru/ su chags/ /'dod chags chen po dga' ba che/ /bcom ldan de nyid bdag sgrubs shig /shin tu dag pa kun gyi mchog /gdod nas grol ba de bzhin gshegs/ /kun tu bzang po kun bdag nyid/ /byang chub sems su bdag sgrubs shig /dngos grub chen po mchog gi mchog /dbang phyug chen po rgyal ba'i rgyal/ /grub pa'i rdo rje cher gsal bas/ /rdo rje bsnyems par bdag sgrubs shig /sems can kun gyi yid khyab pa/ /sems can kun gyi snying la gnas/ /sems can kun gyi yab nyid

de/ /'dod chags mnyam pa'i dam tshig mchog /ces pa dang / bden pa bsgrag pa yang bya ste/ shes rab thabs bdag dkyil 'khor gyi/ /bden pa'i byin rlabs gang yin pa'i/ /mgon po khyod kyi bden pa des/ /bdag gi 'dod pa skongs gyur cig /ces so// —'di da lta'i phyag bzhes su bdag 'dug gi rjes su mdzad do/ /gnyis pa bdag nyid kyi bar chad zhi ba'i phyir 'byung po thams cad pa'i gtor ma btang ba ni 'og nas 'byung ba ltar bya'o/ /gsum pa bdag 'jug dngos ni/ dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo bla ma dbyer med pas slob dpon gyi bya ba mdzad par mos la slob ma gzhug pa ji lta ba bzhin tu tshig gi 'dor len phyed bar byas la rang nyid kyis dkyil 'khor du 'jug cing dbang rdzogs par blang ngo / /gnyis pa bar chad zhi ba'i phyir gtor ma sbyin pa ni/ sgrub pa'i grogs rtsa sngags bzla bzhin tu dkyil 'khor gyi srung bar bzhag la/ slob dpon la sogs pa dkyil 'khor gyi khang pa'i phyi rol du phyin cing / sa phyogs gtsang mar dbus su mchod gtor/ g.yas chu gnyis/ g.yon tu mdun nas rgyab tu

ra༅༅/ /brtsams te nyewa spyod phreng tshar/ mdun tu nang mchod chu sdod sogs 'du byas la/ mdun gyi nam mkhar chos 'byung gru gsum pa'i nang du/ padma 'dab ma brgyad pa/dkar sngo dmar ba'i mdog can gsum brtsegs mar gnas pa/ rang gi gnas gsum gyi oṃ āḥhūm̐ las 'od zer dkar dmar mthing kha 'phros pas sa bla sa 'og sa steng gi 'gro ba thams cad la phog /tshur 'dus pas/ steng du oṃ dkar po/ bar du hūm̐ sngon po/ 'og tu āḥdamar po/ dgu dgu yongs su gyur pa las steng du sku rdo rje lha chen brgyad dang bcas pa dkar po/ bar ma la thugs rdo rje phyogs skyong brgyad dang bcas pa mthing kha/ 'og ma la gsung rdo rje klu chen brgyad dang bcas pa dmar po'i mdog can/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ rang 'od kyi yum la 'khyud cing g.yas brkyang ba'i

stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ thams cad kyi gnas gsum yi ge gsum gyis mtshan pa'i thugs ka'i sa bon gyi 'od kyis rang 'dra'i ye shes pa spyan drangs bar bsam la/ go rī aṅku sha dzaḥ tso rī pā sha hūm̐/ bee tā lī bandha baṃ/ ghasma rī ghaṇḍa hoḥ zhes dgug gzhug bcing mnyes byas la/ slar yang snying kha'i 'od zer lcags kyu lta bus rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa spyan drangs/ oṃ badzra purmye āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ badzra dhu pe āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ badzra garnye āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ badzra ni widre āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ badzra ā lo ke āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ zhes mchod pa lngas mchod/ de rnams kyis dbang bskur bas sku rdo rje 'khor bcas la rnam par snang mdzad/ thugs rdo rje 'khor bcas la mi bskyod pa// gsung rdo rje 'khor bcas la 'od dpag tu med pas dbu brgyan par gyur/ oṃ pra wa ra saṭwā ra arghaṃ pra tītstsha swā hā/ oṃ pra wa ra sasko ra pāhūm̐ pra twetstsha

༄༅/ /swā hā/ oṃ badzra puṣṭi pra twetstsha swā hā/ oṃ badzra dhu pe pra twetstsha swā hā/ oṃ badzra ā lo ke pra twetstsha swā hā/ oṃ badzra garnye pra twetstsha swā hā/ oṃ badzra ni widre pra tītstsha swā hā/ skyed badzra shabha pra tītstsha swā hā/ ces chu gnyis dang /nyer spyod rol mos mchod/gtor ma bsangs sbyang byin gyis brlab pa ni/skyed badzra a mṛ ta kuṇḍa lī ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭa ces bsangs/oṃ swa bhā wa shuddhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā ba shuzlo3 haṃ gis sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las/ ye las rlung gi dkyil 'khor dud kha gzhu'i dbyibs lta bu mtha' ma gnyis ba dan gyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du ram̐ las me'i dkyil 'khor dmar po gru gsum pa/ de'i steng du a las thod pa phyi dkar la nang dmar ba/ nang gi dbus su mi'i sha dang byang chub kyi sems/ shar du glang po che'i sha dang dri chen/ lhor rta'i sha dang dri chu/ nub tu ba lang gi sha dang rakta/ byang du khyi'i sha dang rgyungs pa/

de rnams kyi phyi'i rnam pa oṃ/ srog la āḥ de'i steng du zla phyed rdo rje'i rtse mo la hūm̐ gis mtshan pa mgo thur du blta ba/ rlung gis me sbar thod pa bsros sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga khol bas/ oṃ dang āḥlas 'od zer 'phros te zla phyed rdo rje hūm̐ dang bcas pa las ye shes kyi bdud rtsi bab/ dam tshig gi bdud rtsi dang gnyis su med par 'dres par gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ gsum/ mthar zla phyed rdo rje yang thod pa'i nang du lhungs te zhu bas bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin tu gyur/ pad kor rdo rje thal mo kha phye bas/ skye( ind+ra/ dza ma/ dza la/ dzakṣa/ bhā da/ banni/ bā ༷// rakṣa/ tsanda/ snyudzdza/ mā da/ balpa/ ta la/ pā tā la/ aṣṭha saspa swā hā/ i rda/ ba li/ bhunywa/ dzi gha/phulla/ dhuspa/ māṃ sa/ skra gha/ ambha/ saspa/༄kadzdza/ sa dhā/ khānti/ khu ni/ phe ḍa/ gā da/ skyed a kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharmā rṇa ā du zhutpanma twa ta/ skyed āḥhūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ lan

rjo / sogs gza/kau/mni/ tt+waṃsna/ yakto rā ṭwāṃ byi~Xwa ṭwāṃd pa rdi dād/ga/ ṭwāṃdro sa/zlo/ shā snin rsha snaṭwāṃn nyi rdol/ sgo/ /'a/kṣiṃje sdi sna ṭwāṃ ༵ bye ༵ shā ba/ca/༵la/shā/cha ༷༷ / yi ris//gzhan 'phrul dbang byed pa rnams dang //gang zhig 'phrul dga' yi ni lha//gtsang ma'i gnas na gang dag gnas//bde ba can na gnas rnams dang //'og min gnas na gnas pa dang //'od zer can gyi 'jig rten gnas//sum cu rtsa gsum gnas pa rnams//klu chen stobs rgyu dung skyong dang //debazhinamatha'ayasanorargyasanyid 'jogapodanganirigasaldanate padachenapadmabazangapocan lhaminasemasacanadamyalabarabacasardorjegasu 34

gyi rang bzhin rnams/ /mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di sdoms la/ /rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas la/ /nad med tshe dang dbang phyug dang / /dpal dang grags dang skal pa bzang / /longs spyod rgya chen kun thob cing / /dbang dang mngon spyod dgra sde 'joms/ /dgar dang bsad dang dgug pa dang / /zhi dang rgyas la sogs pa yi/ /las kyi dngos grub bdag la stsol/ /dam tshig can gyis bdag la srungs/ /dngos grub kun gyi stong grogs mdzod/ /dus min 'chi dang nad rnams dang / /gdon dang bgegs rnams med par mdzod/ /rmi lam ngan dang mtshan ma ngan/ /mkha' 'gro'i byad sogs med par mdzod/ /'jig rten bde zhing lo legs dang / /'bru rnams 'phel zhing chos 'phel dang / /bde legs thams cad 'byung ba dang / /yid la 'dod pa kun rdzogs mdzod//

༄7 ces phrin las bcol/rdo rje'i glu blang ba ni/ padma la ni rdo rje gnas/ /padma nyid ni zhing yin no/ /rgyun tu cang te'u brdung bya ste/ /snying rjes ku co bsgrag mi —bya/ /de ru stobs ldan 'bad pas bza'/ /chang yang mang po btung bar bya/ /grogs po skal ldan gzhug par bya/ /skal ba med pa rnam par spang / /bzhi mnyam gla rtsi sihla dang / /ga bur rnams kyis byugs par bya/ /der ni tshod ma sha chen gyis/ /bkang ba dag kyang bza' bar bya/ /'gro dang 'ong ba 'gog mi byed/ /dag dang ma dag bsam mi bya/ /rus pa'i rgyan gyis lus la brgyan/ /de ru ro ni gzhug par bya/ /'dus phyir gnyis ni sbyor ba bya/ /der ni reg min spang mi bya/ /zhes dbyangs dang bcas te bya'o// skyersha pra wa ra satpar 65lhaji mā rna pra tīsbyo/ swā hā/ zhes pas mchod yon sbreng la mchod gtor gshegs/ rdo rje sems dpa'i yi ge brgya pa/ skyersha badzra sa

twa sa ma ya/ ma nu pā la ya/ badzra sa twa twe no pa/ tiṣṭhadṛ ḍho me bha wa/ su tostso me bha wa/ a nu rakto me bha wa/ su postso me bha wa/ sarba sirnyi mme pra yasmo sarba karma su tsa me/ tsitt+waṃ shri yeḥ ku ru hūm̐/ ha ha ha ha hoḥ bha ga wān/ sarba ta thā ga ta badzra mā me muñtsa badzrī bha wa ma hā sa ma ya sa twa āḥ oṃ āḥhūm̐ badzra muḥ btags la se gol gtogs/ gtor mgron rnams rang rang gi gnas su gshegs par gyur/ nye reg spro na skabs 'dir bya/ he ru ka phyag gnyis pa'i nga rgyal gyis nang du 'ongs te rdor dril rol mo bcas dkyil 'khor la g.yas su lan gsum bskor/ shar du g.yon sngon 'gro'i gzhi bca' dang sbrags la/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hi hi brjod de g.yas brkyang stabs kyis/ oṃ badzra be ga hūm̐/ dkyil 'khor gyi nang du rdo rje shugs kyi 'jug pas zhugs par gyur/ me tog sngon pa'i phreng ba gtso bo la 'bul ba'i mos pas/ oṃ pa ra ma su khā sha ya su la li ta bi lwa sa na ma ti na ma te na mā mi bha ga

༄7/ /banti dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ hi hi hi hi hiḥ pra tītstsha ku su māñdza li nā tha hoḥ zhes dkyil 'bar du dor zhing / slar yang phreng ba'i dbang bskur ba'i mos pas/ rang gi spyi bor bcings te phyag byas la/ de ring 'gro ba kun la dngos grub mchog /lus pa med pa'i bka' drin 365 bar mdzod/ /ces gsol te skor ba nas 'di bar slob ma dbang bskur skabs mi dgos so/༈ /gsum pa slob ma dkyil 'khor du gzhug pa ni/ las kyi slob dpon gyis yol ba'am phyi rol du spos chu'i bsang gtor/ maṇḍal/ me tog /gdong g.yogs rnams nyer bsdog bya/ slob ma rnams gos gtsang gyon cing mchil lham phud de gnas pa la khrus bya ba ni/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni/ /lha rnams kyis ni khrus garbershal ltar/ /lha yi chu ni dag pa yis/ /de bzhin bdag gis 'khrus bgyi'o/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐/ maṇḍal spyi mthun/ oṃ badzra bhū mi āḥhūm̐/ gzhi rnam par dag pa dbang chen gser gyi sa gzhi/

oṃ badzra re khe āḥhūm̐/ phyi lcags ri'i khor yug gi rwa bas yongs su bskor ba'i dbus su ri'i rgyal po ri bo mchog rab/ shar lus 'phags po/ lho 'dzam bu gling / nub ba lang spyod/ byang sgra mi snyan/ byang shar du zla ba/ lho nub tu nyi ma/ lha dang mi'i dpal 'byor phun sum tshogs pa ma tshang ba med pa 'di nyid bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo tha mi dad pa'i drung du dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa'i chos rnams zhu ba'i yon tu 'bul bar bgyi'o/ /zhes phul/ sdom ni/ gsol gdab gdong bcing nang du gzhug /bgegs bsal dri lan gsol ba btab/ /sgo bzhir zhugs dang lnga rnam dang / /sdom pa bsgrag gzung me tog sbyin/ /don dam sems bskyed dam bsgrag gnyis/ /mna' chu slob dpon dam bzhag dang / /gsol ba gdab cing bdud rtsi blud/ /ye shes dbab dang brtan par bya/ /snang ba brtag cing me tog gtor/ /mig dbye dkyil 'khor bstan pa'o/ /zhes bya ba rnams las thorga/ mar gsol ba gdab pa ni/ thal sbyar

༄༅/ /bcas/ sangs rgyas kun gyi rang bzhin sku/ /slob dpon la ni skyabs su mchi/ /gtso bo lha mor bcas pa yi/ /lha rnams la yang phyag 'tshal lo/ /thar pa chen po'i grong mchog tu/ /mgon po bdag ni 'jug par 'tshal/ /lan gsum/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ dang spos chus bsangs pa'i gdong g.yogs dmar po bcing / las rdor gyi rdo rje la 'dzin tu bcug nas nang du khrid de slob dpon gyi mdun tu 'bod pa la/ na maḥs manta buddha nai/ na maḥs manta dharmā khāe/ na maḥs manta saṃ ghā nai/ oṃ si tā tā pa tre/ oṃ bi ma la/ oṃ shang ka ra/ oṃ pra tyadhi ra/ badzra uṣṭi ṣa tsakra brti/ sarba yant+ra mant+ra/ mū la karma/ bandha nai/ tā ḍa n-i/ gī la nai thā/ ma ma kṛ ta ye na ken tsi ta kṛ tanta tra/ sarbantu/tshinda tshinda/ bhinda bhinda/ tsi ri tsi ri/ gi ri gi ri/ mā ra mā ra/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa/ ces gtsug tor stsor los sgyur ba'i sngags dang / na maḥs manta

bzhe bhyaḥ oṃ na mo badzra kro dhwa ya/ ma hā do〉sko ṭa bhe ra wā ya/ badzra sarnyo ha darla ya/ oṃ a mṛ ta kuṇḍa lī hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces bdud rtsi waṃl ba'i sngags ring lan re brjod pas bgegs bsal/ gu gul bdug /yungs thun brabs/ slob dpon gyis/ bu cesad rna/ yin zhes 'dri/ slob mas kyang bdag skal pa bzang 21 lags zhes lan gsum brjod cing / slob dpon gyis/ dkyil 'khor pa la/ de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi gnas/ /he ru ka dpal grong khyer mchog /snying po'i dkyil 'khor 'di ru ni/ /bdag gis slob ma gzhug par bgyi/ /zhes gsol ba bto bo/ /de nas/ dkyil 'khor gyi shar gyi sgo phyes te nang du zhugs nas shar gyi lha snam la gnas par gyur par mos mdzod/ thal mo gnas gsum sbyar te/ oṃ na ma ste hūm̐/ na mā mi hūm̐/ na ces na maḥhūm̐ swā hā/ zhes gnas lnga sa la gtugs pa'i phyag bya zhing yid kyis lha dgu'i zhabs la btud pa'i phyag byas pas shin tu mnyes par sems su bcug go/ blo/ de nyid nas

༄7/ /thon te g.yas bskor gyis lho'i sgo phyes te nang du zhugs nas lho'i lha snam la gnas par gyur par mos mdzod/ thal mo gnas gsum sbyar te/ oṃ na ma ste hūm̐/ na mā mi hūm̐/ na mo na maḥhūm̐ swā hā/ sgo de nyid nas thon te g.yas bskor gyis nub kyi sgo phyes te nang du zhugs nas nub kyi lha snam la gnas par gyur par mos mdzod/ thal mo gnas gsum sbyar te/ oṃ na ma ste hūm̐/ na mā mi hūm̐/ na mo na maḥhūm̐ swā hā/ sgo de nyid nas thon te g.yas bskor gyis byang gi sgo phyes te nang du zhugs nas byang gi lha snam la gnas par gyur par mos mdzod/ thal mo gnas gsum sbyar te/ oṃ na ma ste hūm̐/ na mā mi hūm̐/ na mo na maḥhūm̐ swā hā/ slar yang shar sgo nas zhugs te shar gyi lha snam la 'oshesad par gyur par mos la/ sdig pa bshags pa sogs lnga rnam dag ni/ bdag gis sdig pa bgyis pa dang / /bgyid du bstsal dang yi rang ba//

sangs rgyas spyan sngar mchis nas su/ /de dag thams cad bshags par bya/ /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dang / /rang rgyal dgra bcom 'gro rnams kyi/ /sgom dang bzlas brjod bsod nams gang / /de la bdag ni yi rang ngo / /bdag gi dge ba'i las rnams 'di dag gis/ /'jig rten 'dir ni myur du sangs rgyas rbestog /'gro la phan phyir chos rnams ston bgyid cing / /sems can sdug bsngal mang pos gzir las dgrol/ /sems bskyed mngon par sangs rgyas dang / /chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba dang / /byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyi mchog /de la bdag ni skyabs su mchi/ /sangs rgyas 'byung ba ji lta bar//skal ldan byang chub sems dpa' yis/ /byang chub sems ni bskyed pa ltar/ /deng nyid du ni sems bskyed do/ /lan gsum bya'o/ /de nas sdom pa bsgrag pa ni/ sangs

༄7/ /rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te/ /dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su song / /'di ni sangs rgyas rigs dag pa'i/ /sdom pa brtan por gyur pa'o/ /rdo rje dril bu'i phyag rgya ni/ /blo chen khyod kyis gzung bar bya/ /byang chub sems gang de rdo rje/ /shes rab dril bu zhes bsgrags so/ /slob ma khyod kyis bzung bya ste/ /bla ma sangs rgyas kun dang mnyam/ /'di ni rdo rje'i rigs dag pa'i/ /dam tshig sdom pa yin par bshad/ /rin chen rigs la rtag tu ni//nyin re bzhin tu lan drug tu/ /zang zing mi 'jigs chos dang byams/ /sbyin pa rnam bzhi rtag tu sbyin/ /phyi nang gsang ba theg pa gsum/ /dam pa'i chos kyang ma lus gzung / /'di ni padma'i rigs dag pa'i/ /dam tshig yid du 'ong ba'o/ /las kyi rigs mchog chen po la/ /sdom pa thams cad ldan par ni//

yang dag nyid du gzung bar bgyi/ /mchod pa'i las kyang ci nus bgyi/ /zhes pas rigs lnga'i sdom pa dang / gang phyir rdo rje 'dzin pa yi/ /dngos grub slob dpon rjes 'brang gsungs/ /de bas de la brnyas pa ni/ /rtsa ba'i lhung ba dang por bshad/ /bde gshegs bka' las 'das pa ni/ /lhung ba gnyis pa yin par bshad//rdo rje spun la khros pa ni/ /nyes par brjod pa gsum pa yin/ /sems can rnams la byams sems sprong / /bzhi pa yin par rgyal bas gsungs/ /chos kyi rtsa ba byang chub sems/ /de spong ba ni lnga pa yin/ /rang dang gzhan gyi grub pa'i mtha'/ /chos la smod pa drug pa yin/ /yongs su ma smin sems can la/ /gsang ba sgrog pa bdun pa yin/ /phung po sangs rgyas lnga bdag nyid/ /smod par byed pa brgyad pa yin/ /rang bzhin dag pa'i chos rnams la/ /som nyi za ba dgu pa

༄7/ /yin/ /gdug la rtag tu byams ldan par/ /byed pa de ni bcu par 'dod/ /ming sogs bral ba'i chos rnams la/ /der rtog pa ni bcu gcig pa/ /sems can dad dang ldan pa la/ /sems sun 'byin pa bcu gnyis pa/ /dam tshig la ni ji bzhin nyid/ /mi bsten pa de bcu gsum pa/ /shes rab rang bzhin bud med la/ /smod par byed pa bcu bzhi pa/ /sngags pas 'di dag spang na ni/ /dngos grub nges par thob par 'gyur/ /zhes slob dpon gyis lan gcig bsgrag /slob mas sdom pa 'dzin cing dam tshig bsrung bar khas len pa ni/ slob dpon 'dir ni bdag la gson/ /gtso bos ji ltar bka' stsal ba/ /de ltar bdag ni bgyid par 'tshal/ /ji ltar dus gsum mgon po rnams/ /byang chub tu ni nges mdzad pa'i/ /byang chub sems ni bla na med/ /dam pa bdag gis bskyed

par bgyi/ /sangs rgyas rnal 'byor sdom pa la/ /sdom pa yi ni tshul khrims dang / /dge ba'i chos ni sdud pa dang / /sems can don byed tshul khrims gsum//bdag gis brtan por bzung bar bgyi/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te/ /bla na med pa'i dkon mchog gsum/ /deng nas brtsams te bzung bar bgyi/ /nam du yang ni mi spang ngo / /rdo rje'i rigs mchog chen po la/ /rdo rje dril bu'i phyag rgya yang / /yang dag nyid du bzung bar bgyi/ /slob dpon dag kyang bzung bar bgyi/ /rin chen rigs mchog chen po yi/ /dam tshig yid du 'ong ba la/ /nyin re bzhin du dus drug tu/ /sbyin pa rnam bzhi rtag tu sbyin//byang chub chen po las byung ba'i/ /padma'i rigs chen dag pa la/ /phyi nang gsang ba theg pa gsum/ /dam pa'i chos ni gzung bar bgyi/ /las kyi rigs

༄tsho/ /mchog chen po la/ /sdom pa thams cad ldan par ni/ /yang dag nyid du gzung bar bgyi/ /mchod pa'i las kyang ci nus bgyi/ /bla na med pa'i byang chub sems/ /dam pa bdag gis bskyed bgyis nas/ /sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir/ /bdag gis sdom pa ma lus bzung / /ma brgal ba rnams bsgral bar bgyi/ /ma grol ba rnams bdag gis dgrol/ /dbugs ma phyin pa dbugs dbyung zhing / /sems can mya ngan 'das la 'god/ /zhes lan gsum gyis sdom pa bzung ngo / /de nas/ slob ma rnams bcom ldan 'das dgyes pa rdo rje sku mdog nag po zhal brgyad/ phyag bcu drug zhabs bzhi pa/ rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan cing yum bdag med ma dang mnyam par sbyor ba'i skur gyur/ las thams cad pas bsangs pa'i me tog/ oṃ āḥkhaṃ bī ra hūm̐/ zhes pas gtad pa thal mo'i bar du bcug ste snying

gar bzung /slob dpon gyis de'i snying gar rdo rje bzhag la/ skyed sarba yo ga tsitta 55gle da yā mi/ rjes zlos lan gsum/ skye/ su ra te sa ma ya st+waṃ/ skyersha bo dhi tsitta badzra ya thā su khaṃ/ lan gcig gis don dam sems bskyed brtan par byas nas/ lha'i dam tshig bsgrag pa ni/ de ring khyod dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma thams cad kyi nang du zhugs kyis/ ngas khyod la dpal he ru ka'i ye shes bskyed par bya'o/ /khyod de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dang / dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma thams cad kyi dngos grub thob par 'gyur na/dngos grub gzhan lta smos kyang ci dgos/ khyod kyis dkyil 'khor ma mthong ba'i mdun tu smra bar mi bya ste/ khyod dam tshig nyams par 'gyur ta re/ snying gar rdo rje btsā la/ he ru ka dpal deng khyod kyi/ /snying la yang dag zhugs par mdzad/ /gal te tshul 'di smras na ni/ /de ma thag tu dral te gshegs// zhes brjod do//

ra༅༅ mna' chu blud pa ni/ thod pa'i nang du bdud rtsi'i ril bu ma dā na dang sbyar ba/ skyed āḥhūm̐/ zhes yi ge gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs la/ 'di ni khyod kyi dmyal ba'i chu/ /dam tshig 'das na sreg par byed/ /dam tshig bsrung na dngos grub ni/ /rdo rje bdud rtsi'i chu 'dis 'grub/ /oṃ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta u da ka hūm̐/ zhes pas 'thung du gzhug cing / slob dpon gyis dam tshig bsgrag pa ni/ deng nas brtsams te khyod kyi dpal he ru ka nga yin gyi/ ngas gang byos shig ces bsgo ba de khyod kyis bya dgos so/ /khyod kyis nga la brnyas pa'i las ma byed cig khyod mi bde ba ma spangs par tshe'i dus byas nas dmyal bar lhung bar 'gyur ta re/ zhes bsgrag go/ /de nas ye shes pa dbab pa'i don tu/dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma thams cad kyis byin gyis rlobs la/ dpal he ru ka bdag la phob cig /lan gsum gsol ba gdab tu gzhug /bdud rtsi lnga'i chu byin

nas/ khyod rang gi snying gar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor/ de'i dbus su hūm̐ sngon po 'od zer dang bcas pa/ de'i mtha' ma na snying po'i sngags me mar gyi rnam pa bzhin tu dmar lhag lhag pa sgoms shig /dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo bcom ldan 'das sems dpa' sum brtseg tu bzhugs pa'i sa bon hūm̐ sngon po las 'od zer dkar po breng ma chad par na ra ra byung ba/ khyod rang gi snying gar zhugs pas rkyen byas pas lus 'od du me re re zhu bar gyur/ dmigs pa de la sems rtse gcig tu gtod la gzhan gang la'ang yengs su ma gzhug /ces brda sbyar la 'bebs rdzas sam gu gul bdug cing rol mo'i sgra drag tu bya/ mkha' 'gro thams cad kyi byin rlabs slob ma'i rgyud la shar bar bltas te/ snying po'i gzham du 65 65 btags pa bzlas la ye shes pa dbab bo/ /de yang / sku phebs na 'phar ba dang 'dar ba sogs dang / gsung phebs na chos smra ba dang / thugs phebs na mi rtog pa'i ting nge 'dzin 'byung ngo / /des

ra༅tsho ma phebs na snga ma bzhin tu yang yang bskyar te dbab pas phebs par 'gyur ro/ /phebs par gyur na/ slob ma snang ba mtha' yas su bsgoms te/ lce la āḥdamar po bsam nas/ smyos shig bu yis dge mi dge/ /zhes dris pas dge ba dang mi dge ba thams cad ston par byed do/ /ye shes pa babs pa na slob dpon gyi lag pa spos chus brlan te/ slob ma'i spyi bor bzhag la tiṣṭha baṇḍardo zhes pas brtan par bya zhing /rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor gyi kha dog ji lta bu mthong zhes 'dri'o/ /de rnams kyis kyang rang gis ji ltar mthong ba bzhin brjod par bya ste/ dkar ser dmar ljang sna tshogs rnams la rim pa bzhin tu zhi ba dang / rgyas pa dang /dbang dang / mngon spyod dang / las thams cad pa 'grub pa'i ltas su nges par bya'o/ /de nas slob dpon gyis/ yang dag pa yi dkyil 'ashesar 'dir/ /bdag gi ste/ba ma gzhug par bya/ /lha rnams kyi ni rigs ji bzhin/ /ji ltar bsod nams de bzhin 3|ga /ces brjod pa'i rjes su/ slob mas pra twetstsha badzra hoḥ zhes pas me tog phreng ba dkyil 'bor gyi dbus su dmigs

la dor ro/ /de yang gtso bo la phog na mchog gi dngos grub 'khor rnams la phog na thun mong gi dngos grub/ pho brang gi nang du tshud na 'jig rten pa'i dngos grub thob cing / lan gsum bskyar yang pho brang du ma chud na gdon mi za bar 'chi'o/ /zhes bshad/ slob dpon gyis slar yang me tog gi phreng ba de blangs te/ sems can rnyesnabs can khyedad kyis ni/ /'di ni rab tu gzung bar gyis/ /shes me tog gi phreng ba mgo la bcing / slob ma'i mig tu oṃ yig re re gsal bar gyur/ he ru ka dpal deng khyod kyi/ /mig 'byed par ni brtson par mdzod/ /phye bas thams cad mthong bar 'gyur/ /rdo rje'i mig ni bla na med/ /oṃ āḥhūm̐/ ces gdong g.yogs bsal nas/ dkyil 'khor bzang po 'di la ltos/ /da ni dad pa rab tu bskyed/ /khyod ni rnal 'byor ma rigs skyes/ /sngags dang phyag rgyas byin gyis brlabs/ /'gro ba phun tshogs dngos grub kyang / /thams cad 'di las mngon tu 'gyur/ /dngos

༄7/ /grub thob phyir dam tshig skyongs/ /gsang sngags la yang brtson par gyis/ /zhes lta bar bskul nas/snye dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su bcom ldan 'das sogs nas dur khrod me ri'i bar mngon rtogs ltar lha ngo rgyas par bstan/ ga bdag 'jug skabs sogs bsdu na/ chos 'byung gi nang du sna tshogs padma dang sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte bar mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i gzhal yas khang dur khrod rdo rje'i rwa ba me ris bskor ba'i gzhal yas khang gi dbus su/ padma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar bcom ldan 'das yab yum/ 'dab ma brgyad la go rī la sogs pa'i lha mo brgyad sogs rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'ishesar malhudun rna/ma du ma〈snang bar sdo/ra/ zhes sam/ mtshan tsam gyis lha ngo bstan la/ de las kyang khyod kyi me tog phog pa'i lha ni 'di yin no zhes bstan no/ /bzhi pa dbang bzhi bskur ba'i cho ga la bzhi/

bum pa/ gsang ba/ shes rab ye shes/ dbang bzhi pa'o/ /dang po rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor du bum pa'i dbang bskur ba la bco brgyad de/ gsol gdab rig pa'i dbang lnga dang / /thun mong rjes gnang dam tshig gsum//rigs lnga'i rjes su gnang ba dang / /lung bstan gzengs bstod dbugs dbyung dang / /slob dpon dbang dang brtul zhugs so/ /de la thog mar maṇḍal 'bul ba ni/ sa gzhi 11sa chus byugs 3)nga me shenag bkram/ /ri rab gling bzhi nyi zlas brgyan pa 'di/ /sangs rgyas zhing du dmigs te phul ba yis/ /'gro kun rnam dag zhing la spyod par rbestog /gsol ba gdab pa ni/ he ru ka dpal dbang bskur ba/ /'gro ba skyob phyir gzi brjid can/ /ji ltar yon tan 'byung la sogs/ /de bzhin bdag la'ang de stsol cig /dpa' bo chen po mi ldog pa'i/ /dbang bskur ba ni bdag la stsol/ /sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir/ /bdag ni rtag tu slob dpon bgyid// lan gsum/de nas chu dbang

dbyubyu ni/slob ma ba'i rnam lngas byugs pa'i maṇḍal shar du bgod pa la bzhag nas/ skye( badzra a skṛ ta kuṇḍa lī ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭa ces bsangs/ skye( rakṣa rakṣa hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/gis bsrung la/ dkyil 'khor gyi shar phyogs su dbang stegs mchod pa'i bkod pa du ma dang ldan pa'i dbus su/ slob ma skad cig gis pad nyi'i gdan la mi bskyod pa sku mdog sngon po rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ mā ma ki sngon mo gri thod 'dzin pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba la/ mkha' 'gro ma du mas bdud rtsi'i bum pas dbang bskur bar sgoms/ bum pa rgyas par yod na so so'i bum chu rnam rgyal du bsdus te/slob ma'i spyi bor bkod de/ dbang bskur rdo rje chen po ni/ /khams gsum kun gyis phyag byas pa/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi gsang gsum las/ /rab tu byung ba sbyin par bya/ /zhes dang / skyed de wa pi tsu badzra hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ ces snying po'i mthar/ skye/ badzra u

da ka a bhi ṇi3ni māṃ/ zhes brjod cing bum pa'i chu bdud rtsi byang chub sems su dmigs la spyi bor blugs/ kha gdong bkrus shing cung zad 'thung du gzhug go/ de ltar chu'i dbang bskur bas kun gzhi'i rnam par shes pa gnas gyur nas me long lta bu'i ye shes rgyud la skyes pa'i mos pa gyis shig /dbu rgyan dbang ni/ oṃ badzra a mṛ ta kuṇḍa lī ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭa ces bsangs/ oṃ rakṣa rakṣa hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ gis bsrung la/ slob ma skad cig gis pad nyi'i gdan la rin chen 'byung ldan ser po rin po che dang / des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum rin chen sgrol ma ser mo gri thod 'dzin pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ dbang rdzas bsangs sbyang / oṃ badzra a mṛ ta kuṇḍa lī ha na ha na hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ swa bhā wa shuddhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā ba shuddhi3 haṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las/ pad nyi'i gdan la dbu rgyan āo las rin chen 'byung ldan ser po rin po che dang /

༄༅/ /des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum rin chen sgrol ma ser mo gri thod 'dzin pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ gtso bo'i thugs ka'i 'od zer gyis bsgoms pa dang 'dra ba'i ye shes pa spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ dam tshig pa dang gnyis su med par gyur/ swā ratnarghaṃ ka/ gsum/ oṃ badzra puspro āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ skyed badzra dhu pe āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ skyed badzra gandhe āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ skyed badzra ni widre āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ skyed badzra ā 31 ke āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ nyer spyod lngas mchod/ rin chen 'byung ldan yab yum snyoms par zhugs shing zhu ba dbu rgyan gyi gzugs su gsal ba mkha' 'gro ma du mas dar dpyangs dang bcas pa bsnams te dbang bskur bar gyur/ mgor bskon la/ thor tshugs cod pan gyis brgyan pa/ /sangs rgyas kun gyis bsngas/sa pa yi/ /rin chen dag gi dbu rgyan dang / /dar dpyangs

dbang bskur sbyin par bya/ /oṃ ratna a bhi ṣiñtsa / de ltar dbu rgyan dar dpyangs dang bcas pas dbang bskur bas nyon mongs pa can gyi yid gnas gyur nas/ mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes rgyud la skyes pa'i mos pa gyis shig /rdo rje'i dbang ni/ oṃ badzra a mṛ ta kuṇḍa lī ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭa ces bsangs/ oṃ rakṣa rakṣa hūm̐ hūṃ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ gis bsrung la/ slob ma skad cig gis pad nyi'i gdan la snang ba mtha' yas dmar po padma dang des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum gos dkar mo dmar mo gri thod 'dzin pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ dbang rdzas bsangs sbyang / oṃ badzra a mṛ ta kuṇḍa lī ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ swa bhā wa shuddhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā ba shuddhi3 haṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las pad nyi'i gdan la rdo rje dzrī las snang ba mtha' yas dmar po padma dang des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum gos

༄7/ /dkar mo dmar mo gri thod 'dzin pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ gtso bo'i thugs ka'i 'od zer gyis bsgoms pa dang 'dra ba'i ye shes pa spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ dam tshig pa dang gnyis su med par gyur/ hrīḥpadma dhri ka/ gsum/ oṃ badzra pursha āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ skyed badzra dhu pe āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ skyed badzra garnye āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ skyed badzra ni wibye āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ badzra ā lo ke āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ nyer spyod lngas mchod/snang ba mtha' yas yab yum snyoms par zhugs shing zhu ba rdo rje'i rnam par gsal ba mkha' 'gro ma du mas bsnams te dbang bskur bar gyur/ lag pa g.yas su gtad la/ sangs rgyas kun gyi rdo rje'i dbang / /de ring khyod la bskur bar bya/ /sangs rgyas kun tu rab bsgrub phyir/ /rdo rje 'di ni khyod kyis longs/ /oṃ badzra a bhi ṣiñtsa de ltar rdo rje'i dbang bskur bas yid kyi rnam par shes pa
