gnas gyur nas/ so sor kun tu rtogs pa'i ye shes rgyud la skyes pa'i mos pa gyis shig /dril bu'i dbang ni/oṃ badzra a skṛ ta kuṇḍa lī ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭa ces bsangs/oṃ rakṣa rakṣa hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ gis bsrung la/ slob ma skad cig gis pad nyi'i gdan la don yod grub pa ljang gu ral gri dang des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum dam tshig sgrol ma ljang gu gri thod 'dzin pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ dbang rdzas bsangs sbyang / oṃ badzra a skṛ ta kuṇḍa lī ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ swa bhā wa shuddhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā ba shuddhi3 haṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las pad nyi'i gdan la dril bu khaṃ las don yod grub pa ljang gu ral gri dang des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum dam tshig sgrol ma ljang gu gri thod 'dzin pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ gtso bo'i thugs ka'i 'od zer gyis bsgoms pa dang 'dra ba'i ye shes pa

༄༅/ /spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ dam tshig pa dang gnyis su med par gyur/ āḥkarmadṛ ka/ gsum/ oṃ badzra puṣṭi āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ badzra dhu pe āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ badzra gandhe āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ badzra ni widre āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ badzra ā 'osto ke āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ nyer spyod lngas mchod/don yod grub pa yab yum snyoms par zhugs shing zhu ba dril bu'i rnam par gsal ba mkha' 'gro ma du mas bsnams te dbang bskur bar gyur/ lag g.yon tu gtad/ sangs rgyas kun gyi dril bu'i dbang / /de ring khyod la bskur bar bya/ /sangs rgyas kun tu rab bsgrub phyir/ /dril bu 'di ni khyod kyis longs/ /oṃ badzra a dhi pa ti st+waṃ/ a bhi ṣiñtsā mi/ tiṣṭha badzra sa ma ya st+waṃ/ de ltar dril bu'i dbang bskur bas sgo lnga'i rnam par shes pa gnas gyur nas/ bya ba grub pa'i ye shes rgyud la skyes pa'i mos pa gyis shig /ming

dbang ni/ skyed badzra a skṛ ta kuṇḍa lī ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭa ces bsangs/ skyed rakṣa rakṣa hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ gis bsrung la/ :rdzob ma skad cig gis pad nyi'i gdan la rnam snang dkar po 'khor lo dang des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum sangs rgyas spyan ma dkar mo gri thod 'dzin pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ mkha' 'gro ma du mas chos thams cad stong pa nyid du rtogs pa'i brdar rdo rje spyi bor bzhag ste ming gi dbang bskur bar gyur/ sangs rgyas kun gyi ming gi dbang / /de ring khyod la bskur bar bya/ /sangs rgyas kun tu rab bsgrub phyir/ /ming gi dbang ni khyod kyis longs/ /oṃ badzra sa twa st+waṃ a bhi ṣiñtsa / oṃ badzra nā ma a bhi ṣe ka taḥkye dpal che ge mo he 〈co ka zhes bya3(/ /ming gi bye brag /rdo rje bzhad pa/rdo rje rnam par sgeg pa/ zhes skyes pa dang /rdo rje bsnyems ma/rdo rje mtshon cha ma/rdo rje e ma'o bde ba/rdo rje bdag med ma/ zhes pa bud

da༅༅ med rnams la'o/ /gtso bo la me tog phog na/ rdo rje sems dpa'/ dgyes pa rdo rje/ rang byung rnam snang chen po/ rdo rje ā ra li/ thugs rdo rje khro bo/ rdo rje khro bo/ /rdo rje bdud rtsi/ bdud rtsi 'byil ba/he ru ka/snying rje'i stobs zhes gdags shing / de ltar ming gi dbang bskur bas ming gzhi'i phung po gnas gyur nas/ chos dbyings ye shes rgyud la skyes pa'i mos pa gyis shig /des ma rig pa lnga gnas gyur te rig pa'i ye shes lnga mngon tu byed pas rig pa'i dbang ngo / /zhes brda sprad/ 7/ thun mong gi dngos grub rjes su gnang ba ni/ slob ma skad cig gis bcom ldan 'das dgyes pa rdo rje sku mdog nag po zhasnyesmu brgyad/ phyag bcu drug /zhabs bzhi pa/ rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan cing yum bdag med ma dang mnyam par sbyor ba'i skur gyur/ gri thod bsangs sbyang / oṃ badzra a mṛ ta kuṇḍa lī ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ swa bhā wa shuddhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā ba 8)(྅ haṃ/

stong pa'i ngang las a las gri gug shes rab kyi rang bzhin dang / hūm̐ las thod pa thabs bde ba'i rang bzhin tu bsam/ he ru ka dpal kha ṭwāṃ ga /rnal 'byor ma ni ḍa ma mā /rdo rje kha ṭwāṃ rdo rjer bcas/ /dril bu sil sil sgra sgrogs shing / /tshangs pa'i skud thogs rnal 'byor bdag /gri gug dang ni ka pā la/ /dpa' bo chen pos blang bar gyis//snye dbang bskur skabs/ de rnams dang ldan pas zhi ba dang / rgyas pa dang / dbang dang / drag po dang / bskrad pa dang / rmongs par bya ba dang / dgra'i sde 'jig pa dang / bsad pa la sogs pa las de rnams thogs pa med par byos shig /mchil lhum bgo ba dang / char dbab pa dang /nyi ma dang zla ba bzung ba la sogs pa mkha' 'gro ma'i dngos grub thams cad kyang ci dga' bar bsgrub par gyis shig /ces gri gug g.yas thod pa g.yon tu sbyin/

༄༅ /ga dam tshig gsum sbyin pa ni/ slob ma pad zla'i gdan la skad cig gis rdo rje sems dpa' sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ dar dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis spras pa/ zhabs sems dpa'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ rdo rje la/ oṃ badzra a mṛ ta kuṇḍa lī ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭa ces bsangs/ stong pa'i ngang las hūm̐ las byung ba'i rdo rjer gyur/ thog mtha' med pa'i sems dpa' ni/ /rdo rje sems dpa' dga' ba che/ /kun tu bzang po kun bdag nyid/ /rdo rje bsnyems tshul bdag po'i bdag /bcom ldan 'das dpal mchog dang po'i skyes bu'o zhes brjod de/ lag pa g.yas su byin la/snye bdag 'jug la 'di rigs ma brjod kyang rung —des kyang 'khor ba dang mya ngan las 'das pa dbyer med du rtogs par bya'o/ /snyam pa'i blos snying gar rdo rje bzung ba ni thugs kyi dam tshig go/nga /dril bu

la/ oṃ badzra a mṛ ta kuṇḍa lī ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭa ces bsangs/ stong pa'i ngang las a las byung ba'i dril bur gyur/ 'di ni rnal 'byor ma kun gyi/ /shes rab dbyangs kyi rjes 'gror bshad/ /khyod kyis kyang ni rtag tu bcang / /byang chub mchog tu rgyal bas bshad/ /srid pa ngo bo nyid kyis dag /ngo bo nyid kyis dngos med byas/ /rang bzhin dag pa'i sems dpa' ni/ /srid pa'i dam pa byed par 'gyur/ /zhes dril bu g.yon tu byin la/snye chos kyi phung po brgyad khri bzhi stong sems can thams cad la rjesags par bya3sdo snyam pa'i blos dkrol du gzhug pa ni gsung gi dam tshig go//de nas rang gi me tog phog pa'i lha bsgom par gsungs kyang spyi khyab tu/ ga slob ma bcesam ldan 'das yab yum gyi skur gsal bar gyur/ rdor dril 'byud pa'i tshul gyis/ yid kyi lus ni brtan pa'i phyir/ /phyag rgya'i dam tshig ces su brjod/ /dam tshig yid ni brtan

༄༅/ /pa gang / /de phyir phyag rgyar rab tu grags/ /zhes dang /snye dus 'di nas bzung ste yi dam gyi lha dang skad cig kyang mi 'bral bar gyis shig ces bya ba ni sku'i dam tshig go/ /rigs lnga'i rjes gnang ni/ bdag 'jug skabs lha bskyed dor te tshigs bcad rkyang pas rung / slob ma rnam snang dkar po byang chub mchog gi phyag rgya can dar dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa pad zla'i steng la rdo rje skyil krung gis bzhugs par gyur/de'i phyag rgya byed du gzhug/ nga 'jig rten khams ni thams cad du/ /sems can kun la phan pa'i phyir/ /ji ltar sna 31gas 'dul gyur pa/ /chos kyi 'khor lo rab tu skor/ /zhes dang / khyod kyi gdul bya gti mug can rnams kyi don gyis shig /ces brjod/ slob ma mi bskyod pa sngon po sa gnon dang mnyam bzhag gi phyag rgya can dar dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa pad zla'i steng la rdo rje skyil krung gis bzhugs par gyur/ 'jig rten khams ni thams cad du/ /sems can ṭa/na la phan

pa'i phyir/ /ji ltar sna tshogs 'dul gyur pa/ /rdo rje'i 'khor lo rab tu skor/ /zhes dang / khyod kyi gdul bya zhe sdang can rnams kyi don gyis shig /ces brjod/slob ma rin chen 'byung ldan ser po mchog sbyin mnyam bzhag gi phyag rgya can dar dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa pad zla'i steng la rdo rje skyil krung gis bzhugs par gyur/ 'jig rten khams ni thamarba cad du/ /sems can kun la phan pa'i phyir/ /ji ltar sna tshogs 'dul gyur pa/ /nor bu'i 'khor lo rab tu skor/ /zhes dang / khyod kyi gdul bya ser sna can rnams kyi cesan gyis 3)ga /ces brjod/ slob ma snang ba mtha' yas dmar po ting nge 'dzin gyi phyag rgya can dar dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa pad zla'i steng la rdo rje skyil krung gis bzhugs par gyur/ 'jig rten khams ni thams cad du/ /sems can kun la phan pa'i phyir/ /ji ltar sna tshogs 'dul gyur pa/ /padma'i 'khor lo rab tu skor/ /zhes dang / khyod kyi gdul bya

ra༅༅/ /'dod chags can rnams kyi don gyis shig/ ces brjod/ slob ma don grub ljang gu skyabs sbyin mnyam bzhag gi phyag rgya can dar dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa pad zla'i steng la rdo rje skyil krung gis bzhugs par gyur/ 'jig rten khams ni thams cad du/ /sems can kun la phan pa'i phyir/ /ji ltar sna tshogs 'dul gyur pa/ /las kyi 'khor 31 rab tu skor/ /zhes dang / khyod kyi gdul bya le lo can rnams kyi don gyis shig /ces brjod/ slob dpon dbu zhwa phud chos gos snam sbyar bgos pa'i sne la slob ma dag gis 'dzin tu bcug pa'am/ gzhung gzhan nas 'byung ba bzhin/grwa gnyis rna ba ltar byas pa g.yon pa'i khu tshur gyis gzung / g.yas skyabs sbyin gyi phyag rgya byas te/ 'dir ni ngas (1da sdo/nga bstan yin/ /the/ rje sems dpa' de bzhin gshegs/ /srid pa shin tu dag pas na/ /srid dang ngan 'gro rnams las bton/ /shrī che ge mo he ru ka nā ma sarba ta thā ga ta sirnyi sa ma ya st+waṃ bhurbha

wa swa/ 'e/sa dang /snye dbang bskur skabs/ khyod kyi gzugs kyi phung po dang gti mug rnam par dag pa ni go rī ma'o/ /tshor ba'i phung po dang ser sna rnam par dag pa ni tso rī ma'o/ /'du shes kyi phung po dang 'dod chags rnam par dag pa ni bee tā li'o/ /'du byed kyi phung po dang phrag dog rnam par dag pa ni ghasma rī'o/ /rnam par shes pa'i phung po dang nyon mongs pa zhe sdang rnam par dag pa ni bdag med ma'o/ /'byung ba sa rnam par dag pa ni puska sī'o/ /chu rnam par dag pa ni sha ba rī'o/ /me rnam par dag pa ni tsaṇḍa lī'o/ /rlung rnam par dag pa ni ḍombi nī'o/ /mig gi dbang po dang mig gi rnam shes rnam par dag pa ni gti mug rdo rje'o/ /rna ba'i dbang po dang rna ba'i rnam shes rnam par dag pa ni zhe sdang rdo rje'o/ /sna'i dbang po dang sna'i rnam shes rnam par dag pa ni ser sna rdo

༄tsho/ /rje'o/ /lte'i dbang po dang lte'i rnam shes rnam par dag pa ni 'dod chags rdo rje'o/ /lus kyi dbang po dang lus kyi rnam shes rnam par dag pa ni phrag dog rdo rje'o/ /yid kyi dbang po dang yid kyi rnam shes rnam par dag pa ni reg bya rdo rje ma ste/ khyod rang gi phung khams skye mched thams cad lha dang lha mor bstan pa yin no// ga de ltar lung bstan pas sngon ma shes pa'i rang ngo lhar shes pa'i dga' ba skyes pa la gzengs bstod pa ni/bde chen theg pa 'di la ni/ /phyin chad 'chi ba skustod ma yin/ /srid pa shin tu dag pas na/ /srid pa'i sdug bsngal 'das pa'o/// dbang bskur skabs/khyed cag thog ma med pa nas khams gsum 'khesar bar 'oshesar/ngal ba don med pa 'ba' zhig tu song / da ni bcom ldan 'das dgyes pa rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor du zhugs shing dbang bskur/ dam tshig dang sdom pa thob

pas/ mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad las 'jigs pa med par byos la/ thabs bskyed rje'ogs gnyis ba〉stoms pas nges par 'tshang rgya'o// zhes pas dbugs dbyung / nga de nas rdo rje slob dpon tu dbang bskur ba ni/rdor dril gtad la 'byud pa'i tshul byed du gzhug cing / shes rab bcu drug sku1na pa la/ /lag pa dag gis yang dag 'khrud/ /rdo rje dril bu mnyam sbyor ba/ /slob dpon dbang du rab tu brjod/ /ces dang / rdo rje che dang dril chen long / /rdo rje la ni rdo rje gnas/ /de ring rdo rje slob dpon 'gyur/ /slob ma bsdu ba nyid du gyis/snye /sems can thams cad la chos kyi sgo mo brgyad khri bzhi stong bshad cing slob ma bsdu bar bya'o/ /snyam du rdo rje gsor zhing /dril bu dkrol/ ga rdo rje sems dpa'i brtul zhugs sbyin pa ni/ 'di de sangs rgyas thams cad kyis/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i phyag na gnas/ /khyod kyis kyang ni rtag tu bcang //

༄༅/ /phyag na rdo rje'i brtul zhugs brtan/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sirnyi badzra sa ma ya tiṣṭha e ṣa tt+waṃ dhā ra ya mi badzra sa twa hi hi hi hi hūm̐// slob ma'i lag pa g.yas par rdo rje gtad la lan gsum gsor te mthar snying gar gzung du gzhug cing / khyod kyis 'jig rten pa'i spyod pa thams cad brtul nas sngags kyi spyod pa la zhugs par bya'o snyam du sems bskyed par byos shig /ces brjod do// nga de ltar dbang bskur bas/ lus kyi sgrib pa dag /lam bskyed pa'i rim la bsgom pa dang / rgyud nyan zhing 'chad pa la rbershags pas rang gzhan gyi don byed pa la dbang ngo / /skyed maṇḍal pū dza me gha sa mu dra spa ra ṇa sa ma ye āḥhūm̐/ ces bum dbang rdzogs par thob pa'i gtang rag gi maṇḍal 'bul lo/ ༈ /gnyis pa lus kyi dkyil 'khor du gsang dbang bskur ba ni/ gsol gdab lus kyi dkyil 'khor sgrub/ /ye shes dbab cing me tog dor/ /ming dang snyoms 'jug dbang bskur

dang / /rjes gnang yan lag bcas pa'o/ /zhes pa'i rim pa bzhin tu nges par bya ste/ nam phyed kyi dus dkyil 'khor gyi lho phyogs su/ bdud rtsi lnga'i maṇḍal gyi dbus su/ slob dpon stan bzang po'i steng du gnas pa la/slob mas/ sa gzhi spos chus byugs shing me tog bkram/ /ri rab gling bzhi nyi zlas brgyan pa 'di/ /sangs rgyas zhing du dmigs te phul ba yis/ /'gro kun rnam dag zhing la spyod par rberteg /ces maṇḍal sngon du 'gro bas yid las byung ba'i rig ma gus pas phul te/ khyod ni he ru ka dpal te/ /bde gshegs rnams kyi bde stsol mdzad//byang chub sems dpa' che rnams kyi/ /yang dag don mchog rnam dag pa/ /ji ltar de nyid bdud rtsi yi/ /mchog gi dbang ni skur ba bzhin/ /de bzhin bdag la 'khor ba yi/ /sdug bsngal dag ni bsal bar mdzod/ /rnal 'byor bdud rtsi dri med mchog /ma rig nyes pa'i rab rib 'joms/ /gang gis bla med

༄7/ /byang chub pa/ /de 'dir bdag gis thob par mdzod/ /ces gsol ba lan gsum gdab bo// bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo tha mi dad pa bcom ldan 'das dgyes pa rdo rje sku mdog nag po zhal brgyad dang ldan pa'i rtsa ba'i zhal nag po/ g.yas zhal kunda ltar dkar ba/ g.yon zhal dmar zhing cher 'jigs pa/ lhag ma g.yas zhal gnyis dang g.yon zhal gnyis bung ba ltar nag cing / steng zhal dud kha gcigs pa'i nyams can/ spyan nyi shu rtsa bzhi phye ba/dbu skra ser po gyen tu brdzes pa/ dpral ba'i steng du thod pa lnga lnga'i phreng ba dang / sna tshogs rdo rje spyi bor 'dzin pa/ zhal nas hūm̐ gi sgra spro zhing / 'khor lo/snyan cha/ mgul rgyan/ phyag zhabs kyi gdu bu/ ska rags/ thal bas byugs pa ste phyag rgya drug dang ldan pa/ mgo bo lnga bcu'i phreng ba'i do shal 'phyang ba/

phyag bcu drug gi g.yas kyi phyag gi thod pa brgyad na/ rim pa bzhin tu/ glang po che dkar po/ rta sngon po/ bong bu kham pa/ glang dmar po/ rnga mong thal kar/mi dmar po/ sha ra bha sngon po/ byi la gwa pa/ g.yon gyi phyag gi thod pa brgyad na/ sa'i lha mo ser mo/ chu'i lha mo dkar mo/ rlung gi lha mo dud kha/ me'i lha mo dmar mo/ zla ba'i lha mo dkar mo/ nyi ma'i lha mo dmar mo/ gshin rje nag po/ nor bdag ser po/ snying gar thal mo sbyar ba rnams bsnams pa'i phyag dang po gnyis kyis yum la 'khyud pa/ gcer bu zhabs bzhi'i mdun ma gnyis g.yas brkyang ba'i gar dang rgyab ma gnyis skyil krung phyed pa'i stabs kyis nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la bdud bzhi mnyam par mnan zhing / gar gyi nyams dgu dang ldan pa/ 'jigs pa'ang 'jigs par mdzad pa/ yid las byung ba'i rig

༄༅/ /ma bdag med ma sku mdog nag mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum mnga' ba/ mche ba gtsigs pa/ dbu skra ser po gyen tu brdzes pa/phyag g.yas gri gug /g.yon thod pa bsnams pa/ gcer bu phyag rgya lnga dang ldan zhing / thod pa skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang / skam po lnga bcu'i phreng bas brgyan pa/ g.yon gyi gru mor kha ṭwāṃ ga dang ldan pa/ stag gi pags pas smad dkris pa/ zhabs g.yon brkyang pa'i skyil krung phyed pas padma dang ro'i snying gar nyi ma'i gdan la bzhugs pa/ gtso bo'i thugs ka'i 'od zer gyis bsgoms pa dang 'dra ba'i ye shes kyi lha mo spyan drangs/ go rī dzaḥtso rī hūm̐/bee tā lī baṃ/ ghasma rī hoḥ dam tshig pa dang gnyis med du gyur/ thugs ka'i 'od zer gyis spyan drangs pa'i bdud rtsi'i bum pa thogs pa'i lha mo rnams kyis dbang bskur bas/

rigs kyi bdag po mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan par gyur/ oṃ badzra purmye āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ skyed badzra dhu pe āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ badzra gandhe āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ skyed badzra ni widre āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ skyed badzra ā 31 ke āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ ces nyer spyod lngas mchod cing / de nas rang gi snying ga la sogs par dri'i chus thig le bya zhing / bla ma dkyil 'khe ra gyi gces lngasto dang rig ma bdag med mar gsal ba'i snying gar mi bskyod pa sngon po rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ lte bar don grub ljang gu ral gri dang des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/gsang bar rdo rje 'chang chen po dkar po rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ lkog mar snang ba mtha' yas dmar po padma dang des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/dpral bar rin 'byung ser po rin po che dang des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/ spyi gtsug tu rnam snang dkar po 'khor lo dang des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu

༄༅/ /'dzin pa/ thams cad kyang zhabs rdo rje skyil mo krung gis pad nyi'i gdan la bzhugs pa/ rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan par gyur/ oṃ badzra pursha āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ skyes badzra dhu pe āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ badzra gandhe āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ badzra ni widre āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ skyed badzra ā sku ke āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ ces slar yang nyer spyod kyis mchod/g.yon pa'i mtheb srin gyis nang mchod kyi bdud rtsi gnas de rnams su 'thor zhing / skyes āḥhūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes lan drug brjod pas/ lha thams cad mnyes par bsam la dkyil 'khor bsgrub bo/ /lus dkyil sngon ma mthong ba'i brdar/ skyed āḥhūm̐/ ces 'bru gsum gyis gdong g.yogs bcing / slob dpon la g.yon tu bskor ba lan gsum byas nas kha shar du bltas te/ rkang pa gnyis gshibs la 'greng / āḥkhaṃ bī ra hūm̐/gis me tog thal sbyar bar du bzung / slob ma skad cig gis bdag med ma sku mdog nag mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum mnga' ba/ mche ba gtsigs pa/ dbu

skra ser po gyen tu brdzes pa/ phyag g.yas gri gug /g.yon thod pa bsnams pa/ gcer bu phyag rgya lnga dang ldan zhing / thod pa skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang / skam po lnga bcu'i phreng bas brgyan pa/ g.yon gyi gru mor kha ṭwāṃ ga dang ldan pa/ stag gi pags pas smad dkris pa/ zhabs g.yon brkyang pa'i skyil krung phyed pas padma dang ro'i snying gar nyi ma'i gdan la bzhugs pa'i lte bar chos 'byung dmar po'i dbus su rang 'dra ba'i bdag med ma/ slar yang de'i lte bar chos 'byung dmar po'i dbus su bdag med ma/ de'i lte bar chos 'byung dmar po bar med du 'khor bas lus thams cad zag med kyi bde ba chen pos khyab par sdo/ra/ zhes dmigs la/ skyersha yis swā hā a ā/ zhes bdug pa rol mo dang bcas ye shes pa dbab/ pra tī:shā badzra thertoḥ zhes lus dkyil du me tog dor la rigs nges par bya/ sems can

༄7/ /stobs can khyod kyis ni/ /'di ni rab tu gzung bar gyis/ /zhes me tog slar bzung / oṃ āḥhūm̐/ ces lū gsum gyis gdong g.yogs bsal/ rmongs phyir 'khor ba'i gzugs can nyid/ /rmongs med 'khor ba dag pas ni/ /'khor ba mya ngan 'das par 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pa'i tshul gyis slob dpon gyi snying gar mi bskyod pa/ lte bar don grub/ gsang ba rdo rje 'chang / lkog mar snang ba mtha' yas/ dpral bar rin 'byung / spyi gtsug tu rnam snang rnams mngon sum du mthong bar mos/ me tog phog pa'i go rim ltar ming gdags tshul yig rnying las shes/yid las byung ba'i rig ma bdag med ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo thabs shes gnyis su med par snyoms par zhugs pa'i sbyor mtshams nas dga' ba sgyu ma lta bu sid dang phaṭa kyi sgra dang bcas pa'i 'od zer 'phros pas/ sangs rgyas

thams cad bskul/ tshur 'dus te zhal du zhugs/ thugs kar zhu/ rtsa dbu ma nas song / rdo rje'i lam nas byang chub kyi sems sangs rgyas thams cad zhu ba'i ngo bor gyur/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nu rā ga ṇa badzra swa bhā wa ātma ko3 haṃ/ zhes nga rgyal bzung / 'o ma dang bdud rtsi lnga sbyar ba nya phyis la sogs pa'i snod du blugs pa/ slob dpon gyi mtheb srin gyis blangs te/ ji ltar 'das pa'i sangs rgyas kyis/ /byang chub sras por dbang bskur ltar/ /de bzhin gsang ba'i sems rgyun gyis/ /do nub khyod la dbang bskur ro/ /zhes brjod cing lce thog tu byin pas/lus thams cad zag med kyi bde bas khyab par gyur/ zhes mos/dam tshig 'bogs pa ni/khrag chen po ni ga bur bcas//tsandan dmar dang yang dag sbyar/ /de bzhin rdo rje chu dang bcas/ /lnga pa sems las byung bar bshad/ /sangs rgyas kun dang mthun par gsungs/ /dam tshig

༄7/ /'di ni bla na med/ /bzang po khyod kyis bskyang bar bya/ /de ltar gsang ba'i dbang bskur bas ngag gi dri ma dag/ sha lnga dang bdud rtsi lnga brten pa dang / rtsa rlung byang chub sems kyi rdzogs rim bsgom pa la dbang ba yin no/ /oṃ maṇḍal pū dza me gha sa mu dra spa ra ṇa sa ma ye āḥhūm̐/ ces gsang dbang thob pa'i gtong rag tu maṇḍal 'bul/ ༈ gsum pa bha ga'i dkyil 'khor du shes rab ye shes kyi dbang bskur ba ni/ maṇḍal mchod dang gsol ba gdab/ /'khor lo bsgrub cing ye shes dbab/ /me tog dbul dang lha ngo bstan/ /phyag rgya gtad cing dbang don bstan/ /zhes pa ste/ tho rangs dkyil 'khor gyi nub phyogs su/ bdud rtsi byang chub sems kyis byug pa'i maṇḍal gyi steng du/ tshon dkar pos chos 'byung gru gsum pa'i logs dkyil 'khor la bstan pa bris pa'i dbus dang / phyogs bzhi/ slar yang phyogs mtshams brgyad/ phyi'i shar nub tu dri'i thig le bya zhing / me tog gi tshom bu bkod/ lha grangs dang mnyam pa'i nyer spyod lngas bskor/ zhim pa'i bza' ba

gas ba dang //ba la che mchog ma dwa na//zhes sogs bshad pa ltar tshogs kyi yo byad kyang bsham/sa gzhi spos chus byugs shing me tog bkram/ /ri rab gling bzhi nyi zlas brgyan pa 'di//sangs rgyas zhing du dmigs te phul ba yis/ /'gro kun rnam dag zhing la spyod par sho/ga /ces bla ma la mchod pa'i maṇḍal phul nas/bcom ldan zhi ba chen po kye/ /rdo rje rnal 'byor gcig bzhed pa/ /mi phyed phyag rgya sgrub pa po/ /rdo rje rnal 'byor las byung ba/ /ji ltar khyod ni bdag nyid che/ /mnga' bdag bdag la'ang deng stsol cig /'khor ba 'dam gyi tshogs dag tu/ /bying ba skyabs med bdag la skyobs/ /gsol gdab lan gsum/ maṇḍal bsangs sbyang / oṃ badzra a mṛ ta kuṇḍa lī ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ swa bhā wa shuddhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā ba shurje3 haṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las/ chos 'byung gi nang du padma 'dab ma bzhi pa dang brgyad pa rim pa gnyis kyi lte

༄༅/ /ba dang 'dab ma rnams la ro dang nyi ma'i gdan la/snye dbang bskur ba'i skabs su/ lha mo bco lngar skad cig gis gsal ba ni/ dbus su bdag med ma/ phyogs bzhi'i shar du rdo rje ma/ lhor gsang ba'i go rī/ nub tu chu'i rnal 'byor ma/ byang du rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma/ phyi skor gyi shar du dkar mo/ lhor chom rkun ma/ nub tu ro langs ma/ byang du ghasma rī/ byang shar du pukka sī/ shar lhor ri khrod ma/ lho nub tu gdol pa mo/ nub byang du ḍombi nī/ 'og tu sa spyod ma/ steng du mkha' spyod ma rnams sku mdog nag mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum mnga' ba/ mche ba gtsigs pa/ dbu skra ser po gyen tu brdzes pa/phyag g.yas gri gug /g.yon thod pa bsnams pa/ gcer bu phyag rgya lnga dang ldan zhing / thod pa skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang / skam po lnga bcu'i phreng bas brgyan

pa/ g.yon gyi gru mor kha ṭwāṃ ga dang ldan pa/ stag gi pags pas smad dkris pa/ zhabs g.yon brkyang pa'i skyil krung phyed pas padma dang ro'i snying gar nyi ma'i gdan la bzhugs pa/ gtso mo'i thugs ka'i 'od zer sogs drangs bstim dbang bskur gong ltar la/ bdud rtsi'i bum pa thogs pa'i lha mo rnams kyis dbang bskur/chu lhag yar 'khyil ba las/ gtso mo dang puska sī dang dkar mo la mi bskyod pa/ rdo rje ma dang ri khrod ma dang chom rkun ma dang sa spyod ma la rnam par snang mdzad/ gsang ba'i go rī dang gdol pa mo dang ro langs ma la rin chen 'byung ldan/ chu'i rnal 'byor ma dang ḍombi nī dang ghasma rī dang mkha' spyod ma la 'od dpag med/rdo rje mkha' 'aXs ma la don skurdzod grub pas dbu brgyan par gyur/ zhes rgyas gdab/ ga bdag 'jug skabs sogs tshig gi spros pa mi lcog na/dbus su bdag med

༄༅/ /ma/ phyogs bzhir rdo rje ma sogs bzhi dang / 'dab ma bcu la go rī la sogs bcu/ gtso 'khor thams cad kyang sku mdog nag mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum mnga' ba/ mche ba gtsigs pa/ dbu skra ser po gyen tu brdzes pa/ phyag g.yas gri gug /g.yon thod pa bsnams pa/ gcer bu phyag rgya lnga dang ldan zhing / thod pa skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang / skam po lnga bcu'i phreng bas brgyan pa/ g.yon gyi gru mor kha ṭwāṃ ga dang ldan pa/ stag gi pags pas smad dkris pa/ zhabs g.yon brkyang pa'i skyil krung phyed pas padma dang ro'i snying gar nyi ma'i gdan la bzhugs pa/ gtso bo'i thugs ka'i 'od zer gyis bsgoms pa dang 'dra ba'i ye shes kyi lha mo spyan drangs/ go rī dzaḥtso rī hūm̐/ bee tā lī baṃ/ ghasma rī hoḥ dam tshig pa dang gnyis med du gyur/ thugs

ka'i 'od zer gyis spyan drangs pa'i bdud rtsi'i bum pa thogs pa'i lha mo rnams kyis dbang bskur bas/ mi bskyod pa sogs rigs bdag so sos dbu brgyan par gyur zhes pa tsam gyis rung ngo / /gang ltar yang / oṃ badzra purmye āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ badzra dhu pe āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ badzra gandhe āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ badzra ni wibye āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ badzra ā 31 ke āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ ces nyer spyod lngas mchod/ a ā/ i sī/ ༷/ mū/ ṛ dṛ/ li lī/ e i/ ces skyes/ e/ skye( āḥhūm̐/ zhes dbyangs yig bco lnga la 'bru gsum btags pas nang mchod 'bul/skyersha āḥhūm̐/ gis gdong g.yogs bcing /chos 'byung gi dkyil 'khor la g.yon bskor lan gsum/kha lhor phyogs pas 'greng zhing / āḥkhaṃ bī ra hūm̐/ gis me tog thal sbyar bar du bzung /slob ma'i snying gar bdag med ma sku mdog nag mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum mnga' ba/ mche ba gtsigs pa/ dbu skra ser po gyen tu brdzes pa/ phyag

༄༅/ /g.yas gri gug /g.yon thod pa bsnams pa/ gcer bu phyag rgya lnga dang ldan zhing / thod pa skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang / skam po lnga bcu'i phreng bas brgyan pa/ g.yon gyi gru mor kha ṭwāṃ ga dang ldan pa/ stag gi pags pas smad dkris pa/ zhabs g.yon brkyang pa'i skyil krung phyed pas padma dang ro'i snying gar nyi ma'i gdan la bzhugs pa tshon gang bar gsal/ bla ma dang gtso bo tha mi dad pa'i thugs ka nas bsgoms pa dang 'dra ba'i bdag med ma'i sku phra mo dpag tu med pa byung ste/ rang gi snying gar zhugs/ lus thams cad shig shig gang / zag med kyi bde ba chen po rgyud la skyes par gyur/ oṃ e swā hā a ā/ zhes bdug pa rol mo dang bcas gong ltar gyis ye shes pa dbab bo/snye /des ma pheb na/slob ma'i smin mtshams su dus pa'i chos 'byung dmar po'i dbus su g.yung

drung ris dmar po 'khor bar bsgoms la bskyar nas dbab bo/ dze/de nas dkyil 'bor du me tog dor zhing slar bzung ba ni/pra tītstsha badzra hoḥ sems can stobs can khyod kyis ni//'di ni rab tu gzung bar gyis/ /oṃ āḥhūm̐/ gis gdong g.yogs bsal/ rdo rje snyems ma la sogs ming gdags/ 'di ltar rten dang brten par bcas pa ni/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs rdo rje btsun mo'i bha ga rnams la bzhugs so zhes dang / gsang ba mchog gi dgyes pa na/ /thams cad bdag nyid rtag tu bzhugs/ /zhes gsungs te/ chos 'byung dang der bzhugs pa'i lha yang bde stong dbyer med las ma 'das pa'o/ /zhes go bar byas la/ slob ma zhal phyag rgyas par bskyed dgos kyang bdag 'jug skabs sogs su/ bcom ldan 'das dgyes pa rdo rje sku mdog nag po zhal brgyad/ phyag bcu drug /zhabs

༄tsho/ /bzhi pa/ rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa la/ dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bos yid las byung ba'i rig ma bdag med ma'i rnam pa gzugs dang lang tsho phun sum tshogs pa lo bcu drug lon pa'i na tshod can gtad par mos te/ lha mo dga' sbyin gnas sbyin ma/ /sna tshogs gzugs can yid 'ong ma//khyer cig khyer cig sems dpa' che/ /khyer la mchod pa rtag tu gyis/ /lha mo de dang snyoms 'jug gi mthus dga' ba bzhi rim par skyes pa'i mthar lhan cig skyes dga'i ye shes nyams su myong bar mos/ de nas/ longs spyod kyi ni rlabs gnyis la/ /rang gi g.yas dang lag gzhan gyi/ /mthe bong dang ni srin lag gis/ /de ni rnal 'byor pa yis btsir/ /de las ye shes skye bar 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar rtsa rba mmus btsir la/dpe'i lhan skyes ngos bzung ste/de yang / de las ci zhig

skye zhes na/ /gzhon nu'i dga' ba ji bzhin nam/ /lkugs pa'i rmi lam ji bzhin no/ /mchog gi mtha' dang dga' bral dbus/ /stong dang stong min he ru ka/zhes gsungs pa yin no/ /zhes brjod do// de ltar shes rab ye shes kyi dbang bskur bas rtog pa'i sgro 'dogs bcad cing / lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes shar bar byas/ sems kyi dri ma sbyong zhing ye shes dang las kyi phyag rgya'i rnal 'byor bsgom pa la dbang ngo / /oṃ maṇḍal pū dza me gha sa mu dra spa ra ṇa sa ma ye snyahūm̐/ces gtong rag maṇḍal 'bul/ ༈ bzhi pa don dam byang sems kyi dkyil 'khor du tshig dbang bskur ba la gnyis te/ slob mar dbang skur ba'i tshe rngog pa'i phyag len ji lta ba gur rigs bsdus kyi dkyil chog las 'byung ba nyid 'dir sbyar dgos shing dkyus 'di mi dgos so/ /bdag 'jug tsam gyi skabs de nyid mi lcogs na mdo sbyar gyi dgongs pa ni/ dkyil 'khor gyi byang phyogs su slob ma gnas pa'i mos pas/ sa gzhi 11sa

༄༅/ /chus byugs shing me tog bkram/ /ri rab gling bzhi nyi zlas brgyan pa 'di/ /sangs rgyas zhing du dmigs te phul ba yis/ /'gro kun rnam dag zhing la spyod par shog /ces mardza phul/ yang dag ye shes mchog thob ste/ /rang rig pa yi ngo bo la/ /bdag ni shin tu nges shes skyes/ /gnyis med ye shes 'di nyid ni/ /'gro ba gzhan la yod ma yin/ /chos kyi bdud rtsi 'di 'thung phyir/ /bla ma che la gsol ba 'debs/ /gal te bka' drin thob gyur na//'jigs pa med pa'i bka' drin stsol/ /lan gsum gsol ba gdab pas/ gang gi tshe dbang gsum pa'i nyams su myong ba de nyid tshig gis ngo sprad pa'i bka' drin bstsal bar gyur/ phyi nas de nyid yang dag bshad/ /rnam dag ye shes gzugs can dang / /'khor ba rnam par rtog pa la/ /khyad par cung zad yod ma

yin/ /mchog dgar sgom pa med cing sgom pa po'ang med/ /lus kyang med cing gzung ba med la 'dzin pa med/ /sha dang khrag kyang med cing bshang dang gci ba med/ /skyugs bro rmongs med gtsang sbra mchod phyir thogs med dang / /chag/sa med sdang ba med dang rmongs med phrag dog med/ /ser sna med dang nga rgyal med cing mthong bya med/ /bsgom dang sgom pa po med bshes dang dgra med cing / /rloms sems med pa'i lhan cig skyes nga sna tshogs nyid/ /ces dang /ye shes 'di ni ches phra zhing / /rdo rje nam mkha'i dbyings lta bu/ /rdul bral thar sbyin zhi ba nyid/ /khyod rang yang ni de yi pha/ /de ltar don dam byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur bas/ lus ngag yid gsum tha dad du 'dzin pa'i dri ma sbyangs/ bde stong gnyis su med pa'i rdzogs pa'i rim pa bsgom pa la

da༅༅/ /dbang 1sdo zhes pa rnams kyis grub bo/ /de nas dam tshig khas len ni/ gces bos ji ltar bka' 455 pa/ /de dag thams cad bdag gis bgyi/ /lan gsum dang / dbang bzhi rdzogs par thob pa'i gtong rag tu maṇḍal dang lus 'bul ba ni/ sa gzhi spros chus byugs shing me tog bkram/ /ri rab gling bzhi nyi zlas brgyan pa 'di/ /sangs rgyas zhing du dmigs te phul ba yis/ /'gro kun rnam dag zhing la spyod par lha ga /ces dang / deng nas brtsams te bdag bran du/ /khyed la bdag ni 'bul lags na/ /khyed kyi ste/ba mar bzung ba dang / /cha yis kyang ni mdzad du garbershal/ /lan gsum mthar dge bsngo sogs spyi ltar byas la slob ma rnams gyes so/ ༈ /gsum pa rjes kyi cho ga la gsum/ tshogs kyi 'khor lo/ gtong rag mchod bstod/ rjes kyi bya ba dngos so/ /dang po ni gzhan tu shes par bya'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ mchod pa byin gyis brlabs la/ skyes sarba saṃ the dha ni āḥhūm̐ swā hās

bsangs/ oṃ swa dhwa wa shuddhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā ba shuddhi3 haṃ gis sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las/ a las thod pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du/ hūm̐ 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i bsang gtor/ mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me tog /bdug spos/ snang gsal/ dri/ zhal zas/ rol mo la sogs pa'i mchod pa'i yo byad rnams rang bzhin stong pa/byed las dbang po drug gi spyod yul du zag pa med pa'i bde ba skyed nus par gyur/oṃ sarba saṃ sho dha ni āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥkhaṃ ram̐ āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ nī rī ti hūm̐ kha āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ badzra pursha āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ badzra dhu pe āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ badzra ā lo ke āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ badzra gandhe āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ badzra ni widre āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ badzra shabha āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ rol mo bya zhing / oṃ badzra ghaṇḍa ra ṇi ta pra ra ṇi ta saṃ pra ra ṇi ta sarba buddha kṣe tra pra tsa

༄7/ /li te pra dzñā pa ra mi tā nā da saṃ bha wa badzra dharmakhṛ da ya sarnyo ṣa ni hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hoḥ.āḥkhaṃ swā hā/ de nas chu gsum nyer spyod rol mo dang / lha mo brgyad kyis mchod cing bstod pa bcas dkyus su rgyas bsdus skabs dang sbyar la/sgrub mchod nyin tha mar tshigs bcad bcas rgyas par bya'o/ /rgyun du bsdus pa spro na/phyi mchod sngags tsam gyis 'thus pas/ skyes 3gle he 〈co ka rngaṭa pa ri wā ra sarba saṃ sho dha ni āḥhūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ shrī he ru ka sa pa ri wā ra dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥkhaṃ ram̐ āḥhūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ shrī he ru ka sa pa ri wā ra nī rī ti hūm̐ kha āḥhūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/oṃ shrī he ru ka sa pa ri wā ra badzra purmye āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ shrī he ru ka sa pa ri wā ra badzra ddhā pe āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ shrī he ru ka sa pa ri wā ra badzra ā lo ke āḥhūm̐ swā hā/oṃ shrī he ru ka sa pa ri wā ra badzra garnye āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ shrī he ru ka sa pa ri wā ra badzo ni wi dre āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ shrī he ru ka sa pa ri wā ra badzra shabha āḥhūm̐ swā hā/

ces chu gsum nyer spyod rol mo dang / lha mo brgyad kyi mchod pa ni/ dkar mo ri dwags mtshan ma 'dzin/ /chom rkun bdud las rgyal ba'i snod/ /ro langs ma ni chu lag ma//ghasma rī ni sman 'dzin zhing / /puska sī ni rdo rje'i lag /de bzhin ri khrod ma ro 'dzin/ /gdol pa mo ni cang te'u brdung / /'di rnams kyis ni gtso bo mchod//'dod chags chen po'i rjes chags pas/ /g.yung mos sku la 'khyud pa nyid/ /oṃ go rī rga āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ tso rī rtsa āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ bee tā lī baṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā/oṃ ghasma rī rghaṃ āḥhūm̐ swāhā/ oṃ puska sī paṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ sha ba rī shaṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ tsaṇḍa lī rtsa āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ ḍombi ni ḍo āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ bstod pa ni/ oṃ ma hā badzra hūṃ/ oṃ badzra gharnye āḥ ces brjod cing rdor dril bzung la/ khyod ni rnal 'byor ma yi tshogs kyis yongs su bskor/ /khyod ni nyid kyi thugs kyis khyod dgongs 'grub//

༄༅/ /khyod ni rgyu dang mi rgyu 'khor ba kun sgrub pa/ /snying rje'i thugs kyis sems can byang chub tu/ /kun rdzob sgyu ma byang chub sgrub pa yi/ /dgyes —pa thes rje dpal gyi he ru ka la bstod/ /skyed sarba ta thā ga ta stu ti badzra swa bhā ba ātma ska/྅ haṃ/ ces sngags kyis rgyas gdab/ gsum pa rjes kyi bya ba dngos la/ thog mar lhag chad skong ba ni/dkyil 'bar la bskor ba lan gsum dang / oṃ badzra he ru ka sa twa sa ma ya/ ma nu pā la ya/ he ru ka twe no pa/ tiṣṭhadṛ ḍho me bha wa/ su to ṣyo me bha wa/ a nu rakto me bha wa/su po ṣyo me bha wa/ sarba sirnyi mme pra yasmo sarba karma su tsa me/ tsitt+waṃ shri yaḥ ku ru hūm̐/ ha ha ha ha hoḥ bha ga wān/ he ru ka mā me muñtsa he ru ko bha ba ma hā sa ma ya sa twa āḥhūm̐ phaṭa/ ces yi ge brgya pa lan gsum bzla/ gtso bo nus pa ma mchis shing / /ma tshang ba dang lhag gyur dang / /gang yang 'gal bar gyur pa rnams/ /de kun

bzod par mdzad par rigs/ /gsang sngags nyams dang bya ba nyams/ /cho ga nyams par gyur pa gang / /de yang khyod kyis bzod par mdzod// ces bzod par gsol/ skye zhing skye bar rigs mchog tu/ /skye zhing khengs med dam tshig ldan/ /dgyes pa rdo rje ston pa dang / /brtse ldan bla mar gus gyur cig /skye zhing skye bar gyur pa na/ /lag pa rdo rje dril bu 'khrol/ /zab mo'i chos ni ston pa dang / /btsun mo'i shu kra len 'gyur shog /kun tu sangs rgyas thams cad kyi//rdo rje 'chang chen go 'phang ldan/ /dge ba 'di yis thob 'gyur zhing / /'gro ba lngas kyang thob par shog /byang chub rdo rjes bsngags pa yi/ /rdzogs pa'i byang chub phyir spyod dang / /rdzogs sangs rgyas kyi spyod pa gang / /bdag kyang de nyid spyod par shog /ces smon lam gdab/ ras bris yin na/ ye shes pa rnams rten 'di nyid

ra༅2/ /la brtan par bzhugs su ga/rbershal/ /skyed su pra tiṣṭha bahṝ ya swā hā/ zhes brtan bzhugs bya/ rdul tshon gyi nub mtha' ma la/ skyed khyed kyis sems can don kun mdzad/ /rjes su mthun pa'i dngos grub stsol/ /sangs rgyas yul du gshegs nas kyang / /slar yang 'byon par mdzad du gsol/ /badzra muḥ zhes pas ye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa rang gi snying gar thim par gyur/ rang nyid las kyi he ru kar gsal zhing gnas gsum srung ba ni/ slar rang nyid las kyi he ru ka zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa'i skur gyur/ spyi bor oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐ gis mtshan par gyur/ bkra shis brjod pa ni me tog char du bsnyil la/ bkra shis gang zhig chos kyi dbyings las legs grub pa/ /dgyes pa'i rdo rje 'jigs byed rgyal po 'bar ba'i sku/ /shes rab bdag med padma la ni rdo rjes rol/ /bden pa des kyang bde chen

la gnas bkra shis shog /bkra shis gang zhig padma dmar po ge sar bcas/ /'dab brgyad la gnas lha mos zhal brgyad la phyogs shing / /rol thabs sna tshogs kyis ni gtso bo mnyes par byed/ /bden pa des kyang bde chen la gnas bkra shis shog /rab dmar spyan gyis dus gsum gdul bya la gzigs shing / /nang stong la sogs bcu drug phyag gis dug gsum sel/ /bsdu dngos (nabs bzhi yis ni bdud bzhi 'joms mdzad pa/ /bden pa des kyang bde chen la gnas bkra shis shog /log rtog bsal phyir dbu skra dmar ser gyen du 'bar/ /sgeg pa la sogs ro dgu'i cha byad rab tu gsal/ /'khor lo la sogs phyag rgya lnga yis rab tu brgyan/ /bden pa des kyang bde chen la gnas bkra shis shog /me long la sogs ye shes bzhi las grub pa'i sku/ /go rī la

༄༅/ /sogs phyogs kyi padma la gnas pa/ /tshangs pa la sogs bdud bzhi zhabs kyis gnon mdzad pa/ /bden pa des kyang bde chen la gnas bkra shis rberteg /byams pa la sogs tshad med bzhi las grub pa'i sku/ /puska sī sogs mtshams kyi padma la gnas pa/ /gshin rje la sogs bdud bzhi zhabs kyis gnon mdzad pa/ /bden pa des kyang bde chen la gnas bkra shis shog /bkra shis gang zhig dran pa nye bar gzhag pa bzhi rnams dang / /yang dag spong ba rdzu 'phrul dbang po stobs la sogs/ /byang chub phyogs rnams sum cu rtsa bdun yongs rdzogs pa/ /bden pa des kyang bde chen la gnas bkra shis shog /bkra shis gang zhig rin chen pha gus mdzes pa'i gzhal yas khang / /'dod pa lnga yi longs spyod mchog gi bkod pa dang / /mu tig dra ba rin

chen nyi zla gser gyi dril bu dpyangs/ /bden pa des kyang bde chen la gnas bkra shis shog /bkra shis gang zhig rta bab padma 'khor lo gdugs kyis phub//mdzes pa'i ri dwags ba dan bcu drug legs brkyang ba/ /rlung gis bskyod pa'i dril bu dam pa'i chos sgra sgrogs/ /bden pa des kyang bde chen la gnas bkra shis shog /bkra shis gang zhig dur khrod brgyad kyis legs bskor ba/ shwerṣa la sogs byang chub shing brgyad gnas pa la/ /glang chen gdong can la sogs brgyad po gnas pa yi/ /bden pa des kyang bde chen la gnas bkra shis shog /ces ḍombi lhos kyis mdzad pa dang / nyin/ mo bde legs mtshan bde legs/ /nyin mo'i gung yang bde legs shing / /nyin mtshan rtag tu bde legs pa/ /dkon mchog gsum gyi bkra shis shog /ces brjod par bya'o/ /rdul tshon oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ

ra༅༅/ /sarba dharmā twe ā du 〈khunasno twa ta/ skyes āḥhūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ brjod cing mtha' nas bsdus te/ bum par blugs nas rgya mtshor 'bab pa'i chu klung du dor zhing chu gtsang mas gang ba khyer la/dkyil 'khor gyi khang par bsang gtor byas pas bkra shis shing byin chags par 'gyur ro// ༈ gtong rag mchod bstod rjes kyi bya ba rnams sgrub mchod nyin tha mar rgyas par bya ba ni/ mchod pa byin gyis brlabs pa ni/ oṃ sarba saṃ sho dha ni āḥhūm̐ swā hās bsangs/ oṃ swa dhwa wa shuddhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā ba shuddhi3 haṃ gis sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las/ a las thod pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du/ hūm̐ 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i bsang gtor/ mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me tog /bdug spros/ snang gsal/dri/ zhal zas/ rol mo la sogs pa'i mchod pa'i yo byad rnams rang bzhin stong pa/ byed las dbang po drug gi spyod yul du zag pa med pa'i bde ba skyed

nus par gyur/ oṃ sarba saṃ rbesto dha ni āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥkhaṃ ram̐ āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ nī rī ti hūm̐ kha āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ badzra puṣṭi āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ badzra dhu pe āḥhūṃ swā hā/ skyed badzra ā 31 ke āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ skyed badzra gandhe āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ skye( badzra ni widre āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ skyed badzra shabha āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ rol mo bya zhing / skyed badzra ghaṇḍa ra ṇi ta pra ra ṇi ta saṃ pra ra ṇi ta sarba buddha kṣe tra pra tsa li te pra dzñā pa ra mi tā nā da saṃ bha wa badzra dharmakhṛ da ya sarnyo ṣa ni hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hoḥ.āḥkhaṃ swā hā/ dag cing dri med yid 'ong ba'i//sngags kyi bsang gtor mchog 'di dag /mchog tu dad pas khyed la 'bul/ /ci bde bar ni bzhes su gsol/ /oṃ shrī he ru ka sa pa ri wā ra sarba saṃ sho dha ni āḥhūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ dag cing dri med yid 'ong ba'i/ /sngags kyi mchod yon mchog 'di dag/ mchog tu dad pas khyed la 'bul/ /ci bde bar ni bzhes su

༄7/ /gsol/ /oṃ shrī he ru ka sa pa ri wā ra dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥkhaṃ ram̐ āḥhūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ dag cing dri med yid 'ong ba'i/ /sngags kyi zhabs bsil mchog 'di dag /mchog tu dad pas khyed la 'bul/ /ci bde bar ni bzhes su gsol/ /oṃ shrī he ru ka sa pa ri wā ra nī rī ti hūm̐ kha āḥhūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ me tog 'di ni bzang zhing dge/ /dag pa'i skye gnas las dag pa/ /bdag gis dad pas 'bul lags kyi/ /bzhes nas bdag la dgyes par mdzod/ /oṃ shrī he ru ka sa pa ri wā ra badzra puṣṭi/ āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ nags tshal las byung phan pa yi/ /gang zhig dri dang bdug spros mchog /bdag gis dad pas 'bul lags kyi//bzhes nas bdag la dgyes par mdzod/ /oṃ shrī he ru ka sa pa ri wā ra badzra dhū pe āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ srin po 'joms shing dag byed la/ /dge zhing mun pa rnam sel

ba/ /bdag gis dad pas 'bul lags kyi/ /bzhes nas bdag la dgyes par mdzod/ /oṃ shrī he ru ka sa pa ri wā ra badzra ā lo ke āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ lhan cig skyes dang sbyar ba'i dri/ /tshim byed dag pa'i bdud rtsi 'di/ /bdag gis dad pas 'bul lags kyi/ /bzhes nas bdag la dgyes par mdzod/ /oṃ shrī he ru ka sa pa ri wā ra badzra garnye āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ bshos gtsang bza' ba dang bcas pa'i/ /kha dog dri dang ro ldan pa/ /bdag gis dad pas 'bul lags kyi/ /bzhes nas bdag la dgyes par mdzod/ /oṃ shrī he ru ka sa pa ri wā ra badzra ni wi dre āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ sna tshogs dril bu'i sgra rnams dang / /cang te'u la sogs sgra yi tshogs/ /bdag gis dad pas 'bul lags kyi/ /bzhes nas bdag la dgyes par mdzod/ /oṃ shrī he ru ka sa pa ri wā ra badzra shabha āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ ces chu gsum

༄7 nyer spyod rol mo dang /lha mo brgyad kyi mchod pa ni/zla zhun byang sems ga bur gyis gang ba'i/ /padma'i snod 'dzin lha mo go rī ma/ /zhing gi rdul dang mnyam par sprul nas kyang / /bde chen mngon par 'phel slad lha rnams mchod/ /oṃ go rī ge āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ nyi 'od mdangs chags rang byung me tog ni/ /sihlas yongs bkang snod 'dzin tso rī ma/ /zhing gi rdul dang mnyam par sprul nas kyang / /gtum mo'i nus pa rgyas phyir lha rnams mchod/ /oṃ tso rī rtsa āḥhūm̐ swā hā/nang gi gdung ba sel byed gla rtsi ste/ /rdo rje dri chu'i snod 'dzin bai tā li/ /zhing gi rdul dang mnyam par sprul nas kyang / /mtshan 'dzin dri ma sbyong phyir lha rnams mchod/ /oṃ bee tā li baṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ bzhi mnyam bdud rtsis gang ba'i thod pa yis/ /phyag gnyis rtag tu brel gyur ghasma rī/ /zhing gi rdul dang mnyam par

sprul nas kyang / /'chi med thob par bya phyir lha rnams mchod/ /oṃ ghasma rī rghaṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ swā li skyes pa rab brjod tsandan dmar/ /rdo rje stobs kyi snod 'dzin puska sī/ /zhing gi rdul dang mnyam par sprul nas kyang / /mtha' yas mthu stobs rgyas phyir lha rnams mchod/ /oṃ pukka sī paṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ ro bcud sbrang rtsi'i btung ba dang bcas pa'i/ /rnal 'byor lhung bzed thogs pa'i ri khrod ma/ /zhing gi rdul dang mnyam par sprul nas kyang / /rdo rje'i lus thob bya phyir lha rnams mchod/ /oṃ sha ba rī shaṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ gzhom med nā da'i rang bzhin cang telā /dbyangs gsal rdo rje'i sgra sgrogs tsaṇḍa lī/ /zhing gi rdul dang mnyam par sprul nas kyang / /rdo rje chos ni 'grub phyir lha rnams mchod/ /oṃ tsaṇḍa lī rtsa āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ thabs shes snyoms par 'jug las dga' ba bzhi/ /zag med yongs su

༄tsho/ /bskyed pa'i ḍombi nī/ /zhing gi rdul dang mnyam par sprul nas kyang / /bde stong dbyer med thob phyir lha rnams mchod/ /oṃ ḍombi ni ḍo āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ thams cad la'ang mthar se gol dang bcas pa bya'o// oṃ ma hā badzra hūm̐/ oṃ badzra gharnye āḥces sngags kyis rdor dril bzung la/thams cad dngos po'i rang bzhin mchog /gdod nas thams cad bdag nyid gnas/ /thabs dang shes rab gnyis med pa'i/ /kye'i rdo rje la phyag 'tshal/ /bdag med mas ni mgul nas 'khyud/ /dbu skra ser po gyen tu 'bar/ /zhal brgyad pa la spyan gsum pa/ /mgon po de la gus phyag 'tshal/ /spyi bo'i steng na nag po mdzes/ /dkar dang dmar po g.yas dang g.yon/ /gang gi lhag ma'i zhal rnams ni/ /nag pa de la bdag phyag 'tshal/ /glang po rta bong glang rnga mo/ /mi dang sha ra bha byi la/ /g.yas pa'i phyag

brgyad la gnas pa'i/ /thod pa 'dzin la bdag phyag 'tshal/ /sa dang chu dang rlung dang me/ /zla nyi gshin rje gsang ba pa/ /g.yon pa'i phyag brgyad la gnas pa'i/ /thod pa 'dzin la bdag phyag 'tshal/ /zhabs bzhi yis ni bdud bzhi po/ /mnyam par mnan zhing gcer bu nyid/ /nyi mar zhabs g.yas brkyang dang bskum/ /gar mdzad de la bdag phyag 'tshal/ /'khor lo bzhi yi bdag nyid mdzes/ /'dzag pa'i mgo bos rnam par brgyan/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rnam dag pa'i/ /phyag rgya lngas ni rnam par brgyan/ /sna tshogs rdo rje spyi bor 'dzin/ /dpral bar rigs kyi bdag po nyid/ /dam pa'i dga' ba yang dag thob//bde chen de la bdag phyag 'tshal/ /rga las skyes pa'i go rī shar/ /kha dog nag cing g.yon pa nya/ /g.yas pa na ni gri gug 'dzin/ /tshangs pa mnan la

༄7/ /bdag phyag 'tshal/ /rtsa las byung ba'i chom rkun ma/ /btsod kyi kha dog lho phyogs su/ /phyag na phag dang cang te'u bsnams/ /dbang po mnan la bdag phyag 'tshal/ /baṃ las skyes pa'i ser mo nub/ /ro langs ma ni nye dbang mnan/ /phyag g.yon lhung bzed g.yas pa yis/ /rus sbal 'dzin la bdag phyag 'tshal/ /ghasma rī ni byang gi sgor/ /ljang gu rghaṃ las byung ba yi/ /phyag na sprul dang thod pas brel/ /drag po mnan la bdag phyag 'tshal//gshin rje mnan zhing paṃ las byung / /g.yon pa dgra stu seng ge g.yas/ /dbang ldan tu ni 'jigs gzugs ma/ /phyag 'tshal pukka sī sngon la'o/ /ri khrod ma dkar shaṃ las byung / /me ru gnod sbyin steng du gnas/ /g.yon na gsil byed g.yas pa na/ /dge slong 'dzin la bdag phyag 'tshal/ /gtum mo nam

mkha'i sngo bsangs ma/ /srin por rtsa las byung ba yi/ /g.yon na thong gshol 'khor lo g.yas/ /phyag 'tshal srin po mnan khyod la'o/ /ḍo las 'khrungs pa'i g.yung mo ni/ /rlung mtshams thag bzang ris steng gshegs/ /phyag g.yon sdig mdzub g.yas rdo rje/ /sna tshogs mdog la bdag phyag 'tshal/ /skyil krung phyed pa'i gar gyis gnas/ /phyag rgya lnga yis rnam par brgyan/ /gcer bu spyan gsum thams cad la/ /bdag ni gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /phung po khams rnams rnam dag pa/ /byang chub sems las byung ba yi/ /bde rab ster 'di thams cad la/ /dngos po kun gyis phyag 'tshal lo/ /nyid kyi phyag na gzung ba yi/ /phyag mtshan sa bon las byung ba'i/ /bde chen 'dod pa thams cad la/ /rtag tu yang dag phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang zhig nyi zla kha sbyor gnas sa

༄7/ /bon/ /gnyis las skyes pa'i gtso bo rig mar bcas/ /nyid kyis nyid kyi dkyil 'khor 'di la ni/ /'jig rten gsum po sprul par mdzad dang ldan/ /nyid la 'di dag thams cad ma lus pa'i/ /zhi ba bde gsol rig ma bsdu byed pa'i/ /shes rab chags pa bdud rtsi'i ro nyid kyis/ /gnas su zhi ba de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mkha' 'gro ma gtso kye'i rdo rje/ /lha mo 'khor lo bcas bstod pas/ /bdag gis bsod nams gang thob pa/ /des ni 'jig rten de mtshungs thegag /ces bstod pa nyi shu pas bstod/ rjes kyi bya ba dngos la/thog mar lhag chad skong ba ni/dkyil 'khor la bskor ba lan gsum dang / skye/ badzra he 〈co ka sa twa sa ma ya/ ma nu pā la ya/ he ru ka twe no pa/ tiṣṭhadṛ ḍho me bha wa/ su to ṣyo me bha wa/ a nu rakto me bha wa/ su po ṣyo me bha wa/ sarba sirnyi mme pra yasmo sarba karma su tsa me/ tsitt+waṃ shri yaḥ

ku ru hūm̐/ ha ha ha ha hoḥ bha ga wān/ he ru ka mā me muñtsa he ru ko bha ba ma hā sa ma ya sa twa āḥhūm̐ phaṭa/ ces yi ge brgya pa lan gsum bzla/ gtso bo nus pa ma mchis shing / /ma tshang ba dang lhag gyur dang / /gang yang 'gal bar gyur pa rnams/ /de kun bzod par mdzad par rigs/ /gsang sngags nyams dang bya ba nyams//cho ga nyams par gyur pa gang / /de yang khyod kyis bzod par mdzod/ /ces bzod par gsol/ skye zhing skye bar rigs mchog tu/ /skye zhing khengs med dam tshig ldan/ /dgyes pa rdo rje ston/ pa dang / /brtse ldan bla mar gus gyur cig /skye zhing skye bar gyur pa na/ /lag pa rdo rje dril bu 'brol/ /zab mo'i chos ni ston pa dang / /btsun mo'i shu kra len 'gyur shog /kun tu sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /rdo rje 'chang chen go 'phang ldan/ /dge ba 'di yis thob 'gyur zhing / /'gro

༄tsho/ /ba lngas kyang thob par shog /byang chub rdo rjes bsngags pa yi/ /rdzogs pa'i byang chub phyir spyod dang / /rdzogs sangs rgyas kyi spyod pa gang //bdag kyang de nyid spyod par shog /ces smon lam gdab/ rdul tshon gyi nub mtha' ma la/ oṃ khyed kyis sems can don kun mdzad/ /rjes su mthun pa'i dngos grub stsol///sangs rgyas yul du gshegs nas kyang / /slar yang 'byon par mdzad du gsol/ /badzra muḥ zhes pas ye shes pa gzhegs/ dam tshig pa rang gi snying gar thim par gyur/ slar rang nyid las kyi he ru ka zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa'i skur gyur/ spyi bor oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐ gis mtshan par gyur/ ces las kyi he ru kar gsal/ gnas gsum srung / mchod sbyin gnas 'dir gang lhags pa/ /'byung po sa 'og rgyu ba dang / /gang yang sa steng 'khod pa dang / /sa blar rgyu ba gang

yin pa/ /mgu bar gyis la rang gnas su/ /thams cad tha dad 'gro bar gyis/ /sarba dhwa ta gasmo dkon mchog rin chen gsum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dge ba 'di yis nye bar mtshon nas ni/ /sems can rnams kyi dus gsum bsags pa yi/༄/zag bcas zag med zung 'jug dge ba rnams/ /bla med byang chub chen por bsngo bar bgyi/ /'gro kun thams cad mkhyen pa thob par shog /chos dbyings byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor du/ /bdag sogs sems can thams cad kyi/ /dus gsum bsags dang rtogs pa yis/ /'gro drug sems can ma lus pa/ /sku lnga yongs rdzogs sangs rgyas myur thob shog /oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharmā ṇḍaṃ ā du zhutpanma twa ta/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ ces brjod cing rdul tshwa mtha' nas bsdus te/ bkra shis brjod pa ni me tog char du bsnyil la/ bkra shis gang zhig chos

༄༅/ /kyi dbyings las legs grub pa/ /dgyes pa'i rdo rje 'jigs byed rgyal po 'bar ba'i sku/ /shes rab bdag med padma la ni rdo rjes rol//bden pa des kyang bde chen la gnas bkra shis shog /bkra shis gang zhig padma dmar po ge sar bcas/ /'dab brgyad la gnas lha mos zhal brgyad la phyogs shing / /rol thabs sna tshogs kyis ni gtso bo mnyes par byed/ /bden pa des kyang bde chen la gnas bkra shis shog /rab dmar spyan gyis dus gsum gdul bya la gzigs shing / /nang stong la sogs bcu drug phyag gis dug gsum sel/ /bsdu dngos zhabs bzhi yis ni bdud bzhi 'joms mdzad pa/ /bden pa des kyang bde chen la gnas bkra shis shog /log rtog bsal phyir dbu skra dmar ser gyen du 'bar/ /sgeg pa la sogs ro dgu'i cha byad

rab tu gsal/ /'khor lo la sogs phyag rgya lnga yis rab tu brgyan/ /bden pa des kyang bde chen la gnas bkra shis shog /me long la sogs ye shes bzhi las grub pa'i sku/ /go rī la sogs phyogs kyi padma la gnas pa/ /tshangs pa la sogs bdud bzhi zhabs kyis gnon mdzad pa/ /bden pa des kyang bde chen la gnas bkra shis shog /byams pa la sogs tshad med bzhi las grub pa'i sku/ /puska sī sogs mtshams kyi padma la gnas pa/ /gshin rje la sogs bdud bzhi zhabs kyis gnon mdzad pa/ /bden pa des kyang bde chen la gnas bkra shis shog /bkra shis gang zhig dran pa nye bar gzhag pa bzhi rnams dang / /yang dag spong ba rdzu 'phrul dbang po stobs la sogs/ /byang chub phyogs rnams sum cu rtsa bdun yongs rdzogs pa/ /bden pa des kyang bde chen la

rjo da/ /ka/ 'ag/ kāḍi dṛ zlosna kshi rnyi py-ig gakṣiṃ/ ༵ kaudzñoṭwāṃn/che/ṭwāṃṭwāṃ sbri sda~X ༵ dīsdo sbyisnatre ṅgikṣiṃ dī/sngi /ṣṭṛṭwāṃ ṅgi lnga/ ṭwāṃhai ༵ dzhaidzhai sna/ bhi ṭwāṃ rjo ṭwāṃbye ༷kharalagasdoṭwāṃs kyas phub//masnros ༷sa ra dwags zlo dan bkyā drug 3sa brkyang zlo/'e/dung gsatram̐ skyad pagā dral bund+ra ma pa' chas sgra'i sgrags//bdan pa das kyang baṭwāṃ nagalaganas ༷gi shas shago/bkra shas sang zhaghra duraXd brgyad sngi~X gas bskar ba/'iyāntu la sakās thrung chuX shang brgyad gzhus rdzu la//glang na gdang can la sags brgyad pa gnas pa ya//bdan pa das kyang bad na la gnas bkra shas shag /sa ḍa zhabs kyas mdzad pa dang /nyan ma

bde legs mtshan bde legs/ /nyin mo'i gung yang bde legs shing / /nyin mtshan rtag tu bde legs pa/ /dkon mchog gsum gyi bkra shis 3(ga /ces brjod par bya'o/ /rdul tshon bum par blugs nas rgya mtshor 'bab pa'i chu klung du dor zhing chu gtsang mas gang ba khyer la/ dkyil 'khor gyi khang par bsang gtor byas pas bkra shis shing byin chags par 'gyur ro// nā ro mai tri'i zhal lung bdud rtsi'i rgyun/ /dgyes mdzad lo tsā'i thugs kyi bum par bskyil/ /rngog ston rdo rje 'dzin pa'i phreng sogs kyis/ /skal ldan rnams la rtogs grol gsos su bkyes/ /grub pa'i skye bo'i phyag tu brgyud pa las/ /mkhas 'dod blo gros chu yis ma bslad pas/ /dus kyi mthar yang byin rlabs zil dngar brgyas/ /blo bzang rnams kyi snying gi bcud du grub/ /so skye'i blo yis skyon gyur gang mchis bla ma lha la bshags/ /bsod nams gzi brjid sna tshogs 'bar bas 'gro ba mtha' yas pa'i/ /lhan skyes snying gi mun pa rab bsal thar pa'i grong khyer du/ /zung 'jug snang ba'i dga' ston chen por longs spyod yongs grub shog/ // ces pa 'di 'ang dkyil

no༅༅ 'khor gyi dbang phyug he ru ka'i ngo bor bzhugs pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa dag gis gser gyi me tog dang bcas rjes su gnang ba yang nas yang du bstsal ba dang / mkhyen pa'i spyan ras yangs shing bstan 'gro la thugs gcig tu gzhol ba'i skyes chen khyad par can dag gis kyang yang yang bkas bskul ba ltar/ mar rngog gi gsung rnams gzhir bzhag /rje rang byung ba dang spyan snga thams cad mkhyen pa'i dgongs don srog tu bzung ste rgyas bsdus kyi bsnon 'brid phran bu tsam las rang bzo'i tshig gis ma bslad par/ kun mkhyen tā'i si tu'i bka' 'bangs karma ngag dbang yon tan rgya mtshos gdan sa chen po dpal spungs kyi yang dben tu sbyar ba dge legs 'phel// // dpal dgyes pa rdo rje'i cho ga'i nag 'gros 'di nyid 7skyabs rje rdo rje 'chang mkhan chen khra 'gu rin po che mchog nas nag 'gros 'di lta bu zhig dgos zhes bka' bstsal spyi bor gnang bar brten/mdo khams bka' brgyud kyi gdan sa chen po dpal spungs par ma gzhir bzung thog dag ther gang thub dang / 'don cha'i go rim tsam la rtsis su ma byas par dkyus kyi gzhung don sa bcad kyi go rim dang mthun par wa ṇa

badzra bisdi'i gtsug lag slob gnyer khang du kame shes rab phun tshogs nas phyi lo 2005 chu stod zla ba'i yar tshes bzang por nag 'gros su bgyis pa'i zhabs phyi gang thub grub pa'i dge bas 7skyabs rje rdo rje 'chang mkhan chen khra 'gu rin po che don gyi slad du mtshan nas smos na kame blo gros ring lugs smra ba'i seng ge mchog gi sku tshe zhabs pad bcom ldan mgon po tshe dpag med kyi ngo bor brtan pa'i rgyur 'gyur cig/ // zhes pa 'di 'ang wā ṇa badzra bidu'i dpe mdzod khang du par du bsgrubs pa'o// maṅga lam̐// //
'i tshogs mchod kyi cho ga yongs 'du'i snye ma zhes bya ba bzhus/sa so// //

ra༅༅/ /mar lugs bla med rgyud sde spyi'i tshogs mchod kyi cho ga yongs 'du'i snye ma zhes bya ba/ bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi lha la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'jigs byed he ru ka dpal dgyes pa che/ /'khor lo'i 'dren pa rnal 'byor mas 'byud de/ /sa gsum khyab par zag med bde stsol mdzad/ /bdag gi snying la bde chen gar mdzod cig /skad cig 'gro la mchog gi dngos ster ba/ /mig 'phrul lta bu'i ye shes sgyu ma ni/ /spyod pa'i yan lag nyid du byin brlabs pa/ /tshogs

༄tsho/ /kyi 'khor lo'i bya ba mdo tsam bshad/ /de la gnyis/ spyod pa'i skabs su bya ba tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor gyi rim pa dang / las dang po pa rnams kyis bsgrub par bya ba'i rim pa'o/ /dang po la gsum/ thun mong / thun mong min pa/ spros pa dang bcas pa'i gnas skabs so/ /de re re la'ang gnas dus rnal 'byor pa dang bya ba'i rim pa thun mong dang khyad par gyi rnam dbyer 'byung ba dag ni 'dir mi spro bas/ dgyes rdor brtag pa phyi ma'i le'u bdun pa dang /

gdan bzhi mant+ra e sa'i ṭī ka sogs nas ji skad bshad pa'i khungs dang sbyar ba'i rnam gzhag dang lag len gyi rim pa gzhan dag las shes par bya'o/ /gnyis pa la lnga/ dgos ched/ gnas/ dus/ gang zag /lag len tu bya ba'i rim pa'o/ /dang po ni/ spyir dbang rdzogs pa'i gang zag gis rab nyin re/ 'bring zla ba re re/ tha ma lo re re la tshogs 'khor lan re ma byas na bza' ba'i dam tshig nyams par gsungs shing / khyad par dngos grub bsgrub pa dang / dam tshig nyams pa gso ba/ bar chad kyi bgegs bsal ba/ nad zhi ba/ bsod nams kyi tshogs gsog pa ste rnam pa lnga'i don tu nan tan bya bar gsungs so/ /gnyis pa gnas ni/ dur khrod la sogs par brtsigs pa'i tshogs khang mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'am/ ma 'byor na dbang ma thob pa'i skye bo pho mo'i spyod yul du ma gyur pa'i gnas dben zhing nyams dga' bar bya ste grong pa'i mi nag 'dus pa'i dbus la sogs par gsang ba'i spyod pa bya ba ni tshul ma yin no/ /gsum pa dus ni/ spyir dbang bskur ba dang sgrub pa'i mchod pa la sogs pa'i dus su bya zhing / khyad par du/ slob dpon ratna rakṣi tas/ rnal 'byor kun spyod la sogs pa/ /'khor lo

༄7/ khrom pa'i rgyud kyis ni/ /nag po'i phyogs dang dkar phyogs kyi/ /bcu pa la ni de rab mchod/ /yi dwags zla phyed bcu bzhi dang / /de bzhin tu ni brgyad pa la/ /dpal ldan dgyes mdzad rdo rje mchod/ /dus kyi 'khor lo nya gnyis la/ /gsang ba 'dus pa zla re bzhin/ /lnga brgyad bcu dang bcu bzhi dang / /de bzhin bco lnga nag phyogs la'ang / /lnga ste dus ni bcu ru 'gyur/ /de dag dus kyi khyad par ro/ /'dir ni rtag tu phun tshogs sam/ /ji ltar 'dod cing ji ltar nus/ /grub par nus na nyin re'am/ /lo zla kun tu bya ba'o/ /zhes gsungs shing de dag gi'ang mtshan mo'i cha kho na mkha' 'gro 'du ba'i khyad par gyi dus so/ /bzhi pa gang zag ni/ rnal 'byor pa dbang thob cing dam tshig dang ldan la bskyed rdzogs gnyis ka'am gang yang rung ba las su rung zhing / sngags kyi kun spyod la the tshom bral zhing ma dad pa mi 'byung ba'i 'dus pa dag gis brtson par bya ba'o/ /lnga pa lag len tu bya ba'i rim pa la gnyis/ spyir smos pa dang / lag len dngos so/ /dang po ni/ spyir tshogs kyi 'khor lo zhes bya ba ni bza' btung gi tshogs dang kunda ru'i spyod pas gzung 'dzin bcom ste phyi nang gsang ba'i he ru

ka dang grub pa rnams mnyes pa'i byed pas 'dod pa'i don skad cig la 'grub par byed pa zhig la zer bas/ med du mi rung ba sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga po mtshon byed māṃ sa dang ma dā na'i rdzas tsam la brten te bsam gtan gyis nan tan du bsgrub pa dang / yid rig ye shes kyi phyag rgya tsam la brten te mos ngor rnal 'byor pho mo grangs mnyam du byas nas stoms par zhugs pa dang / tha mal pa'i ngag dang 'du shes kyi kun rtog spang ste/ rgyud las 'byung ba'i brda dang brda'i ming gis mtshon ciri lha so so'i dkyil 'khor pa gtso 'khor gyi ting nge 'dzin la rtse gcig tu mnyam par bzhag pa ni nges par dgos so/ /gnyis pa lag len dngos la gnyis/ tshogs 'khor kho na dmigs su bya ba dang / dkyil 'khor gzhan dang 'brel ba'i lugs so/ /dang po ni/ yo byad tshogs par byas la sngon 'gro nas bdag bskyed bzlas pa la thug gi bar byas nas dkyil 'khor rang nyid la bsdu/ gzhan nas 'byung ba ltar maṇḍal gyi tshogs mdun bskyed bsgrub/ tshogs byin brlabs nas lhag ma rdo rje'i glu smon lam la thug gi bar btang / mdun bskyed la mchod bstod nongs bshags gshegs bsdu bkra shis sogs spyi ltar bya'o/ /gnyis pa

༄tsho/ /dkyil 'khor gzhan dang 'brel ba'i lugs ni/ stegs bu stag lpags kyi khebs dang ldan pa'i dbus su maṇḍal la chos 'byung gnyis brtsegs bris pa'i steng du thod chung lnga la sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga'i ril bu phyogs ma nor bar bkod pa'am/ ma 'byor na thod pa mtshan ldan chang gis bkang ba gcig la bdud rtsi ril bu'i phab rgyun tshad ldan btab pa bshams pa'i mtha' bskor du bza' bca' btung bzhi rigs gyur tshogs kyi yo byad ci 'byor bas bskor/ dud sol ma'i gtor ma spos mar me me tog btsug pa'ang bsham/ bdag mdun la sogs pa'i sgrub mchod zin nas tshogs kyi cho ga'i skabs su bab pa'i tshe/ byin— brlabs byas pa'i nang mchod bran la/ oṃ badzra a mṛ ta kuṇḍa lī ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭa ces bsangs/ oṃ swa bhā wa shuddhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā ba shuzlo3 haṃ gis sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las/ ye las rlung gi dkyil 'khor dud kha gzhu'i dbyibs lta bu mtha' ma gnyis ba dan gyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du ram̐ las me'i dkyil 'khor dmar po gru gsum pa/ de'i steng

du a las thod pa phyi dkar la nang dmar ba/ nang gi dbus su mi'i sha dang byang chub kyi sems/ shar du glang po che'i sha dang dri chen/ lhor rta'i sha dang dri chu/nub tu ba lang gi sha dang rakta/ byang du khyi'i sha dang rgyungs pa/ de rnams kyi phyi'i rnam pa oṃ/ srog la āḥ de'i steng du zla phyed rdo rje'i rtse mo la hūm̐ gis mtshan pa mgo thur du blta ba/ rlung gis me sbar thod pa bsros sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga khol bas/ oṃ dang āḥlas 'od zer 'phros te zla phyed rdo rje hūm̐ dang bcas pa las ye shes kyi bdud rtsi bab/ dam tshig gi bdud rtsi dang gnyis su med par 'dres par gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ gsum/ mthar zla phyed rdo rje yang thod pa'i nang du lhungs te zhu bas bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin tu gyur/ ces cho ga so so'i gtor chog ltar byin gyis brlab ste/ ji skad du/ rdo rje thod pa'i sbyor ba las/ /skye bo gang dang gang rnams kyi/ /sha ni mkhas pas bza' bar bya//

༄༅ sems can de de dbang du 'gyur/ /ces so/ /de nas tshogs zhing spyan 'dren zhing byin tsos 'bebs pa ni/ gnas rdo rje btsun mo'i gsang ba nas/ /dpal rdo rje 'chang chen gnas 'dir byon/ /gnas gsang ba mchog gi dgyes pa nas/ /yum ye shes mkha' 'gro gnas 'dir byon/ /gnas chos 'byung thar pa'i grong khyer nas/ /bka' bzhi brgyud pa'i bla ma gnas 'dir byon/ /gnas dag pa bde stong mkha' spyod nas/ /mda' bsnun klu sgrub yab sras gnas 'dir byon//gnas 'khor lo gsum gyi dkyil 'khor nas/ /rnal 'byor dbang phyug te lo gnas 'dir byon/ /yul dur khrod chen po'i gnas brgyad nas/ /dpa' bo chen po nā ro gnas 'dir byon/ /ri me ltar 'bar ba'i dur khrod nas/ /mnga' bdag mai tri gupta gnas 'dir byon/ /nub du lakṣi tra'i dgon pa nas/ /paṇa

chen ye shes snying po gnas 'dir byon/ /lho ha la pa ṭa'i mtsho ngogs nas/ /nag po shānti bha dra gnas 'dir byon/ /gnas so sa gling gi dur khrod nas/ /ḍā ki mi rus rgyan can gnas 'dir byon/ /yul nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i gnas mchog nas/ /rje lho brag chen po gnas 'dir byon/ /shar seng ge lta bu'i ka chen pa//dol gyi mtshur ston dbang nge gnas 'dir byon/ /rim lnga'i lam gyi shing rta ba/ /rje 'khon ston yab sras gnas 'dir byon/ /lho rgya stag lta bu'i ka chen pa//gzhung gi rngog ston chos rdor gnas 'dir byon/ /bshad rgyud bka' bab he ru ka /rje mdo sde yab sras gnas 'dir byon/ /nub khyung chen lta bu'i ka chen pa/ /gtsang rong mes ston tshon po gnas 'dir byon/ /'od gsal gyi snang ba sbar mdzad pa/ /rje zhang ston yab sras gnas 'dir byon/ /byang rgod po lta

༄༅/ /bu'i ka chen pa/ /gung thang mi la ras chen gnas 'dir byon/ /sgrub brgyud kyi chu bo mkha' khyab 'dren/ /dge slong 'tsho byed yab sras gnas 'dir byon/ /snang srid zil gnon gyi rdzu 'phrul can/ /grub thob karma pakshi gnas 'dir byon/ /mkha' spyod btsun mo'i tshogs khang nas/ /rje rang byung yab sras gnas 'dir byon/ /kha sbyor longs spyod khang brtsegs nas/ /gar dbang sprul pa'i sku mchog gnas 'dir byon/ /gnas rtag brtan rdo rje'i grong khyer nas/ /gsang bdag tā ra nā tha gnas 'dir byon/ /zhing bde chen padmo bkod pa nas/ /grub brnyes chags med yab sras gnas 'dir byon//sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i dkyil 'khor nas/ /kun mkhyen bstan pa'i nyin byed gnas 'dir byon/ /dpal padma 'od phung 'khyil ba nas/ /padma nyin byed dbang po

gnas 'dir byon/ /ris med mkhas grub tshogs dbus/ nas/ /rje blo gros mtha' yas gnas 'dir byon/ /snang srid zil gnon gyi 'phrin las can//byams mgon padma dbang mchog gnas 'dir byon/ /rje 'gro ba'i mgon po 'dzam gling rgyan/ /rgyal dbang rig pa'i rdo rje gnas 'dir byon/ /gang 'dul sprul pa'i pho brang nas/ /drin can rtsa brgyud bla ma gnas 'dir byon/ /e waṃ zung 'jug gzhal yas nas/ /bcom ldan dkyil 'khor lha tshogs gnas 'dir byon/ /gnas yul dur khrod zhing rnams nas/ /dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma tshogs gnas 'dir byon/ /bdud 'dul phrin las pho brang nas/ /dpal ma mgon lcam dral gnas 'dir byon/ /khyed bka' brgyud rnams sku la gzi brjid 'bar/ /sku mi bzod chags pa'i nyams dang ldan/ /khyed grub thob rnams

༄7/ /gsung la rdo rje'i glu/ /brjod med nā da'i sgra ru 'bar/ /khyed bla ma rnams thugs bde chen gyis myos/ /de myos pas bdud rtsi char du bab//de babs pas snod bcud tshogs su gyur/ /tshogs de la ye shes kyi mchod sprin gyur/ /de myong tsam phyag chen gyi dngos grub thob/ /bza' btung la bcud cig de na gda'/ /pha bka' brgyud la mchod pa 'bul snying 'dod/ /dus de tsa na gdung shugs me ltar 'bar/ /de nas las kyi rdo rjes slob dpon nas bzung / thams cad kyi gnas gsum du dri'i thig le 'bul/me tog/spos/dri chab/lha bshos/mar me/dril bu'i sgras mchod cing / dngos su 'byor dang yid kyis sprul pa dang / /phyogs dus kun gyi rme/chod rdzas bzang dgu rnams/ /bla ma rgyal ba sras dang bcas la 'bul/ /mkha' khyab 'gro ba'i don du bzhes su gsol/ /oṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badzra pursha āḥhūm̐ swā hā/

skyes badzra dhā pe āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ skye( badzra garnye āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ skyes badzra ni bidu āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ skyes badzra ā 61 ke āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ skyes badzra shabha āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ tshogs phud gtor ma la sgron te slar yang sbyan rlabs bya ba ni/ oṃ badzra a mṛ ta kuṇḍa lī ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭa ces bsangs/ oṃ swa bhā wa shuddhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā ba 8)(྅ haṃ gis sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las ye las rlung gi dkyil 'khor dud kha gzhu'i dbyibs lta bu mtha' ma gnyis ba dan gyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du ram̐ las me'i dkyil 'khor dmar po gru gsum pa/ de'i steng du a las thod pa phyi dkar la nang dmar ba/ nang gi dbus su mi'i sha dang byang chub kyi sems/ shar du glang po che'i sha dang dri chen/ lhor rta'i sha dang dri chu/ nub tu ba lang gi sha dang rakta/ byang du khyi'i sha dang rgyungs pa/ de rnams kyi phyi'i rnam pa oṃ/ srog la āḥ de'i steng du zla phyed rdo rje'i rtse mo

༄7/ /la hūm̐ gis mtshan pa mgo thur du blta ba/ rlung gis me sbar thod pa bsros sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga khol bas/ oṃ dang āḥlas 'od zer 'phros te zla phyed rdo rje hūm̐ dang bcas pa las ye shes kyi bdud rtsi bab/ dam tshig gi bdud rtsi dang gnyis su med par 'dres par gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ gsum/ mthar zla phyed rdo rje yang thod pa'i nang du lhungs te zhu bas bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin tu gyur/ phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi ngo bo dpal ldan rtsa ba'i bla ma dam pa'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ bcom ldan 'das rigs drug pa rdo rje 'chang chen po'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ bcom ldan rdo rje phag mo/rgyal sras rdo rje snying po/ grub chen sa ra ha pa/ dpal ldan 'phags pa klu sgrub/ rgyal sras ārya de ba/ paṇa chen zla ba grags pa/ rnal 'byor mā taṅgi pa/ te

lo shes rab bzang po/ nā ro dzñā na sirnyi/ mnga' bdag rgyal ba mi tri/ mar pa chos kyi blo gros/ rngog ston chos sku rdo rje/ rngog ston zhe sdang rdo rje/ rngog ston seng ge sgra/ rngog ston kun dga' rdo rje/ rgya sgom ye shes 'od/ grub chen karma pakshi/ gnyan ras dge 'dun 'bum/ bshes gnyen tshul khrims rin chen/ kun mkhyen rang byung rdo rje/ bla ma chos kyi rgyal mtshan/ yor pa ye shes dpal ba/ bka' bzhi ratna bha dra/ rje btsun mthong ba don ldan/ byang sems dpal 'byor don grub/ spyan snga chos kyi grags pa/ rje btsun karma phrin las/ 'jigs bral mi bskyod rdo rje/ sprul sku dkon mchog yan lag /rgyal tshab grags pa don grub/ stag lung rnam rgyal dpal bzang / chos rje ngag dbang rnam rgyal/ mtshungs med bkra shis dpal grub/ mkhan chen karma nyi ma/ mkhan mchog phrin

༄7/ /las mtshan can/ go shrī don yod snying po/ dpal chen chos kyi don grub/ kun gzigs chos kyi 'byung gnas/ karma tshe dbang kun khyab/mchog sprul phrin las rab rgyas/ khra legs ye shes nyi ma/ rgyal sras blo gros mtha' yas/ padma dbang mchog rgyal po/ rang byung rig pa'i rdo rje/drin can rtsa brgyud bla ma'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams la 'bul/ oṃ de ba pi tsu bahṝ ya oṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ e ni ratna yi oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes gtso bo yab yum dang / oṃ go rī haṃ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ tso rī rtsa oṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ bee tā lī baṃ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ ghasma rī rghaṃ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ puska sī paṃ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ sha ba rī shaṃ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ tsaṇḍa lī rtsa oṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ ḍombi ni ḍo oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes 'bor brgyad dang / oṃ hūṃ shrī ya de wī kā li kā li ma hā kā li hūṃ bhyo oṃ āḥhūm̐/ ces dud sol ma dang / oṃ ma hā kā lā ya oṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ ma hā kā li ye oṃ

āḥhūm̐/ zhes chos skyong spyi dang bye brag la 'bul/ oṃ dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥkhaṃ ram̐ āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ ni rī ti hūm̐ kha āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ badzra puṣṭi āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ badzra dhu pe āḥhūṃ swā hā/ oṃ badzra ā lo ke āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ badzra gandhe āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ badzra ni widre āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ badzra shabha āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ ces chu gnyis nyer spyod dang /dkar mo ri dwags mtshan ma 'dzin/ /chom rkun bdud las rgyal ba'i snod/ /ro langs ma ni chu lag ma/ /ghasma rī ni sman 'dzin zhing / /pukka sī ni rdo rje'i lag /de bzhin ri khrod ma ro 'dzin/ /gdol pa mo ni cang te'u brdung / /'di rnams kyis ni gtso bo mchod/ /'dod chags chen po'i rjes chags pas/ /g.yung mos sku la 'byud pa nyid//oṃ go rī gi āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ tso rī rtsa āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ bee tā lī baṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ ghasma rī rghaṃ āḥhūm̐ swāhā/ oṃ pukka sī paṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ sha ba rī shaṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā/

༄tsho/ /oṃ tsaṇḍa lī rtsa āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ ḍombi ni ḍo āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ zhes pas lha mo brgyad mchod/ oṃ ma hā badzra hūm̐/ oṃ badzra gharnye āḥ ces sngags wo gnyis brjod cing don dran bzhin pas rdor dril bzung la/ khyod ni rnal 'byor ma yi tshogs kyis yongs su bskor/ /khyod ni nyid kyi thugs kyis khyod dgongs 'grub/ /khyod ni rgyu dang mi rgyu 'khor ba kun sgrub pa/ /snying rje'i thugs kyis sems can byang chub tu/ /kun rdzob sgyu ma byang chub sgrub pa yi/ /dgyes pa rdo rje dpal gyi he ru ka la bstod//oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta stu ti badzra swa bhā ba ātma ko3 haṃ/ 7/ de nas dud sol ma'i gtor chog tshang bar 'don/ de mtshams/ oṃ int+ra/ dza ma/ dza la/ dzakṣa/ bhā da/ banni/ bā u/rakṣa/ tsanda/ mūljon mā da/ bskra/ ta la/ pā tā la/ aṣṭha saskra swā hā/ i rda/ ba li/ bhunywa| dzi gha/ phulla/ dhuspa/ māṃ sa/ skra gha/ ambha/ saṃspa/ kaljon sa ṅgā/

khānti/ khu ni/ phe ḍa/ gā da/ oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharmā ṇḍaṃ ā du nutpanma twa ta/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ lan gsum gyis bsngo/g.yas rdo rje dang bcas pa'i thal mo snying khar bakha /g.yon pas dril bu lol bzhin pas/ lha chen brgyad po 'khor dang bcas/ /klu chen brgyad po 'khor dang bcas/ /'jig rten skyong ba brgyad rnams dang / /gnod sbyin tshogs rnams ma lus dang / /srin po'i tshogs rnams ma lus dang / /'byung po'i tshogs rnams ma lus dang / /yi dwags tshogs rnams ma lus dang / ga za'i tshogs rnams ma lus dang / /smyo byed tshogs rnams ma lus dang / /rjed byed tshogs rnams ma lus dang / /mkha' 'gro'i tshogs rnams ma lus dang //de la sogs pa 'byung po'i tshogs/ /ma lus 'khor dang bcas pa kun/ /'dir gshegs bdag la dgongs su gsol/ /mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di snoms

༄༅/ /la/ /rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas la/ /nad med tshe dang dbang phyug dang / /dpal dang grags dang skal pa bzang / /longs spyod rgya chen kun thob cing / /dbang dang mngon spyod dgra sde 'joms/ /dgar dang bsad dang dgug pa dang / /zhi dang rgyas la sogs pa yi/ /las kyi dngos grub bdag la stsol/ /dam tshig can gyis bdag la srungs/ /dngos grub kun gyi stong grogs mdzod/ /dus min 'chi dang nad rnams dang / /gdon dang bgegs rnams med par mdzod/ /rmi lam ngan dang mtshan ma ngan/ /mkha' 'gro'i byad sogs med par mdzod/ /'jig rten bde zhing lo legs dang //'bru rnams 'phel zhing chos 'phel dang / /bde legs thams cad 'byung ba dang / /yid la 'dod pa kun rdzogs mdzod/ /las kyi rdo rjes slob dpon la phyag byas te

pad kor sngon du 'gro bas/ g.yas thod pa ma dwa nas gang ba sogs tshogs kyi yo byad bzung / g.yon rtse gsum gyi phyag rgya bstan la/ gzigs shig mdzes ldan dam pa'i byebyes/ /'di la the cenam byar mi rung/ /bram ze khyi dang gdol pa phag /rang bzhin gcig tu dgongs te rol/ /zhes brjod la rim par drang / len pa pos kyang pad kor bcas/ rin thang med las legs 'ongs chos/ /'dod chags dri ma dang bral zhing / /gzung dang 'dzin pa rnam par spangs/ /de kho na nyid la bdag phyag 'tshal/ /zhes blangs/ mtheb srin sbyar bas spyi bor bla ma/ mgrin par bdud rtsi'i lha mo/ snying gar ye shes sems dpa' mchod par mos la/ skyes āḥhūm̐/ lan gsum gyis bdud rtsi'i thigs gtor 'bul/ de nas sems kyis rgyal po a yod pa la mchod par bsam la btung / thams cad kyi phud bsdus la cha gnyis su byas pa g.yon dang g.yas su bzhag nas yi dam dang chos skyong la 'bul bar bshad pas/ da lta'i lag len tu cha dang po shin tu phud yi dam dang / cha gnyis pa phud lhag chos

dbyugyi /skyong gi gtor ma la bstab/ chos skyong la bstab pa'i phud lhag cha shas zur du bzhag pa phyogs skyong sogs la sbyin/ de'ang gzhung so so'i gtor chog gam bdud rtsi'i mchod pa ltar byin gyis brlab cing dkyil 'khor ba la 'bul/ 'jig rten pa la phud gtor so so'i cho ga ltar gtang / de nas longs spyod de/ ḍombi bas/ de nas rnal 'byor pa rnams kyis/ /chu gnas su ni ram̐ las kyang / /'bar ba'i khung bu 'od 'bar bsam/ /de nang paṃ las chu skyes gdan/ /de steng lha yi dkyil 'khor bsam/ /kha ni hom khung rab bsams te/ /lag gnyis lha las rdo rje yi/ /gzar bu gnyis su yang dag bsgom/ /zhes dang / gzar bus bdud rtsi blangs nas ni/ /'bar ba'i nang du bsreg par bya/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar nang gi sbyin sreg gi tshul du rol zhing / ye rgya dang snyoms par 'jug pa'i bde ba bsgom la/ kolla i reṣṭa ā bolla sogs sam/ de bod skad du bsgyur ba/padma la ni rdo rje gnas/ /padma nyid ni zhing yin no/ /rgyun tu cang te'u brdung bya ste/ /snying rjes ku co bsgrag mi bya/ /de ru stobs ldan 'bad pas bza'/ /chang

yang mang po btung bar bya/ /grogs po skal ldan gzhug par bya/ /skal ba med pa rnam par spang / /bzhi mnyam gla rtsi sihla dang / /ga bur rnams kyis byugs par bya/ /der ni tshod ma sha chen gyis/ /bkang ba dag kyang bza' bar bya/ /'gro dang 'ong ba 'gog mi byed/ /dag dang ma dag bsam mi bya/ /rus pa'i rgyan gyis lus la brgyan/ /de ru ro ni gzhug par bya/ /'dus phyir gnyis ni sbyor ba bya/ /der ni reg min spang mi bya/ /rdo rje 'dzin sogs phyag 'tshal lo//khyod la rab tu dad pa yis/ /mchod pa'i tshogs ni rab phul bas/ /bdag dang mtha' yas sems can kun/ /'khor ba'i sdug bsngal spangs nas kyang //bde chen thes rje 'dzin rgyal re|ga /ces smon lam btab/ lhag ma bsdus la cha gnyis su byas pa'i cha dang po dud sol ma la 'bul bar bshad kyang rnal 'byor pa rtogs pa dman na gong gi phud lhag 'bul ba

༄༅ phyag len yin pas/'bar ba'i phyag rgya bstan/phud gtor bdud rtsis bran la/ skyed bhyo batta li batta litstsha zhes brjod la/ lha mo zhal gcig phyag bzhi ma bong bu gwa pa la zhon pa spyan drangs la/ oṃ ku ru ku ru batta li ma hā batta li/ dur khrod bdag mo dngos grub zhal/ /gtum mo gtsigs byed yi dwags kha/ /dam tshig srung ma khrag dga' mo/ /ki li'i sgra sgrogs sbyor zin ma/ /dur khrod ro yi tshal dbus na/ /tshogs dang pho nyar bcas pa mā /gtsigs byed gtum mo dud sol ma//gsol zhig bzhes shig dam tshig lha/ /gnas nas gnas su mdzad du gsol/ /bdag gi sems la ci 'dod pa/ /de ni khyod kyis grub par gyis/ /bdag gi las 'di ci byed kyang / /de la kun gyis grogs gyis shig /zhesaphrin las bcol la/ hūm̐ rghaṃtna rghaṃtna sarba duṣṭa nai bhakṣa phe oṃ phe phaṭa swā hā/ zhes rdo rje khu tshur gnyis kyi mdzub

mo mche ba'i tshul gyis kha'i grwar bzhag la gshegs su gsol lo//shin tu lhag ma rnams snod gcig tu bsags/chu gtsang gis bran la/skyed a kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharmā khāe ā du 〈khutron twa ta/skyes āX hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/gis byin gyis brlab/oṃ kha kha khā hi khā hi usnrisni ñtsinda bhinda sa ne hūm̐ swā hā/ zhes rol mo'i sgra dang bcas phyi rol du ཿnga po rnams la sbyin zhing drag sngags kyis masgos bcad/sgo drung du gtor skyel la mar me dang me long bstan/chu gtsang khar sbyin/dkyil 'khor gyi rjes kyi bya ba rang gzhung ltar byas pas 'grub bo//de la bza' btung gis lus lha mchod pa phyi/kunda rus rtsa khams kyi lha mchod pa nang /gzung 'dzin bcom pas de kho na nyid kyi lha mchod pa ni gsang ba ste tshogs 'khor rnam pa gsum chabs cig tu bsgrub pa ni mtshan nyid dang ldan pa yin pas ji skad bshad pa'i las dang dngos grub thams cad 'grub la/nang dang gsang ba'i 'khor lor 'du bar mi nus pas ni bza' btung sogs rgya chen pos mchod cing bsgrubs kyang kha zas kyi rnal 'byor tsam du 'gyur ro//de dag gi skabs su shes par bya ba gal po che dpal nā ro zhabs kyis

da༅༅ tshogs kyi 'du ba bsgrags pas gsungs pa'i rnam bzhag bco lnga ni/ dge slong dang bram ze yin kyang brtul zhugs dang rigs kyi rtog pa mi rung / ma sring dang sha za yin kyang ngo tsha dang 'jigs pa'i rtog pa mi rung / dam tshig gi rdzas la mi gtsang ba'i rtog pa mi rung ba ste mi bya ba gsum/ rdo rje 'dzin pa dang las rdor la ming g.yin/ rdo rje spun la bla dwags kyi ming / dam rdzas la tha mal gyi ming nas bzung ste mi 'bod pa gsum/ lus lha/ ngag sngags/ sems chos nyid de mi 'bral ba gsum/ bya ba'i dus/ byas pa'i grags pa/ ji ltar bya ba'i tshul gsang ba ste gsang ba gsum/ tshogs gral du ma bsdad pa la mi sgyin/ rang gis byin gyis brlab pa gzhan la mi sgyin/ lhag ma khyi dang bya rog lta bu gso ba'i phyir du mi sgyin pa ste mi sbyin pa gsum rnams 'bad pas bsrung shing / tshogs gral du rtsod pa dang ku co bag med kyi spyod pa spang zhing ji tsam 'dod pa longs spyod pa'i zos lhag gzhan du khyer mi rung bas de nyid du lhag gtor ltos med du btang dgos par gsungs so/ /rdo rje theg pa'i rnal 'byor pas tshogs kyi 'du ba tshul bzhin du spyad pa ni 'dus byas kyi bsod nams thams cad

las mchog gam phul du gyur pas thun mongs ma yin pa'i sngags kyi dngos grub chen po myur du 'grub pa'i nye rgyur byed pa ni rdo rje 'chang gi gsang tshig go /tshogs gnyis gter ldan rgya mtsho 'di 'khyil bas/ /thar ba'i dbul ba srid na mi gnas par/ /gsang ba'i dgyes pas rol ba'i rgyal sa na/ /he ru ka dpal 'phrul gyis dbang byed shog /ces pa'ang rngog dkyil rnams dang 'dus pa sogs mar lugs bla med kyi dkyil 'khor spyi'i cha lag tu/rngog pa'i bzhed gzhung gzhir bzhag /kai tshang brgyud pa'i phyag bzhes kyis zur brgyan te rnal 'byor mos pas spyod pa blo gros mtha' yas kyis dpa la spungs dben khrod du bgyis pa dge legs 'phel// //zhes pa 'di 'ang wā ṇa badzra bisdi'i dpe mdzod khang du par du bsgrubs pa'o// sarba maṅga lo//

da༅༅/ /skyes swa sti/ rngog dkyil tshogs mchod 'don 'grigs dpal karma kai tshang gi phyag bzhes ltar na/ dgyes rdor la/ tshogs byin rlabs sngon gtor ltar bya/ gnas rdo rje nas/ shabha āḥlha swā hā bar/ tshogs phud gtor ma la spron te slar yang byin rlabs gong ltar dang / khyedags bcu dus ganda/ma gyi nas/ ma hā kā li ye skyed āḥhūm̐ bar bdud rtsi myang ba'i skabs ltar/ chu gnyis nyer spyod/go rī brgyad/ khyod ni rnal 'byor ma sogs kyis bstod/ de nas dud sol ma'i gtor chog tshang bar 'don/ de mtshams/ oṃ int+ra/ dza ma sogs nas/ yid la 'dod pa kun rdzogs thegag gi bar/ tshogs 'bul len bya/ rdo rje'i glu/ smon lam/ phud lhag shin tu lhag ma btang nas mthar dbyung ngo / /rngog dkyil gzhan la'ang des rigs 'gre ste/ 7/ gsang 'dus la/ byin rlabs nang mchod ltar/gnas rdo rje sogs/ tshogs phud gtor mar spron/ slar yang byin rlabs/ lha rnams kyi ljags sogs/rdo rje 'chang chen sogs nas/ oṃ sarba dharma pā la sogs kyi bar/ chu bzhi nyer spyod/

'dod yon bcas sngags mchod/ de nyid lnga pas bstod/ skyed āḥhūm̐ i rda sthā na sogs nas/ zhi dang bkra shis mdzad du garbestol/ swā hā'i bar/ 'bul drangs yan sngar ltar la rdo rje'i glu dgyes rdor nas blang ngo // 7 mā yā la/ nang mchod ltar byin brlab/ gnas the/ rje sogs/ tshogs phud phul nas slar yang byin brlab/ dkyil chog ltar/ he 〈co ka dpal sogs nas/ rtsa brgyud bla ma'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ sgrub thabs ltar/ oṃ shrī he ru ka ma hā badzra pra tītstsha me nas/ mchod bstod/ sna tshogs mkha' 'gror phyag 'tshal bstod/ bar/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ gnas bdag gzhi bdag nas/ na/na 'o/spyab malngardod/ bar/ tshogs 'bul drangs yan sngar ltar ro/ /zhes pa'ang gu ṇas so/ /dge legs 'phel// //
tor chog 'bring po yongs 'dus ljon pa'i skyed tshal zhes bya ba bzhugs so// //

༄7/ /na ma utta ra shrī he ru ka pā dwa ya/ 'phags bzhi'i skyed yum shes rab pha rol phyin/ /bdud 'dul khrag 'thung chen mo'i skur bstan pa/ /'dod khams dbang phyug dgyes pa'i 'dzum zhal gyis/ /bdag 'khor byang chub bar du skyong bar mdzod/ /birba nā ro mar pa sogs/ /grub pas bsten cing mkhas pas bsngags/ /thub bstan skyong mdzad tshogs kyi rje/ /phrin las snying po 'di rmad do/ /khrag 'thung nag mo chen mo dud pa'i sol ba ma'i gtor chog 'bring por

༄7/ /bya ba la gsum/ spyor ba/ dngos gzhi/ rjes so/ /dang po ni/ 'di nyid ched du sgrub pa'i gnas phyi nang gi rten dang rten gyi gtor ma sogs rgyun du yod pa'i sar/ mchod gtor dang phyi mchod gso bran bya/ 'bul gtor dang sman raka gi phud mchod bsham/ rten med cing nyi tshe ba'i gsol mchod lta bu la/ lcags sam thod pa'i snod du mchod gtor gru gsum bra gzugs ma grong nge ba rtse mo gsum pa'i g.yas g.yon mdun logs su thod gzugs kyi nang sku

gsung thugs sprul gsum/ de rgyab ma mo bzhi/ de rgyab gdong can brgyad/ de rgyab sgo ma bzhi rnams la zur gsum rim par sum chas chung du btang ba'i mthar thebs kyu grangs mang g.yas bskor du bskor/ nyi zla dang zhi rgyan gyi rtser me ri dung khog mas mtshan pa/ gtor rtse g.yas g.yon dbus gsum du man thig res brgyan pas nor bu sum tshoms su dod pa la sha sna snying sna'i 'phan dar gyis brgyan/ khur ba shing tog chang dang khrag sna khyad par bya mo nag mo dang ra rog po'i sha khrag blugs/ 'bul gtor zur gsum rtse gsum nyams tsam dod cing thebs kyu bcu dgus bskor ba me ri dung khog mas brgyan pa dang / phyi mchod grang tshar/ sman rag phud skyems rnams bsham mo/ /gnyis pa dngos gzhi la/ bskyed bstim dam bsgrag mchod cing bstod/ /bzlas pa skong bshags bcas te brgyad/ /ces pa'i dang po dam tshig pa bskyed pa ni/ bsnyen sgrub skabs bdag bskyed kyang lha mor bsgoms pa yin rung / gtor chog tsam la dgyes rdor dang gdan bzhi gang yang rung ba'i bdag bskyed rgyas bsdus gari rung sngon du grub par byas nas/ skyed badzra a skṛ ta kuṇḍa lī ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭa/ skye( swa bhā wa
