༄tsho/ /shuddhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā ba shuddhi3 haṃ/ rang nyid yi dam lhar gsal ba'i mdun du lha mo dud sol ma rnam smin gyi lus can du gsal ba'i thugs kar padma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa kha bye ba'i dbus su oṃ dkar po 'od zer dang bcas pa/ de'i steng du ram̐ dmar po/ de las me 'bar bas gzung 'dzin rnam smin gyi lus thul gyis bsregs nas thal ba'i phung por gyur/ de'i steng du srog gi i dkar po 'od zer dang bcas pa'i steng du bam̐ dkar po las bum pa dkar por gyur pa'i kha nas bdud rtsi dkar lhung lhung bab pa i la thim pas i yig 'od du 'bar bar gyur/ oṃ i ma hā kā lī de bī kā lī be grwanta kā la rā tri tsaṇḍa rū bi sum̐ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ de yongs su gyur pa las dur khrod brgyad gzhal yas khang thod mkhar zur gsum pa sum rim dang bcas pa me rlung dmar

nag 'tshubs pa'i dbus su/ ye shes kyi dpal ldan lha mo dud pa'i sol ba ma nag mo sprin dang bung ba ltar gnag pa/shin tu sbeg la keng rus kyi lus can zhal gcig phyag bzhi ma/ g.yas kyi dang po na ral gri me 'bar ba phyar zhing gnyis pa na thod rlon dmar gyis bkang nas zhal du gsol ba/ g.yon gyi dang po na shasti'i mtshon cha 'dzin cing 'og ma na tri shā la rtse gsum pa'i mgul na dar dpyangs 'phur ba bsnams pa/ mi ro rengs pa khar bcug nas mche ba bzhi gtsigs pa/ spyan gsum dmar po zlog cing khams gsum la lta ba/ dbu skra kham ser gyen du brdzes shing lan bu g.yon du 'khyil ba/ dbu la sgrul dang thod phreng gis brgyan cing rma bya'i rgyal mtshan spyi gtsug na phyar ba/ snyan cha g.yas pa sgrul gyi mgul nas dril bu gsil zhing g.yon pa seng ge ral dmar

༄tsho/ /can 'phyo ba/ rna ltag gnyis na me tog dang dar nag gi cod pan 'phur ba/ lha ma yin la sogs pa'i thod pas do shal du byas pa/ glang po che'i ko ba rlon pas stod g.yogs shing ba lang gi ko rlon chan pas dras pa la re lde ser po'i sham bu btags pas smad dkris pa/ rus pa'i rgyan cha lngas brgyan cing klu chen po brgyad gshibs pa'i ska rags can/ khrag zhag dang thal chen gyi thig le tshom bur bkod pa/ zhabs gnyis lcags sgrog gis mdzes par brgyan cing bong bu dmar gwa'i steng na btsan skyil brjid pa'i tshul gyis bgying zhing rol pa/ ye shes kyi me dpung rab tu 'bar ba'i dbus na gsung ni dung dang 'brug gi sgra lta bur sgrog cing ma mo mkha' 'gro sha za thams cad dbang du sdud pa'i skur gsal bar gyur/ gtso rkyang bskyed pa la ye shes pa bcug zin nas lubor

rnams nyi ma dang zer bzhin bsgom pa rtsa gzhung rnams kyi dgongs pa yin kyang / phyis kyi bla ma brgyud pa'i phyag bzhes ltar skabs 'dir mos bskyed tsam spro na/ 21da mkhar nang gi sdi/ ga༄/ma du // garna/nga thugs sprul gyi ma mo gsum/ nag mo gcer bu mi snying dang thod khrag thogs shing bong bu la zhon pa/ zhing gos re lde rus pas brgyan pa/ thod mkhar phyi'i phyogs bzhir rigs bzhi'i lha mo dkar ser dmar ljang bzhi gri thod 'dzin cing dur khrod chas can bong bu la zhon pa/ de rgyab shar du seng gdong ma/ lhor stag gdong ma/ nub tu spyang gdong ma/ byang du phag gdong ma/ byang shar bya rgod gdong ma/ shar lhor cung ga'i gdong ma/ lho nub tu dur bya'i gdong ma/nub byang du bya rog gdong ma rnams kyang gri thod 'dzin cing dur khrod chas can dril rta la zhon pa/phyogs bzhir sgo srung kai ka'i gdong can mtshon cha sna tshogs

༄༅/ /thogs shing dril nag stag spyang spre'u la zhon pa/ gzhan yang thugs sprul nag mo 'bum sde sogs sprul pa'i las mkhan bye ba 'bum phrag/ye shes dang las dang 'jig rten las grub pa'i ma mo mkha' 'gro sha za thams cad kyis bskor bar gyur/ lha mo'i thugs kar 'od sgo nga'i dbyibs lta bu sor bzhi'i tshad me dmar lta bu'i dbus su hūṃ mthing nag zla ba dang nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor can/ de las 'od 'phros dgra bgegs thams cad tshar bcad dregs byed thams cad kyi srog gi snying po bsdus te tshur 'dus pas hūṃ gi mtha' skor 'od kyi thig le'i nang du/ oṃ hūṃ shrī ya de wī kā li kā li ma hā kā li hūṃ bhyo/sngags kyi phreng ba 'od zer dang bcas pas bskor bar gyur/ rang gi thugs ka'i hūṃ las hūṃ gcig chad de lha mo'i bha gar thim/ badzra lā su rā ga ya mi hūṃ/

'di ni gsang ba'i lha mo bha gar gzhug pa zhes bya ste lha mo bdag bsgom du byed pa'i tshe/ rang gi thugs ka'i hūṃ las hūṃ chad de bdag nyid kyi gsang bar gzhug pa yin no// ga'e1 'ashesar thams cad kyi gnas gsum du sku gsung thugs rdo rje gsum gyi ngo bo oṃ āḥhūṃ/ 'khor thams cad kyi thugs kar bhyo yig gis mtshan pa/ bdag mdun gyi thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer lcags kyu lta bu 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas dpal lha mo nag mo 'bum sde'i tshogs dang bcas pa skad cig gis spun drangs par gyur/gnyis pa ye shes pa spyan drangs shing bstims pa ni/ gu gul sogs sbyar skros bdug dbyangs rol bcas/ bhyo/ ri rab chen po'i byang shar mtshams/ /g.yu mtsho mu le mthing gi dbus//rin chen lnga ldan gzhal yas khang / /de dbus srid gsum thod mkhar nang / /gru gsum 'bar ba'i klong dkyil nas/ /dpal ldan lha mo dud sol ma/ /sku

༄༅/ /mdog mthing nag 'jigs pa'i gzugs/ /zhal gcig phyag bzhi bong bu chibs/ /'khor yang nag mo 'bum sde'i tshogs/ /gnas 'di nyid du gshegs su gsol/ /da lta snyigs ma'i dus 'di mā /dam can bzhud par mi 'os kyang / /sngon tshe byang chub shing gi drung / /thub pa chen po'i spyan snga mā/ji ltar khas blangs dam bcas ltar//sangs rgyas bstan pa bsrung ba dang //'gro kun bde la 'god pa'i phyir//dpal ldan lha mo gshegs su gsol//gsang sngags srung ma dam tshig can/ /'khor bcas gshegs shing bzhugs su gsol/ /bhyo/ gzhan yang gshin rje'i pho brang dang / /lha khang dur khrod ri sul nas/ /chos skyong srung ma 'khor bcas rnams/ /mchod pa 'bul ba bzhes slad du/ /da lta nyid du byon nas kyang / /gnyis med brtan par bzhugs su

garbedu44/ /zhes spyan drangs pas ye shes pa 'khor bcas mdun gyi nam mkhar sprin gyi phung po 'thibs pa'am bung ba tshang la 'du ba bzhin du thib thib byon par bsam la dgug gzhug bcings mnyes kyi phyag rgyas/ skyes hūṃ shrī ya de wī kā li kā li ma hā kā li hūṃ rjestodṛ shu dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ sa ma ya st+waṃ/ sa ma ya hoḥ zhes dam ye gnyis med chu la chu 'dres pa ltar bzhugs par bsam/ gsum pa bka' bsgo dam bsgrag ni/ dpal ldan lha mo dud pa'i sol ba ma khyod kyis bdag la sku dngos su ston cig /gal te sku dngos su mi ston na/ bla ma gong ma rdo rje 'dzin pa rnams kyi spyan sngar dam bcas pa bzhin du sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa gnyan po bsrung ba dang / bla ma dam pa rnams kyi phrin las sgrubs shig /sngags 'chang sgrub pa po bdag cag gi dgra bgegs thams cad myur du sgrol cig /tshe dang dpal skyed cig /gzhan yang bdag cag gi yid la gang 'dod pa thams cad khyed

ra༅༅/ /kyis sgrubs shig /skyed hūṃ shrī ya de wī kā li kā li ma hā kā li hūṃ bhyo/ mthar/ e ā ralli hri dzaḥ nang mchod dam gur gum gyi chu la sngags btab pa 'thor la/'di ni khyod kyi dam tshig chu/ /dam tshig 'das na sreg par byed/ /dam tshig srung na dngos grub ni/ /rdo rje bdud rtsi'i chu 'dis 'grub/ /oṃ ha na ha na badzra sa ma ya 65 ti kra ma rna ṭwāṃ phaṭa/ spyi la de tsam gyis 'thus/sgrub pa khyad par ba dang las drag po'i skabs su gnad kyi dam bsgrag phrin las rgyas pa'i ltar bya'o/ /bzhi pa rma chod pa la thog mar mchod rdzas rnams/ skyes saṃ sho dha ni hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ swa bhā wa shuddhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā ba shuddhi3 haṃ/ ces bsang sbyang / oṃ āḥhūṃ ha hoḥhrīḥ lan gsum/ mchod rdzas kyi kha dog dri ro ngan pa bsal nas ngo bo ye shes kyi bdud rtsi/ rnam pa phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod rdzas nam mkha' mdzod kyi 'khor lo'i sprin chen por gyur/ phyi mchod ni/ oṃ hūṃ shrī ya de wī kā li kā li

ma hā kā li hūṃ bhyo/ oṃ badzra arghaṃ pra titstsha pū dza me gha sa mu dra spa ra ṇa sa ma ye hūṃ swā hās mchod yon dang / oṃ hūṃ shrī ya de wī kā li kā li ma hā kā li hūṃ bhyo/ mthar/ oṃ badzra pra ba ra sad ka ra pra tīrtu/ pū dza me gha sa mu dra spa ra ṇa sa ma ye hūṃ swā hā/ btags pas zhabs bsil 'bul/ nyer spyod lnga'ang sngags tsam gyis 'bul chog kyang tshigs bcad spro na/ hūṃ/utpal padma dbang lnga'i me tog dang / /tsandan a gar gu gul tshil chen spos/ /sbyar dang lhan skyes bdud rtsi lnga yi dri/ /'bru sna 'brasdo zan sha lnga dgra bgegs lus/ /nyi zla nor bu zhun chen mar nag me/ /rol mo snyan dbyangs thod rnga rkang gling sgra/ /ma gcig lha mo 'khor dang bcas la 'bul/ /oṃ hūṃ shrī ya de wī kā li kā li ma hā kā li hūṃ bhyo/ mthar/ oṃ badzra pursha dhū pe gandhe ni bidu ā lo ke shardi pū dza me gha sa mu dra spa ra ṇa sa ma ye hūṃ swā hā/ nang mchod ni/mdzes dgu'i gzugs

༄7/ /dang snyan brdzid sgra dbyangs tshogs/ /dri zhim spos dang ro ldan sha khrag zlas/ /reg 'jam na bza'i bye brag dpag med rnams/ /bstan srung chen mo 'khor dang bcas la 'bul/ /rdo rje'i dbang po mchog tu tshim gyur cig /oṃ hūṃ shrī ya de wī kā li kā li ma hā kā li hūṃ bhyo/ mthar/ oṃ badzra rū pa shapta gandhe ra sa sparnye pū dza me gha sa mu dra spa ra ṇa sa ma ye hūṃ swā hā/ gsang mchod ni/ hūṃ/ rang byung dam rdzas bdud rtsi lnga/ /rtsa ba brgyad la yan lag stong / /dmar chen mtsho dang māṃ sa'i dri/ /ga bur shel gyi pog spos 'di/ /mtshan bzang nag mo re ma ti/ /ma tshogs stong gi tshogs bcas la/ /dgyes mchod dam pa 'bul lags na/ /bzhes nas dbang dang dngos grub stsol/ /sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta māṃ sa rakta la khā hi/ khyad par gtor ma 'bul ba ni/ oṃ saṃ rberte dha ni hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ swa bhā wa

shuddhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā ba shuddhi3 haṃ/ ces bsang sbyang / gtor ma'i nang du ha ser pos kha dog ngan pa bcom nas kha dog phun sum tshogs par gyur/ hoḥdakar pos dri ngan pa bcom nas dri phun sum tshogs par gyur/ hrīḥsngon pos ro ngan pa bcom nas ro phun sum tshogs par gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ gsum/ oṃ ha hoḥhrīḥswā hā/gsum brjod pas byin brlab/ thal mo brkyang la yid kyis btegs la zhal du bstab pa'i tshul gyis/ ma khyod la mchod pa 'bul ba ni/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i tshogs kyi mchod pa dang //dam nyams bsgral ba'i don snying mkhal mar bcas/ /sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /rnal 'byor bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod//ces dang / oṃ hūṃ shrī ya de wī kā li kā li ma hā kā li hūṃ bhyo/ mthar/ sa pā ri bā ra/ ma hā ba li ta khā hi/ ma hā māṃ sa khā hi/ ma hā go ro tsa na khā hi/ ma hā tsitta khā hi/

༄༅/ /ma hā rakta khā hi/ ma hā ba su ta khā hi/ oṃ i rda ba li kṛhā pā ya grihā pā ya hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ i rda ba li kha kha khā hi khā hi/ lan gsum gyis 'bul lo//lnga pa bstod pa dngos grub lūng rgyud nas gsungs pa ni/ hūṃ bhyo/ dpal ldan lha mo mi pham srid gsum bdag /rang don bsgrub phyir rnam thar gsum gzhol yang / /snying rje'i dbang gis rjes la thob pa yi/ /shes rab sna tshogs dag gis 'gro don mdzad/ /lha mo sku mdog nag mo char sprin mdog /mtshan mo nag mo shin tu gtum pa'i gzugs/ /shin tu sbeg cing keng rus lus can ma/ /zhal gcig phyag bzhi zhabs gnyis brjid pa'i sku/ /ral pa gyen brdzes lan bu g.yon du 'khyil/ /skra ser sprul dang thod pa'i phreng thod bcings/ /rna ltag me tog dar nag cod pan can/ /khrag gi chang gis ra ro spyan gsum dmar/ /mi ro rengs

pa khar bcug mche ba bzhi/ /rnam par gtsigs nas khrag la shin tu dgyes/ /snyan g.yas sprul gyi mgul nas dril gsil zhing / /gdug pa btul nas tshangs pa'i sgra sgrog ma/ /snyan cha g.yon pa seng ge ral pa dmar/ /dpa' mo khams gsum seng ge'i sgra sgrog ma/ /phyag bzhi g.yas kyi dang po ral gri phyar//'og mas bhandha rakta dmar skyil bkang / /g.yon gyi dang po shasti'i mtshon cha 'dzin/ /'og ma tri shāl mgul nas dar nag 'phyangs/ /shalti ral gri mtshon gyis bsad pa yi/ /lha ma yin gyi thod sogs do shal mdzad/ /glang po che yi ko rlon stod g.yogs mdzes/ /smad ni ba glang ko rlon dras pa la/ /phyed ni re lde ser po'i sham bu dkris/ /klu yi dbang po gshibs pa'i sked bcings mdzad/ /zhabs gnyis lcags sgrog dag gis mdzes par brgyan/ /khrag zhag me yi

༄7/ /thig le tshom bur bris/ /bhyo/ bong bu gwa zhon mtshan mo dur khrod rgyu/ /bong bu'i rmig pa glog gi shugs can ma/ /khams gsum skad cig gcig la bskor ba mdzad/ /gsung ni dung dang 'brug gi sgra lta bus/ /ma mo mkha' 'gro sha za dbang du sdud/ /lho phyogs gshin rje'i pho brang rtag tu gnas//dam pa'i sa nas gzugs sku gnyis gzigs ma/ /ting 'dzin dbang thob gzugs khams gnas su byon/ /tshangs pa'i rgyal po la sogs phyag byas ma//gzhan la dbang sgyur 'dod khams mthar yang phyin/ /dbang phyug chen po'i sku la dges 'khril ma/ /sum cu rtsa gsum tshal bzhir byon pa'i tshe/ /lha rnams dbugs dbyung brgya byin phyag byas ma/ /lha ma yin rnams pham par mdzad pa'i tshe/ /lha min dbang po kun gyis phyag byas ma/ /sku mchog ri rab che dang

'gran pa'i tshe/ /lte ba'i thad kyi phyogs nas nyi zla 'char/ /rgyal chen bzhi la rbe gas pas phyag byas ma/ /rgya mche'i gting nas me 'bar mtsho skem nus/ /sa 'og dbang po kun gyis phyag byas ma/ /lha mo khyod kyi cho 'phrul 'di bstan pas/ /bdud dang gshin rje'i rgyal po 'dar zhing 'dud/ /ma mo srin mo'i tshogs rnams 'dar zhing rngams/ /tsitta rin chen gur phub gzhal yas khang / /nyi zla'i dkyil 'khor brtsegs pa'i 'od zer 'bar/ /phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten dug gi bcud bsdus nas/ /nyi zla'i dkyil 'khor dag la thim par mdzad/ /dug gi rlangs pas nag po'i phyogs rnams kyi/ /bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi'i nad rnams slong mdzad ma/ /de phyir nad kyi bdag mo dam la 'dus/ /phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten bdud rtsi'i bcud bsdus nas/ /zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dag la thim par

༄tsho/ /mdzad/ /bdud rtsi'i rlangs pas dkar po'i phyogs rnams kyi/ /bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi'i nad rnams rtsad gcod ma/ /bdud rtsi sman gyi rgyal mo dam la 'dus/ /gang zhig khyed la dad na ma bas byams/ /de phyir ma gcig nad bdag sman gyi gtso/ /lha mo khyod la bdag gis rtag tu bstod/ /rgyun du de tsam gyis 'thus la/ spro na rgyud las 'byung ba gzhan rnams dang /til mar ma sogs kyis bstod par bya'o//drug pa bzlas pa bya ba ni/lha mo'i thugs ka'i sa bon hūṃ yig gi mthar snying po'i sngags kyi phreng bas bache/ra ba la dmigs te bzlas pa bya/ skyed hūṃ shrī ya de wī kā li kā li ma hā kā li hūṃ rjeX/ gang bdag bskyed thugs ka'i 'od zer phog pas thugs rgyud bskul sngags phreng mgal me ltar g.yon tu 'khor/ ci 'dod pa'i las rab 'byams bsgrub par mos la sngags ci nus su bzlas pa'i mthar/ thun gtor la bdud rtsi bran/ mche ba'i phyag rgya bcas la/ skyes rjedaḥbatta li batta li tshe/ rjed/ dur

khrod bdag mo dngos grub zhal/ /gtum mo gtsigs byed yi dwags kha/ /dam tshig srung ma khrag dga' mo/ /gī li'i sgra sgrog sbyor zin ma/ /dur khrod ro yi tshal dbus na/ /tshogs dang pho nyar bcas pa mā /gtsigs byed gtum mo dud sol ma/ /gsol cig bzhes shig dam tshig lha/ /gnas su gnas par mdzad du gsol/ /bdag gi sems la ci 'dod pa/ /de ni khyod kyis grub par mdzod/ /bdag gi las ni ci byed kyang / /de la kun gyis grogs mdzod cig/lha mo nag mo mthu mo che/ /'phags ma khyed la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /bstan la gnod pa'i gdug pa kun/ /myur du bsgral ba'i phrin las mdzod/ /nyin dang mtshan du bya ra mdzod/ /bcol ba'i phrin las grub par mdzod/ /oṃ hūṃ shrī ya de wī kā li kā li ma hā kā li hūṃ bhyo/ groṇḍa grohā sarba duṣṭan bhakṣa bhakṣa phre sum̐ phri phaṭa

da༅༅/ /swā hā/ zhes se gol gtogs la thun gtor 'bul lo/ /bdun pa skong ba ni/ skong rdzas rnams bsang sbyang / skye( saṃ 3| dha ni hūṃ phaṭa/ skye( swa bhā wa 〈khyuḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā ba shuzlo3 haṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las gnas khang dur khrod drag po'i bkod pa 'jigs su rung ba'i dbus su/ hūṃ yig dpag tu med pa 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i/phyi nang gsang ba'i rten rdzas sgrub rdzas skong rdzas mchod rdzas kyi bye brag bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'jig rten gyi khams rgyas par gang zhing rgyun mi chad par 'byung ba dang / sman gtor rakta dam ye gnyis su med pa'i bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho kha dog dri ro nus mthu phun sum tshogs shing zad mi shes par gyur/ oṃ ha hoḥhrīḥswā hā/ lan gsum / na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta bhyo bi shwa mu khe bhyaḥ sarba thā khaṃ giṅka te spa ra ṇa i me ga ga na khaṃ groste rda ba lbā di swā hā/ ces nam mkha' mdzod kyi sngags rgya lan

gsum gyis spel la/ bhyo/ dga' ba tshal gyi dur khrod nas/ /'das dang ma byon da ltar gyi/ /bstan pa srung bar mnga' gsol ba'i/ /chos skyong srung ma dud sol ma/ /khyod kyi thugs dam gnyan po ni/ /rig 'dzin rnal 'byor bdag gis bskang / /dam can srung ma 'dir byon cig /rnal 'byor dgra lha 'dir byon cig/'bod pa'i dam rdzas yin pa'i phyir/ /g.yab dar nag pos thugs dam bskang / /sgrub pa'i dam rdzas yin pa'i phyir/ /rtag gtor chen pos thugs dam bskang / /ma dang mi 'bral 'grogs pa'i phyir/ /rgyun gyi gtor mas thugs dam bskang / /dam tshig gnyan po bsre ba'i phyir/ /bdud rtsi sman gyis thugs dam bskang / /bstan pa'i dam rdzas yin pa'i phyir/ /dgra bgegs sha dang nal bu'i sha/ /māṃ sa'i bye brag dpag med kyis/ /bskang ngo khyed kyi thugs dam

༄༅/ /bskang / /dgyes pa'i dam rdzas yin pa'i phyir/ /ra nag khrag dang bya nag khrag /dgra bgegs khrag la sogs pa yi/ /rakta'i rgya mtshos thugs dam bskang / /dgra bgegs gsur la rngams pa'i phyir/ /tshil chen dud pas thugs dam bskang / /chu dang tshal skyes me tog dang / /tsandan a ka ru spos dang / /dri bzang sbyar ba'i yon chab kyis/ /bskang ngo khyed kyi thugs dam bskang / /gro nas 'bras kyi bshos gtsang dang / /'bru rtsi zhun chen snang gsal sogs/ /phyi yi mchod pa rnam lnga yi/ /bskang ngo khyed kyi thugs dam bskang / /gzugs sdug sgra snyan dri zhim pa/ /ro bzang reg bya 'jam pa yi/ /'dod pa'i yon tan rnam lnga yi/ /bskang ngo khyed kyi thugs dam bskang / /mi rta glang sogs sha lnga dang / /byang sems rgyud pa rakta sogs/ /bdud rtsi lnga la sogs pa yi//

gsang ba'i mchod pas thugs dam bskang / /bza' ba'i dam rdzas yin pa'i phyir/ /bshos gtsang dmar gyis brgyan pa dang / /chang dang khur ba sgog btsong sogs/ /tshogs kyi mchod pas thugs dam bskang / /phyi yi rten rdzas yin pa'i phyir/ /bong bu gwa dmar lug nag dang / /dar nag bhañdza ma ral gyis/ /bskang ngo khyed kyi thugs dam bskang / /nang gi rten rdzas yin pa'i phyir/ /rma bya nor bu'i rgyal mtshan dang / /nal bu'i rgyal mtshan bhañdza yis/ /bskang ngo khyed kyi thugs dam bskang / /gsang ba'i rten rdzas yin pa'i phyir/ /a mṛ ta dang myos byed bcud/ /dgra bgegs gri snying nal bu'i snying / /tsitta snying gis thugs dam bskang / /sku yi rten rdzas yin pa'i phyir/ /lugs sku 'dag sku bris sku dang / /dar sku sku 'bag la sogs kyis/ /bskang ngo khyed kyi thugs dam bskang //

༄tsho/ /gsung gi rten rdzas yin pa'i phyir/ /rnga dang rdza rnga rnga chen dang / /'khar rnga dung dang cha lang dang / /gdung ba'i dbyangs kyis thugs dam bskang / /dam tshig gnyan po bskul ba'i phyir/ /dam tshig dril bus thugs dam bskang / /phrin las gnyan po bskul ba'i phyir/ /cang te'u sgra yis thugs dam bskang / /'jig rten dbang du sdud pa'i phyir/ /gsang ba'i rnge'u chung thugs dam bskang / /thugs dam gnad nas bskul ba'i phyir/ /phyag rgya sngags dang ting 'dzin dang / /snying po 'dzab kyi bzlas pa yis/ /bskang ngo khyed kyi thugs dam bskang / /bhyo/ gzhan yang thugs dam bskang ba ni/ /sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'dis/ /'gugs byed ma dang gsod byed ma/ /las mkhan rnams kyi thugs dam bskang / /phrin las rnam bzhi sgrub byed pa'i/ /mkha' 'gro

bzhi yi thugs dam bskang / /dgra bgegs ma lus sgrol byed pa'i/ /gdong can brgyad kyi thugs dam bskang / /nyams pa'i sha khrag za byed pa'i/ /sgo ma bzhi yi thugs dam bskang / /drag po'i las la 'gyed pa'i phyir/ /nag mo 'bum sde'i thugs dam bskang / /gzhan yang sprul pa'i las mkhan ni/ /dkar mo ser mo dmar mo dang / /ljang nag la sogs 'bum sde'i tshogs/ /bskang ngo khyed kyi thugs dam bskang / /bdud kyi dmag dpung bzlog pa'i phyir/ /yang sprul bye ba'i thugs dam bskang / /mnyes pa'i rten dang ma nyams phud/ /tshogs dang mchod gtor rgya chen 'dis/ /'dod khams ma mo kun gyi gtso/ /'khor bcas thugs dam bskang gyur cig /de ltar lha mo 'khor bcas kyi/ /thugs dam bskang ba'i byin brlabs kyis/ /rig 'dzin rnal 'byor bdag cag la//

༄7/ /mkha' 'gro'i nyams chags byung bas skang / /'jig rten mkha' 'gro'i gnod pa zlog /ma mo'i dal yams byung ba zlog /gzhin rje'i khram kha btab pa zlog /bdud kyi zhags pa nag po chod/ /bande'i byad kha slad la sgyur/ /sde brgyad gnod pa thams cad zlog /gzhan gyi rbad 'dre phur kha sgyur//rmis ltas mtshan ma ngan pa zlog /lo keg zla keg thams cad sgyur/ /sdang ba'i dgra dang gnod pa'i bgegs/ /bdud dang bar du gcod pa'i tshogs/ /thams cad thal ba rdul du rlog /bdag cag rnal 'byor thams cad kyi/ /dam tshig nyams pa skong gyur cig /mchog dang thun mong la sogs pa'i/ /dngos grub ma lus stsal du gsol/ /tshe dang dbang phyug spel du gsol/ /dpal dang grags pa bsgrub tu gsol/ /'khor dang bstan pa bsrung du gsol/ /nyin dang mtshan

du bya ra mdzod/ /legs dang sprod la nyes dang bsnol/ /bsam pa sgrubs la re ba skongs/ /mthu stobs skyed la dpung gnyen mdzod/ /lus dang grib ma bzhin du 'grogs/ /nyin dang mtshan du bya ra mdzod/ /gzhan yang yid la ci 'dod pa/ /de ni khyod kyis sgrub par mdzod/ /ces rngog kun dga' rgyal maryā gyis mdzad pa'o/ /tshar grangs lta bur yi ngur mos na/ bhyo/ /sngon tshe dpag bsam byang chub shing gi drung / /rgyal ba thub pa chen po'i spyan snga mā /bstan pa gnyan po srung bar zhal bzhes pa'i/ /khrag 'thung dud sol lha mo'i thugs dam bskang / /mtha' bral chos kyi dbyings las ma g.yos kyang / /sna tshogs rdzu phrul mtha' yas sprul pa'i sku/ /ye shes mkha' 'gro'i gtso mo 'khor dang bcas/ /dgyes rgu'i mchod sprin rnams kyis thugs dam bskang / /dpal ldan lha mo rgyal ba kun gyi yum//

༄7/ /shes rab pha rol phyin ma'i ngo bo nyid/ /mchog dang thun mong dngos grub ster mdzad pa/ /dam tshig rdzas mchog rnams kyis thugs dam bskang / /nyer spyod 'dod yon sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga/ /rtag gtor rten gtor rgyun gtor sha rus khrag /bdud rtsi sman dang rakta'i rgya mtsho yis/ /'dod khams dbang phyug 'khor bcas thugs dam bskang / /sku gsung thugs dang yon tan phrin las dang / /phyi nang gsang rten spyi dang khyad par mchog /phyag rgya sngags bzlas ting 'dzin bye brag dang / /sbyor sgrol tshogs kyi 'khor los thugs dam bskang / /lha mo 'khor bcas thugs dam bskangs pa'i mthus/ /nyams chags 'gal 'khrul ci mchis byang ba dang / /'gal rkyen mi mthun gnod pa'i phyogs rnams zhi/ /yid la 'dod pa'i don kun thogs med 'grub/ /bshad sgrub

bstan pa phyogs bcur rgyas pa dang / /mchog thun dngos grub sgrub pa'i grogs mdzod cig /brgyad pa ༅gas pa ni/ hūm̐/ 'gro ba'i don tu sku mchog 'jigs pa ni/ /ma lus khyab par gsal bar mdzad pa yis/ /nga rgyal dregs pa can rnams 'joms mdzad pa/ /yon tan rdzogs pa'i sku la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'da' dka' rdo rje'i dam tshig gtan gyi gnyer/ /bsrung bar dam bcas sku yi dam tshig la/ /sku yi spyod pa tshul bzhin ma rtogs te/ /khams gsum khyab pa'i sku la bzod par gsol/ /rnal 'byor gdung sob bdag cag 'dir 'dus rnams/ /spyi dang khyad par dam tshig mi gtong yang / /klong du gyur pa'i goms shas rtsal chung ba/ /ma gcig lha mo'i sku la bzod par gsol/ /thugs rjes nges par gzigs pa'i lha mo la/ /dam rdzas gtsang ma'i mchod pa ma bshams te//

༄tsho/ /phongs sems dbang gis mchod pa'i rgyu chung ba/ /rdzong mo dka' zlog sku la bzod par gsol/ /ma gcig sku mdog phyag mtshan cha lugs la/ /don dang mthun par tshul bzhin ma bris te/ /'phags ma'i thugs rjes gsal bar gyur pa rnams/ /bdud las rgyal ba'i sku la bzod par gsol//bu yi tshul gyis rgyu yi dam tshig la/ /le lo gnyid dbang g.yeng brel gtam la sogs/ /thugs dang 'gal bar gyur pa ci mchis pa/ /thugs rje chen pos tshangs par stsal du gsol// ces dang / oṃ badzra re ma ti sa twa sa ma ya/ ma nu pā la ya/ badzra re ma ti sa twa twe no pa/ tiṣṭhadṛ ḍho me bha wa/ su tostso me bha wa/ su pokhyo me bha wa/ a nu rakto me bha wa/ sarba sirnyi mme pra yasmo sarba karma su tsa me/ tsitt+waṃ shri yeḥ ku ru hūm̐/ ha ha ha ha hoḥ bha ga wān/ sarba ta thā ga ta badzra re ma ti

mā me muñtsa re ma ti bha ba ma hā sa ma ya sa twa āḥ ces man ngag gi yi ge brgya pa brjod do/ /gsum pa rjes kyi bya ba la lnga/dang po bskul cing phrin las bcol ba ni/ rjerto/ sangs rgyas shākya thub pa'i spyan snga mā /khyod kyis deng nas 'khor ba ji srid bar/ /dkar po'i phyogs kyi nad dang sdug bsngal sogs/ /zhi bar bya phyir tshe dang bsod nams spel//nag po'i phyogs ni dgug cing dbang du sdud/ /smyo 'bog bsad pa la sogs las 'di dag /bstan pa bsrung phyir las 'di 'grub par mdzod/ /'di las 'gal na rgyal ba'i bka' bslus pas/ /dus gsum rgyal ba'i rdo rje'i mgo 'gems therdzog /de skad rgyal ba'i spyan sngar khas blangs shing / /dam bcas bzhin du phrin las grub par mdzod/ /rnal 'byor bdag dang bdag gi 'khor rnams la/ /zhal nas bdud rtsi'i char gyi rgyun phob la/ /nad sogs sdug bsngal

༄7/ /tshogs rnams zhi bar mdzod/ /tshe dang dbang thang longs spyod rgyas par mdzod/ /zang zing lo thog 'bru yi phung po dang / /rin chen rkang 'gro phyugs rnams 'phel bar mdzod/ /gzhan yang khyod la phrin las bcol ba ni/ /bla ma smod cing dkon mchog dbu 'phang smad/ /bdag gi dge ba'i bar chad byed pa'i dgra/ /bstan dang 'gro la 'tshe ba'i las ngan 'di/ /khyod kyi khong nas dug gi rlung bus la/ /'du ba rnam bzhi'i nad rnams khong nas slong //pags bzhi lhu rnams sa la rdeb tu chug /don snying rnam lnga'i khong khrag skyug tu chug /las ngan 'khor bcas brang chen brdung du chug /smre sngags cho nge gnam la 'bod du chug /'chi ba'i dus 'das smyo 'bogs bsad par mdzod/ /gcan gzan mkha' lding la sogs ltas ngan phob/ /bstan pa srung ba'i las rnams

grub par mdzod// gnyis pa 'dod pa'i don la gsol ba 'debs pa ni/ mkha' 'gro ma dud pa'i sol ba ma 'khor dang bcas pa khyed rnams kyis/ mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma kha dog dam pa dri dam pa ro dam pa dang ldan pa 'di gsol la/ rnal 'byor pa bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa'i nad kyi rigs su gyur pa/ rlung las gyur pa/ mkhris pa las gyur pa/ bad kan las gyur pa/ 'dus pa las gyur pa'i nad bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi po thams cad zhi zhing bzlog par gyur cig /gdon gyi rigs su gyur pa/ lha yi gdon/ klu'i gdon/ gnod sbyin gyi gdon la sogs pa/ gdon brgyad khri bzhi stong gi gnod pa thams cad zhi zhing bzlog par mdzod cig /chags che ba dang / rmi lam ngan pa dang / mtshan ma ngan pa dang / ltas ngan pa/ bkra mi shis pa thams cad zhi zhing bzlog par mdzod cig/

༄tsho/ /gzhan yang rnal 'byor pa bdag cag dang lus dang grib ma'i tshul bzhin du 'grogs par mdzod cig /sngon nas sus/ phyi nas skyol—/bsam pa thams cad 'khru/ba tu chug /bsam pa thams cad mthar phyin tu chug cig /gsum pa bsnyen sgrub sogs dmigs bsal la mchod bstod mdor bsdus tsam bya/ gtor chog tsam la mi dgos/ yig brgya brjod la/ gang yang bdag rmongs blo yis ni/ /ma tshang ba dang nyams pa dang / /khyod kyi dgongs pa ma grub pa/ /mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la ba11da par garbedul/ /ces nongs pa bshags/ bzhi pa gshegs bsdu ni/ badzra lā su rā ga ya mi hūm̐/ zhes dam tshig gi lha mo dang ye shes pa dbyer med par rten rdzas dang bris sku'i thugs kar bsdu ba'am/gtor ma de nyid gshegs pa yin na/ badzra the/ཿ zhes se gol lan gsum gtogs pas sgrub pa po khyod kyis ji ltar bsgo ba bzhin bya'o/ /zhes dgyes bzhin zhal gyis bzhes te 'khor dang bcas sho dir gyis dgyes par

bsam mo/ /gtor ma dpal 'bar btsugs la sa gtsang sar bskyal lo/ /lnga pa bsngo smon shis brjod ni/ sems can thaman da nad med cing / /sems can thams cad bde gyur cig/gang gi lam nas 'gro ba yi/ /sangs rgyas nyid dang 'phrad par rbestog /ma bsgral ba rnams bsgral ba dang / /ma grol ba rnams bdag gis grol/ /da lta nyid du rjes brtse ba'i/ /lam de nyid la gnas par ye ga /ces dang smon lam shis brjod spyi mthun rgyas bsdus 'tshams par brjod/ snying po'i bstan pa rgyas pa dang / /'jig rten rgud pa zhi 'dod rnams//gong ma'i gsung bzang legs bshad kyi/ /lang tshos spras 'di bsten par rigs/ /mchod sgrub phrin las rgyas pas bstan srung ches/ /ma yis bu bzhin gzigs pa mi g.yel bar/ /nag po'i rtsa lag mthu stobs phyir bsnyil nas/ /sgrub brgyud bstan pa'i dbu 'phang dgung snyegs shog /ces 'dod khams dbang phyug dud sol ma'i phrin las 'bring po 'di nyid bsnyen sgrub la'ang 'jug pa bde ba dang /rgyun gyi gtor chog la'ang rgyas bsdus mtshams

ra༅༅ par mthong zhing / sgrub brgyud bstan pa'i sgron me rje dpon bsam 'phel mchog gi sprul sku'i zhal snga nas gsung bskul gnang ba ltar/ karma ngag dbang yon tan rgya mtsho 'am blo gros mtha' yas pa'i— sdes shrī de bī ko ḍa'i sgrub gnas su bgyis pa dge legs 'phel// zhes pa 'di'ang wā ṇa badzra bisdi'i dpe mdzod khang du par du bsgrubs pa'o// maṅga lam̐// //
/bstan srung gtso mo dud sol ma'i gtor chog dbyar rnga'i sgra dbyangs zhes bya ba bzhugs so

༄༅/ /na mo gu ru be/ bde chen rdo rje btsun mo ni/ /'jigs byed gtum mor snang de la/ /btud nas rngog pa'i phyag bzhes bzhin/ /gtor chog mdor bsdus 'bri bar bya/ /de la rje nā ro pa dang mar rngog gi bka' srung brgya rtsa brgyad kyi gtso bo dud pa'i sol ba ma 'di ni bka' brgyud 'dzin pa rnams kyi thun mong ma yin pa'i chos skyong gi gtso bor bsten dgos la/ khyad par dgyes gsang sogs mar lugs kyi rgyud sde chen po rnams kyi dbang dang bsnyen sgrub bgyid

༄7/ /pa'i tshe ci nas kyang 'di nyid mchod pa la brtson par bya'o/ /de'ang chos skyong 'di nyid kyi rjes gnang thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa thob pa dag gis bsnyen sgrub bya ba'i tshul ni gzhan tu shes la/ gtor chog dkyus ma tsam gyi tshe/ thod pa mtshan ldan la sogs pa'i snod bzang por dpal bshos zur gsum khru gang ba me ri'i rgyan ldan gcig la mtheb kyu mang pos bskor/ ra nag bya nag gtso bor gyur pa'i sha khrag gi 'phan dar/ yungs kar gong bu la

sogs pas brgyan/ khur ba shing tog chang gi bye brag blugs la malji'i steng du bzhag /phyi mchod rnams dang / gser skyems/ rakta mdun du bsham/ bdag bskyed dgyes rdor mā yā gdan bzhi sogs sngon tu song nas/ yi dam gyi sgrub thabs ltar mchod pa byin gyis brlab ba ni/ skyed sarba saṃ therdo dha ni āḥhūm̐ swā hās bsangs/ skyed swa bhā wa shuddhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā ba 8)(྅ haṃ gis sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las a las thod pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du/ hūm̐ 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i bsang gtor/ mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/me tog /bdug spos/ snang gsal/ dri/ zhal zas/ rol mo la sogs pa'i mchod pa'i yo byad rnams rang bzhin stong pa/ byed las dbang po drug gi spyod yul du zag pa med pa'i bde ba skyed nus par gyur/ oṃ sarba saṃ sho dha ni āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥkhaṃ ram̐ āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ nī rī ti hūm̐ kha āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ badzra

༄༅/ /pursha āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ badzra dhu pe āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ badzra ā 31 ke āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ badzra gandhe āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ badzra ni widre āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ badzra shabha āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ rol mo bya zhing / oṃ badzra ghaṇḍa ra ṇi ta pra ra ṇi ta saṃ pra ra ṇi ta sarba buddha kṣe tra pra tsa li te pra dzñā pa ra mi tā nā da saṃ bha wa badzra dharmakhṛ da ya sarnyo ṣa ni hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hoḥ.āḥkhaṃ swā hā/ oṃ badzra a mṛ ta kuṇḍa lī ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ swa bhā wa shuddhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā ba shuddhi3 haṃ/ mdun tu skad cig gis lha mo dud sol ma bzhugs pa'i snying gar/ oṃ dkar po la gnas pa'i ra yig dmar po/ ra las me 'od 'phro bas/ sku lus skad cig gis bsregs/ oṃ de'i steng du baṃ yongs su gyur pa las bum pa dkar po bdud rtsis gang ba/ de las bdud rtsi lud de/ oṃ bkrus pas 'od zer dkar po rab tu 'bar bar gyur/ oṃ e ma hā kā li

de wī kā li bi grwanta tsaṇḍa rū pi ṇi hūm̐ phaṭa/ de nyid skad cig gis dpal ldan lha mo'i skur gyur pa ni/ sku mdog nag mo keng rus ltar skem pa'i lus can/zhal gcig phyag bzhi zhabs gnyis pa/ g.yas kyi dang po na ral gri/ gnyis pa na bhañdza dmar chen gyis bskyil ba/ g.yon gyi dang po na shasti/ gnyis pa na tri shā la dar dpyangs can 'dzin pa/ mi ro rengs pa khar bcug nas mche ba gtsigs shing spyan gsum dmar ba/ dbu skra ral pa dmar ser gyen brdzes lan bu g.yon tu 'khyil zhing sgrul dang thod phreng gis brgyan pa/ snyan g.yas na dril bu'i mgul rgyan can gyi sbrul dang / g.yon na seng ges brgyan pa/ me tog dang dar nag gi cod pan can/ lha ma yin gyi mgo bos do shal byas pa/ glang po che'i ko bas stod g.yogs shing / ba glang gi pags pa re lde ser po'i

rlo /stedā ༷ batram̐/sna ṭwāṃskyi hūm̐ ca ༵bye ༵py-i nā ༷ /༷ zlor tre sdo ༵ sdirnyi dzño jisna ༷snya jesngi sa/ rjo zlo ma/khagauṅgi khri shi ༵ ljadzhai ṭwāṃṭwāṃ dzo kāX/ ༷༷ sa ༷ ljags kya yashās mar ltar 'bar zlospyi nga' dzhaibyagāsacanaswārabazhapa'i/da'aṭwāṃbusasu hū/masdo' skar sa 'i shra ya dā bā kyā kyi la ma hā kā zhi bhyaḥ'is pas bkrir bar gyuX/thugasbya ka' dzños gcag chaṭwāṃ da spyi gar /ma/ba swā su rā ga yā mo/radā ga snyadī ga ༷swā 'ad ra 'aṭwāṃs pas/rang batshon gyas grub pa' dpal lha ma nag ma 'bum da/nga bcas pa ba sa mā ཿ dbyangs ral dang bcas ta/bhya / ra rab na pa' byang shar mams//g.yu ma mu

le gting gi dbus/ /rin chen lnga ldan gzhal yas khang / /de dbus srid gsum thod mkhar dbus/ /gru gsum 'bar ba'i klong dkyil nas/ /dpal ldan lha mo dud sol ma/ /sku mdog mthing nag 'jigs pa'i gzugs/ /zhal gcig phyag bzhi bong bu chibs/ /'khor yang ma mo 'bum sde'i tshogs/ /gnas 'di nyid du gshegs su gsol/ /da lta snyigs ma'i dus nyid du/ /dam can gshegs par mi 'os kyang / /sngon tshe byang chub shing drung du/ /thub pa chen po'i spyan snga mā /ji ltar khas blangs dam bcas ltar/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa bsrung ba dang / /'gro kun bde la 'god pa'i phyir/ /dpal ldan lha mo gshegs su gsol/ /gsang sngags srung ma dam tshig can/ /'khor bcas gshegs shing bzhugs su gsol/ /oṃ hūm̐ shri ya de bī kā li kā li ma hā kā li hūm̐ bhyo/ dṛ shya

༄༅/ /dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ sa ma ya st+waṃ/ sa ma ya hoḥ zhes pas gnyis su med par thim/'khor nag mo 'bum sde thams cad kyang gcer bu ral pa can/ g.yas mi snying dang / g.yon bandha skra can thogs pa'o/ /thams cad kyi thugs kar bhyo yig gis mtshan pa'o/ /dud pa'i sol ba ma khyod kyis sku myur du ston cig /sku mi ston na yang yid la gang 'dod pa thams cad 'grub par gyis shig /nang mchod gtor la/ 'di ni khyod kyi dmyal ba'i chu/ /dam tshig 'das na sreg par byed//dam tshig srung na dngos grub ni/ /rdo rje bdud rtsi'i chu 'dis 'grub/ /oṃ ha na ha na badzra sa ma ya ma ti kra ma n-i hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces dam la bzhag oṃ hūṃ shrī ya de wī kā li kā li ma hā kā li hūṃ bhyo/ badzra puspro pū dza me gha sa mu dra spa ra ṇa sa ma ye hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ hūṃ shrī ya de wī kā li kā li ma hā kā li hūṃ bhyo/ badzra dhū pe pū dza me gha sa mu dra spa

ra ṇa sa ma ye hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ hūṃ shrī ya de wī kā li kā li ma hā kā li hūṃ bhyo/ badzra gandhe pū dza me gha sa mu dra spa ra ṇa sa ma ye hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ hūṃ shrī ya de wī kā li kā li ma hā kā li hūṃ bhyo/ badzra ni wi du pū dza me gha sa mu dra spa ra ṇa sa ma ye hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ hūṃ shrī ya de wī kā li kā li ma hā kā li hūṃ bhyo/ badzra ā lo ke pū dza me gha sa mu dra spa ra ṇa sa ma ye hūm̐ phaṭa/ gtor ma'i nang du ha ser po/ hoḥdakar po/ hrīḥsngon po/ de rnams kyi 'od kyis kha dog dri ro ngan pa bcom ste bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ ha ho hrīḥswā hā/ lan gsum brjod/ oṃ hūṃ shrī ya de wī kā li kā li ma hā kā li hūṃ bhyo/ mthar/ oṃ ma hā me sa khā hi/ ma hā go ro tsa na khā hi/ mahā ba su ta khā hi/ 6) rda ba shā/ ༷|hā grihā pā ya hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes lan bdun gyis phul bas 'khor dang bcas pas gsol bar bsam/ bar 'dir bstod pa til mar ma dang / gzhan yang bstod pa'i bye brag ci shes

༄/'i da/kyisardzustod pa tshi la/drosdu na/ hūm̐snro/dpal rnyin lha ༷ sngi pham byed gaspyas dag/zlong sprond+ra ༷sgrub phyir rnam thar la gzhol sar //snying gon py-ibadā gag sas la sdob pa ya//shas rab sna gzi dag gas 'gra dan sprad//lha phyagasache gzhashes rja' pha brarda rtag ṇḍa gnas//khams gsuṭā skad sdug mgyardzu skar babye byad/'i/gzhakyi lasngang sgyur ༷dakhams ya ṭwāṃthar༈ra/ོ/dbang phyug na pa' sku la dgyas 'khraswā mari/'i/lha dgāng brgya byān lha man dkāng rngi dang /ོ/'ings pa' rgyal ṭā sa 'ag dbang rngi dāng/she/rgaṭwāṃn bzha la sagaswā pas phyag byasag sa//bdudādangagashan sdi' rgyaṭwāṃ pa 'dar zhang 'dud//man ma nag ma shan tu gtum pa' gzugs//ma ma sran ma' gas rnams 'dar zhang dngangs//phyags bcu' dug bsdus nya ma mas par mdzad//nad

rnams slong byed nad bdag dam la 'du/ /bdud rtsi'i bcud bsdus zla bar thim mdzad ma/ /nad yams gcod mdzad sman mo dam la 'du/ /gang zhig khyod la dad na ma bas byams/ /lha mo khyod la bdag gis rtag tu bstod/ /bstan pa bsrung ba'i las 'di myur du sgrubs/ /rakta dang chang gtor ma la gtor zhing / oṃ ro ru ro ru bi tiṣṭha/ ba to sī/ ka ma la rākṣa sī hūṃ bhyoḥ dgra bgegs mā ra ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces brjod/ lha mo'i thugs ka'i sngags phreng la dmigs te/ oṃ hūṃ shrī ya de wī kā li kā li ma hā kā li hūṃ dherto/ ci 'grub bzla/ lag pa khu chur mdzub mo gnyis bsgreng ste kha 'gram g.yas g.yon tu bzhag la/ skyes rjeXḥbatta li batta li tshe/ lan gsum gyis gtor ma la bdud rtsi'i kha phrus btab/ dherto/dur khrod bdag mo dngos grub zhal/ /gtum mo gtsigs byed yi dwags kha/ /dam tshig srung ma khrag dga' ma/ /gī li'i sgra sgrogs sbyor zin ma/ /dur khrod

༄7/ /ro yi tshogs dbus su/ /tshogs dang pho nya bcas pa sa /gtsigs byed gtum mo dud sol ma/ /gsol zhig bzhes shig dam tshig lha// gnas su gnas par mdzad du gsol/ /bdag gi sems la ci 'dod pa/ /de ni khyod kyis grub par gyis/ /bdag gis las ni/ ci byed kyang / /de la kun gyis grogs gyis shig /lha mo nag mo mthu mo che/ /'phags ma khyod la bdag bstod do/ /bstan la gnod pa'i gdug pa kun/ /myur du sgrol ba'i phrin las mdzod/ /nyin dang mtshan tu bya ra gyis/ /bcol ba'i phrin las grub par mdzod/ /kṛṇḍa kṛhā sarba duṣṭi bhakṣa bhakṣa/ phre sum̐ phri phroṃ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes brjod la se gol gdab/ mkha' 'gro ma dud pa'i sol ba ma/ 'khor nag mo 'bum sde dang bcas pa khyed rnams kyis mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma kha dog dri ro reg bya dam pa dang

ldan pa 'di gsol la rnal 'byor pa bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa'i nad rigs bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi/ gdon rigs stong phrag brgyad cu/ rmi ltas mtshan ngan chag che nyam nga bkra mi shis pa thams cad zhi zhing bzlog par mdzad du gsol/ /bdag gi lus dang grib ma'i tshul du 'grogs la bsam pa'i don thams cad yid bzhin tu 'grub par mdzod cig /bka' bzhin bgyi 'o zhes zhal gyis bzhes par bsam/ 7/ skabs 'dir spro na/skyed āḥhūm̐/ bhandha rin chen 'bar ba'i 11da yangs par//mthun rdzas sman raka gtor ma'i bye brag dang / /bsten dang sgrub dang mchod pa'i nyer spyod kun/ /mkha' dbyings gang ba dgyes bskyed rang bzhin gyur/ /oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha ho hrīḥ pū dza badzra spa ra ṇa khaṃ/ zhes byin gyis brlabs nas/ chags med zhabs kyis mjad pa'i lha mo'i bskang ba ni/ bhyo/ byang shar chos dbyings pho brang dam pa 'dir/ /rgyal

༄7/ /ba'i bskyed yum lha mo dud sol ma/ /yams nad zhi mdzad bkra shis sha wa ri/ /bdud rtsi sman gyi rgyal mo'i thugs dam bskang / /dbang phyug sras mo dkar mo dung skyong ma/ /mgon po'i lcam gcig dpal ldan rang byung ma/ /srid pa'i rgyal mo srid pa gsum gyi bdag /sa brgyad sems ma chen mo'i thugs dam bskang / /gsang sngags srung ma sngags srung ral gcig ma/ /dpag bsam shing gi bdag mo 'od zer can/ /sa rgyan gnas kyi gtso mo phag zhal can/ /dkyil 'khor kun gyi gtso mo'i thugs dam bskang / /mi mngon dbyings na ngo bo gcig nyid de/ /ngo bo gcig las sprul pa stong phrag 'gyed//sprul pa re la phyag brnyan 'bum phrag re/ /khams gsum kun khyab lha mo'i thugs dam bskang / /ngo bo gcig/ la rnam pa dpon g.yog tshul/ /bdud kyi bu mo

nag mo re ma ti/ /sprul pa re ti mched bzhi g.yog 'khor 'bum/ /ma gcig lha mo dpon g.yog thugs dam bskang / /lha klu gnod sbyin dri za nam mkha' lding / /mi'am ci dang grul bum bram ze mi/ /kun gyis bstod cing phyag byas mnga' gsol ba/ /srid gsum 'gran bral lha mo'i thugs dam bskang //dbyings kyi khro rgyal rnam par snang mdzad de/ /'gro ba'i don du sa brgyad sems mar sprul/ /'jigs pa'i skur ston gdug pa kun 'dul ma/ /rab 'jigs khrag 'thung rgyal mo'i thugs dam bskang / /ming brgya mtshan stong rnam 'phrul bsam mi khyab/ /rdzu 'phrul dpag med mthu rtsal thogs pa med/ /dam tshig rjes gcod rnal 'byor drod tshad nyul/ /dam ldan lha mo dpon g.yog thugs dam bskang / /dkar ser dmar ljang zhi dang zhi ma khro/ /sna tshogs sku dang de

༄tsho/ /bzhin sna tshogs sngags/ /sna tshogs phrin las dngos grub kun 'byung ba'i/ /yid bzhin nor mchog lha mo'i thugs dam bskang / /phyi yi gnas yul nang gi rtsa rlung khams/ /gsang ba rang gi sems dang dbyer med cing / /'khor 'das kun la khyab cing dbang bsgyur pa'i/ /kun khyab kun bzang lha mo'i thugs dam bskang / /'dod pa'i khams na 'dod chags las gyur pa'i/ /snang srid ma mo mkha' 'gro ci mchis pa/ /thams cad khyod kyi 'khor g.yog pho nya ste/ /mo rgyud ma mo yongs kyi thugs dam bskang / /bdag cag dpon slob 'khor dang bcas pa yi/ /nyams chag 'gal 'khrul rtog sgrib ci mchis pa/ /lha mo dpon g.yog 'khor dang bcas la bshags/ /mi sgrib tshangs pa'i dngos grub stsal nas kyang / /yams nad rims nad zhi ba'i phrin las

mdzod/ /ces dang /ma more 'grugs skong ni/ bhyo/ lnga brgya dus kyi tha ma la/ /gsang sngags bon du gyer pa'i tshe/ /pha zer bu yis mi nyan dus/ /dus ngan nye ba 'thab pa dang / /gos ngan re thul gyon pa dang / /zas ngan lci ba za ba dang / /sde 'khrugs nang dme byed pa'i dus/ /ma mo nag mo thugs khros nas/ /bud med sna tshogs stong khams gang / /mi nad phyugs nad sna tshogs gtong / /mkha' la nad sprin sna tshogs 'khrigs/ /dus kyi 'khrugs pa slong byed ma/ /mtshon gyi bskal pas 'jig byed ma/ /glo bur mi la lhog rgod 'bebs/ /thog ser 'bebs pa'i snying mo che/ /sa bdag klu gnyan khyod kyi 'bangs/ /lha srin sde brgyad khyod kyi 'khor/ /khyod kyis mi 'dul gang yang med/ /nad kyang ma mo khyod kyi nad/ /rims kyang ma mo khyod kyi rims/ /khrag kyang ma mo khyod kyi khrag /spyi

༄7/ /bdud nad kyi kha lo sgyur/ /bskang ngo khyod kyi thugs dam bskang / /dam rdzas bdud rtsi gtor ma dang / /bsten rdzas skong rdzas sgrub rdzas kyis/ /'khrugs pa'i ma mo'i thugs dam bskang / /thugs dam bskang ngo sa ma ya/ /thugs dam bskang ba'i byin rlabs kyis/ /rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas kyi/ /nad kha chod la rims kha sgyur/ /khram kha phyis la shwa rdel spos/ /nad gdon bar chad bsgyur du gsol/ /mo ngan mtsher rtsub bsgyur du gsol//pho bdud dal kha g.yas su bsgyur/ /mo bdud dal kha g.yon du sgyur/ /spyi bdud dal kha mkha' la bsgyur/ /bzlog bsgyur chen po'i dus la babs/ /dus la babs po sa ma ya/ /bcol ba'i phrin las sgrub par mdzod/ /thog med dus nas ma rig dbang gyur pas/ /mi shes sgrib pa le lo'i dbang gis ni//

thams cad mkhyen pa'i lam las 'gal ba rnams/ /sprul pa mkha' 'gro'i tshogs kyis bzod par mdzod/ /skyed badzra re ma ti sa twa sa ma ya/ ma nu pā la ya/badzra re ma ti sa twa twe no pa/ tiṣṭhadṛ ḍho me bha wa/ su tostso me bha wa/ su postso me bha wa/ a nu rakto me bha wa/ sarba sirnyi mme pra yasmo sarba karma su tsa me/ tsitt+waṃ shri yeḥku ru hūm̐/ ha ha ha ha hoḥ bha ga wān/ sarba ta thā ga ta badzra re ma ti mā me muñtsa re ma ti bha ba ma hā sa ma ya sa twa āḥ ces man ngag gi yig brgya dang / lag g.yas mdzub mo srin lag gnyis mthil du bkug /mthe bong gung mo mthe'u chung gsum bsgreng ba phyar ba tri shul la'i phyag rgyas/ hūm̐ phaṭaḥ mahā de bī kā li duṣṭa na ta ka ha na da ha 〈co 'u/ bhanta pa tsa pa ra na hūm̐ phaṭa/ces mtshan ngan ldog go /lag gnyis sor mo bcu bsdus nas khog pa zlum po bdud rtsi bum pa'i phyag rgyas/ skyes badzra bhā ki nī de wī ma hā kā lī re ma ti/ kā ya wā ka tsitta sid dhi sa mā ya pha la

༄༅/ /a we sha ya āḥ thal mo sbyar te/ oṃ ye shes lha dang lha mo mi pham bdag /dang po bsgrub dang sgrub tu byas nas ni/ /mthun pa'i dam rdzas gzhung bzhin ma tshogs pa/ /dpal ldan lha mo'i thugs dang 'gal gyur pa/ /bka' yi chad pa'i gnas su gyur nas kyang / /dam nyams khrims ral gcig tu gyur lags na/ /ye shes thugs rje can la bzod par gsol/ /thugs dang 'gal bar gyur pa mthol lo bshags/ /dam tshig nyams par gyur pa bskang gyur cig /ces dang / yig brgya brjod la nongs pa bshags/ badzra lā stsa rā ga yā mi hūm̐/ zhes pas gtor ma'i lha dam ye dbyer med bris sku sogs rten gyi thugs kar bsdu/ badzra the/ཿsa 'khor rnams gshegs shing gtor ma gtsang sar bskyel/ bsngo smon dang bkra shis bya'o/ /chos skyong tshogs rjes nyes byed cing / /rdo rje slob dpon zhal gyi rgyan/ /gtor chog bris pas dge thob pas/ /bstan pa'i dbu 'phang dgung snyegs shog/

ces pa'ang mar lugs sgrub dkyil rnams kyi zur 'degs su/ rngog zhe sdang rdo rje yab sras kyi gsung rgyun zhabrul med gsang bdag tā ra nā thas khyer bder bsdus pa nyid sor bzhag la/ sbyor dngos mjug tshad gyi kha gsal phran bus brgyan te blo gros mtha' yas kyis gdan sa chen po dpal spungs yang dben tu bris pa sgrub brgyud bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan srid rtser bsgreng ba'i srog shing du gyur cig/ zhes pa 'di'ang wā ṇa badzra bisdi'i dpe mdzod khang du par du bsgrubs pa'o// maṅga lo//
/bcom ldan 'das dgyes pa rdo rje'i las bzhi'i sbyin sreg phrin las 'od 'bar zhes bya ba bzhutpā

ra༅༅/ /bcom ldan 'das dgyes pa rdo rje'i las bzhi'i sbyin sreg phrin las 'od 'bar zhes bya ba/ bla ma dang dpal dgyes pa rdo rje la phyag 'tshal lo//phung rtems dri ma kun za ye shes kyi/ /me phung dbus na dpyid thig bsreg blug rol/ /dga' bzhi'i mthar son las bzhi'i gar mdzad pa/ /mar ston he ru ka dpal la phyag 'tshal/ /phyi nang bsreg bya lha zhal me yi lcer/ /stobs pas las dang dngos grub thogs med du/ /'grub 'gyur gnad shes 'jug pa'i lam

༄tsho/ /bzang ni/ /rgyud don man ngag bsdebs te 'chad pa yin/ /dpal dgyes pa rdo rje'i bsnyen pa sngon du song ba'i rnal 'byor pas lhag chad kha skong ngam/ rab gnas sgrub mchod sogs sngags kyi nus pa 'byin pa'i ched du sbyin sreg bya ba ni/ dpal brtag pa gnyis pa las/ ci gsung sbyin sreg byas nas ni/ /dkyil 'khor dam pa bzhengs pa dang / /zhes sogs dang / rdo rje gur gyi rgyud don grub chen mtsho skyes sogs kyis bkral ba mar rngog gi man ngag

gis brgyan pa'i gzhung lag len tu bstar ba la don gnyis te/ dngos dang 'phros don no/ /dang po ni/ spyir rgyud sde rnams nas dgug pa dang / rmongs rengs sogs las kyi bye brag sgrub pa'i sbyin sreg gi dbye sgo mang du gsungs pa rnams/ ye shes thig le dang rdo rje mkha' 'gror rtsa ba'i dbye gzhi phrin las bzhir bsdus te bstan pa'i rjes su da lta'i phyag len mkhan rnams 'brangs pa ltar 'chad pa ste/ de la bzhi/ zhi ba/ rgyas pa/ dbang /mngon spyod do/ /dang po la gsum/ sbyor ba/ dngos gzhi/ rjes kyi rim pa'o/ /dang po la gsum/ sa'i cho ga /bcas dang yo byad/ cho ga'i sngon 'gro'o/ /dang po ni/ sngar sbyin sreg ma byas pa sogs sa gzhi ma dul ba yin na dkyil chog nas 'byung ba ltar sa'i cho ga rgyas pa'am/ sdom 'byung gi dgongs pa ltar sa bdag la gtor ma sgyin cing / rtsa ba'i sngags brjod de stong nyid du sbyangs pa tsam bya'o/ /gnyis pa bcas dang yo byad la gsum/ thab dang 'brel ba/ rdzas dang 'brel ba/ sgrub pa po dang 'brel ba'o/ /dang po ni/ 'di nyid kyi rgyud dgongs 'grel dang bcas pa las bru thab dang bri thab gnyis gsal bar bstan cing / gshed dmar rgyud le'u bcu dgu pa nas

༄༅/ /brtsigs thab gsungs pas lugs srol gsum las da lta phal cher gyi lag len bde ba'i dbang gis bri thab kho na mdzad pa ltar na/ stegs bu 'thas par gcag cing tsandan dkar po sogs kyis byugs pa'i steng du thig chen brgyad btab/ dbus nas mtho gang tshad kyis zlum por bskor ba thab kyi dngos gzhi dang / de'i phyi rol sor bzhi bskor ba mchu/ de rgyab sor bzhi kha khyer/ de dang zur thig 'dzom pa'i sa nas sor bzhi'i mtshan ma btab pa rtse sbrel bstegs bu/ de'i phyi rol du'ang sor bzhi pa'i gru bzhi mdzad pa bsgom don stegs bu'i dpangs dang bri char mig sngar mdzes pa'i don tu bzhed/ thabs kyi dbus su 'khor lo sor brgyad pa'i lte bar rdo rje/shar du 'khor lo/lhor rin chen/nub tu padma/byang du rarka4 gri rnams sor gcig pas mtshan pa/kha khyer nang ngos rdo rje'i phreng ba dang /phyi ngos pad phreng mtshon byed/stegs bu'i grwa bzhir rdo rje rtse gsum pa re re ste/gzhi thams cad dkar po la bcad tshon dmar skya kho nas bri/ 'o ma can gyi shing gi rtse mo'i cha las byung ba'am srog chags med pa'i ba lang gi lci ba skam pos thab kyi nang zlum por brtsig cing shar lhor me tshang bzhag /thab

dang sgrub pa po'i bar du gdan bzhi las gsungs pa ltar me yol 'jim pa so phag sogs las byas pa'i gangs ri'i gzugs dkar po rgyar mtheb sor bcu gnyis/dpangs su sked par sleb pa zhig bzhag la dngos gzhi'i tshe ri bo gangs can bdag nyid kyi tsha gdung sel ba'i nus pa dang ldan par bsam pa'am/ gal te ma 'grub na me lha spyan drangs pa'i rjes sgrub pa po la 'tshe ba'i phyi 'brang gi 'byung po las thams cad pa'i sngags sogs kyis bskrad dgos par gsungs/ spor byed me rgyun bzhag dang / dgon pa'i me'am/ 'o ma can gyi shing dang gtsubs shing las byung ba snod du 'du bya zhing 'bru gsum gyis bsrungs la bzhag go/ /gnyis pa rdzas dang 'brel ba ni/stegs bu dkar po gnyis sgrub pa po'i g.yas g.yon tu bzhag pa'i g.yas su dngul shel dung sogs dkar zhing zlum pa'i snod du 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i zlum gtor dkar po gnyis/ me tog /bdug spos/dri chab/ zhal zas/ mar me ste mchod rdzas rnams dang / 'o ma can gyi shing gi rtse mo'i cha las byung ba'i yam shing sor bcu gnyis pa'i rtse gnyis sbrang 'o ma mar khus nyugs pa/ mar dkar khu ba/ til nag/ 'bras ma grugs pa/

༄7/ /zas mchog ste zho bag phye bu ram gsum bsres pa'i ril bu/ 'bras so ba/ nas/ mon sran grelā gro/ dūrba dang ku sha ma nyams pa/ 'o ma can gyi shing lngar mos pa'i yam shing tsho lnga/ khyad par rdzas shing tog/bdud rtsi lnga/ gos zung / grangs 'dzin tis/ bsangs chu bcas rim par bzhag /g.yon du chu gsum/ mdun tu bzed zhal/ nang mchod/ rdor dril bar du dgangs glugs kha sbyar ba bcas bzhag /so sor phral na bar chad kyi chos yin gsungs/ thams cad kyang dngos sam mos pas brtags te kha dog dkar po 'ba' zhig pa'o/ /gsum pa sgrub pa po dang 'brel ba ni/ sgrub pa po dar ras dkar po'i gos dang shel dkar sogs kyi rgyan gyis spras la srod dam dgongs ka'i dus su zhi ba'i bsam pas kha shar du phyogs te 'jam pa'i stan la padma'i skyil krung gis 'khod cing phrin las la 'jug /de'ang don dam par phyogs med pas gnas skabs rten 'brel dbang gis phyogs su rtog pas bzhag pa ste/ dkyil 'khor dang 'brel na de'i shar du thab bca' zhing / sgrub pa po dkyil 'khor gyi shar la kha phyogs te thab dang zhal sprod bya ba dang / dus gzhan tu 'byung ba'i shar la kha phyogs

pa'i mdun tu thab kyi kha tshur bstan tu bya dgos so/ /gsum pa cho ga'i sngon 'gro ni/ rje mar rngog yab sras kyi phyag bzhes te sgrub mchod dang 'brel na bdag mdun bum sgrub bdag nyid 'jug pa zin pa'i rjes su khrus dang bgegs sbyang nas sbyin sreg la 'jug /sbyin sreg grub rjes tshogs 'khor man chad mthar dbyung ba yin la/ 'di nyid sger du bya ba'i tshe/ bdag nyid las kyi he 'ukyi ka sogs nang mchod byin gyis brlab cing myang ba nas rdor sems bsgom bzlas yan grub pa dang / rnam rgyal dang las bum bsgrub 'od zhu sogs zin nas rnam rgyal bum pa'i chus dkyil 'khor ram/ ras bris la khrus gsol spyi mthun byas pa'i chu des sgrub pa po rnams la las sngags bzlas te khrus bya zhing / gnas khang dang yo byad la'ang bsangs gtor bya/ de nas yungs kar dang bsres pa'i zan gyi changs bus/ las sngags/ skyes band+ragu 65 mṛ ta ṭa/ṇḍa lī ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭa/ces bzlas te rang dang grogs la bskor/ lus ngag yid kyi nyes pa thams cad bsdus te changs bu la thim par mos/ gyo mo la sogs pa'i snod du brgyag te rol mo'i sgra dang bcas phyi rol du dor

ra༅༅ ro/ ༈ /gnyis pa dngos gzhi la gsum/ lha'i rnal 'byor bsgom pa/ 'jig rten pa'i me lha mchod pa/ dkyil 'khor pa mchod pa'o/ /dang ngo ni/ sgrub mchod sngon tu song na skabs 'dir mi dgos kyang / gzhan tu bla ma dag pa nas brtsam/rdo rje padma byin gyis brlab pa'i bar gyis chog pa'i skabs kyang yod mod kyi/ dkyus su bzlas pa/ dag dran/ bsdu rim gyi bar du btang la rang nyid gtso bo yab yum gyi nga rgyal gyis gnas par bya'o/ /gnyis pa 'jig rten pa'i me lha mchod pa ni/ las bum gyi chu bsres pa'i bsangs chu ku shas 'thor la/ skyes sarba saṃ theg dha ni āḥhūm̐ swā hākhi bsangs/ skyes swa bhā wa sdo/tnaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā ba shuddhi3 haṃ gis sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las/ a las thod pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du/ hūm̐ 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i bsang gtor/ mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me tog /bdug spos/ snang gsal/ dri/ zhal zas/ rol mo la sogs pa'i mchod pa'i yo byad rnams rang

bzhin stong pa/ byed las dbang po drug gi spyod yul du zag pa med pa'i bde ba skyed nus par gyur/ oṃ sarba saṃ sho dha ni āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥkhaṃ ram̐ āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ ni rī ti hūm̐ kha āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ badzra puṣṭi āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ badzra dhu pe āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ badzra ā lo ke āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ badzra gandhe āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ badzra ni wibye āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ badzra shabha āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ rol mo bya zhing / oṃ badzra ghaṇḍa ra ṇi ta pra ra ṇi ta saṃ pra ra ṇi ta sarba buddha kṣe tra pra tsa li te pra dzñā pa ra mi tā nā da saṃ bha wa badzra dharmalha da ya sarnyo ṣa ni hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hoḥ.āḥkhaṃ swā hā/ zhes sgrub thabs ltar mchod pa byin rlabs bya/ bsreg rdzas rnams bsangs sbyang /bdud rtsi ltar byin gyis brlab pa ni/skyes badzra a skṛ ta kuṇḍa lī ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭa ces bsangs/ oṃ swa bhā wa shuddhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā ba shuzlo3 haṃ gis sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las yam̐ las rlung / ram̐ las me/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ las thod

༄༅/ /pa'i sgyed bu gsum gyi steng du/ a las thod pa yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du/ hūm̐ sum̐ e dzī khaṃ/ māṃ māṃ māṃ tt+waṃ māṃ las skyes pa'i bdud rtsi lnga dang /sha lngar gyur/ ha hoḥhrīḥ zhes brjod pas/ tha mal pa'i kha dog dang dri dang nus pa phrogs shing / rlung g.yos/ me sbar/ bcud rnams bskol bas/ nyi ma 'char kha lta bu'i mdog can gyi rlangs pa hūṃ las rdo rje kha ṭwāṃ ga 'bar bar gyur pa zhu zhing / de nyid du lan gsum lhung bas dri ma thams cad dang bral ba shel ltar gsal ba'i dam tshig gi bdud rtsis gang ba'i steng du/ oṃ las byung ba'i zla ba kha chod kyi tshul du gnas pa la g.yas skor du ā li g.yon skor du kā li yongs su gyur pa'i oṃ āḥhūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros/ phyogs bcur bzhugs pa'i rdo rje 'dzin pa thams cad kyi thugs ka nas/ ye shes kyi bdud rtsi

bkug /zla ba yi ge gsum dang bcas pa zhu bas ngo bo ye shes kyi bdud rtsi rnam pa bsreg rdzas so sor gyur/dgang blugs kha sbyar bas reg la/ skyed swā hā/ rdzas bkru ba'i sngags so// skye( āḥswā hā/ yam shing dang / skyed shri swā hā/ zhun mar dang / skyes dro swā hā/ 'bru dang / skyes ku 2kyi ku 〈co swā hā/ rdzas lhag ma sbyar ba'i sngags te de rnams lan gsum gsum brjod/ dam pa kha cig gis/ rang gi lag pa gnyis kyi nang du a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ hūm̐ las rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa lte bar hūṃ gis mtshan pa/ de las 'od 'phros nas rdzas rnams la phog pas/ rdzas rnams kyi skyon thams cad dag nas dngas shing thogs pa med pa las bsgrub pa'i nus pa dang ldan par bsams/ lag pa gnyis rdo rje khu tshur las gung mo gnyis gshib la brkyangs te/ oṃ shrī swā hā/ zhes sogs kyis bsreg rdzas sbyang zhes bshad/ me thab bsangs sbyang / skye( badzra a skṛ ta kuṇḍa lī ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭa/ skye( swa bhā wa 85)ཿsarba

༄7/ /dharmāḥswa bhā ba shuddhi3 haṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las/ padma dang nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ hūm̐ dang i las bcom ldan 'das dgyes pa rdo rje sku mdog nag po/ zhal brgyad pa/ phyag bcu drug pa/ zhabs bzhi pa/ rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan cing yum bdag med ma dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ yab yum snyoms par zhugs/ 'od du zhu ba las zhi ba'i thab khung zlum po dkar po yangs shing rgya che la mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs par gyur/ me g.yas bskor gyis spar zhing / oṃ dzwa la dzwa la hūm̐/ zhes brjod/ rlung g.yab g.yob la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes brjod/ skyed de wa pi tsu badzra hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ badzra a skṛ ta kuṇḍa lī ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces snying po'i sngags dang las sngags kyis mar khu dgang blugs gsum mam bdun 'bul/ ku sha'i chun po ma grugs pa/shin tu ring ba ma yin pa zung du byas pa dag rim pas blangs te/ skyed ṭa/ ro/ 'di

ni gtsang zhing dge/ /tshangs pa lha rnams dag byed yin/ /dkon mchog gsum po mnyes byed pa/ /sa las skyes 'di 'dab ma'i snying / /bdag gi bgegs rnams thams cad ni/ /zhi dang bkra shis mdzad du garbershal/ /swā hā/ zhes dang / tso( badzra sa twa āḥ zhes chun po gcig thab kyi steng du bzhag pa me lha'i gdan tu bsam mo/ /chun po gzhan dag ni thab kyi g.yas rang gi g.yon nas g.yas bskor du rtse mo shar dang / lho dang /nub dang / byang du lta ba snga ma'i rtse dang / phyi ma'i rting ba sprod pa'i tshul gyis stegs bu g.yogs/ me lha bskyed pa ni/ thab kyi dbus su/ padma dang nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ hūm̐ dang oṃ las rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa dang / gri gug oṃ gyis mtshan pa yongs su gyur pa las/ bcom ldan 'das dgyes pa rdo rje sku mdog nag po/ zhal brgyad pa/ phyag bcu drug pa/ zhabs bzhi pa/ rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan cing yum bdag med ma dang mnyam

༄7/ /par sbyor ba/ yab yum snyoms par zhugs/ 'od du zhu ba las/ ram̐ dang dzaḥlas me lha sku mdog dmar po/ zhal bzhi dang ldan pa'i rtsa zhal dmar po/ g.yas zhal nag po/ rgyab zhal ser po/ g.yon zhal dkar ba'i zhal re re la/ spyan gsum gsum dang ldan pa/ ral pa'i thor tshugs chen po 'chang ba/ lto ba 'phyang zhing / me'i dkyil 'khor gru gsum gyi steng du padma dang nyi ma'i gdan la bzhugs pa/ 'od zer 'bar bas brgyan pa/ phyag bzhi'i g.yas dang pos mchog sbyin/ gnyis pas bgrang phreng / g.yon dang pos ril ba spyi blugs/ gnyis pas dbyug gu 'dzin pa/ rang snang gi rig ma la 'khyud cing / drang srong gi tshogs kyis bskor bar gyur/ lag pa g.yas pa'i thal mo brkyang pa'i mthe bong g.yab bcing / oṃ/ gzi brjid chen po me yi lha/ /'dod pa thams cad rab

sgrub pa/ /snying rjes thams cad don grub mdzad/ /'dir ni nye bar mdzad du gsol/ /oṃ e hye hi/ ma hā bhā ta de wa ṛ ṣi di dza satta ma kṛ hi tā ā hū ti ma hā asmin sanni hi she1 bha we/ zhes ye shes kyi me lha mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs pa la/ hūm̐ brjod cing bsang gtor gyi chus bgegs bskrad rnos/ skye( badzra purmye āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ skyed badzra dhu pe āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ badzra gandhe āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ badzra ni widre āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ badzra ā lo ke āḥhūṃ swā hā/ zhes nyer spyod lngas mchod do// go rī dzaḥ tso rī hūm̐/ bee tā lī baṃ/ ghasma rī hoḥzhes dgug gzhug bcing mnyes byas te/ lag pa g.yas rdo rje dang bcas pa'i mthe bong gis mthe'u chung mnan zhing / sor mo gzhan gsum bsgreng ba'i rtse gsum gyi phyag rgya bstan la/ skyes baṇḍardo 65 na 95 ma hā dhwa ta dzwa la ya sarba bhasgru ku 2kyi sarba duṣṭṛ hūm̐ phaṭa/ dṛ shu dzaḥhūṃ bam̐ thertoḥ sa ma ya st+waṃ a haṃ/ zhes gur las gsungs pa'i sngags kyis dam la gzhag cing / lag pa gnyis khu tshur kha sbyar ba las/༄gung

༄tsho mo gnyis rtse sprad/mthe bong gshibs pa'i steng du mdzub mo gnyis bkug la bzhag pa rin po che'i phyag rgyas/ oṃ ratna a bhi ṣiñtsa st+waṃ/ zhes brjod de/ rin po che'i dbu rgyan gyis dbang bskur ba dang ldan par gyur/ de nas bsreg blugs 'bul ba ni/ oṃ sarba saṃ ye dha ni āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ zhes bsang gtor dang / oṃ pra wa ra satpā ram̐ pra twetstsha swā hā/ zhes mchod yon dang / skyed sarba pā paṃ da ha na badzrī ya badzra sa twa su sarba pā paṃ da ha swā hās zhabs bsil dbul te/ sngags phyi ma dag gur las byung ba'o/ /gzhan yang / skyes badzra sditu| āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ skyed badzra dhu pe āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ badzra gandhe āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ badzra ni widre āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ badzra ā lo ke āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ ces nyer spyod lnga dang / oṃ st+waṃ dhī zhes pa'i mthar/ i rda ba li ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ zhes btags pas gtor ma yang phul la/ glu glang ba sngon tu 'gro bas sgeg sogs brgyad kyis mchod pa ni/ sgeg mo'i lag pas sgeg mo ste/ /phreng bas phreng ba'i

mkha' 'gro ma/ /hūm̐ gi glu yis dam tshig glu/ /lag bskum pas ni gar nyid de/ /mchod pa 'di dag bla na med/ /sangs rgyas thams cad mnyes par byed//sangs rgyas rnams ni mchod pas mchod/ /'dod pa'i dngos grub byed par 'gyur/ /phyag rgya mthong brgyud ltar bya zhing / oṃ badzra sa twa su saṃ gra hā da/ oṃ badzra lā stsa hūm̐/oṃ badzra ratna mā nutta ram̐/ oṃ badzra mā le tt+waṃ/ oṃ badzra dharma gā ya ni/ oṃ badzra gī ti hrīḥ oṃ badzra karma ka roddhā be/ oṃ badzra skṛ tī āḥ me tog skyur ba'i tshul gyis dang //bdug pas bdug pa'i tshul gyis dang / /sdong bu mar me'i mchod pa dang / /byug pa'i tshul gyis rjes su dri/ /mchod pa 'di rnams bla na med/ /sangs rgyas thams cad mnyes par byed/ /sangs rgyas rnams ni mchod pas mchod/ /'dod pa'i dngos grub byed par 'gyur/ /oṃ badzra sa twa su saṃ gra hā da/ oṃ badzra dhū

༄7/ /pe hūm̐/ oṃ badzra ratna mā nutta ram̐/ oṃ badzra puspro trī/ oṃ badzra dharma gā ya ni/ oṃ badzra ā lo ke hrīḥ oṃ badzra karma ka roddhā be/ oṃ badzra gandhe āḥ 'jig rten dbang phyug tshangs dbang mgon gyi sras/ /me lha'i rgyal po ṭā kis dbang bskur ba/ /shes rab mchog gis nyon mongs ma lus bsreg /'dzin byed me lha nyid la rnam par 'dud/ /ces bstod/ dam bzhag gi sngags/ skyed badzra a na la ma hā bhā ta dzwa la ya sarba bhasnri ku ru sarba duṣṭṛ sni phaṭa/ mthar/ skyed bo dhi bṛkṣu ya swā hā/zhes btags pa'i sngags kyis yam shing zung du byas pa dag g.yas pa'i gung mtheb kyis bzung la gyen tu bskor nasaṃ mchog sbyin gyi tshul gyis nyi shu rtsa gcig sogs 'bul mthar/ bdag cag da21na tā(ba 'khor dang bcas pa'i nad gdon sdig sgrib bar du gcod pa thams cad shānti ku ru swā hā/ zhes spel tshig sbyar/ de bzhin tu lag pa g.yon byang chub mchog gi phyag rgya kha steng du bstan

pas dgang gzar mar khus gang ba dang / lag pa g.yas phyag rgya de nyid 'og tu phyogs pas blug gzar kha gyen bstan bzung la/ dgang dhra/garba/ () kha 05 rang gi lha'i sa bon yi ge gsum gyi bar du spel ba'am/ hūm̐ 'od zer dang bcas pa dang / me lha'i zhal du ram̐ gyis mtshan par gyur par bltas la dgang blugs kha sbyar te lag pa gnyis pus mo las phyir mi 'da' bar g.yon skor gyis/ skyetshe badzra a na la ma hā dhwa ta dzwa la ya sarba bhasmṛ ku ru sarba duṣṭṛ hūm̐ phaṭa/ mthar/ skyed asna ye hūm̐/ zhes btags pas mar khu 'bul zhing 'dod gsol ni/ bdag cag dpon he/ba 'ashesar dang bcas pa'i naid gdon sdig sgrib bar du gcod pa thams cad shānti ku ru swā hā/ de nas/ oṃ badzra a na la ma hā dhwa ta dzwa la ya sarba bharghaṃ ku ru sarba duṣṭṛ sni phaṭa/mthar/ oṃ sarba pā paṃ da ha na bahṝ ya badzra sa twa su sarba pā paṃ da ha swā hā/ til lo// bdag cag dpon slob 'khor ding bcas pa'i nad gdon sdig sgrib bar du

༄༅/ /gcod pa thams cad shānti ku ru swā hā/ oṃ badzra a na la ma hā bhā ta dzwa la ya sarba bhasnri ku ru sarba duṣṭṛ hūm̐ phaṭa/ mthar/ oṃ badzra pus ya swā hā/'bras ma chag pa'o// bdag cag dpon slob 'khor dang bcas pa'i nad gdon sdig sgribo bar du gcod pa thams cad shānti ku ru swā hā/ oṃ badzra a na la ma hā dhwa ta dzwa la ya sarba bhasmṛ ku ru sarba duṣṭṛ hūm̐ phaṭa/ mthar/ oṃ sarba saspa de swā hā/ zas mchog go/ bdag cag dpon slob 'khor dang bcas pa'i nad gdon sdig sgribee bar du gcod pa thams cad shānti ku ru swā hā/ oṃ badzra a na la ma hā dhwa ta dzwa la ya sarba bhallī ku ru sarba duṭwāṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ mthar/ oṃ badzra bī dzā ya swā hā/ 'bras so ba'o// bdag cag dpon slob 'khor dang bcas pa'i nad gdon sdig sgribaṃ bar du gcod pa thams cad shānti ku ru swā hā/ oṃ badzra a na la ma hā bhā ta dzwa la

ya sarba bhasnru ku ru sarba duṣṭṛ hūm̐ phaṭa/ mthar/ oṃ ma hā be ga ya swā hā/ nas so// bdag cag dpon slob 'khor dang bcas pa'i nad gdon sdig sgrib bar du gcod pa thams cad shānti ku ru swā hā/ oṃ badzra a na la ma hā bhā ta dzwa la ya sarba bhallī ku ru sarba duṣṭṛ hūm̐ phaṭa/ mthar/ oṃ ma hā ba lā ya swā hā/ mon sran gre'u 'o//bdag cag dpon slob 'khor dang bcas pa'i nad gdon sdig sgrob bar du gcod pa thams cad shānti ku ru swā hā/ oṃ badzra a na la ma hā dhwa ta dzwa la ya sarba bhallī ku ru sarba duṣṭṛ hūm̐ phaṭa/ mthar/ oṃ badzra ghasma ri swā hā/ grosno// bdag cag dpon slob 'khor dang bcas pa'i nad gdon sdig sgrib bar rdu gcod pa thams cad shānti ku ru swā hā/ oṃ badzra a na la ma hā bhū ta dzwa la ya sarba bhasnru ku ru sarba duṣṭṛ hūm̐ phaṭa/ mthar/ oṃ badzra ā yu ṣe swā hā/ dūrba'o// bdag cag dpon slob

༄༅/ /'khor dang bcas pa'i nad gdon sdig sgrib bar du gcod pa thams cad shānti ku ru swā hā/ oṃ badzra a na la ma hā dhwa ta dzwa la ya sarba bhasnru ku ru sarba duṣṭṛ hūm̐ phaṭa/ mthar/ oṃ badzra a pra ti ha ta badzrī ya swā hā/ ku sha'o// bdag cag dpon slob 'khor dang bcas pa'i nad godon sdig sgrib bar du gcod pa thams cad shānti ku ru swā hā/ oṃ badzra a na la ma hā bhā ta dzwa la ya sarba bhasnri ku ru sarba duṣṭṛ hūm̐ phaṭa/ mthar/ oṃ badzra yadzñā ya swā hā/ u dusba ra'o//bdag cag dpon slob 'khor dang bcas pa'i nad gdon sdig sgribee bar du gcod pa thams cad shānti ku ru swā hā/ oṃ badzra a na la ma hā bha ta dzwa la ya sarba bhasnru ku ru sarba duṣṭṛ sni phaṭa/ rme thar/ oṃ bo dhi bṛkṣu ya swā hā/ byang chub shing ngo // bdag cag dpon slob 'khor dang bcas pa'i nad gdon sdig sgrob bar du gcod

pa thams cad shānti ku ru swā hā/ skyed badzra a na la ma hā bha ta dzwa la ya sarba bhasmṛ ku ru sarba duṣṭṛ hūm̐ phaṭa/ mthar/ skyed badzra la tā ya swā hā/ blakṣa'o// bdag cag dpon slob 'khor dang bcas pa'i nad gdon sdig sgrib bgri du gcod pa thams cad shānti ku ru swā hā/ oṃ badzra a na la ma hā dhwa ta dzwa la ya sarba bhallī ku ru sarba duṣṭṛ hūm̐ phaṭa/ mthar/ oṃ badzra ku be rā ya swā hā/ n+ya gro dha'o// bdag cag dpon slob 'khor dang bcas pa'i nad gdono sdig sgrib bar du gcod pa thams cad shānti ku ru swā hā/ skyed badzra a na la ma hā bhā ta dzwa la ya sarba bhasmṛ ku ru sarba duṣṭṛ hūm̐ phaṭa/ mthar/ skyed sa hā ka rā ya swā hā/ a mra ste shing lnga po dngos su mi 'grir bas 'o ma can shing gang yang rung ba de dag tu mos nas 'bul/ bdage cag dpon slob 'khor dang bcas pa'i nad gdon sdig sgrib bar du gcod pa thams cad shānti ku ru

da༅༅/ /swā hā/ rdzas de rnams las 'bru la sogs pa ni blugs gzar gyis dbul lo/ /de yang zhu ba'i rdzas rnams zhal du/ yam shing bdug spos sogs 'od kyi dkyil 'khor la/til la sogs pa phyag tu/ me tog dbu la/ dri thugs kar/ mar me dang mchod yon mdun tu/ zhabs bsil zhabs la/ bsangs gtor sku thams cad la phul bar mos par bya/ khyad par rdzas shing tog /bdud rtsi lnga/ gos zung sogs kyang dam bzhag gi sngags kyis 'bul ba ni/ oṃ badzra a na la ma hā bhā ta dzwa la ya sarba bhasnru ku ru sarba duṣṭṛ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ shing tog go/ bdag cag da/pon slob 'khor dang bcas pa'i nad gdon sdig sgrib bar du gcod pa thoms cad shānti ku ru swā hā/ oṃ badzra a na la ma hā bhā ta dzwa la ya sarba bhasnri ku ru sarba duṣṭṛ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ bdud rtsi lnga'o// bdag cag dpon slob 'khor dang bcas pa'i nad gdon sdig sgrib bar du gcod sku thams cad shānti ku ru swā hā/ oṃ badzra a na la

ma hā bhā ta dzwa la ya sarba bhasnru ku ru sarba duṣṭṛ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ gos zung ngo / bdag cag dpon slob 'khor dang bcas pa'i nad gdon sdig sgrib bar du gaXrshad ༄pa thams cad ro/3sni ṭa/ 〈co swā hā/ skabs 'di dag tu me pra brtags la ngan na bsangs gtor dang dgang blugs 'bul/mthar spyan snga sogs kyis ma gsungs kyang /skyes 65sna ye hūm̐/ gis dgang blugs kyang 'bul lo// gsum pa dkyil lubor pa mchod pa ni/ bud shing kha gsos/ me lha yab yum me phung 'bar ba'i rnam par gyur pa'i dbus su rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i khang pa brtsegs pa gru bzhi sgo bzhi pa/ phyi nas dkar ser dmar ljang sngo ba'i rtsig pa rim pa lnga dang ldan zhing / rin po che'i pha gu dang do shal dang do shal phyed pa 'phyang ba/ shar bu dang mda' yab kyis mdzes pa/ ka ba bzhi bzhis btegs pa'i rta babs bang rim bzhi dang ldan pa'i steng du/ padma la gnas

༄tsho/ /pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo dang / gdugs dang ri dwags dang bcas pa/ 'dod yon gyi snam bu dmar po la lha mo bcu drug dkyil 'khor pa la mchod pa'i tshul gyis 'khod cing / sgo khyud kyi mtshams su zla phyed rdo rjes spras pa/ lha snams kyi shar dkar/ lho ser/ nub dmar/ byang ljang ba/ ka ba brgyad dang ldan zhing / rdo rje'i gdung nye bar bres pa/ thog phyur bur gyur pa'i rtse mor rdo rje rin po che'i tog gis spud pa/ gzhan yang gos dang / me tog gi phreng ba dang / rnga yab dkar po dang / gdugs dang / ba dan kha dog sna tshogs pa rlung gis bskyod pa dang dril bu 'khrol ba la sogs pas brgyan pa'i dbus su/ padma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa ge sar dang bcas pa/ gzhal yas khang gi phyi rol rdo rje'i phreng bas bskor ba'i nang du/ shar du gtum drag /lhor

'jigs su rung ba/ nub tu 'bar ba 'khrugs pa/ byang du tshang tshing 'khrigs pa/ byang shar du ha ha rgod pa/ shar lhor dpal gyi nags/ lho nub tu 'jigs pa'i mun pa/ nub byang du ki li ki li sgrogs pa/ dur khrod chen po de rnams su shīrṣa la sogs pa'i shing chen po brgyad kyi drung brgya byin la sogs pa'i phyogs skyong brgyad yum dang bcas pa/ lha'i dge 'dun la sogs pa'i zhing skyong brgyad phyogs skyong gi bzhon pa'i gdong can shing lo'i gseb nas lus stod phyung ba/mtsho chen po brgyad la gnas pa'i nor rgyas ser po la sogs klu chen brgyad yum dang bcas pas thal mo sbyar ba'i steng du sgrogs byed sogs sprin brgyad lding ba/ gzhan yang me dang ri bo mchod rten rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug brgyad brgyad gnas shing / dur khrod kyi bkod pa 'jigs su rung ba dang ldan pa'i

༄7/ /gzhal yas khang gi dbus kyi padma'i lte bar tshangs pa/ dbang po/ nye dbang / drag po ste bdud bzhi'i gdan/ 'dab ma brgyad la/ shar du tshangs pa ser po/ lhor dbang po dkar po/ nub tu nye dbang dmar po/ byang du drag po sngon po/ byang shar du gshin rje nag po/ shar lhor nor bdag ser po/lho nub tu srin po sngo nag /nub byang du thag bzang ris ljang gu rnams gan rkyal du gnas pa'i snying gar nyi ma'i gdan dang bcas pa'o/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta 65 nī 'i/ ya badzra swa bhā wa yi/tma ska/྅ haṃ/ zhes sngags kyis rgyas gdab pa'i bar bya/rdul tshon dang 'brel ba'i tshe slob mas dkyil 'khor gyi drung nas me tog sngags brjod pas spyan drangs/slob dpon la phul te thab tu rim bzhin sngags bzla zhing dor ba phyag bzhes so//—skedze dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du hūm̐ dang e sngon po las rdo rje dang gri gug hūm̐ dang e gis mtshan pa yongs su gyur

pa las/ bcom ldan 'das dgyes pa rdo rje sku mdog nag po zhal brgyad dang ldan pa'i rtsa ba'i zhal nag po/ g.yas zhal kunda ltar dkar ba/ g.yon zhal dmar zhing cher 'jigs pa/ lhag ma g.yas zhal gnyis dang g.yon zhal gnyis bung ba ltar nag cing / steng zhal dud kha gtsigs pa'i nyams can/ spyan nyi shu rtsa bzhi phye ba/ dbu skra ser po gyen tu brdzes pa/ dpral ba'i steng du thod pa lnga lnga'i phreng ba dang / sna tshogs rdo rje spyi bor 'dzin pa/ zhal nas hūm̐ gi sgra spro zhing / 'khor lo/ snyan cha/ mgul rgyan/ phyag zhabs kyi gdu bu/ ska rags/ thal bas byugs pa ste phyag rgya drug dang ldan pa/ mgo bo lnga bcu'i phreng ba'i do shal 'phyang ba/ phyag bcu drug gi g.yas kyi phyag gi thod pa brgyad na/ rim pa bzhin tu/ glang po che dkar po/ rta sngon po/ bong bu kham pa/ glang dmar po/

༄༅/ /rnga mong thal kar/ mi dmar po/ sha ra bha sngon po/ byi la gwa pa/ g.yon gyi phyag gi thod pa brgyad na/ sa'i lha mo ser mo/ chu'i lha mo dkar mo/ rlung gi lha mo dud kha/ me'i lha mo dmar mo/ zla ba'i lha mo dkar mo/ nyi ma'i lha mo dmar mo/ gshin rje nag po/ nor bdag ser po/ snying gar thal mo sbyar ba rnams bsnams pa'i phyag dang po gnyis kyis yum la 'khyud pa/ gcer bu zhabs bzhi'i mdun ma gnyis g.yas brkyang ba'i gar dang rgyab ma gnyis skyil krung phyed pa'i stabs kyis nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la bdud bzhi mnyam par mnan zhing / gar gyi nyams dgu dang ldan pa/ 'jigs pa'ang 'jigs par mdzad pa'o/ /yum bdag med ma sku mdog nag mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum mnga' ba/ mche ba gtsigs pa/ dbu skra ser po gyen tu brdzes pa/

phyag g.yas gri gug /g.yon thod pa bsnams pas yab la 'khyud pa/ gcer bu phyag rgya lnga dang ldan zhing / thod pa skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang / skam po lnga bcu'i phreng bas brgyan pa/ zhabs g.yon brkyang / g.yas bskum pas yab la 'khyud pa/ 'dab ma brgyad la rga rtsa baṃ rghaṃ paṃ shaṃ rtsa ḍo rnams yongs su gyur pa las/ shar du go rī nag mo g.yas gri gug g.yon nya ro hi ta bsnams pa/ lhor tso rī dmar mo g.yas cang te'u g.yon phag pa bsnams pa/ nub tu bee tā li ser mo g.yas rus sbal g.yon thod pa bstsa/mas pa/ byang du ghasma rī ljang gu g.yas sprul g.yon thod pa bsnams pa/ byang shar du puska sī sngon mo g.yas seng ge g.yon dgra stu bsnams pa/ shar lhor sha ba rī dkar mo g.yas dge slong g.yon gsil byed bsnams pa/ lho nub tu tsaṇḍa lī sngon mo g.yas 'khor lo

༄7/ /g.yon thong gshol bsnams pa/nub byang du ḍombi ni sna tshogs pa'i mdog can/ g.yas rdo rje/ g.yon sdigs mdzub mdzad pa/ lha mo thams cad kyang zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum ma/ mche ba gtsigs pa/ dbu skra ser po gyen tu brdzes pa/ gcer bu phyag rgya lnga dang ldan zhing / thod pa skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang / skam po lnga bcu'i phreng bas brgyan pa/ zhabs g.yon brkyang ba'i skyil krung phyed pa'i gar gyis gnas pa'o/ /sems dpa' dang skye mched gnas gsum byin gyis brlab pa ni/ bcom ldan 'das kyi thugs kar rang 'dra'i ye shes sems dpa'/ de'i thugs kar ting 'dzin sems dpa' rdo rje rtse dgu pa'i lte bar nyi ma'i dkyil 'bor gyi dbus su hūm̐ sngon po/ yum gyi thugs kar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du e sngon po 'od zer dang bcas pa/ mig tu oṃ

las gti mug rdo rje ma dkar mo/ /rna bar sdu las zhe sdang rdo rje ma nag mo/ /sna la me las ser sna rdo rje ma ser mo/ /lce la rī las 'dod chags rdo rje ma dmar mo/ /dpral bar i las phrag dog rdo rje ma ljang gu/ /snying ga'i cha stod du a las reg bya rdo rje ma sngon mo/ /spyi bor oṃ las sku rdo rje ma dkar mo//mgrin par āḥlas gsung rdo rje ma dmar mo/ /snying ga'i cha smad du hūm̐ las thugs rdo rje ma sngon mo/ /de thams cad kyang zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ g.yas gri gug /g.yon na thod pa bsnams shing kha ṭwāṃ ga mchan khung du bcug pa/ spyan gsum pa/ dbu skra ser po gyen tu brdzes pa/ phyag rgya lnga dang ldan pa/ stag gi pags pas smad dkris pa/ ro'i stan la skyil krung phyed pa'i gar gyis bzhugs pa'o/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta khe tsa dī badzra swa bhā wa ātma ko3 haṃ/ oṃ sarba ta thā

༄༅/ /ga ta bhu tsa ri badzra swa bhā wa ātma ko3 haṃ/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ba ta la wā si ni badzra swa bhā wa ātma ko3 haṃ/ rang gi snying ga'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas/ ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs/ rin chen 'bar ba las bshad pa ltar/ dmigs med mkha' ltar dag cing khyab pa yi//chos sku nam mkha' lta bur dbyer med kyang / /thabs dang shes rab gzugs brnyan skur ston pa'i/ /bcom ldan 'khor bcas 'dir ni gshegs su gsol//rdo rje'i rtse mos bsang gtor gyi chu mchod rdzas la gtor zhing / hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ brjod pas bgegs bskrad nas/ lag pa g.yas rdo rje dang bcas pas mchod pa rnams la bskor zhing / skyed āḥhūm̐ lan gsum brjod pas/mchod pa'i yo byad rnams rang bzhin stong pa/ byed las dbang po drug gi spyod yul du zag pa med pa'i bde ba skyed nus par gyur/ zhes byin gyis brlabs la/ g.yon

dril bu dkrol zhing / g.yas pasamachod rdzas stob pa'i tshul gyis dbul bzhin pas/ skyed dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ therteḥkhaṃ ram̐ āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ zhes pas mchod yon/ skyes nī ri ti hūm̐ khaḥ.āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ zhes pas zhabs bsil/oṃ badzra pursha āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ badzra dhu pe āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ badzra gandhe āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ badzra ni wibye āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ badzra ā lo ke āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ zhes pa'i mchod pa lngas mchod/dkar mo ri dwags mtshan ma 'dzin/ /chom rkun bdud las rgyal ba'i snod/ /ro langs ma ni chu lag ma/ /ghasma rī ni sman 'dzin zhing / /puska sī ni rdo rje'i lag /de bzhin ri khrod ma ro 'dzin/ /gdol pa mo ni cang te'u brdung / /'di rnams kyis ni gtso bo mchod/ /'dod chags chen po'i rjes chags pas//g.yung mos sku la 'khyud pa nyid/ /oṃ go rī rga āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ tso rī rtsa āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ bee tā lī baṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ ghasma rī rghaṃ āḥhūm̐ swāhā/ oṃ puska sī paṃ āḥhūm̐

༄༅/ /swā hā/ oṃ sha ba rī shaṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ tsaṇḍa lī rtsa āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ ḍombi ni ḍo āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ zhes lha mo brgyad kyis kyang mchod nas/ oṃ ma hā badzra hūm̐/ oṃ badzra gharnye āḥ zhes pas rdo rje dang dril bu bzung la/ zhe sdang rdo rjer phyag 'tshal bstod/ /gti mug rdo rjer phyag 'tshal bstod/ /ser sna rdo rje bdag la skyobs//'dod chags rdo rje bdag la stsol/ /phrag dog rdo rje nga rgyal te/ /sgyu 'phrul rdo rje mgon po kun/ /las kun rab tu sgrub byed pa/ /thams cad rdo rje bdag mgur 'gyur/ /zhes pas bstod/ so so'i phyag rgya bcings la sku/ rī dzaḥ zhes pas ye shes pa dgug ce 'dre hūm̐ gis bzhug bee tā lī baṃ gyis bcings/ ghasma rī thesteḥ zhes pas dgyes par byas/ dbang bskur ba ni/slar yang thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer nag po lcags kyu'i rnam pa 'phros pas khams gsum na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas thams cad spyan drangs pa

la go rī ma la sogs pas mchod pa ni/ oṃ go rī haṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ tso rī rtsa āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ bee tā lī baṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ ghasma rī rghaṃ āḥhūm̐ swāhā/ oṃ puska sī paṃ āḥhūṃ swā hā/ oṃ sha ba rī shaṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ tsaṇḍa lī rtsa āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ ḍombi ni ḍo āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ mgon po de bzhin gshegs pa kun/ /khyed kyis lha la dbang skur cig/ces gsol ba btab pas/ sangs rgyas de rnams he ru ka'i gzugs su gyur nas bdud rtsi lngas gang ba'i bum pas dbang bskur ba na/ me tog gi char 'bab pa dang / rnga'i sgra grags pa dang / gur gum gyi char 'bab pa dang / gzugs rdo rje ma la sogs pas mchod pa dang / rdo rje'i glu/ spyan ma la sogs pas len pa dang / rig pa'i rgyal po khro bo rnams kyis bgegs bskrad cing dbang bskur/ chu'i lhag ma cung zad yar 'khyil ba las rang gi rigs kyi bdag

༄7/ /pos dbu brgyan pa ni/ gtso bo yab yum la mi bskyod pa/ pukka sī dang go rī la mi bskyod pa/ sha ba rī dang tso rī la rnam par snang mdzad/tsaṇḍa lī dang bee tā snyi la rin chen 'byung ldan/ ḍombi ni dang ghasma rī la snang ba mtha' yas kyis dbu brgyan par bsam la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta badzra swa bhā wa ātma skosa3 haṃ/ ces sngags kyis rgyas gdab/ ༈ dkyil chog ltar mchod bstod rgyas pa ni/ mchod pa rnams/ skyes sarba saṃ rbe dha ni āḥhūm̐ swā hā sa bsangs/ skyes swa bhā wa sdo/giḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā ba shuzlo3 haṃ gis sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las/ a las thod pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du/ hūm̐ 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i bsang gtor/ mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me tog /bdug spos/ snang gsal/ dri/ zhal zas/ rol mo la sogs pa'i mchod pa'i yo byad rnams

rang bzhin stong pa/ byed las dbang po drug gi spyod yul du zag pa med pa'i bde ba skyed nus par gyur/ oṃ sarba saṃ sho dha ni āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥkhaṃ ram̐ āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ skyed nī rī ti hūm̐ kha āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ skye/ badzra purmye āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ skye/ badzra dhu pe āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ skye/ badzra ā 31 ke āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ skyes badzra garnye āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ skye( badzra nai widre āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ badzra shabha āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ rol mo bya zhing / oṃ badzra ghaṇḍa ra ṇi ta pra ra ṇi ta saṃ pra ra ṇi ta sarba buddha kṣe tra pra tsa li te pra dzñā pa ra mi tā nā da saṃ bha wa badzra dharmakhṛ da ya sarnyo ṣa ni hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hoḥ.āḥkhaṃ swā hā/ces byin gyis brlab/ dag cing dri med yid 'ong ba'i/ /sngags kyi bsang gtor mchog 'di dag /mchog tu dad pas khyed la 'bul/ /ci bde bar ni bzhes su garbe/la/ /pad kor sngon tu 'gro bas/ g.yas pa'i mtheb mdzub kyis bsang gtor dbul zhing / skyed shrī he ru ka sa pa ri wā ra sarba

༄༅/ /saṃ sho dha ni āḥhūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ dag cing dri med yid 'ong ba'i/ /sngags kyi mchod yon mchog 'di dag /mchog tu dad pas khyed la 'bul//ci bde bar ni bzhes su gsol/ /pad kor sngon tu 'gro bas/rdo rje'i thal mo gnyis kyis dung chos bzung la mchod yon bzed zhal du dbul zhing / oṃ shrī he ru ka sa pa ri wā ra dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥkhaṃ ram̐ āḥhūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ dag cing dri med yid 'ong ba'i/ /sngags kyi zhabs bsil mchog 'di dag /mchog tu dad pas khyed la 'bul/ /ci bde bar ni bzhes ༄/ garbedul/ /pad kor sngon tu 'gro bas/ skyes shrī he 〈co ka sa pa ri wā ra nī rī ti hūm̐ kha āḥhūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ g.yas pa'i mtheb mdzub sbyar ba'i khu tshur gyis me tog blangs la lan gsum bskor nas/mthe'u chung nas mdzub mo'i bar rim gyis bkrol te bzed zhal du sgreng ngo // de nas lag pa g.yon pas dril bu 'brol zhing / g.yas pas mchod rdzas so sor blangs nas bstab pa'i tshul gyis dbul ba'am/ so so'i phyag

rgya dang bcas pas/ me tog 'di ni bzang zhing dge/ /dag pa'i skye gnas las dag pa/ /bdag gis dad pas 'bul lags kyi/ /bzhes nas bdag la dgyes par mdzod/ /oṃ shrī he ru ka sa pa ri wā ra badzra puṅge āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ nags tshal las byung phan pa yi/ /gang zhig dri dang bdug spos mchog /bdag gis dad pas 'bul lags kyi/ /bzhes nas bdag la dgyes par mdzod/ /oṃ shrī he ru ka sa pa ri wā ra badzra dhā pe āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ srin po 'joms shing dag byed la/ /dge zhing mun pa rnam sel ba/ /bdag gis dad pas 'bul lags kyi/ /bzhes nas bdag la dgyesi par mdzod/ /oṃ shrī he ru ka sa pa ri wā ra badzra ā lo ke āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ lhan cig skyes dang sbyar ba'i dri/ /tshim byed dag pa'i bdud rtsi 'di/ /bdag gis dad pas 'bul lags kyi/ /bzhes nas bdag la dgyes

༄tsho/ /par mdzod/ /oṃ shrī he ru ka sa pa ri wā ra badzra gandhe āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ bshos gtsang bza' ba dang bcas pa'i/ /kha dog dri dang ro ldan pa//bdag gis dad pas 'bul lags kyi/ /bzhes nas bdag la dgyes par mdzod/ /oṃ shrī he ru ka sa pa ri wā ra badzra ni wi dre āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ zhesanyer spyod lnga'i mchod pa gur las gsungs pa dang / sna tshogs dril bu'i sgra rnams dang / /cang te'u la rbershags sgra yi tshogs/ /bdag gis dad pas 'bul lags kyi/ /bzhes nas bdag la dgyes par mdzod/ /oṃ shrī he ru ka sa pa ri wā ra badzra shabha āḥhūṃ swā hā/ 'dod yon lnga'i mchod pa ni/ rang gi snying gsaspros pa'i 'dod yon gyi lha mo du mas mchod par bsam la/gzugs la rnam gsum shes bya ste/ /lha rnams la ni dbul bar bya/ /de nyid bcom ldan rgyal ba ni/ /mnga' bdag rdo rje rnam snang mdzad/ /g.yon khu tshur gyi steng

du g.yas pa'i thal mo me long gi tshul ltar bzhag la/ skyed shrī he ru ka sa pa ri wā ra rū pa pū dza me gha sa mu dra spa ra ṇa sa ma ye hūṃ/ sgra la rnam gsum shes bya ste/ /lha rnams la ni dbul bar bya/ /de nyid bcom ldan rdo rje can/ /rdo rje sems dpa' grags chen po/ /oṃ shrī he ru ka sa pa ri wā ra shapta pū dza me gha sa mu dra spa ra ṇa sa ma ye hūm̐/ rol mo bya/dri la rnam gsum shes bya ste/ /lha rnams la ni dbul bar bya/ /de nyid bcom ldan sangs rgyas ni/ /rin chen phung por rab tu grags/ /g.yon khu tshur las mdzub mo brkyang ba kha steng du phyogs pa la g.yas pa'i thal mos dri blangs nas byugs pa'i tshul gyis/ skye( shrī he 〈co ka sa pa ri wā ra garnye pū dza me gha sa mu dra spa ra ṇa sa ma ye hūm̐/ blos la rnam gsum shes bya ste/ /lha rnams la ni dbul bar bya/ /de nyid bcom ldan 'dod chags che/ /rdo rje chos kyis bzhes su gsol/ /thal mo gnyis bkan nas zhal
