༄7 zas 'bul ba'i tshul gyis/ oṃ shrī he ru ka sa pa ri wā ra ra sa pū dza me gha sa mu dra spa ra ṇa sa ma ye hūm̐/ reg la rnam gsum shes bya ste/ /lha rnams la ni dbul bar bya/ /de nyid bcom ldan sna tshogs pa/ /don yod 'bras bu ster ba po/ /gos zung dbul zhing / oṃ shrī he ru ka sa pa ri wā ra sparnye pū dza me gha sa mu dra spa ra ṇa sa ma ye hūm̐/ zhes dang / srab 'jam yang ba lha yi gos/ /mi bskyod rdo rje'i sku brnyes la/ /mi phyed dad pas bdag 'bul na/ /bdag kyang rdo rje'i sku thob shog /sna tshogs dbang po'i gzhu ltar rab bkra zhing / /gang la reg na bde ba'i rgyur gyur pa/ /gos bzang rin chen bdag blo sbyang phyir 'bul/ /bzod pa dam pa'i bo/sa kyis brgyan par re ga /skyed badzra wasta āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ zhes pas gos zung 'bul lo/ /rgyal srid bdun gyi mchod pa ni/ rin chen sna bdun ri mor bris pa sogs 'bul ba'am so

so'i phyag rgya spyi mthun byas la/ gser las legs byas lte ba shin tu zlum/ /rtsibs stong ldan zhing mu khyud rab mnyam bzang / /dang po'i sa las rnam par rgyal gyur gang / /'khor lo rin chen nam mkha' bkang ste 'bul/ /oṃ tsakra ratna pū dzi te āḥhūm̐/ bdag dang mtha' yas pa'i sems can thams cad dran pa yang dag byang chub kyi chos bla na med pa kun tu spyod pa thob par gyur cig /yan lag thams cad legs skyes sa la ni/ /rab gnas gangs can rtse 'dra'i glang po mchog /rgyal po la 'os mkha' la rab 'gro ba'i/ /glang po rin chen nam mkha' bkang ste 'bul/ /oṃ hasti ratna pā dzi te āḥhūm̐/ bdag dang mtha' yas pa'i sems can thams cad shes rab yang dag byang chub kyi chos bla na med pa kun tu spyod pa thob par gyur cig /tho rangs dus su phyogs rnams ma lus pa'i//

༄7/ /sa rnams bskor nas slar yang ldog gyur gang / /rma bya'i mgrin 'dra spu ni yid 'ong ba'i/ /rta mchog rin chen nam mkha' bkang ste 'bul//oṃ a shwa ratna pū dzi te āḥhūṃ/ bdag dang mtha' yas pa'i sems can thams cad brtson 'grus yang dag byang chub kyi chos bla na med pa kun tu spyod pa thob par gyur cig /dri med beeḍūrya 'dra'i rin po che/ /kun tu dpag tshad tsam du snang byed pa/ /sgrib med mtshan mo ci 'dra nyin de bzhin/ /nor bu rin chen nam mkha' bkang ste 'bul/ /oṃ ma ṇi ratna pū dzi te āḥhūm̐/ bdag dang mtha' yas pa'i sems can thams cad dga' ba yang dag byang chub kyi chos bla na med pa kun tu spyod pa thob par gyur cig /gang zhig reg dri gzugs dang mdangs ldan pa/ /bud med dam pa dregs ldan rnams kyi mchog /lha mo bzhin tu yon

tan kun ldan pa/ /btsun mo rin chen nam mkha' bkang ste 'bul/ /oṃ snri ratna pū dzi te āḥhūm̐/ bdag dang mtha' yas pa'i sems can thams cad shin tu sbyangs pa yang dag byang chub kyi chos bla na med pa kun tu spyod pa thob par gyur cig /gang yang 'di na rgyal la mu tig dang / /gser sogs mang po thub la phul ba yi/ /nor ldan mtshungs par nor mang ldan pa yi/ /khyim bdag rin chen nam mkha' bkang ste 'bul/ /oṃ gro ha spa ti ratna pū dzi te āḥhūm̐/ bdag dang mtha' yas pa'i sems can thams cad ting nge 'dzin yang dag byang chub kyi chos bla na med pa kun tu spyod pa thob par gyur cig /'gro dang kun tu gnas dang rnam ldog par/ /ma lus dpung la ma /bas par byed pa yi/ /dpal ldan bdun pa 'byung 'gyur mi yi ni/ /blon po rin chen nam mkha' bkang ste 'bul//

༄7/ /oṃ pu ru ṣa ratna pū dzi te āḥhūm̐/ bdag dang mtha' yas pa'i sems can thams cad btang snyoms yang dag byang chub kyi chos bla na med pa kun tu spyod pa thob par gyur cig /sgeg sogs brgyad kyi mchod pa ni/ sgeg mo'i lag pas sgeg mo ste/ /phreng bas phreng ba'i mkha' 'gro ma/ /hūm̐ gi glu yis dam tshig glu/ /lag bskum pas ni gar nyid de/ /mchod pa 'di dag bla na med/ /sangs rgyas thams cad mnyes par byed/ /sangs rgyas rnams ni mchod pas mchod//'dod pa'i dngos grub byed par 'gyur/ /phyag rgya mthong brgyud ltar bya zhing / oṃ badzra sa twa su saṃ gra hā da/ oṃ badzra lā su hūm̐/ oṃ badzra ratna mā nutta ram̐/ oṃ badzra mā le tt+waṃ/oṃ badzra dharma gā ya ni/ oṃ badzra gī ti hrīḥ oṃ badzra karma ka roddha be/ oṃ badzra dṛ tī āḥ me tog skyur ba'i tshul gyis dang / /bdug pas bdug pa'i tshul gyis

dang / /sdong bu mar me'i mchod pa dang / /byug pa'i tshul gyis rjes su dri/ /mchod pa 'di rnams bla na med/ /sangs rgyas thams cad mnyes par byed/ /sangs rgyas rnams ni mchod pas mchod/ /'dod pa'i dngos grub byed par 'gyur// oṃ badzra sa twa su saṃ gra hā da/ oṃ badzra dha pe hūm̐/ oṃ badzra ratna mā nutta ram̐/ oṃ badzra puṣṭi lha/ oṃ badzra dharma gā ya ni/ oṃ badzra ā lo ke hrīḥ oṃ badzra karma ka roddhā be/ oṃ badzra garnye āḥ phyag rgya nyi shu'i mchod pa ni/gīn chen 'bar ba dang bzang po yongs bzung dgongs pa ltar phyag len tu rgyas par sbyar ba'i tshul 'byung yang bsdu na/ gar pad bcas/ te na hūm̐/ te na hūm̐/ te na te te hūm̐/ hūm̐ hūm̐/ pi wang tshul gyis sgreng ba dang / /gling bu'i tshul gyis sgyur ba dang / /dung gi tshul gyis 'bud pa dang / /sil khrol tshul gyis rdeb pa dang / /phyag 'tshal tshul gyis 'dud pa dang / /rnga yab tshul gyis

༄༅/ /g.yob pa dang / /rgyal mtshan tshul gyis sgreng ba dang / /bla bre'i tshul gyis bre ba dang / /ba dan tshul gyis 'phyar ba dang / /gdugs kyi tshul gyis dgab pa dang / /rnga zlum tshul gyis rdeb pa dang / /rdza rnga'i tshul gyis rdung ba dang / /gar gyi tshul gyis yan lag skyod/ /bzhad pa'i tshul gyis 'dzum pa dang / /sgeg pa'i tshul gyis sgeg pa dang / /khro ba'i tshul gyis 'jigs pa dang / /mda' 'phen tshul gyis drang bar bya/ /rdo rje gsor zhing phyag 'tshal lo/ /chags pa'i tshul gyis nu ma 'jib/ /gus pa'i tshul gyis thal mo sbyor/ /rdo rje'i mchod pa nyi shu pos/ /he ru ka dpal 'khor bcas mchod/ /nang gi mchod pa ni/ zla zhun byang sems ga bur gyis gang ba'i/ /padma'i snod 'dzin lha mo go rī ma/ /zhing gi rdul dang mnyam par sprul

nas kyang / /bde chen malhudun par 'phel slad lha rnams mabyebyed/ /g.yon rdo rje khu tshur gyi steng du g.yas pa'i thal mo bkan la bzhag pa dkar cha'i snod 'dzin pa'i tshul gyis/skyed sku/ rī ge āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ nyi 'od mdangs chags rang byung me tog ni/ /sihlas yongs bkang snod 'dzin tso rī ma/ /zhing gi rdul dang mnyam par sprul nas kyang / /gtum mo'i nus pa rgyas phyir lha rnams mchod/ /snga ma las zlog pa dmar cha'i snod 'dzin pa'i tshul gyis/ oṃ tso rī rtsa āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ nang gi gdung ba sel byed gla rtsi ste/ /rdo rje dri chu'i snod 'dzin bee tā li/ /zhing gi rdul dang mnyam par sprul nas kyang / /ma/tshan/ 'dzin dri ma sbyong phyir lha rnams mchod/ /mchod yon gyi phyag rgyas/ oṃ ze tā li baṃ āḥhūṃ swā hā/bzhi mnyam bdud rtsis gang ba'i thod pa yis/ /phyag gnyis rtag tu brel gyur ghasma rī/ /zhing gi rdul dang mnyam par sprul nas kyang / /'chi med thob par bya

ra༅༅/ /phyir lha rnams mchod/ /g.yon pa'i khu tshur gyi steng du g.yas pa'i sor mo rnams kyi rtse mo bsdusate bzhag pa sman 'dzin pa'i tshul gyis/ skyes ghasma rī rghaṃ āḥhūṃ swā hā/ swā li skyes pa rab brjod tsandan dmar/ /rdo rje stobs kyi snod 'dzin pukka sī/ /zhing gi rdul dang mnyam par sprul nas kyang / /mtha' yas mthu stobs rgyas phyir lha rnams mchod/ /khu tshur gnyis mnyam du gshibs te kha drung du 'jog pa sha la rol pa'i tshul byas la/ oṃ pukka sī paṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ ro bcud sbrang rtsi'i btung ba dang bcas pa'i/ /rnal 'byor lhung bzed thogs pa'i ri khrod ma/ /zhing gi rdul dang mnyam par sprul nas kyang / /rdo rje'i lus thob bya phyir lha rnams mchod/ /rdo rje thal mo kha phye bas snod 'dzin pa ltar byas la/ oṃ sha ba rī shaṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ gzhom med nā da'i rang bzhin cang telnga /dbyangs gsal rdo rje'i sgra sgrogs tsaṇḍasī/ /zhing gi rdul dang mnyam

par sprul nas kyang / /rdo rje chos ni 'grub phyir lha rnams mchod/ /gabon dkur bzhag cing g.yasapa'i khu tshur gyi mdzub mo dang mthe'u chung 'byog por byas pa cang te'u 'brol pa'i rnam pas/ oṃ tsaṇḍalī rtsa āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ thabs shes snyoms par 'jug las dga' ba bzhi/ /zag med yongs su bskyed pa'i ḍombi nī/ /zhing gi rdul dang mnyam par sprul nasakyang / /bde stong dbyer med thob phyir lha rnams mchod/ /snying gar khu tso bsnol ba 'byud pa'i tshul gyis/ oṃ ḍombi nī ḍo āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ thams cad la'aji mthar se gol dang dkusapa bya'o/ /gsang ba'i mchod pa ni/ gtso 'khor thams cad dpa' bo'i cha lugs su bsgyur te g.yung mos 'gyud pa las byung ba'i bde ba chen po'i de kho na nyid sku nyams su bstar ba'i mos pas/ gang gis rnam thertog rnam spangs te/ /byang chub sems ni rnam bsgom zhing / /lus dang sems ni rnam dag pa/ /'di ni don dam mchod pa yin// zhes pa rnams kyi mthar/ oṃ sarba ta thā

༄92/ /ga ta pū dza badzra swa bhā ba ātma ko3 haṃ/ zhes pa'i sngags kyis rgyas gdab par bya'o/ /bstod pa bya ba ni/ skyed ma hā badzra hūm̐/ skye/ badzra gharnye āḥ ces brjod de don dran pa dang sngags kyis rdor dril bzung la/ thams cad dngos po'i rang bzhin mchog /gdod nas thams cad bdag nyid gnas/ /thabs dang shes rab gnyis med pa'i//kye'i rdo rje la phyag 'tshal/ /bdag med mas ni mgul nas 'khyud/ /dbu skra ser po gyen tu 'bar/ /zhal brgyad pa la spyan gsum pa/ /mgon po de la gus phyag 'tshal/ /spyi bo'i steng na nag po mdzes/ /dkar dang dmar po g.yas dang g.yon/ /gang gi lhag ma'i zhal rnams ni/ /nag pa de la bdag phyag 'tshal//glang po rta bong glang rnga mo/ /mi dang sha ra bha byi la/ /g.yas pa'i phyag brgyad la gnas pa'i/ /thod pa 'dzin la bdag phyag 'tshal/ /sa dang chu dang rlung dang

me/ /zla nyi gshin rje gsang ba pa/ /g.yon pa'i phyag brgyad la gnas pa'i/ /thod pa 'dzin la bdag phyag 'tshal/ /zhabs bzhi yis ni bdud bzhi po//mnyam par mnan zhing gcer bu nyid/ /nyi mar zhabs g.yas brkyang dang bskum/ /gar mdzad de la bdag phyag 'tshal/ /'khor lo bzhi yi bdag nyid mdzes/ /'dzag pa'i mgo bos rnam par brgyan/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rnam dag pa'i/ /phyag rgya lngas ni rnam par brgyan/ /sna tshogs rdo rje spyi bor 'dzin//dpral bar rigs kyi bdag po nyid/ /dam pa'i dga' ba yang dag thob/ /bde chen de la bdag phyag 'tshal/ /rga las skyes pa'i go rī shar/ /kha dog nag cing g.yon pa nya/ /g.yas pa na ni gri gug 'dzin/ /tshangs pa mnan la bdag phyag 'tshal/ /rtsa las byung ba'i chom rkun ma/ /btsod kyi kha dog lho phyogs

༄༅/ /su/ /phyag na phag dang cang te'u bsnams/ /dbang po mnan la bdag phyag 'tshal/ /baṃ las skyes pa'i ser mo nub/ /ro langs ma ni nye dbang mnan/ /phyag g.yon lhung bzed g.yas pa yis/ /rus sbal 'dzin la bdag phyag 'tshal/ /ghasma rī ni byang gi sgor/ /ljang gu rghaṃ las byung ba yi/ /phyag na sgrul dang thod pas brel/ /drag po mnan la bdag phyag 'tshal/ /gshin rje mnan zhing paṃ las byung / /g.yon pa dgra stu seng ge g.yas/ /dbang ldan tu ni 'jigs gzugs ma/ /phyag 'tshal puska sī sngon la'o/ /ri khrod ma dkar shaṃ las byung / /me ru gnod sbyin steng du gnas/ /g.yon na gsil byed g.yas pa na//dge slong 'dzin la bdag phyag 'tshal/ /gtum mo nam mkha'i sngo bsangs ma/ /srin por rtsa las byung ba yi/ /g.yon na thong gshol 'khor lo g.yas//

phyag 'tshal srin po mnan khyod la'o/ /ḍo las zhabrungs pa'i g.yung mo ni/ /rlung mtshams thag bzang ris steng gshegs/ /phyag g.yon sdig mdzub g.yas rdo rje/ /sna tshogs mdog la bdag phyag 'tshal/ /skyil krung phyed pa'i gar gyis gnas/ /phyag rgya lnga yis rnam par brgyan/ /gcer bu spyan gsum thams cad la/ /bdag ni gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /phung po khams rnams rnam dag pa/ /byang chub sems las byung ba yi/ /bde rab ster 'di thams cad la/ /dngos po kun gyis phyag 'tshal lo/ /nyid kyi phyag na gzung ba yi/ /phyag mtshan sa bon las byung ba'i/ /bde chen 'dod pa thams cad la/ /rtag tu yang dag phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang zhig nyi zla kha sbyor gnas sa bon/ /gnyis las skyes pa'i gtso bo rig mar bcas/ /nyid kyis nyid kyi dkyil 'khor 'di la ni/ /'jig

༄7/ /rten gsum po sprul par mdzad dang ldan/ /nyid la 'di dag thams cad ma lus pa'i/ /zhi ba bde gsol rig ma bsdu byed pa'i/ /shes rab chags pa bdud rtsi'i ro nyid kyis/ /gnas su zhi ba de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mkha' 'gro ma gtso kye'i rdo rje/ /lha mo 'khor lo bcas bstod pas/ /bdag gis bsod nams gang thob pa/ /des ni 'jig rten de mtshungs shog /ces slob dpon mtsho skyes rdo rjes mdzad pa'i bstod pa nyi shu pa dang / khyod ni rnal 'byor ma yi tshogs kyis yongs su bskor/ /khyod ni nyid kyi thugs kyis khyod dgongs 'grub/ /khyod ni rgyu dang mi rgyu 'khor ba kun sgrub pa/ /snying rje'i thugs kyis sems can byang chub tu/ /kun rdzob sgyu ma byang chub sgrub pa yi/ /dgyes pa rdo rje dpal gyi he ru ka la bstod/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta stu ti badzra swa bhā ba ātma ko3 haṃ/ zhes

sngags kyis rgyas gdab bo// ༈ mi lcogs na mdor bsdus sbyar/ de nas sgrub thabs ltar/ byin rlabs sngon tu 'gro ba'i bdud rtsi phul ba ni/ skyes badzra a skṛ ta kuṇḍa lī ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭa ces bsangs/oṃ swa bhā wa shuddhaḥsarba dharmāḥsu bhā ba shukhyo3 haṃ gis sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las yam̐ las rlung / ram̐ las me/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ las thod pa'i sgyed bu gsum gyi steng du/ a las thod pa yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du/ hūm̐ sum̐ e dzī khaṃ/ māṃ māṃ māṃ tt+waṃ māṃ las skyes pa'i bdud rtsi lnga dang / sha lngar gyur/ ha hoḥhrīḥ zhes brjod pas/ tha mal pa'i kha dog dang dri dang nus pa phrogs shing / rlung g.yos/ me sbar/ bcud rnams bskol bas/ nyi ma 'char kha lta bu'i mdog can gyi rlangs pa hūṃ las rdo rje kha ṭwāṃ ga 'bar bar gyur pa zhu zhing / de nyid du lan gsum lhung bas dri ma thams cad dang bral ba shel ltar gsal ba'i dam tshig gi bdud rtsis gang ba'i

༄༅/ /steng du/ oṃ las byung ba'i zla ba kha chod kyi tshul du gnas pa la g.yas skor du ā li g.yon skor du kā li yongs su gyur pa'i oṃ āḥhūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros/ phyogs bcur bzhugs pa'i rdo rje 'dzin pa thams cad kyi thugs ka nas/ ye shes kyi bdud rtsi bkug /zla ba yi ge gsum dang bcas pa zhu bas bdud rtsi'i rgya mtshor gyur/ spyo byin gyis rlabs/ gtso 'khor thams cad kyi ljags kyi rtse mo rdo rjer gyur pa'i 'od kyi sgu gus bdud rtsi drangs te gsol bar dmigs la/ g.yon pa'i mtheb srin gyis nang mchod blangs nas 'bul zhing / phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi ngo bo dpal ldan rtsa ba'i bla ma dam pa'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ bcom ldan 'das rigs drug pa rdo rje 'chang chen po'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ bcom ldan rdo rje phag mo'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ rgyal sras rdo rje

snying po'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ grub chen sa ra ha pa'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ dpal ldan 'phags pa klu sgrub zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ rgyal sras ārya de ba'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/paṇa chen zla ba grags pa'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ rnal 'byor mā taṅgi pa'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ te lo shes rab bzang po'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ nā ro dzñā na sirnyi'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ mnga' bdag rgyal ba mai tri'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ mar pa chos kyi blo gros zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ rngog ston chos sku rdo rje'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ rngog ston zhe sdang rdo rje'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/rngog ston seng ge sgra yi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/rngog ston kun dga' rdo rje'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ rgya sgom ye shes 'od kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/grub chen karma pakshi'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ gnyan ras dge 'dun 'bum gyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūṃ/ bshes gnyen tshul khrims rin chen zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ kun mkhyen

༄༅/ /rang byung rdo rje'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ bla ma chos kyi rgyal mtshan zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ yor pa ye shes dpal ba'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ bka' bzhi ratna bha dra'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ rje btsun mthong ba don ldan zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ byang sems dpal 'byor don grub zhal du oṃ āḥhūṃ/ spyan snga chos kyi grags pa'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ rje btsun karma phrin las zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ 'jigs bral mi bskyod rdo rje'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ sprul sku dkon mchog yan lag zhal du oṃ āḥhūṃ/ rgyal tshab grags pa don grub zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ stag lung rnam rgyal dpal bzang zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ chos rje ngag dbang rnam rgyal zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/mtshungs med bkra shis dpal grub zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ mkhan chen karma nyi ma'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ mkhan mchog phrin las mtshan can zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ go shrī

don yod snying po'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ dpal chen chos kyi don grub zhal du oṃ āḥhūṃ/ kun gzigs chos kyi 'byung gnas zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ karma tshe dbang kun khyab zhal du oṃ āḥhūṃ/ mchog sprul phrin las rab rgyas zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ khra legs ye shes nyi ma'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ rgyal sras blo gros mtha' yas zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ padma dbang mchog rgyal po'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ rang byung rig pa'i rdo rje'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ drin can rtsa brgyud bla ma'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ de ba pi tsu badzñā ya oṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ e ni nātpa yi oṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ go rī ge oṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ tso rī rtsa oṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ bee tā lī baṃ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ ghasma rī rghaṃ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ pukka sī paṃ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ sha ba rī shaṃ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ tsaṇḍa lī rtsa oṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ ḍombi ni ḍo oṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ hūṃ shrī ya de wī kā li kā li ma hā kā li hūṃ bhyo oṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ ma hā kā lā ya oṃ

ra༅༅/ /āḥhūṃ/ skyed ma hā kā li ye skye( āḥhūm̐/ skyed sarba ta thā ga ta a skṛ ta swā da badzra swa bhā wa ātma sko/྅ haṃ/ zhes sngags kyis rgyas gdab/ ༈ de nas bsreg rdzas gtso 'khor so so la 'bul dgos pas/ thog mar gtso bo'i snying po'i mthar/ rnge'umi bṛlta/ btags la yam shing 'bul ba nas/ snying por 'bru gsum btags pas/ gos zung bar 'jig rten pa'i skabs ltar phul ba ni/skyed de wa pi tsu badzra hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ mthar/ skyes bo dhi bṛkṣu ya swā hā/ zhes btags pa'i sngags kyis yam shing zung du byas pa dag g.yas pa'i gung mtheb kyis bzung la gyen tu bskor nas mchog sbyin gyi tshul gyis nyi shu rtsa gcig sogs 'bul mthar/ bdag cag dpon slob 'khor dang bcas pa'i nad gdon sdig sgrib bar du gcod pa thams cad shānti ku ru swā hā/zhes spel tshig sbyar/ de bzhin tu lag pa g.yon byang chub mchog gi phyag rgya kha steng du bstan pas dgang gzar mar khus gang ba dang / lag pa g.yas phyag rgya de nyid 'og tu phyogs pas blug gzar kha gyen bstan bzung la/

dgang blugs kyi kha la rang gi lha'i sa bon yi ge gsum gyi bar du spel ba'am/ hūm̐ 'od zer dang bcas pa dang / dkyil 'khor pa'i zhal du hūm̐ gis mtshan par gyur par bltas la dgang blugs kha sbyar te lag pa gnyis pus mo las phyir mi 'da' bar g.yon skor gyis/ skyersha de wa pi tsu badzra hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ mthar/ skyed 65sna ye hūm̐/ zhes btags pas mar khu 'bul zhing 'dod gsol ni/ bdag cag dpon slob 'khor dang bcas pa'i nad gdon sdig sgrib bar du gcod pa thams cad shānti ku ru swā hā/ de nas/ oṃ de wa pi tsu badzra hūm̐ hūṃ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ mthar/ oṃ sarba pā paṃ da ha na badzrī ya badzra sa twa su sarba pā paṃ da ha swā hā/ til lo// bdag cag dpon slob 'khor dang bcas pa'i nad gdon sdig sgrib bar du gcod pa thams cad shānti ku ru swā hā/ oṃ de wa pi tsu badzra hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ mthar/ skyed badzra pus ya swā hā/ 'bras ma chag pa'o// bdag cag

༄7/ /dpon slob 'khor dang bcas pa'i nad gdon sdig sgrib bar du gcod pa thams cad shānti ku ru swā hā/ oṃ de wa pi tsu badzra hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ mthar/ oṃ sarba saspa de swā hā/ zas mchog go/ bdag cag dpon slob 'khor dang bcas pa'i nad gdon sdig sgrib bar du gcod pa thams cad shānti ku ru swā hā/ oṃ de wa pi tsu badzra hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ mthar/ oṃ badzra bī dzā ya swā hā/ 'bras so ba'o// bdag cag dpon slob 'khor dang bcas pa'i nad gdon sdig sgrib bar du gcod pa thams cad shānti ku ru swā hā/ oṃ de wa pi tsu badzra hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ mthar/ oṃ ma hā be ga ya swā hā/ nas so// bdag cag dpon slob 'khor dang bcas pa'i nad gdon sdig sgrib bar du gcod pa thams cad shānti ku ru swā hā/ oṃ de wa pi tsu badzra hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ mthar/ oṃ ma hā ba lā ya swā hā/

'khor dang bcas pa'i nad gdon sdig sgrib bar du gcod pa thams cad shānti ku ru swā hā/ ༈ de'ang las bye brag pa sgrub pa'i tshe so sa'i khyad par gyi rdzas spung bskyed/bsnyen pa'i kha skong lta bur 'jig rten par bdun/ gtso bor nyer gcig 'khor rnams la bdun res mtshon mang nyung skabs bstun 'bul ba'i mthar/ gtso bo'i snying po/ skyes de wa pi tsu badzra hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/mthar/ sa pa ri bā ra skye( āḥhūm̐ btags pas rdzas bsdus phul bas bcu cha'i grangs gsog pa nyid da lta'i phyag rgyun tu snang ngo / /'dod gsol ni/ sgrub pa lngatsware nad gangesan sdig sgrib sngags kyi lhag chad la rbedugs pa'i nyes pa thams cad shānti ku ru swā hā/ mthar gtor ma bsangs sbyang byin rlabs ni/ oṃ badzra a mṛ ta kuṇḍa lī ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭa ces bsangs/ skyes swa bhā wa shuddhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā ba shuzlo3 haṃ gis sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las yam̐ las rlung / ram̐ las me/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ las thod pa'i sgyed bu gsum gyi steng du/ a las thod

༄༅/ /pa yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du/ hūm̐ sum̐ e dzī khaṃ/ māṃ māṃ māṃ tī māṃ las skyes pa'i bdud rtsi lnga dang / sha lngar gyur/ ha hoḥhrīḥ zhes brjod pas/tha mal pa'i kha dog dang dri dang nus pa phrogs shing / rlung g.yos/ me sbar/ bcud rnams bskol bas/ nyi ma 'char kha lta bu'i mdog can gyi rlangs pa hūṃ las rdo rje kha ṭwāṃ ga 'bar bar gyur pa zhu zhing / de nyid du lan gsum lhung bas dri ma thams cad dang bral ba shel ltar gsal ba'i dam tshig gi bdud rtsis gang ba'i steng du/ oṃ las byung ba'i zla ba kha chod kyi tshul du gnas pa la g.yas skor du ā li g.yon skor du kā li yongs su gyur pa'i oṃ āḥhūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros/ phyogs bcur bzhugs pa'i rdo rje 'dzin pa thams cad kyi thugs ka nas/ ye shes kyi bdud rtsi bkug /zla ba yi ge gsum dang bcas pa zhu bas

bdud rtsi'i rgya mtshor gyur/ gtor sngags 'jig rten pa'i skabs ltar/ skyed dhī dhī i rda ba li ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ gsum mam bdun brjod pas 'bul/ skyed shrī he ru ka sa pa ri wā ra dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥkhaṃ ram̐ āḥhūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ shrī he ru ka sa pa ri wā ra ni rī ti hūm̐ kha āḥhūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ shrī he ru ka sa pa ri wā ra badzra puṣṭi āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ shrī he ru ka sa pa ri wā ra badzra dhā pe āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ shrī he ru ka sa pa ri wā ra badzra ā lo ke āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ shrī he ru ka sa pa ri wā ra badzra garnye āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ shrī he ru ka sa pa ri wā ra badzra ni waṃ dre āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ skyed shrī he ru ka sa pa ri wā ra badzra shabha āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ zhes chu gnyis nyer spyod sngags tsam gyis mchod/ lha mo brgyad kyis mchod pa ni/ dkar mo ri dwags mtshan ma 'dzin/ /chom rkun bdud las rgyal ba'i snod/ /ro langs ma ni chu lag ma/ /ghasma rī ni sman 'dzin zhing / /puska sī ni rdo rje'i lag /de

༄7/ /bzhin ri khrod ma ro 'dzin/ /gdol pa mo ni cang te'u brdung / /'di rnams kyis ni gtso bo mchod/ /'dod chags chen po'i rjes chags pas/ /g.yung mos sku la 'khyud pa nyid/ /oṃ go rī ge āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ tso rī rtsa āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ bai tā lī baṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ ghasma rī rghaṃ āḥhūm̐ swāhā/ oṃ puska sī paṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ sha ba rī shaṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ tsaṇḍa lī rtsa āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ ḍombi nī ḍo āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ bstod pa ni/ oṃ ma hā badzra hūm̐/ oṃ badzra gharnye āḥ ces brjod cing rdor dril bzung la/ khyod ni rnal 'byor ma yi tshogs kyis yongs su bskor/ /khyod ni nyid kyi thugs kyis khyod dgongs 'grub/ /khyod ni rgyu dang mi rgyu 'khor ba kun sgrub pa/ /snying rje'i thugs kyis sems can byang chub tu/ /kun rdzob sgyu ma byang chub sgrub pa yi/ /dgyes pa rdo rje dpal gyi he ru ka la bstod/ /mchod sbyin

gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas la/ /nad med tshe dang dbang phyug dang / /dpal dang grags dang skal pa bzang longs spyod rgya chen kun thob cing / /dbang dang mngon spyod dgra sde 'joms/ /dgar dang bsad dang dgug pa dang / /zhi dang rgyas la sogs pa yi/ /las kyi dngos grub bdag la stsol/ /dam tshig can gyis bdag la srungs/ /dngos grub kun gyi stong grogs mdzod/ /dus min 'chi dang nad rnams dang / /gdon dang bgegs rnams med par mdzod/ /rmi lam ngan dang mtshan ma ngan/ /mkha' 'gro'i byad sogs med par mdzod/ /'jig rten bde zhing lo legs dang //'bru rnams 'phel zhing chos 'phel dang / /bde legs thams cad 'byung ba dang / /yid la 'dod pa kun rdzogs mdzod/ /mthar/ bdag cag 'khor dang

༄༅/ /bcas pa rnams kyi gnas skabs su 'gal rkyen bar chad zhi ba dang / nyon mongs pa dang nye ba'i nyon mongs pa thams cad zhi nas/ bla na med pa'i sangs rgyas thob par mdzad du gsol/ /zhes gsol ba btab/ bzod gsol dang yig brgyas lhag chad bskang ba ni/ gtso bo nus pa ma mchis shing / /ma tshang ba dang lhag gyur dang / /gang yang 'gal bar gyur pa rnams/ /de kun bzod par mdzad par rigs/ /gsang sngags nyams dang bya ba nyams/ /cho ga nyams par gyur pa gang / /de yang khyod kyis bzod par mdzod/ /ces bzod par gsol/ oṃ badzra he ru ka sa twa sa ma ya/ ma nu pā la ya/ he ru ka twe no pa/ tiṣṭhadṛ ḍho me bha wa/su to ṣyo me bha wa/ a nu rakto me bha wa/ su po ṣyo me bha wa/ sarba sirnyi mme pra yasmo sarba karma su tsa me/ tsitt+waṃ shri yaḥ ku ru hūm̐/ ha ha ha ha hoḥ bha ga wān/ he ru ka

mā me muñtsa he ru ko bha ba ma hā sa ma ya sa twa āḥhūm̐ phaṭa/ ces yi ge brgya pa lan gsum bzla/ oṃ khyed kyis sems can don kun mdzad/ /rjes su mthun pa'i dngos grub stsol/ /sangs rgyas yul du gshegs nas kyang / /slar yang 'byon par mdzad du gsol/ /oṃ badzra sa twa sa ma ya/ ma nu pā la ya/ badzra sa twa twe no pa/ tiṣṭha dṛ ḍho me bha wa/ su to ṣyo me bha wa/ su po ṣyo me bha wa/ shā shwa rkyo me bha wa/ a nu rakto me bha wa/ hri da ye me a dhi tilga sarba sirnyi mme pra yasmo sarba kār ye ṣā me tsitt+waṃ shri yeḥ ku ru hūm̐/ ha ha ha ha hoḥ bha ga wān/ sarba ta thā ga ta badzra mā me mulga badzre bha ba ma hā sa ma ya sa twa āḥ zhes pa'i gur gyi yig brgya la/ muḥ btags pas ye shes pa gshegs su gso' /rdul tshon sogs la tshom bu phyag len ltar gshegasati snokṣi dam tshig pa rnams rang gi snying gar thim par //ra/ zhes mos/ ༈ gsum pa rjes kyi bya ba ni/skye( asna

༄༅/ /ye hūm̐/ zhes dgang blugs phul la/ slar yang me lha 'bar ba'i rnam pa las bzhengs te zhal phyag yongs su rdzogs par gsal bar gyur/ gtang rag tu yam shing dang mar khu sogs bsreg rdzas tshang ba lan gsum la sogs pa 'bul ba ni/ dam bzhag gi sngags/ skyes badzra phyag na la ma hā bhā ta dzwa la ya sarba bhasnri ṭa/ 〈co sarba duṣṭṛ hūm̐ phaṭa/ mthar/oṃ bo dhi bṛkṣu ya swā hā/ zhes btags pa'i sngags kyis yam shing 'bul mthar/ bdag cag dpon slob 'khor dang bcasaṃ pa'i nad gdon sdig sgrib bar du gcod pa thams cad shānti ku ru swā hā/ zhes spel tshig sbyar/ dgang blugs kyi kha la rang gi lha'i sa bon yi ge gsum gyi bar du spel ba'am/ hūm̐ 'od zer dang bcas pa dang / me lha'i zhal du ram̐ gyis mtshan par gyur/ skye( badzra a na la ma hā bhū ta dzwa la ya sarba bhasnru ku ru sarba duṣṭṛ sni phaṭa/ mthar/ skye( asna ye hūm̐/ zhes btags pas mar khu 'bul/ bdag cag

dpon slob 'khor dang bcas pa'i nad gdon sdig sgrib bar du gcod pa thams cad shānti ku ru swā hā/ de nas/ oṃ badzra a na la ma hā bhā ta dzwa la ya sarba bhallī ku ru sarba duṭaṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ mthar/ oṃ sarba pā paṃ da ha na bahṝ ya badzra sa twa su sarba pā paṃ da ha swā hā/ til lo// bdag cag dpon slob 'khore dang bcas pa'i nad gdon sdig sgrib bar du gcod pa thams cad shānti ku ru swā hā/ oṃ badzra a na la ma hā bhā ta dzwa la ya sarba bhallī ku ru sarba durto hūm̐ phaṭa/ mthar/ oṃ badzra pus ya swā hā/ 'bras ma chag pa'o// bdag cag dpon slob 'khor dang bcas pa'i nad gdon sdig sgrob bar du gcod pa thams cad shānti ku ru swā hā/ oṃ badzra a na la ma hā bhū ta dzwa la ya sarba bhasnru ku ru sarba duṣṭṛ hūm̐ phaṭa/ mthar/ oṃ sarba saspa de swā hā/ zas mchog go/ bdag cag dpon slob 'khor dang bcas pa'i nad gdon

༄7/ /sdig sgrib bar du gcod pa thams cad shānti ku ru swā hā/ oṃ badzra a na la ma hā dhwa ta dzwa la ya sarba bhasnru ku ru sarba duṣṭṛ hūm̐ phaṭa/ mthar/ oṃ badzra bī dzā ya swā hā/ 'bras so ba'o// bdag cag dpon slob 'khor dang bcas pa'i nad gdon sdigo sgrib bar du gcod pa thams cad shānti ku ru swā hā/ oṃ badzra a na la ma hā dhwa ta dzwa la ya sarba bhallī ku ru sarba duṣṭṛ hūm̐ phaṭa/ mthar/ oṃ ma hā be ga ya swā hā/ nas so// bdag cag dpon slob 'khor dang bcas pa'i nad gdon sdig sgrib b.re du gcod pa thams cad shānti ku ru swā hā/ oṃ badzra a na la ma hā dhwa ta dzwa la ya sarba bhasmṛ ku ru sarba duX hūm̐ phaṭa/ mthar/ oṃ ma hā ba lā ya swā hā/ mon sran gre'u 'o// bdag cag dpon slob 'khor dang bcas pa'i nad gdon sdig treeb bar du gcod pa thams cad/ shāX ku ru swā hā/ oṃ badzra a na

la ma hā dhwa ta dzwa la ya sarba bhasmṛ ku ru sarba duṣṭṛ hūm̐ phaṭa/ mthar/ oṃ badzra ghasma ri swā hā/ gro'// bdag cag dpon slob 'khor dang bcas pa'i nad gdon sdig sgrib bar sdadu gcod pa thams cad shānti ku ru swā hā/ oṃ badzra a na la ma hā dhwa ta dzwa la ya sarba bhasnru ku ru sarba duṣṭṛ sni phaṭa/ mthar/ oṃ badzra ā yu ṣe swā hā /dūrba'o// bdag cag dpon slob 'khor dang bcas pa'i nad gdon sdig sgrib bar sdu gcod pa thams cad shānti ku ru swā hā/ oṃ badzra a na la ma hā bhā ta dzwa la ya sarba bhasmri ku ru sarba duṭwāṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ mthar/ oṃ badzra a pra ti ha ta badzā ya swā hā/ ku sha'o// bdag cag dpon slob 'khor dang bcas pa'i nad gdon sdig sgrib bar du gcod pa thams cad shānti ku ru swā hā/ oṃ badzra a na la ma hā bhū ta dzwa la ya sarba bhasmṛ ku ru sarba duṣṭṛ hūm̐ phaṭa/ mthar/ oṃ badzra yadzñā ya swā hā/ u sla ra'o//

༄7/ /bdag cag dpon slob 'khor dang bcas pa'i nad gdon sdig sgrib bar du gcod pa thams cad shānti ku ru swā hā/ oṃ badzra a na la ma hā dhwa ta dzwa la ya sarba bhasnru ku ru sarba duṭaṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ mthar/ oṃ bo dhi bṛkṣu ya swā hā/ byang chub shing ngo // bdag cag dpon slob 'khor dang bcas pa'i nad gdon sdig sgrib bar du gcod pa thams cad shānti ku ru swā hā/ oṃ badzra a na la ma hā dhwa ta dzwa la ya sarba bhasnru ku ru sarba duṣṭṛ hūm̐ phaṭa/ mthar/ oṃ badzra la tā ya swā hā/blakṣa'o// bdag cag dpon slob 'khor dang bcas pa'i nad gdon sdig sgrib b.re du gcod pa thams cad shānti ku ru swā hā/ oṃ badzra a na la ma hā bhā ta dzwa la ya sarba bhallī ku ru sarba duṭwāṃ sni phaṭa/ mthar/ oṃ badzra ku be rā ya swā hā/ n+ya gro dha'o// bdag cag dpon slob 'khor dang bcas pa'i nad gdon sdig sgribaṃ bar du

gcod pa thams cad shānti ku ru swā hā/ oṃ badzra a na la ma hā dhwa ta dzwa la ya sarba bhallī ku ru sarba duṣṭṛ hūm̐ phaṭa/ mthar/ oṃ sa hā ka rā ya swā hā/ a mra ste shing lnga po dngos su mi 'byor bas 'o ma can shing gang yang rung ba de dag tu mos nas 'bul/ bdagi cag dpon slob 'khor dang bcas pa'i nad gdon sdig sgrib bar du gcod pa thams cad shānti ku ru swā hā/ oṃ badzra a na la ma hā dhwa ta dzwa la ya sarba bharghaṃ ku ru sarba duṣṭṛ sni phaṭa/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ shing tog go/ bdag cag dpon slob 'khor dang bcas pa'i nad gdon sdig sgrib bar du gcod pa khrims cad shānti ku ru swā hā/ oṃ badzra a na la ma hā bhā ta dzwa la ya sarba bhallī ku ru sarba duṭwāṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/bdud rtsi lnga'o// bdag cag dpon slob 'khor dang bcas pa'i nad gdon sdig sgrib bar du gcod pa thoms cad shānti ku ru swā hā/ oṃ badzra a na la ma hā bhū

༄7/ /ta dzwa la ya sarba bhasmṛ ku ru sarba duṣṭṛ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ gos zung ngo / bdag cag dpon slob 'khor dang bcas pa'i nad gdon sdig sgrib— bar du gcod pa thams cad shānti ku ru swā hā/ chu gnyis nyer spyod kyis mchod pa ni/ oṃ pra wa ra satpā ram̐ pra twetstsha swā hā/ zhes mchod yon dang / oṃ sarba pā paṃ da ha na bahṝ ya badzra sa twa su sarba pā paṃ da ha swā hās zhabs bsil dbul/ skyed badzra pursha āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ skyed badzra dhu pe āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ skyed badzra gandhe āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ skye( badzra ni wibye āḥhūm̐ swā hā/oṃ badzra ā lo ke āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ badzra shabha āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ bstod pa ni/ 'jig rten dbang phyug tshangs dbang mgon gyi sras/ /me lha'i rgyal po ḍā kis dbang bskur ba/ tags rab mchog gis nyon mongs ma lus bsreg /'dzin byed me lha nyid la rnam par 'dud/ /ces bstod/ oṃ badzra he ru ka sa twa sa ma ya/ ma nu

pā la ya/ he ru ka twe no pa/ tiṣṭhadṛ ḍho me bha wa/ su tostso me bha wa/ su pokhyo me bha wa/ a nu rakto me bha wa/ sarba sirnyi mme pra yasmo sarba karma su tsa me/ tsitt+waṃ shri yaḥku ru hūm̐/ ha ha ha ha hoḥ bha ga wān/ he ru ka mā me muñtsa he ru ko bha ba ma hā sa ma ya sa twa āḥhūm̐ phaṭa/ ma 'byor pa dang nyams pa dang / /gang yang bdag rmongs blo yis ni/ /bgyis pa dang ni bgyid stsal ba/ /de kun mgon pos bzod par mdzod// ces bzod par gsol nas/ bdag gi don dang gzhan gyi don/ /bsgrubs kyis bsreg bya za ba gshegs/ /ji lta'i dus bzhin slar byon te/ /bdag gi dngos grub thams cad bsgrubs/ /zhes pas/ me lha ye shes pa rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs/ dam tshig pa he badzra yab yum du gyur pa rang gi thugs kar thim par gyur/ zhes mos/ me de long yod na ma shi'i bar du dkrug brdal mi bya bar bzhag long

da༅༅ med na 'o ma dang dri'i chu la sogs pas me gzhil te thal sol rnams bum par blugs la/ rgya mtshor 'bab pa'i chu klung du dor/ bum pa de nyid chu gtsang mas bkang la slar khyer nas sbyin sreg khang par bsangs gtor bya zhing / las kyi rjes mi mngon par bya'o/ ༈ /gnyis pa rgyas pa'i sbyin sreg ni/ cho ga'i spyi 'gros zhi ba'i sbyin sreg sor bzhag la/ khyad par gyi chos ni/ gur gum sogs kyis byugs pa'i stegs bur/thab dbus 'khor lo'i lte bar rin chen/ shar du rdo rje/ lhor 'khor lo sogs dang / rdor phreng tshab rin chen phreng ba/ grwa bzhir rin po che 'bar ba/ gzhi ser po/ bcad tshon dmar ser/ bud shing 'bras bu can gyi shing gi dbus kyi cha las byung bas gru bzhir brtsig /me dge 'dun gyi bsro khang dang rgyal po'i g.yos khang nags tshal rin po che rnams las byung ba/ gdan dang chas gos rgyan sogs ser po/ snod kyi dbyibs dang gtor ma gru bzhi/yam shing bud shing dang rgyu 'dra ba khru gang ba/ gur gum 'o ma mar gyis spags pa/ mchod bsreg rdzas gzhan zhi ba ltar la/ khyad par rdzas/ swā li dmar po/ mngar gsum/ zho/ sbrang rtsi mar sbyar/ bilnga/ ge sar rnam gsum

sogs 'du bya/ tshe bsod phun tshogs rgyas pa'i ched du dga' zhing tshims pa'i bsam pas snga dro'i dus su kha byang du phyogs la khri'u'i steng du bzang po'i stabs kyis 'khod/ thab bskyed skabs/ rgyas pa'i thab 2/nga lnga/ bzhi ser po zhes bsgyur/ me lha las bzhi kar sku mdog dmar po las bsgyur mi dgos/ ku sha rtse byang bstan/ spel tshig bdag cag dpon :snab 'ashesar dang bcas pa'i tshe bsod dpal 'byor spangs rtogs kyi yon tan thams cad puṣṭi ku ru po ṣaṭa/ zhes sbyar/ dkyil lubor pa'i gtor 'bul mjug gsol gdab ni/ bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi gnas skabs su tshe bsod dpal 'byor snyan grags mnga' thang thams cad rgyas pa dang / nyams dang rtogs pa legs pa'i yon tan thams cad gong du 'phel zhing / bla na med pa'i sangs rgyas thob par mdzad du gsol/ /zhes sbyar/ rab gnas kyi skabs lta bur dge legs kyi yon to myur du skyed pa'i rten 'brel du 'o thug sgrub pa'i phyag

ra༅༅ bzhes ltar na/ me lha'i rjes chog skabs rin po che'i snod gtsang ma dris byugs/ me tog gi phreng bas bcings pa'i nang du hūṃ yig las byung ba'i zhal zas ro brgya nus pa stong ldan tu mos la/ 'bras ma grugs pa dang / mar/ sbrang rtsi/ ka ra rnams 'o ma dang sbyar ba blugs gzar gyis blugs la thab nang lcags sgyed lta bur btsugs la bskol/ snying po'i mthar/ skyed di bya asni sa mā dhi dhya na bṛ ṇa ne swā hā/zhes btags pa bzlas te me lha la mchod cing / rang gis rol/ gzhan la'ang dngos grub tu 'brim pa ni tsā ru'i bza' ba zhes bya'o/ ༈ /gsum pa dbang bi/ sbyin sreg gi khyad chos ni/ tsandan dmar po dang sindha ras byugs pa'i stegs bur/ thab dbus 'khor lo'i lte bar lcags kyu/ rtsibs bzhir rdo rje rin chen padma ral gri/ kha khyer pad phreng / grwa bzhir chu skyes kyis mtshan pa'i lcags kyu/ gzhi dmar po/ bcad tshon skrug nag /bud shing mngar zhing skyur la 'bras bu dmar po chags pa'i yal ga'i cha las byung bas zla gam du brtsig /me las dkyil du byung ba'am smad tshong ma'i khyim nas byung bas byas/ gdan dang chas gos rgyan sogs dmar po/ snod kyi dbyibs dang

gtor ma zla gam/ yams shing bud shing gi rgyu las sor brgyad pa dri dang mar khus byugs/ khyad par rdzas/til dmar po/ pri yang ku/ utpal sogs me tog dang 'bras bu dmar po'i rigs nye bar bsdog /chags shing dbang du sdud pa'i bsam pas dgongs mo'i dus su kha nub tu phyogs la padma'am rdo rje'i skyil krung gis 'khod/ thab bskyed skabs/ dbang gi thab khu/nga zla gam dmar 21/ zhes bsgyur/ ku sha rtse nub bstan/ spel tshigabadag cag dpon slob 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyis las dang dngos grub lha 'dre mi gsum thams cad bā shaṃ ku ru shrīḥdzaḥ/ zhes sbyar/ dkyil 'bar pa'i gsol gdab ni/ bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyis lha 'dre mi gsum/ zas nor longs spyod/ las dang dngos grub/ 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dge legs kyi yon tan thams cad dbang du gyur nas/ bla na med pa'i sangs rgyas thob par mdzad du gsol/ /zhes sbyar ro/ ༈ /bzhi pa drag po'i sbyin sreg gi khyad

da༅༅ chos ni/ dug khrag gis byugs pa'i stegs bur drag po'i 'khor lo'i lte bar ral gri/ kha khyer ral gri'i phreng ba/ gru bzhir ral gri me 'bar/ gzhi nag po/ bcad tshon mthing ga /bud shing tsher ma can dang dug shing gi rtsa ba'i cha las byung bas gru gsum du brtsig /me rdo lcags gtsubs pa'am shan pa dang dur khrod las byung ba/ gdan dang chas gos sogs nag po/ rus pa dang dur khrod kyi rgyan gdag /snod kyi dbyibs dang gtor ma gru gsum/ yams shing bud shing gi rgyu las sor bcu pa dug khrag thal chen gyis byugs pa/ khyad par gyi rdzas khrag chen rus chen rnam snang / bong bu'i sbang dang spu/ khyi'i brun dang spu dang sen mo 'bru mar gyis byugs pa/ mar nag tshan mo sogs 'du bya/ ngo bo snying rje rnam pa zhe sdang gi sems kyis srod kyi dus su kha lhor phyogs la bsgrub bya'i gzugs kyi brang ngam der brtags pa'i sra ba'i stan la tsog pur rkang pas rkang pa mnan la 'khod/mchod bsreg rdzas g.yas g.yon go ldog tu bsham/ dgang blugs bzung stabs sogs snga ma gsum las go ldog tu bya/ thab bskyed/ drag lnga'ire thab khu/nga sdi/ garda/ma nag 21/ zhes dang / ku sha rtse mo lhor bstan

g.yon bskor/ spel tshig bdag cag dpon slob 'khor dang bcas pa la gnod cing 'tshe bar byed pa'i dgra bgegs thams cad mā ra ya phaṭa/ zhes sbyar/ dkyil lubor pa'i gsol gdab/ bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa rnams la gnod cing 'tshe ba dang / thar pa byang chub sgrub pa la bar du gcod pa'i dgra bgegs bdud bzhi log par 'dren pa thams cad ming gi lhag ma tsam yang mi dmigs par myur du tshar bcad pa dang / bla na med pa'i sangs rgyas thob par mdzad du gsol//zhes dang me dug chus bsad/ thal ba lam rgya gram du mnan pa'am rlung chen la bskur ro/ /gzhan yang las bzhi ka'i lag len bsham bkod dmigs gnad sogs gsang ba spyi'i cho ga shes pas 'phrul lo/ /gnyis pa 'phros rdo/na tu smos pa ni/ sasbu ṭi'i rgyud kyi dgongs pa rin chen 'bar ba las/ las thams cad pa'i sbyin sreg kyang zhar byung du bstan te/ de'i thab kyi tshad dbyibs sogs zhi ba dang mthun cing / kha shar du lta/ bsreg rdzas

da༅༅ 'dod gsol sogs las bzhi ka spel bas 'grub/ yab bkar dngos su bshad pa 'dis/ yum bka' bdag med ma dang gur rigs bsdus la'ang lha sngags bsgyur ba tsam gyis 'grub pa yin te/de ltar na phyi'i sbyin sreg ji ltar bya ba'i tshul bshad zin to/ /rnal 'byor pa rdzogs pa'i rim pa la gzhol ba rnams kyis gtso bor nyams su len pa dang / bskyed rim pa dag gis kyang zhar byung du bgyid par bya ba ni/ bza' btung la longs spyod pa'i tshe/ de nas rnal 'byor pa rnams kyis/ /chu gnas su ni ram̐ las kyang / /'bar ba'i khung du 'od 'bar bsam/ /de nang khaṃ las chu skyes gdan/ /de steng lha yi dkyil 'khor bsam/ /kha ni ham khung rab bsam te/ /lag gnyis nyu las rdo rje yi/ /gzar bu gnyis su yang dag bsgom/ /zhes dang / gzar bur bdud rtsi blangs nas ni/ /'bar ba'i nang du bsregs par bya/ /zhes ḍombi pas gsungs pa ltar bsgoms te nang gi sgyin sreg go/ /dpal saskru ṭi'i le'u drug pa'i rab tu byed pa gsum pa las/ mgo bo'i thod pa nyid kyang ni/ /bsreg rdzas kyi ni snod du gsungs/ /glugs gzar ro mar bshad pa ste/ /snying ga'i 'khor lo rkyang ma dag/

dgang gzar zhes byar yang dag brjod/ /thab khung lte ba'i dkyil 'khor du/ /las kyis rlung gis bskyod pa yi/ /tshangs pa'i me ni sum mdor gnas/ /zhes gtum mo 'bar 'dzag gi tshul la sbyin sreg tu gsungs pa dang /dpal phyag rgya chen po thig le'i rgyud kyi le'u bcu gcig pa las/ lte ba'i gnas na tshul yod la/ /tshul gyi mtha' na gsang pad do/ /de ru rang 'bar gyi ni rlung / /bskor ba byas nas ngal bso ste/ /dbang po gnyis ni sbyor ba yis/ /rlung gi me ni sbar ba'o/ /mar yod pa ni steng 'khor lo/ /de ni mar snod ces su dran/ /haṃ ni blugs gzar zhes su bshad/ /dgang gzar 'di ru rdo rje bstan/ /āoṃ khung bha ga zhes su bshad/ /'bru ni dbang po lnga ru dran//yams shing phung po zhes byar bstan/ /byang chub sems ni mar du bsreg /ces las rgya'i rnal 'byor gyi sreg blugs bya bar gsungs pa dag nyams su len pa ni gsang ba'i sbyin sreg go /dpal bde ba dam pa rtog pa'i rgyud las/ rnam par mi rtog sems nyid gang / /thab kyi sgra yis mtshon pa yin/ /rnam par dben pa'i me dbus su/ /gzugs la sogs pa'i phung po lnga/ /sems nyid bud shing gyur ba yis/ /ma lus pa rnams sbyin sreg bya//

da༅༅ gzugs la sogs pa'i dngos rnams gang / /bud shing du ni rab tu bshad/ /mar ni 'di yi zla ba'i rgyun/ /phung po khams dang skye mched sogs/ /khams gsum ma lus gnyis su ni/ /dbyer med shes rab me la ni/ /dgang blugs sbyin sreg dbul bar bya/ /zhes rgyas par gsungs pa'i don la rnal 'byor du bya ba ni de kho na nyid kyi spyin sreg ste/ de dag gi dgos pa ni/ rdo rje gur las/ 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa mtha' dag cho ga 'dis tshims pa'i tshul shin tu rgyas par gsungs pa dang / kha sbyor las/ sbyin sreg gis ni lha rnams tshims/ /tshims par gyur las dngos grub stsol/ /gang zhig sngags kyi lhag chad dag /de kun sbyin sreg gis ni dgang / /zhes dang / ye shes thig le las/ de bas kun nas 'bad pa yis/ /rnam pa thams cad mchog gi rgyur/ /mchod sbyin sbyin sreg gtor ma bya/ /bsod nams tshogs ni 'phel phyir dang / /sems can phan 'dod de dag bya/ /zhes dang / phyag chen thig le las/ de yis mkha' 'gro ma rnams dang / /gzhan yang rnal 'byor ma mo rnams/ /gang zhig yid la ci bsam pa/ /dngos grub chen po mtha' yas ster/ /re ba thams cad

'grub byed pa/ /de lta'i sbyin sreg bdag gis gsungs/ /zhes 'byung ngo / /gdug pa'i 'byung po brngan te 'phral rkyen gyi/ /skyabs su re ba mur 'dug grub mtha' yin/ /rdo rje 'chang gis rgyud las rab gsungs pa/ /'di tsam lag len bgyid pa'i skal dman pa/ /da lta'i skye ngan phal cher bya sla ba'i/ /don chen bor nas bya dga' don chung ba/ /'bad pas sgrub pa'i blo ngan spangs nas kyang / /'khrul med lugs bzang 'di la 'jug par shog/ dpal dgyes pa rdo rje'i las bzhi'i sbyin sreg gi rim pa rgyud dang rin chen 'bar ba sogs rgya gzhung dgongs don/ mar rngog gi gdams ngag gis brgyan pa spyan snga ba thams cad mkhyen pas rtsa bar mdzad pa nyid lag len dang 'don bya gsal bar phyes te/ dpal spungs kyi gtsug lag khang du karma ngag dbang yon tan rgya mtshos bris pa dge legs 'phel// // zhes pa 'di yang wa ṇa badzra bisdi'i dpe mdzod khang du par du bsgrubs pa'o//sarba maṅga lo//

da༅༅/ /sbyin bsreg deb bcu gcig gi mdun la/ snokṣimachod sil 'og tu las rdor pas spos sna thogs/ slob dpon yar byon dkyil 'khor mdun yig brgya brjod bzhin mchod yon sbreng / spos thogs te/ rten ni rdul tshon dkyil 'khor la/ /bzhugs pa'i brten pa dkyil 'khor pa/ /thab kyi dbus kyi dkyil 'khor du/ /deng 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol/ /zhes snyan gsan dbab/ oṃ de wa pi tsu badzra hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ go ri ge āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ tso rī rtsa āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ bee tā lī baṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ ghasma rī rghaṃ āḥhūm̐ swāhā/ oṃ puska sī paṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ sha ba rī shaṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ tsaṇḍa lī rtsa āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ ḍombi ni ḍo āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ ces gtso 'bor so so'i snying po brjod pas me tog lha yi ngo bor mos te/ bkur bsti bcas sbyin bsreg khang par spyan drangs nas/ thab la g.yas bskor gyis shar du 'khod mthar/ mchod sil bzhag phe phe sgras bskul nas thab kyi steng mkhar bzhugs la/ skyes sku/ ri

rga āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ sogs lha mo brgyad kyis mchod/ oṃ de wa pi tsu badzra hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ badzra sa ma ya st+waṃ/ oṃ go ri haṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ sogs gtso 'bor so so'i sngags la badzra sa ma ya st+waṃ sbyar ba'i me tog g.yas bskor gyis thab tu dor/ mthar/ thab kyi padma'i dbus sdo/ bzhugs par sdo/ra/ slob dpon mar bzhugs/ dkyus la 'jug go/ snokṣisbyin bsreg deb zhe gcig gi rgyab la/slob dpon yar bzhengs la/ me tog thab nas len tshul gyis/ skyed de wa pi tsu badzra sogs gtso 'khor so so'i sngags la/ sa ma ya st+waṃ/ zhes btags pa gong ltar brjod la/ sngar dor rim bzhin blangs rjes/dam tshig pa rnams rang gi snying gar thim par gyur/ mchod sil 'og tshom bu yar sgrub pa'i khang par spyan drangs te/ dkyil 'khor la g.yas bskor gsum gyis mdun 'khod/ mthar/ rdul tshon gyis ni dkyil 'ashesar la/ /lha tshogs thams cad thim par gyur/ /tshom bu'i me tog dkyil 'khor la gtor te/ mar byon gdan la bzhugs/ mchod sil bzhag dkyus la 'jug go//

༄tsho/ /na mo gu ru he badzrī ya/ 'dir dbang bskur ba'i sta gon gyi thog mar sbyin sreg sta gon nges par dgos kyang / bsreg blugs rgyas pa lag len cung zad dka' ba la bsnyad nas gzhung don gtan nas 'dor ba la phan pa'i phyir du khyer bde ba'i sbyin sreg bsdus pa ni/ zhi ba'i thab spyi 'tshams sam/ cis kyang mi 'grub na sa stegs 'thas par bcag la 'bru tshom dgu bkod cing bud shing brtsig /mchod rdzas chu gnyis nyer spyod/ bsreg rdzas mar khu yam shing ni med du

༄7/ /mi rung la/ gzhan dag ci 'byor tsam dang til yungs bkod/ ku sha'i chun po brgyad 'du bya/ bdag bskyed bum pa sta gon khrus dang byur bsal ba zin nas slob dpon lha'i nga rgyal ma dor ba de yis/ skyes badzra yakta/ hūm̐/ zhes rdo rje'i rtse mos bsangs gtor bya/ thab bsangs sbyang / lha/nga pa'i ngang las me thab rin po che'i gzhal yas khang du gyur/ ku sha'i rtse mo thab kyi shar nas brtsams te bkram la/

skyed badzra satwa āḥ zhes lan bzhi brjod/ skye( badzra dzwa la hūm̐/ zhes me sbar/ skye( āḥhūm̐/ gis rlung g.yab/ skye'o asna ye hūm̐ gis mar gyi dgang blugs gsum gyis me gso/ thab kyi dbus sdo/ baXrsham ldan 'das dgyes pa rdo rje yab yum 'od du zhu ba las me lha dkar po zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa/ g.yas gnyis mchog sbyin dang bgrang phreng / g.yon gnyis spyi blugs dang dbyug to 'dzin pa/ drang srong gi cha lugs can 'khor mang pos bskor ba/ rang 'od kyi rig ma la 'khyud pa'i gnas gsum 'bru gsum las 'od 'phros/ ye shes pa spyan drangs/ phyag rgya spyi ltar byas la/ oṃ e hye hi ma hā dhwa ta de ba ṛ ṣi di dza satta māṃ/ kṛ hi tā a hu ti/ ā ha rusmin sanni hi to bha badṛ shya dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ sa ma ya st+waṃ a haṃ/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ gis bsangs gtor bya/ puspro nas/ sum̐ lo ke'i bar gyis mchod/ go rī dzaḥ/ tso rī hūm̐/ bee tā li bam̐/ ghasma rī hoḥ/ dam

da༅༅/ /tshig pa dang gnyis rna/ med par sdo/ra/ chu gnyis nyer spyod sngags tsam gyis mchod/ de nas mar khu dang rtem shing nas bzung bsreg rdzas gang yod sngags 'di kho nas 'bul te/—oṃ badzra a na la ma hā dhwa ta dzwa la sarba duzhun bhasmin ku ru hūm̐ phaṭa/ bdag cag dpon slob 'khor dang bcas pa'i sdig sgrib bar chad thams cad shānti ku ru swā hā/ zhes pas grangs gadro 'os mthar mar gyi dgang blugs gcig 'bul/ me lha'i lho ba yangs shing rgya che ba'i dbus su pad nyi bdud bzhi'i gdan la skad cig gis bcom ldan 'das dgyes pa rdo rje sku mdog nag po zhal brgyad pa/ phyag bcu drug pa/ zhabs bzhi pa/ rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan cing yum bdag med ma dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ 'dab ma brgyad la go rī lha mo brgyad dang bcas pa/ de dag gi mig tu oṃ/ rna bar dwo/ sna la māṃ/ lcer ram̐/ dpral bar i/ snying gar a/

dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūm̐ sngon pos mtshan par gyur/ /thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas ye shes kyi 'khor 31 sogs nas/ snang ba mtha' yas kyis dbu brgyan/ bar sgrub thabs ltar/ snying po sogs la 'bru gsum btags pas bdud rtsi 'bul/ mchod bstod cung zad rgyas pa'am/ dkyus su sgrub thabs ltar/oṃ sarba saṃ rbesgo dha sogs dang / dkar mo ri dwags sogs kyis mchod/ rdor dril bzung la/ khyod ni rnal 'byor sogs kyis bstod/ de nas bsreg rdzas 'bul ba ni/ de ba pi tsu la/ oṃ asna ye swā hā/ dang / skyed kres dhi bṛkṣu ya swā hā/ so sor btags pas mar khu dang yam shing 'bul/ rdzas gzhan so sor 'bul ba sbyin sreg rgyas pa'i gzhung ltar ram/ dkyus su snying po la/ skye( sarba pā paṃ da ha na badzā ya swā hā/ btags pas til lan grangs ci nus 'bul zhing / rdzas gzhan gang 'byor phyogs gcig bsres pa/ snying po'i mthar 'bru gsum btags pa kho nas 'bul/ lha mo brgyad la/ skyes sku/ rikhro haṃ āḥhūm̐

ra༅༅/ /swā hā/ sogs kyi mthar mar khu yam shing til sngags dang 'bru gsum btags pa lan gsum mam bdun re 'bul/ spel tshig gong ltar sbyar/ mthar mchod bstod mdor bsdus dang / bcesam ldan 'das dpal dgyes pa rdo rje'i lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyis bdag cag dpon slob 'khor dang bcas pa'i nad gdon sdig sgrib bar chad mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad bsal zhing bla na med pa'i byang chub thob pa'i phrin las mdzad du gsol/ /zhes 'dod don gsol/ yig brgya dang / ma 'byor ba sogs kyis bzod par gsol/ gur gyi yig brgya'i mthar/ muḥ btags pas/ dkyil 'ashesar pa 'od du zhu nas rang gi snying gar thim par gyur/ rjes me lha la/ mar khu sngon tu 'gro ba'i bsreg rdzas ci 'gror/ badzra a na la'i sngags kyis gsum mam bdun sogs phul/ drang srong me lha 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyis bdag cag dpon slob 'khor dang bcas pa'i nad

gdon sdig sgrib bar chad mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad bsal zhing dge ba'i phyogs thams cad yar ngo'i zla ba bzhin 'phel zhing rgyas par mdzad du gsol/ /yig brgya brjod/ bdag gi don dang gzhan gyi don/ /bsgrubs kyi bsreg bya za ba gshegs/ /ji bzhin dus su slar byon la// bdag gis dngos grub thob par mdzod/ /badzra muḥ ye shes kyi me lha shar lhor gshegs/ dam tshig pa he badzra gyur pa rang gi snying gar thim par gyur/ bsngo smon bkra shis dang me thal ba sogs rjes kyi bya ba'i tshul spyi ltar ro/ /rgyas pa lag tu mi lon cing / /bsdus pa'ang byed tshul mi shes pas/ /de lta'i sman tu 'di 'gyur nas/ /tshod yod nyes pa dang bral shog/ ces pa ni rngog rdo rje seng ges mdzad pa'i dkyil chog nyi ma 'bum gyi gzi brjid las ji ltar 'byung ba nyid go bder bsdebs pa ste/ dwa ri drwa blo gros mtha' yas kyi sug las so/ /dge legs 'phel// //
bcom ldan 'das dgyes pa rdo rje'i rgyun gyi rnal 'byor dran pa gcig pa bzhugs so

༄༅/ /na mo badzra dha rā ya/ /sna tshogs srid zhi'i sgyu 'phrul pa/ /bde chen gcig pu'i gar mkhan ni/ /bla ma dgyes mdzad he ru kar/ /btud nas rgyun gyi nyams len 'chad/ /dpal dgyes pa rdo rje'i rnal 'byor rgyun khyer du bya bar 'dod la/ rgyas par mi lcog pa dag gis nyams len tu bya ba'i rim pa ni/ lus ngag yid gsum gyi zhen pa zlog pa'i bskyed bzlas rdzogs pa'i rim pa gsum gyi dang po la/ bla ma dag pa tshad med bsgom/ /stong nyid sa bon gzugs rdzogs pa/ /yi

༄tsho/ /ge dgod cing dam ye bsre/ /dbang bskur ting 'dzin rnam dag go/ /zhes pa ltar chos bcus sgo nas nyams su len dgos te/ de'ang grub na byin rlabs bcas bdud rtsi myang ba ni/ tshul bzhin bsgrubs pa'i ril bu yod na lcer bzhag/ med na nang mchod byin gyis brlab ste/ rang gi snying gar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ zla ba'i 'od ltar dkar ba'i hūm̐ las 'od zer dkar po 'phros/ lus

thams cad gang / sdig pa dang sgrib pa ma lus pa sbyangs nas stong par gyur/ ngag tu/ hūṃ/ zhes brjod pas/ bdag nyid las kyi he ru ka zhal gcig phyag gnyis par gsal ba'i spyi bor zla ba'i steng du oṃ dkar po/ lkog mar padma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i steng du āḥdamar po/ snying gar nyi ma'i steng du hūm̐ sngon pos mtshan par gyur/ oṃ badzra a mṛ ta kuṇḍa lī ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭa ces bsangs/ oṃ swa bhā wa shuddhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā ba shuddhi3 haṃ gis sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las yam̐ las rlung /ram̐ las me/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ las thod pa'i sgyed bu gsum gyi steng du/ a las thod pa yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du/ hūm̐ sum̐ e dzī khaṃ/ lī māṃ māṃ tt+waṃ māṃ las skyes pa'i bdud rtsi lnga dang / sha lngar gyur/ ha hoḥhrīḥ zhes brjod pas/ tha mal pa'i kha dog dang dri dang nus pa phrogs shing / rlung g.yos/ me sbar/ bcud rnams

༄༅/ /bskol bas/ nyi ma 'char kha lta bu'i mdog can gyi rlangs pa hūṃ las rdo rje kha ṭwāṃ ga 'bar bar gyur pa zhu zhing / de nyid du lan gsurme lhung bas dri ma thams cad dang bral ba shel ltar gsal ba'i dam tshig gi bdud rtsis gang ba'i steng du/ oṃ las byung ba'i zla ba kha chod kyi tshul du gnas pa la g.yas skor du ā li g.yon skor du kā li yongs su gyur pa'i oṃ āḥhūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros/phyogs bcur bzhugs pa'i rdo rje 'dzin pa thams cad kyi thugs ka nas/ ye shes kyi bdud rtsi bkug /zla ba yi ge gsum dang bcas pa zhu bas bdud rtsi'i rgya mtshor gyur/ zhes byin gyis slabs pa'i bdud rtsi g.yon pa'i mtheb srin sbyar bas myang bar bya/ mi 'grub na/ skyes yi/ཿhūm̐ gis bdud rtsi ril bu lcer bzhag pa bcas grub na legs pa'i yan lag go/ skyes ralta/ ralta/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ lan gsum/ bdag dang gnas dang

rnal 'byor bsrung bar gyur/ he badzra/ rang nyid skad cig gis dgyes pa rdo rje yum bdag med ma dang mnyam par sbyor ba'i skur gyur pa'i snying khar hrīḥlas padma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa'i dbus su/ ra las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor dmar po/ de'i dbus su hūm̐ sngon po 'od zer lnga dang bcas pa/ hūm̐ gi 'od zer gyis bcom ldan 'das 'khor gyi lha mos mchod pa byed bzhin pa dang bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi shar khyams na rang gi bla ma bzhugs pa mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs/ snying ga'i sa bon las 'phros pa'i go rī la sogs pa'i lha mo brgyad kyis mchod par gyur/ dkar mo ri dwags mtshan ma 'dzin//chom rkun bdud las rgyal ba'i snod/ /ro langs ma ni chu lag ma/ /ghasma rī ni sman 'dzin zhing / /puska sī ni rdo rje'i lag /de bzhin ri khrod ma ro 'dzin//

༄7/ /gdol pa mo ni cang te'u brdung / /'di rnams kyis ni gtso bo mchod/ /'dod chags chen po'i rjes chags pas/ /g.yung mos sku la 'byud pa nyid/ /oṃ go rī rga āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ tso rī rtsa āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ bee tā lī baṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ ghasma rī rghaṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ puska sī paṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ sha ba rī shaṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ tsaṇḍa lī rtsa ā hūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ ḍombi nī ḍo āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su mchi/ /sdig pa thams cad so sor bshags/ /'gro ba'i dge la rjes yi rang / /sangs rgyas byang chub yid kyis bzung / /sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs mchog la/ /byang chub bar du skyabs su mchi/ /byang chub sems su 'di bgyis te/ /bdag dang gzhan don rab sgrub phyir/ /bdag gis byang chub sems mchog bskyed/ /e ma'o sems can kun 'gron gnyer//

byang chub spyod mchog mdzad bzhin spyad/ /'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas shog /he badzra maṇḍal muḥ tshangs pa'i gnas bzhi bsgom pa ni/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan par gyur cig /sdug bsngal dang sdug bsngal gyi rgyu dang bral bar gyur cig /sdug bsngal med pa'i bde ba dam pa dang mi bral bar gyur cig /nye ring chags sdang gnyis dang bral ba'i btang snyoms chen po la gnas par gyur cig /ces pa'i don dran par byas la nan to tu bsgom mo// rang gi snying ga'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros pas/ snod kyi 'jig rten bcud kyi sems can la bsdu/ de rnams rang gi lus la thim zhing / lus kyang snying ga'i padma 'dab brgyad la thim ste rim pa bzhin tu nyi ma dang / hūm̐ yang zhabs kyu khog pa zla tshes thig le'i bar du 'dus nas/ nā da'i rnam par gnas pa las stong pa nyid kyi rang sgra

༄7/ /byung bar gyur/ oṃ shā n+ya tā dzñā na badzra swa dhwa wa ātma ko3haṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las padma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar tshangs pa/ dbang po/ nye dbang / drag po ste bdud bzhi gan rkyal du gnas pa'i snying gar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor/ de'i steng du nam mkhar gnas pa'i nā da de nyid hūm̐ mthing nag tu gyur/ de las 'od zer 'phro 'dus rdo rje mthing nag hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ de yongs su gyur pa las/ bcom ldan 'das dgyes pa rdo rje sku mdog nag po zhal brgyad dang ldan pa'i rtsa ba'i zhal nag po/ g.yas zhal kunda ltar dkar ba/ g.yon zhal dmar zhing cher 'jigs pa/ lhag ma g.yas zhal gnyis dang g.yon zhal gnyis bung ba ltar nag cing / steng zhal dud kha gtsigs pa'i nyams can/ spyan nyi shu rtsa bzhi phye ba/ dbu skra ser po gyen tu brdzes pa/ dpral ba'i steng

du thod pa lnga lnga'i phreng ba dang / sna tshogs rdo rje spyi bor 'dzin pa/ zhal nas hūm̐ gi sgra spro zhing / 'khor lo/ snyan cha/ mgul rgyan/ phyag zhabs kyi gdu bu/ ska rags/ thal bas byugs pa ste phyag rgya drug dang ldan pa/ mgo bo lnga bcu'i phreng ba'i do shal 'phyang ba/ phyag bcu drug gi g.yas kyi phyag gi thod pa brgyad na/rim pa bzhin tu/ glang po che dkar po/ rta sngon po/ bong bu kham pa/ glang dmar po/ rnga mong thal kar/ mi dmar po/ sha ra bha sngon po/ byi la gwa pa/ g.yon gyi phyag gi thod pa brgyad na/ sa'i lha mo ser mo/ chu'i lha mo dkar mo/ rlung gi lha mo dud kha/ me'i lha mo dmar mo/ zla ba'i lha mo dkar mo/ nyi ma'i lha mo dmar mo/ gshin rje nag po/nor bdag ser po/ snying gar thal mo sbyar ba rnams bsnams pa'i phyag dang po gnyis kyis yum la 'khyud pa/ gcer bu zhabs

༄7/ /skrezhi'i mdun ma gnyis g.yas brkyang ba'i gar dang rgyab ma gnyis skyil krung phyed pa'i stabs kyis nyi ma'i dkyil 'bor la bdud bzhi mnyam par mnan cing / gar gyi nyams dgu dang ldan pa/ 'jigs pa'ang 'jigs par mdzad pa'o/ /yum bdag med ma sku mdog nag mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum mnga' ba/ mche ba gtsigs pa/ dbu skra ser po gyen tu brdzes pa/ phyag g.yas gri gug /g.yon thod pa bsnams pas yab la 'khyud pa/ gcer bu phyag rgya lnga dang ldan zhing / thod pa skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang / skam po lnga bcu'i phreng bas brgyan pa/ zhabs g.yon brkyang / g.yas bskum pas yab la 'gyud pa/ bcom ldan 'das kyi thugs kar rang 'dra'i ye shes sems dpa'/ de'i thugs kar ting 'dzin sems dpa' rdo rje rtse dgu

pa'i lte bar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su hūṃ sngon po/ yum gyi thugs kar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du e sngon po 'od zer dang bcas pa/ mig tu oṃ dkar mo/ rna bar dwo nag mo/ sna la me ser mo/ lce la rī dmar mo/ dpral bar i ljang gu/ snying ga'i cha stod du a sngon mo/ bsdu na go cha'i yi ge drug bor bas rung /spyi bor oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ snying gar hūm̐ sngon po/ hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs/go rī jaḥ tso rī hūm̐/ bee tā lī baṃ/ ghasma rī hoḥ slar yang hūm̐ gi 'od zer gyis khams gsum na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas thams cad spyan drangs/ mgon po de bzhin gshegs pa kun/ /khyedakyis bdag la dabhang bskur cig /ces gsol ba btab pas/ sangs rgyas de rnams he ru ka'i gzugs su gyur nas bdud

༄༅/ /rtsi lngas gang ba'i bum pas dbang bskur/ sku gang / dri ma dag /chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan par gyur/ /mchod bstod phyag len du mi mdzad kyang spro na 'gal ba med pas/ oṃ sarba saṃ the dha ni āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥkhaṃ ram̐ āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ ni ri ti hūṃ kha āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ badzra purmye ā hūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ badzra dha pe āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ badzra a lo ke āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ badzra ga/ndhe āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ badzra ni wi du āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ badzra shabha āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ dang / oṃ go rī rga āḥhūm̐ bhā hā/ oṃ tso rī rtsa āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ bee tā lī baṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ ghasma rī rghaṃ āḥhūm̐ swāhā/ oṃ pukka sī paṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ sha ba rī shaṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ tsaṇḍa lī rtsa āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ ḍombi ni ḍo āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ ces lha mo brgyad kyis mchod/ khyod ni rnal 'byor ma yi tshogs kyis yongs su bskor/ /khyod ni nyid kyi thugs

kyis khyod dgongs 'grub/ /khyod ni rgyu dang mi rgyu 'khor ba kun sgrub pa/ /snying rje'i thugs kyis sems can byang chub tu/ /kun rdzob sgyu ma byang chub sgrub pa yi//dgyes pa rdo rje dpal gyi he ru ka la bstod/ /mi spro na rgyas gdab grub mtshams 'dir 'jug ste/ snying po/ nye snying / rtsa sngags/ rnams smun re brjod pas/ sku mdog phyag mtshan rgyan cha lugs shin tu gsal bar gyur/ zhes yun ring gsal gdab cing bsgom/ rnam dag dran pa ni phyag len tu rjes su sbyor ro/ /gnyis pa bzlas pa ni/ yum gyi thugs kar zla ba la gnas pa'i a yig gi mthar bzla bya'i sngags phreng rang mdog g.yas bskor du gnas pa las 'od zer dang sngags kyi phreng ba byung / yum gyi zhal nas yab kyi zhal du zhugs/ a ba dhū ti nas mar song / rdo rje nor bu nas yum gyi padmar bab ste thugs kar zhugs/ slar yang yum gyi zhal nas yab kyi zhal du zhugs te thi gu

༄tsho/ /sgro chun lcags sgrog mda'i shugs kyi 'gros kyis 'khor bas phrin las bzhi bsgrub par gyur/ oṃ de wa pi tsu badzra hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes snying pore// oṃ badzra karta ri he badzra ya hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes nye ba'i snying pan// oṃ aṣā na nā ya/ skra gorbha ke sha brtu ne/ tsa tur bi sha ti ne tru ya/ kho ḍa sha bhu dzā ya/kṛṣṭa dzi mū ta ba pu ṣe/ ka pā la mā la a ni kai ṅgā ri ṇi/ ātma ta kru ra tsitta ya/ andhend+ra rdaṣṭi ne/ oṃ mā ra ya mā ra ya/ kā ra ya kā ra ya/ gardza ya gardza ya/ tardza ya tardza ya/ therdzo ṣa ya rberte ṣa ya/ sapta swā ga rā na/ bandha banta/ nā ga aṣṭa kā na/ skṛṇḍa kṛhā/ sha phrin ha hā hi hi hu hū he hai ho ho haṃ haḥphaṭa swā hā/ rtsa ba'i sngags te snying po gtsor bton/ gzhan gnyis kyang ci 'grub bzla/ spro na yum gyi snying po/ skyersha e hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes pa'ang bzla'o/ /gsum pa rdzogs pa'i rim pa ni/ bskyed bzlas kyi zhar byung tsam la/ snying rje'i spyan

ni dmar po ste/ /rdo rje gsum gyis dag pa'i spyan/ /byams pa'i thugs la yan lag gnag /bsdu ba'i dngos po bzhi yis ni/ /zhabs ni rnam pa bzhi zhes brjod/ /zhal brgyad rnam par thar pa brgyad/ /phyag ni stong pa bcu drug nyid/ /gug skyed kyis ni sangs rgyas lnga/ /gdug pa 'dul phyir khro bor byas/ /de thams cad kyang bde stong dbyer med kyi rang bzhin tu rnam par dag pa'o/ /zhes bsgom/ rdzogs rim gtsor byed na/ lte bar gtum mo 'bar ba yis/ /de bzhin btanags pa lnga bsregs shing / /spyan la rbe1gas pa yang bsregs te/ /bsregs pas ri krerdzong can haṃ 'dzag /ces 'khor lo bzhi la brten pa'i 'bar 'dzag bsgom zhing zhu bde'i ngo bo rnam kun mchog ldan gyi stong pa nyid dang zung du lacag pa'i rnal 'byor la bslab bo/ /mthar/ thugs ka'i sa bon gyi 'od kyis brtan g.yo snod bcud thams cad rang nyid la

༄༅/ /bsdu/ rang nyid kyang yum yab la/ yab thugs ka'i ye shes sems dpa' dang ting nge 'dzin sems dpa' la rim gyis 'dus pas/ de nyid kyang zhabs kyu/ khog pa zla tshes thig le nā da'i rnam par snang ba mi dmigs par gyur te/ chos thams cad kyi rang bzhin 'od gsal ba'i de kho na nyid la zhugs par gyur/ zhes mnyam par bzhag/ slar rang nyid las kyi he ru ka zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa'i skur gyur/ spyi bor oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐ gis mtshan par gyur/ zhes mos la snang grags rtog gsum lha sngags bde ba chen por lam du khyer/ gtor ma 'bul ba spro na mngon rtogs ltar 'dir blang / skye zhing skye bar rigs mchog tu//skye zhing khengs med dam tshig ldan/ /dgyes pa rdo rje ston pa dang // brtse ldan bla mar gus gyur cig /skye zhing skye bar gyur pa na/ /lag pa rdo rje dril bu 'brol//

zab mo'i chos ni ston pa dang / /btsun mo'i shu kra len 'gyur shog /kun tu sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /rdo rje 'chang chen go 'phang ldan/ /dge ba 'di yis thob 'gyur zhing / /'gro ba lngas kyang thob par shog /byang chub rdo rjes bsngags pa yi/ /rdzos/sa pa'i byang chub phyir spyod dang / /rdzogs sangs rgyas kyi spyod pa gang / /bdag kyang de nyid rjeXd par 3rdog /ces sogs kyis smon lam gdab cing dge ba bsngo ba'ang bya'o// bskyed rim kun gyi rtsa ba ni/ /dran pa gcig pa'i rnal 'byor te/ /'di la gsal snang thob pa yis/ /dkyil 'khor bsgom na myur 'grub 'gyur/ /byis blo bum pa'i khyon ltar dogs/ /gzhung bzang mkha' dbyings chun par dka'/ /de bas 'di byas dge gang des/ /kun kyang he ru ka 'grub shog /ces pa 'di'ang /sgrub brgyud bstan pa'i shing rta pa chen po mtshungs bral dbon sprul rin po ches bka' stsal gtsug tu mchod de/ rngog ston chen po zhe sdang rdo rjes mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs rdo rje rnam bzhi dang / rje spyan snga'i gsung sor bzhag rang

da༅༅ bzos ma bslad par blo gros mtha' yas kyis dpal spungs dben khrod du bris pa dge legs 'phel// // sarba thā maṅga lo// zhes pa 'di 'ang wa ṇa badzra bisdi'i dpe mdzod khang du par du bsgrubs pa'o// maṅga lo//

༄༅/ /oṃ phyag 'tshal ba'i don/ aṭī na nā ya/ rab bsngags brgyad pa'i zhal can la/ piṅga loddhā ke sha wartu nee/ dmar ser dbu skra gyen brdzes la/ tsa turbirsha ti nee tyā ya/ nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i spyan ldan la/ kho ḍa sha bhu dzā ya/ bcu drug pa'i phyag can la/ kṛṣā dzī tsū ta wa pu ṣe/ char sprin ltar gnag pa'i sku can la/ ka pā la mā lwa ne kā dhwa ri ṇi/ thod phreng du ma 'dzin pa la/ addhā ta bhūr tsitpā ya/ khong nas 'khrugs pa'i thugs can la/ andhentu rdasgyi ṇi/ zla phyed lta bu'i mche gtsigs la/ 'di yan chad mngon rtogs kyi sgo nas bsngags shing phyag 'tshal ba'o/ /'di nas las la bskul ba'i sngags su gsungs/ oṃ mā ra ya mā ra ya/ sod cig sod cig kā ra ya kā ra ya/ mdzod cig mdzod cig gardza ya gardza ya/ sgrogs

shig sgrogs shig tardza ya tardza ya/ sdigs shig sdigs shig 3( ṣa ya rbesto ṣa ya/ skoms shig skoms shig las de rnams gang la bya ba'i yul ni/sapta swa ga rā ṇa/ rgya mtsho bdun rnams/ bandha banta/ chings shig chings shig nā gāṣṭa kā na/ klu brgyad rnams/ kṛhā grohā/ zungs shig zungs shig sha phyin/ dgra bo rnams/ ha hā hi hi hu hū he hai ho ho haṃ haḥ gad mo bcu gnyis 'jig rten du sgrogs shig pa'o//phaṭa gtor ba'am 'gems pa'i don/ swā hā/ gzhi tshugs shig pa'am sdig pa zhi ba'am dge tshogs 'phel ba gsum gang rung la sbyar ro//pho/ oṃ de wa pi tsu badzra lha mi bskyod rdo rje'am lha 'jam pa'i rdo rje zhes mtshan btags nas 'bod pa'o/ /hūm̐ hūm̐ hūṃ sku gsung thugs mi phyed

༄tsho/ /pa/ /phaṭa las la spro zhing dgyes par mdzod cig pa'i don/ swā hā gzhi tshugs shig pa'o//7/ oṃ shrī badzra he ru ka sa ma ya ma nu pā la ya/ rdo rje khrag 'thung dam tshig rjes su skyong / /he ru ka twe no pa tilga khrag 'thung nyid kyis nye bar gnas par mdzod/ /dro rdo me bha wa/ bdag la brtan par mdzad du gsol/ /su to ṣyo me bha wa/ bdag la shin tu dges par mdzod//a nu rakto me bha wa/ bdag la rjes su chags par mdzod/ /su po ṣyo me bha wa/ bdag la shin tu rgyas par mdzod/ /sarba sirnyi mme pra yasmo bdag la dngos grub thams cad stsol/ /sarba karma su tsa me/ las kun la yang bdag gi ni/ /tsitt+waṃ shri yaḥku ru hūm̐/ sems la dge legs su

ni mdzod/ /ha ha ha ha hoḥbha ga wān/ bcom ldan rdo rje khrag 'thung du/ /badzra he ru ka /mā me musma bdag grol khrag 'thung nyid du mdzod//he ru ko bha wa/ /ma hā sa ma ya satwa āḥhūṃ phaṭa/ dam tshig sems dpa' chen po āḥ7/ na maḥs manta buddhā māṃ/ phyag 'tshal lo kun nas sangs rgyas la/ na maḥs manta dharmā ṇḍaṃ/ phyag 'tshal sku1 kun nas chos la/na maḥs manta saṃ ghā nai/ phyag 'tshal lo kun nas dge 'dun la/ oṃ si tā ta pa tre/ gdugs dkar po/ oṃ bi ma la/ dri ma dang bral ba/oṃ shaṅka ra/ bde bar byed pa/ oṃ pra hye gi ra/ phyir bzlog pa/ badzra uṣṭi ṣa tsakra warti/ rdo rje gtsug tor lubor los sgyur ba/

༄༅/ /sarba yant+ra/ thams cad 'khrul 'khor/ mant+ra/ sngags/ mū la karma/ rtsa ba'i las/ bandha n-i/ bcings pa dang /tā ḍa n-i/ brdeg pa dang / gī la nai wā/ phur bus btab kyang rung / ma ma kṛ te/ bdag la byed pa dang / ye na ken tsi ta/ gang ci yang rung ba/ kṛ tanta ta/ byed pa de/ sarpāntu/ thams cad/ ñtsinda ñtsinda/ chod chod/ bhinda bhinda/ phug phugatsi ri tsi ri/ phye mar gyis phye mar gyis/ gi ri gi ri gnon gnon/ ma ra ma ra/ sod sod/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ phaṭa phaṭa 24sheg:/

7/ oṃ mgo 'dren/ rakṣa rakṣa srungs shig srungs shig hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ bdag dang gnas dang rnal 'byor byin gyis rlob byed/phaṭa swā hā bar gcod bgegs srungs shig pa'o//7/ oṃ nges pa kho na/ int+ra dbang po/ dza ma gshin rje/ dza la chu lha/ dzakṣa gnod sbyin/ dhwa ta 'byung po/banni me lha/ bā u rlung lha/ rakṣa srin po/ tsanda zla ba/ mūdzdza nyi ma/ mā da sa'i lha mo/ beeskra tshangs pa/ta la sa steng / pā tā la sa 'og aṣṭha brgyad/ saspa sprul te klu chen po brgyad do/ /swā hā lhan cig pa'am zhi bar byed pa'i

༄༅/ /don no/ /de ltar mgron gyi ming khad nas gtor ma 'bul ba'i sngags ni/ i rda 'di/ ba li gtor ma/ bhuñdza gsol cigadzi gha dri snoms shig phulla me tog dhuspa bdug spos/ māṃ sa sha/ skra gha nya sha'am chang dang bcas pa'o phrin las bcol ba ni/ ambha bdag gi/ saspa thams cad/ kadzdza bya ba/ sa dhā sgrubs shig khānti bzod pa/ khu ṇi garbestol ba/ phe ḍa gā da gnod 'tshe sol cig pa'o// de'i rjes su 'bor gsum mi rtog pa'i chos kyi sbyin pa ni/ oṃ nges pa kho na/ a kā ro/ ma byas pa'o//mu khaṃ sgo/ sarba dharma khaṃ chos thams cad/ a du gnyis su med pa'o/ /a nutpan skye ba med pa/ na tā ta de kho na nyid/

oṃ āḥhūṃ sku gsung thugs kyi ngo bo byin gyis rlob byed yin/ phaṭa sreg cing gtor ba ste 'dir rnam rtog gcod pa'i don/ swā hā las () gzhi tshugs 3)ga /gtor sngags 'di la 1 mgron gyi ming / 2 gtor 'bul/ 3 phrin bcol/ 4 bzod gsol/ 5 chos sbyin te don tshan lnga tshang bar gsungs so// zhes pa 'di 'ang wā ṇa badzra bidu'i dpe mdzod khang du par du bsgrubs pa'o// maṅga lo// //

༄༅/ /dgyes rdor yab bka' dang yum bka'i mchod rol zin bris su bkod pa ni/ gsham gsal mchod rol 'di bzhin phyi lo 2005 'o ra badzra bisdi'i gtsug lag khang du yum bka' bdag med ma'i sgrub mchod thog mar dbu btsugs pa'i skabs su bdag cag yongs kyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen chen po 7mkhan chen khra 'gu rin po che mchog nas dgyes rdor yab bka' dang yum bka' la mchod rol zhig dgos tshul bskul ma phul ba bzhin/ sgrub brgyud bstan pa'i gtsug nor 7dpal 7rgyal ba'i dbang po bcu bdun pa chen po o rgyan 'gro 'dul phrin las rdo rje mchog nas badzra bibyā'i gtsug lag khang gi gzims spyil kun bzang yang rtser dgong mo'i dus zhig la phyag gnyis sil snyan thugs kar 'dzin zhing thugs ting nge 'dzin la cung zad mnyam par bzhag pa'i mthar mchod sil 'di lta bu bya rung zhes ḍā ru bcad mtshams dang

bcas pa bka' slob zab mo dang 'brel gsar brtsams gnang zhing / phyi nyin ji ltar gsol ba 'debs pa bzhin tshogs kyi rdo rje slob dpon du chibs bsgyur dang bcas mchod rol 'di nyid kyi phyag bzhes thog mar dbu btsugs pa sogs byin rlabs kyi mtshan ka khyad par du 'phags pa zhig yin/ mchod rol 'di nyid ma 'ongs par gsar bslad dang brjed nges sogs mi byung ba'i ched du brdung tshul ḍār bcad dang bcas pa zin bris su bkod pa ni/ thog mar rgyud sde spyi sgros ltar mchod rol 'ur phab nas thang thang du sil/ pad kor gcig bya nas slar thang thang du sil nas pad kor gnyis pa bya mthar 'ur gcig phab/ de nas sil snyan kha phyir bsgyur dang bcas pa'i mchod sil 'ur bsdus shugs drag can thengs gnyis phab/ de nas sil snyan kha phyir bsgyur med pa mchod sil 'ur bsdus zhi dal can lan gnyis bya/ slar pad

༄7/ /kor byas nas 'ur bsdus gnyis phab pas grub pa'o/ /skabs der ḍā ru bcad mtshams kyi rim pa ni/ thog mar spyi sgros ltar ḍār bcad gcig bya nas bskrogs/ pad kor gnyis pa'i mjug gi 'ur gyi mthar ḍār bcad gcig 'ur bsdus shugs drag can gnyis la ḍār bcad re re/ 'ur bsdus chung ngu gnyis la ḍār bcad re re/ mtha' ma'i 'ur bsdus gnyis la ḍār bcad re re bcas khyon bsdoms ḍā ru bcad mtshams brgyad bya dgos so// zhar byung du cho ga so sor mchod rol gang yin bde blag tu nges pa'i phyir/ mchod rol rnams kyi rtags kyi mtshan ma bris tshul gyi rim pa ni/ te/ dgyes rdor yab bka' dang yum bka'i mchod rol la/nye:tho ke phag mo'i mchod rol la/ duskyipyi spu bde mchog gi mchod rol la/ lhozhu 4) rgyal rgyam mchod rol la/ 〉tshu ke byin 'bebs mchod rol la/ 49

tu/ bsangs chog gi mchod rol la/ () 7/ bzhi rol la/ sgro〉 she gter gsar mchod rol la/ 〉〈 bcas bris srol yod pa bzhin rgan kame bsam 'grub nas bsam 'char dang rtags de rnams 'tshol bsgrubs gnang ba la bka' drin che zhu bcas/ gus shes rab phun tshogs nas/ phyi lo 2007 zla 1 tshes 25 nyin/
